Furthermore, short-circuit current density improved by 9.8% and 23.1%, respectively. These findings are consistent with existing studies in the field and support the validity of the approach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要提及“Samples were created”“Laboratory results revealed”等实验操作与实测数据。；研究对象：钙钛矿太阳能电池，具体为将导电聚合物聚苯胺（polyaniline）掺入电池各传输层（尤其是空穴传输层）中的器件体系，并以氧化石墨烯（GO）和还原氧化石墨烯（rGO）作为对比材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将聚苯胺掺入钙钛矿太阳能电池的传输层可提升器件稳定性与性能；以还原氧化石墨烯替代标准聚苯胺构型时，功率转换效率提高36.8%，短路电流密度提高23.1%，优于氧化石墨烯（分别提高17.5%和9.8%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将聚苯胺掺入钙钛矿太阳能电池的传输层可提升器件稳定性与性能；以还原氧化石墨烯替代标准聚苯胺构型时，功率转换效率提高36.8%，短路电流密度提高23.1%，优于氧化石墨烯（分别提高17.5%和9.8%）。；创新点：系统比较了聚苯胺的两种氧化掺杂类型及其在空穴传输层中的集成效果，并以GO和rGO作为对比模型，定量验证了导电聚合物替代方案对效率提升的有效性。（摘要未突出说明更微观的机理创新）
papers.method_zh: 实验制备不同传输层构型的钙钛矿太阳能电池样品（含聚苯胺、GO、rGO），通过掺杂氧化方式调控聚苯胺，并测量器件的功率转换效率与短路电流密度等光伏参数进行对比评估。

papers.title: Multi-Species Multi-Reaction Model Parametrization of a Commercial NCA Positive Electrode from Half-Cell Open-Circuit Potential Data
papers.abstract: Physics-based models of lithium-ion batteries require the open-circuit potential (OCP) of each electrode as a function of its lithiation. The multi-species multi-reaction (MSMR) model provides a compact, thermodynamically grounded description of this relationship, representing each insertion reaction by a standard potential, a site fraction and a disorder parameter. Here, we parametrize the MSMR model for nickel-cobalt-aluminum oxide (NCA), a cathode chemistry widespread in automotive cells, using the positive electrode of a commercial silicon-graphite/NCA cell. Cathode material was harvested from a pristine cell and from cells cycle-aged to the end of life under two state-of-charge windows, and its half-cell OCP was measured by slow galvanostatic cycling. Smooth differential-capacity curves were obtained by histogram counting, and the charge and discharge branches were fitted with a constrained, scale-invariant optimization that keeps every reaction anchored to a visible peak. We report the first MSMR parameter set for an NCA cathode and show, through a differential-capacity peak analysis across aging states, that its thermodynamic signature is essentially unchanged by aging. This finding supports the common modeling practice of holding the electrode's intrinsic parameters fixed and ascribing aging to electrode-level capacity and alignment changes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“harvested from a pristine cell”、“half-cell OCP was measured by slow galvanostatic cycling”等实验操作与测量手段。；研究对象：商用锂离子电池中的镍钴铝氧化物（NCA）正极材料，具体研究其嵌锂/脱锂过程中的开路电位（OCP）与多物种多反应（MSMR）模型参数化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次给出了NCA正极的MSMR模型参数集，并发现该电极的热力学特征（差分容量峰结构）在循环老化至寿命终点后基本不变，支持将老化归因于电极容量与对齐变化而非内在热力学参数变化的建模惯例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次给出了NCA正极的MSMR模型参数集，并发现该电极的热力学特征（差分容量峰结构）在循环老化至寿命终点后基本不变，支持将老化归因于电极容量与对齐变化而非内在热力学参数变化的建模惯例。；创新点：首次报道NCA正极的MSMR参数集，并利用跨老化状态的差分容量峰分析证明其热力学特征在老化后基本不变。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 从原始及两种SOC窗口下循环老化至寿命终点的商用硅-石墨/NCA电池中提取正极材料，通过慢速恒流循环测量半电池OCP；采用直方图计数获得平滑的差分容量曲线；使用约束的、尺度不变的优化方法对充放电分支进行拟合，使每个反应锚定到可见峰。

papers.title: Exact topology of conservative multiplicative cascades: An ultrametric transfer-operator genus
papers.abstract: The multiplicative cascade is a well-known method for generating random fields that are both genuinely non-Gaussian and scale invariant. Its one-point and scaling statistics, namely the multifractal spectra $τ(q)$, $D_q$, and $f(α)$, are known exactly; however, its geometric and topological measures are not. In this work, we show that the topological structures of a conservative (microcanonical) random permutation cascade can be precisely predicted. We compute the digital (cubical) Euler characteristic, or genus, of the level-$j$ excursion set of the two-dimensional cascade in closed form, using a transfer operator on the cascade's $b$-ary tree closed by its ultrametric structure and a conservative without-replacement sibling split. The result requires no Monte Carlo and matches simulated realizations with a maximum residual of $\sim\!10^{-4}$ in the Euler density, a controlled discretization artifact of the atomic measure. We tie the genus scaling analytically to the multifractal spectrum, and show that for a geometric ladder of weights the genus is exactly self-similar under the multifractal-width dial. The construction uses the tree-sum cumulant machinery of Greiner et al. (Phys. Rev. E 58, 554, 1998), specialized to topological functionals; the conservative split carries the microcanonical fingerprint $\mathrm{Cov}(\ln w_a,\ln w_b)/\mathrm{Var}(\ln w)=-1/(n-1)$ that distinguishes it from canonical and lognormal cascades. The cascade is the multiplicative counterpart of the Rayleigh--Lévy flight and a controlled benchmark for the morphology of strongly non-Gaussian fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：closed form、transfer operator、无需Monte Carlo、解析推导。；研究对象：保守（微正则）随机置换乘性级联生成的二维随机场，重点是其水平集（excursion set）的拓扑结构（数字欧拉示性数/亏格）及其与多重分形谱的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该级联在任意层级j的二维水平集的数字欧拉示性数（亏格）可精确闭式预测，其标度行为与多重分形谱解析关联；在几何权重阶梯下，亏格在多重分形宽度调节下严格自相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该级联在任意层级j的二维水平集的数字欧拉示性数（亏格）可精确闭式预测，其标度行为与多重分形谱解析关联；在几何权重阶梯下，亏格在多重分形宽度调节下严格自相似。；创新点：首次精确计算保守乘性级联的拓扑测度（亏格），而非仅其一阶和标度统计；将拓扑标度与多重分形谱解析联系；通过保守分裂的微正则指纹Cov(ln w_a, ln w_b)/Var(ln w) = -1/(n-1)区分于正则和对数正态级联。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 利用b叉树上的传递算子（transfer operator），结合级联的ultrametric结构和无放回保守分裂；采用Greiner等人（Phys. Rev. E 58, 554, 1998）的树和累积量（tree-sum cumulant）机制，专门化到拓扑泛函。数值验证通过模拟实现，最大残差约10⁻⁴（欧拉密度），该残差被归因于原子测度的离散化伪影。

papers.title: Fast generation of spectrally-shaped disorder, on the sphere
papers.abstract: The design of disordered point patterns with desirable properties is an exciting and ongoing research endeavor, with applications ranging from materials to computer science. A successful approach in recent years has been the optimization of point patterns through a loss function that enforces properties in their Fourier-space representation. Yet, these methods have so far strictly been limited to flat Euclidean space, precluding their use in the contexts of coatings of curved surfaces for photonics, or of sampling of curved manifolds for instance. We introduce FaSHIoNPOp, an algorithm that relies on fast non-uniform spherical harmonics transforms, to enforce pair correlations in point patterns on the sphere with an $O(N \log N)$ complexity in $N$ the number of points. Having demonstrated its performance, we showcase applications of FaSHIoNPOp, ranging from the generation of hyperuniform structures on the sphere for sampling and physical applications, to the design of gyromorphs (disordered structures with maximal scattering power at a given frequency) on the sphere. We additionally show that FaSHIoNPOp can be combined to both global constraints like centrosymmetry, with applications to the design of more isotropic $3d$ gyromorphs, and local real-space constraints like pair repulsion. Our work paves the way for optimal sampling and coating design on curved manifolds, with many applications across physics, materials and computer science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“algorithm”“optimization”“fast non-uniform spherical harmonics transforms”“O(N log N) complexity”等关键词，核心贡献是提出一种数值算法。；研究对象：球面上的无序点图案（disordered point patterns），具体包括超均匀结构（hyperuniform structures）和陀螺形貌（gyromorphs，即在特定频率具有最大散射功率的无序结构），以及三维陀螺形貌的各向同性设计。物理背景涉及曲面光子学涂层和流形采样。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了名为FaSHIoNPOp的算法，可在球面上以O(N log N)复杂度快速生成具有指定傅里叶空间（谱）性质的无序点图案，并成功应用于生成球面超均匀结构和球面陀螺形貌，且可与全局约束（如中心对称）和局域实空间约束（如对排斥）结合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了名为FaSHIoNPOp的算法，可在球面上以O(N log N)复杂度快速生成具有指定傅里叶空间（谱）性质的无序点图案，并成功应用于生成球面超均匀结构和球面陀螺形貌，且可与全局约束（如中心对称）和局域实空间约束（如对排斥）结合。；创新点：首次将基于傅里叶空间损失函数优化的无序点图案设计方法从平面欧几里得空间推广到球面（弯曲流形），突破了此前方法仅限于平坦空间的限制，并展示了与全局/局域约束的兼容性。
papers.method_zh: 基于快速非均匀球谐变换（fast non-uniform spherical harmonics transforms）的迭代优化算法，通过损失函数在傅里叶空间（球谐系数空间）强制目标对关联函数（pair correlations），复杂度为O(N log N)。未使用实验手段。

papers.title: Accidental accuracy and vertex corrections in $GW$: Exact benchmarks for the extended Hubbard model
papers.abstract: The $GW$ approximation is the standard tool for quasiparticle predictions in materials, yet its regime of validity in correlated systems remains poorly quantified, because \textit{ab initio} vertex corrections are computationally prohibitive. Using exact diagonalization of the half-filled extended Hubbard model on finite rings as a numerically exact reference, we construct the corresponding model-space $GW$ theory on the identical Hilbert space and quantify its error as a function of local ($U$) and non-local ($V$) interaction strength. We find that the vertex correction changes character across the phase diagram: in the weak-coupling regime the effective vertex $Γ_{\rm eff} < 1$, reflecting the suppression of RPA charge fluctuations by exact short-range correlations, whereas in the Mott regime $Γ_{\rm eff}$ grows monotonically (to $\sim 3$ for $N=6$, reflecting the local vertex required to open the Hubbard gap. Vertex corrections in the electron-hole (polarizability) channel are shown to \emph{worsen} the gap error, indicating that the Mott gap resides in the self-energy channel. For $V=0$, static $COHSEX$ is accidentally exact at a single crossover point $U^* \approx 3.5\,t$; finite $V$, through non-local Fock exchange, splits this point into a double-crossover window that collapses toward weak coupling. These results yield quantitative diagnostics for the reliability of $GW$ in correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“exact diagonalization”（精确对角化）作为数值参考，并构建“model-space $GW$ theory”进行理论对比，属于强关联电子体系的第一性原理/模型计算方法研究。；研究对象：半填充的扩展Hubbard模型（extended Hubbard model）在有限环（finite rings）上的基态和准粒子性质，重点考察局域相互作用 $U$ 与非局域相互作用 $V$ 对 $GW$ 近似误差的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: $GW$ 近似的顶点修正（vertex correction）在相图中发生定性变化：弱耦合区有效顶点 $\Gamma_{\rm eff}<1$（抑制RPA电荷涨落），而Mott区 $\Gamma_{\rm eff}$ 单调增大至约3（用于打开Hubbard能隙）；且电子-空穴（极化率）通道的顶点修正会恶化能隙误差，表明Mott能隙主要来自自能通道。此外，静态COHSEX在 $V=0$ 时于 $U^*\approx 3.5t$ 处偶然精确，有限 $V$ 通过非局域Fock交换将该点分裂为双交叉窗口并向弱耦合移动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：$GW$ 近似的顶点修正（vertex correction）在相图中发生定性变化：弱耦合区有效顶点 $\Gamma_{\rm eff}<1$（抑制RPA电荷涨落），而Mott区 $\Gamma_{\rm eff}$ 单调增大至约3（用于打开Hubbard能隙）；且电子-空穴（极化率）通道的顶点修正会恶化能隙误差，表明Mott能隙主要来自自能通道。此外，静态COHSEX在 $V=0$ 时于 $U^*\approx 3.5t$ 处偶然精确，有限 $V$ 通过非局域Fock交换将该点分裂为双交叉窗口并向弱耦合移动。；创新点：首次在相同希尔伯特空间内，以精确对角化为基准，定量刻画 $GW$ 近似在关联体系中的误差随 $U$、$V$ 的演化，并揭示顶点修正在不同通道（极化率 vs 自能）中的相反作用，以及COHSEX“偶然精确”的交叉点结构。
papers.method_zh: 以半填充扩展Hubbard模型在有限环上的精确对角化（exact diagonalization）作为数值精确参考，在相同希尔伯特空间内构建模型空间 $GW$ 理论，系统比较局域 $U$ 和非局域 $V$ 变化下的误差；并分析静态COHSEX近似与顶点修正（有效顶点 $\Gamma_{\rm eff}$）的行为。

papers.title: Predicting THz Generation Capability of Organic Crystals through Data Mining and Crystal Nonlinearity Models
papers.abstract: We report the use of DFT computation and mathematical models to predict the nonlinear dielectric polarization (P^{NL}) and nonlinear susceptibility coefficients (χ^{(2)}_{IJK}) of organic materials based on their crystal structures. We apply this computation approach on single-component crystals, co-crystals and ionic crystals found through data mining the Cambridge Structural Database. We verify these computational results with experimental terahertz (THz) generation efficiencies for known THz generators, demonstrating consistency between the measurements and the computed values. Several mined structures show similar or larger PNL values compared to state-of-the-art THz generation crystals DAST, OH1 and BNA, suggesting great potential for their use in nonlinear optical (NLO) applications. Importantly, we also compared the resulting model of nonlinear optical tensor components with commonly-used simplifications of nonlinearity, showing that the comprehensive approach should be the standard method to evaluate the nonlinear optical properties of single-crystalline materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：DFT computation、mathematical models、data mining。；研究对象：有机晶体材料，包括单组分晶体、共晶体和离子晶体，用于太赫兹（THz）产生和非线性光学（NLO）应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过DFT计算和数学模型，可以基于晶体结构预测有机材料的非线性介电极化（P^NL）和二阶非线性系数（χ^(2)_IJK），且计算结果与已知THz产生晶体的实验效率一致。部分数据挖掘得到的晶体结构显示出与DAST、OH1和BNA相当或更大的P^NL值，具有潜在的非线性光学应用价值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过DFT计算和数学模型，可以基于晶体结构预测有机材料的非线性介电极化（P^NL）和二阶非线性系数（χ^(2)_IJK），且计算结果与已知THz产生晶体的实验效率一致。部分数据挖掘得到的晶体结构显示出与DAST、OH1和BNA相当或更大的P^NL值，具有潜在的非线性光学应用价值。；创新点：将数据挖掘与DFT计算相结合，对多种有机晶体类型（单组分、共晶、离子晶体）进行系统性的非线性光学性能预测，并指出完整张量模型应作为评估单晶非线性光学性质的标准方法，而非使用常用简化近似。
papers.method_zh: 采用DFT计算结合数学模型预测非线性介电极化和非线性系数；通过数据挖掘剑桥结构数据库（CSD）获取晶体结构；将计算结果与实验THz产生效率进行对比验证；并比较了完整非线性光学张量模型与常用简化模型的差异。

papers.title: AlV$_2$O$_4$ thin films via in-situ interfacial topotaxy
papers.abstract: Conventional oxide epitaxy approaches face challenges when the oxidation conditions of constituent elements differ significantly. Here we demonstrate that V--O thin films can serve as solid-phase precursors for epitaxial AlV$_2$O$_4$, comprising a pyrochlore V$^{2.5+}$ network coexisting with AlO$_4$ tetrahedra within the spinel structure. The epitaxial AlV$_2$O$_4$/Al$_2$O$_3$ (0001) heterostructures are realized via interfacial topotactic transformation, involving V--O growth at a moderate temperature followed by in-situ ultra-high-temperature post-annealing to drive a reaction with the Al$_2$O$_3$ substrate. Transmission electron microscopy and temperature-dependent X-ray diffraction analyses reveal excellent structural characteristics that closely reproduce the known charge-ordering transition. This study presents a novel approach to realizing epitaxial structures with convoluted oxidation states where thermodynamic and kinetic barriers would otherwise limit synthesizability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到薄膜生长、退火、透射电子显微镜、X射线衍射等实验手段。；研究对象：AlV₂O₄薄膜，具体为尖晶石结构中含有烧绿石V².⁵⁺网络与AlO₄四面体共存的体系，以及其与Al₂O₃(0001)衬底构成的异质结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过界面拓扑反应，以V–O薄膜为固相前驱体，成功在Al₂O₃衬底上外延生长出AlV₂O₄薄膜，且该薄膜具有优异的结构质量，并复现了已知的电荷有序相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过界面拓扑反应，以V–O薄膜为固相前驱体，成功在Al₂O₃衬底上外延生长出AlV₂O₄薄膜，且该薄膜具有优异的结构质量，并复现了已知的电荷有序相变。；创新点：提出了一种利用固相前驱体与衬底反应实现外延生长的新策略，解决了传统氧化物外延中因组成元素氧化条件差异过大而难以合成具有复杂氧化态结构的问题。
papers.method_zh: 采用两步法：先在中等温度下生长V–O薄膜，再进行原位超高温后退火以驱动与Al₂O₃衬底的界面拓扑反应。表征手段包括透射电子显微镜（TEM）和变温X射线衍射（XRD）。

papers.title: Roton Instability in Quantum Droplets with Finite-Range Soft-Core Interaction
papers.abstract: We investigate the emergence of roton instability in self-bound quantum droplets interacting via a finite-range soft-core potential modeled by a Heaviside step interaction. The ground-state properties are obtained by solving the extended Gross-Pitaevskii equation including Lee-Huang-Yang corrections with a nonlocal interaction term. The collective excitation spectrum reveals the formation and progressive softening of a roton minimum as the interaction strength and range increase. When the roton energy approaches zero, the system becomes unstable, signaling the onset of density modulation. The rotonic behavior is further characterized through the static structure factor, which exhibits pronounced peaks at the roton momentum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“求解扩展Gross-Pitaevskii方程”（theoretical framework）以及“集体激发谱”和“静态结构因子”的计算（computational characterization）。；研究对象：具有有限程软芯相互作用（Heaviside阶跃势）的自束缚量子液滴，具体关注其集体激发谱中的旋子（roton）不稳定性及由此引发的密度调制现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着相互作用强度和范围的增大，量子液滴的集体激发谱中出现并逐渐软化的旋子极小值；当旋子能量趋近于零时，系统失稳，标志着密度调制（周期性结构）的开始。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着相互作用强度和范围的增大，量子液滴的集体激发谱中出现并逐渐软化的旋子极小值；当旋子能量趋近于零时，系统失稳，标志着密度调制（周期性结构）的开始。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于将有限程软芯势（Heaviside阶跃相互作用）引入自束缚量子液滴体系，并系统展示了旋子不稳定性随相互作用参数演化的完整图景（摘要中未明确对比已有工作，故此处保守表述）。
papers.method_zh: 求解包含Lee-Huang-Yang（LHY）修正和非局域相互作用项的扩展Gross-Pitaevskii方程，得到基态性质；通过计算集体激发谱和静态结构因子来表征旋子行为。

papers.title: Kinetic Turnover in the Early-Stage Nucleation of Multi-Shell Condensed Clusters
papers.abstract: Nucleation is a key rate-limiting process in phase transition and phase separation. Recent studies highlight a significant discrepancy between experimentally measured nucleation rates and theoretical predictions, particularly when dynamic structural reordering occurs along multi-step pathways. To bridge this gap, we develop a multi-shell model with a space-time-dependent order-parameter field to describe the reordering-nucleation process, where structural reorganization couples with the early growth of condensed clusters. Through stochastic simulations, we track the time-resolved evolution of heterogeneous structural order inside growing clusters. Path analysis of the first-passage problem in early-stage nucleation demonstrates that shifting the reordering rate alters the nucleation rate by several orders of magnitude. Furthermore, as the coupling strength increases, the relationship between the mean first-passage time and reordering susceptibility shifts from monotonic to non-monotonic, exhibiting a turnover effect. We quantitatively rationalize these behaviors with an effective nucleation barrier that accounts for non-equilibrium properties. Our findings elucidate the mechanisms behind multi-step nucleation and offer a predictive framework for future studies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a multi-shell model”“stochastic simulations”“path analysis”，属于理论建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：多壳层凝聚团簇在早期成核阶段的结构重排-成核耦合过程，具体涉及多步成核路径中动态结构有序化与团簇生长的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结构重排速率的变化可使成核速率改变数个数量级；当重排与生长的耦合强度增大时，平均首通时间与重排敏感性之间的关系从单调变为非单调，出现“翻转效应”（turnover effect）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结构重排速率的变化可使成核速率改变数个数量级；当重排与生长的耦合强度增大时，平均首通时间与重排敏感性之间的关系从单调变为非单调，出现“翻转效应”（turnover effect）。；创新点：提出了一个能统一描述多步成核中结构重排与团簇早期生长耦合的理论框架，并揭示了耦合强度导致的成核速率非单调翻转效应，为多步成核机制提供了预测性模型。（摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比验证。）
papers.method_zh: 构建了具有空间-时间依赖序参量场的多壳层模型，用于描述结构重排与成核的耦合；采用随机模拟追踪生长团簇内部异质结构序的时间分辨演化；通过首通问题的路径分析研究早期成核动力学；并用考虑非平衡特性的有效成核势垒对结果进行定量解释。

papers.title: Beyond capillary condensation: Shear-induced bridging transitions in patterned slits
papers.abstract: We study the equilibrium phase behavior of a fluid confined in a slit made from two patterned walls. Shearing the walls frustrates the fluid, due to a competition between capillary condensation and interface delocalization, forcing the formation of bridging phases with different pinning properties. This leads to an unusually rich phase diagram, displaying first-order and continuous phase transitions, depending sensitively on the slit width and shear. Generalized Kelvin equations determine the phase boundaries, while the bridging phases are characterized by large correlation lengths, predictions for which are tested using a microscopic density functional model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“equilibrium phase behavior”“Generalized Kelvin equations”“microscopic density functional model”等理论建模与数值求解关键词。；研究对象：受限在由两个图案化壁面构成的狭缝中的流体，重点研究剪切作用下毛细凝聚与界面去局域化竞争所诱导的桥接相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 剪切壁面会迫使流体形成具有不同钉扎性质的桥接相，产生异常丰富的相图，其中包含一级相变和连续相变，且相边界可由广义开尔文方程描述；桥接相具有大关联长度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：剪切壁面会迫使流体形成具有不同钉扎性质的桥接相，产生异常丰富的相图，其中包含一级相变和连续相变，且相边界可由广义开尔文方程描述；桥接相具有大关联长度。；创新点：揭示了剪切诱导的桥接转变这一超越传统毛细凝聚的新机制，并系统展示了狭缝宽度与剪切强度对相图拓扑的敏感调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与微观密度泛函理论（classical density functional theory, DFT）数值计算，用于检验桥接相关联长度的理论预测；采用广义开尔文方程推导相边界。

papers.title: Multiscale Modelling of Ferroelectrics using a Physics-Informed Neural Network Driven by Molecular Dynamics Data: Parameter Identification and Field Reconstruction
papers.abstract: In multiscale modeling of ferroelectrics, combining atomistic simulation with continuum-scale phase-field models (PFM) remains a fundamental challenge. A key difficulty lies in faithfully capturing discrete atomic-level information within a continuum modeling framework, while accurately representing material behavior at the mesoscale. In this paper, a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) driven by molecular dynamics (MD) data is used. The loss function of the network consists of a supervised term that fits the discrete spatial polarization distributions obtained from MD simulations of systems containing domain walls, and a physics-based term that incorporates the residuals of partial differential equations (PDEs) of steady-state PFM. To ensure stable and balanced training among the different loss components, adaptive gradient normalization (GradNorm) is used to dynamically adjust the task weights. By minimizing the total loss, the model not only reconstructs the polarization field along with the associated strain, stress, and energy landscape at the continuum scale, but also identifies critical physical parameters of the phase-field model, including the characteristic energy density, characteristic length factor, gradient energy anisotropy factor, and Landau polynomial coefficients. By using the PINN-predicted physical parameters in COMSOL Multiphysics to solve the corresponding PDEs within a finite element framework, we demonstrate that these parameters enable accurate reproduction of the ferroelectric domain structure and the associated material response, including stress/strain distributions and energy landscape. This framework provides an effective methodology for establishing multiscale connections between atomistic and continuum descriptions, and holds the potential to infer underlying physical properties directly from polarization distributions for a wide range of materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN)”“molecular dynamics (MD) data”“phase-field models (PFM)”“finite element framework”等计算与建模关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：铁电材料的多尺度建模，具体为含畴壁（domain walls）的铁电体系，关注其极化场、应变、应力及能量景观的连续介质描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过MD数据驱动的PINN，能够同时重构连续尺度的极化场及相关力学/能量分布，并识别出相场模型的关键物理参数（特征能量密度、特征长度因子、梯度能各向异性因子、Landau多项式系数）；这些参数在COMSOL有限元求解中可准确复现铁电畴结构和材料响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过MD数据驱动的PINN，能够同时重构连续尺度的极化场及相关力学/能量分布，并识别出相场模型的关键物理参数（特征能量密度、特征长度因子、梯度能各向异性因子、Landau多项式系数）；这些参数在COMSOL有限元求解中可准确复现铁电畴结构和材料响应。；创新点：提出了一种将原子尺度MD信息与连续尺度PFM直接连接的多尺度框架，且无需额外实验标定即可从极化分布中推断相场模型的物理参数；摘要未突出说明与传统参数拟合方法相比的具体优势细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用物理信息神经网络（PINN），其损失函数包含两项：监督项（拟合MD模拟得到的离散空间极化分布）和物理项（稳态PFM偏微分方程残差）；使用自适应梯度归一化（GradNorm）动态调整各损失项权重；最终用COMSOL Multiphysics在有限元框架下验证预测参数。

papers.title: Enhanced Superconductivity in Multilayer FeSe Films by Simplified Molecular Beam Epitaxy
papers.abstract: Multi-unit-cell (UC) \b{eta}-FeSe films grown on SrTiO3(100) continue to attract attention because of the significant enhancement in the superconducting transition temperature (Tc) compared to that in bulk FeSe. In prior reports of molecular beam epitaxy (MBE)-grown \b{eta}-FeSe/SrTiO3(100), elaborate growth protocols have been used to achieve enhanced Tc, leading to a general belief that careful pre-treatment of the SrTiO3 substrate and post-growth annealing in ultrahigh vacuum (UHV) are essential. Here, we report a greatly simplified protocol for the MBE growth of superconducting multi-UC \b{eta}-FeSe films on SrTiO3(100), eliminating the need for careful substrate pre-treatment and post-growth UHV annealing while still achieving an enhanced Tc. With appropriate capping, epitaxial films with 14 UC thickness exhibit a zero-resistance transition temperature Tc ~ 20 K in ex situ electrical transport measurements. The MBE optimization process is guided by the growth-parameter dependencies of film morphology and structural properties, as characterized by reflection high-energy electron diffraction, X-ray diffraction, atomic force microscopy, and scanning transmission electron microscopy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了分子束外延（MBE）生长、输运测量及多种表征手段（RHEED、XRD、AFM、STEM）。；研究对象：多层（多单胞厚度）β-FeSe薄膜，生长在SrTiO3(100)衬底上，关注其超导转变温度增强现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过大幅简化的分子束外延生长方案，无需精细衬底预处理和超高真空后退火，即可在14个单胞厚度的β-FeSe/SrTiO3(100)薄膜中实现零电阻转变温度Tc ≈ 20 K的增强超导电性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过大幅简化的分子束外延生长方案，无需精细衬底预处理和超高真空后退火，即可在14个单胞厚度的β-FeSe/SrTiO3(100)薄膜中实现零电阻转变温度Tc ≈ 20 K的增强超导电性。；创新点：打破了以往认为实现增强Tc必须依赖精细SrTiO3衬底预处理和超高真空后退火的普遍认知，提出了大幅简化的生长协议，同时仍能获得增强的超导电性。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）薄膜生长；反射高能电子衍射（RHEED）、X射线衍射（XRD）、原子力显微镜（AFM）、扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）用于表征薄膜形貌与结构；异位（ex situ）电输运测量确定超导转变温度。

papers.title: Hierarchical Quantum Transport from Coupled Topological Domain-Wall States in SSH Chains
papers.abstract: We investigate the transport properties of Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chains containing multiple topological domain walls and show that their interaction generates a hierarchy of emergent spectral structures. Each domain wall contributes a localized state inside the SSH gap, and the hybridization of these states produces minibands whose signatures are directly reflected in the transmission spectra. By combining domain-wall lattices with different domain-wall separations, we construct effective SSH structures within the miniband subspace. The resulting transmission spectra reproduce the characteristic features of conventional SSH chains, including gap formation, finite-size resonances, and the correspondence between transmission spectra and band structure. The construction can be applied recursively, generating successive generations of effective SSH structures. As a consequence, effective SSH spectra repeatedly emerge within progressively narrower energy intervals, producing a self-similar hierarchy of minibands and spectral gaps. To understand the origin of this hierarchy, we develop an effective renormalized description based on successive decimation. The effective parameters exhibit a hierarchy of interlaced singularities whose number increases at each iteration. These singularities partition the energy axis into progressively finer intervals and provide a natural interpretation of the repeated fragmentation of the spectrum. Our results show that topological domain-wall states can act as emergent degrees of freedom from which multiscale transport channels, effective couplings, and hierarchical spectral structures may be engineered. More generally, the framework introduced here establishes a connection between recursive topological constructions, effective Hamiltonians, and the emergence of self-similar spectra in one-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：investigate transport properties、effective renormalized description、successive decimation（理论建模与数值计算结合）。；研究对象：含多个拓扑畴壁的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链，以及由畴壁态杂化产生的多尺度量子输运与自相似能谱结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 拓扑畴壁态之间的杂化可在SSH带隙内形成微带，通过递归构造可在不断变窄的能量区间内反复产生有效SSH能谱，形成自相似的能谱层级结构；该层级源于重整化描述中逐次增加的交替奇异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：拓扑畴壁态之间的杂化可在SSH带隙内形成微带，通过递归构造可在不断变窄的能量区间内反复产生有效SSH能谱，形成自相似的能谱层级结构；该层级源于重整化描述中逐次增加的交替奇异性。；创新点：提出拓扑畴壁态可作为涌现自由度，通过递归构造在微带子空间中生成多代有效SSH结构，建立递归拓扑构造、有效哈密顿量与一维系统自相似谱之间的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算相结合：基于畴壁态杂化构造有效SSH模型，采用逐次抽稀（decimation）的重整化方案解析能谱层级，并通过透射谱计算验证能带结构与有限尺寸共振特征。

papers.title: Jerky Motion of Active Granular Particles
papers.abstract: Abrupt transitions between rest and motion can render the standard Newtonian description -- based on position, velocity, and acceleration -- incomplete, requiring higher-order derivatives such as the jerk, the third time derivative of position. Here, we show that the interplay between activity and dry friction gives rise to robust jerk-dominated dynamics in self-propelled particles: the particle speed increases quadratically with time under an active force, in contrast to the linear growth expected for conventional Newtonian dynamics. We demonstrate this behavior analytically, numerically, and experimentally using active vibrobots self-propelling on a vertically vibrating plate at low vibration amplitudes, where surface asperities generate dry friction and, thus, give rise to jerky motion when combined with activity. Our results establish dry friction as a simple mechanism for realizing higher-order dynamics in active matter and suggest that jerky dynamics may arise broadly in nonequilibrium systems with frictional contacts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论分析 + 数值模拟 + 实验验证）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“analytically, numerically, and experimentally”。；研究对象：活性颗粒体系中的“急动”（jerk，位置的三阶时间导数）动力学，具体为在垂直振动板上自推进的活性振动机器人（vibrobots），在低振动幅度下由表面粗糙度产生干摩擦。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性与干摩擦的相互作用使自推进颗粒呈现急动主导的动力学：在活性力作用下，颗粒速度随时间呈二次方增长（而非牛顿动力学预期的线性增长），表明标准牛顿描述（位置、速度、加速度）不完整，需引入更高阶导数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性与干摩擦的相互作用使自推进颗粒呈现急动主导的动力学：在活性力作用下，颗粒速度随时间呈二次方增长（而非牛顿动力学预期的线性增长），表明标准牛顿描述（位置、速度、加速度）不完整，需引入更高阶导数。；创新点：确立干摩擦作为一种简单机制，可在活性物质中实现高阶动力学；并指出急动动力学可能广泛存在于具有摩擦接触的非平衡系统中。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析推导（基于活性力与干摩擦的动力学方程）；数值模拟；实验采用垂直振动板上的活性振动机器人，在低振动幅度下运行，利用表面粗糙度产生干摩擦。

papers.title: Visualizing flat-band spatial renormalization in rhombohedral graphene superlattices
papers.abstract: Rhombohedral graphene/hBN moiré superlattices exhibit flat-band-driven emergent phases, including superconductivity and the fractional quantum anomalous Hall effect (FQAHE), yet the microscopic role of the moiré potential remains unclear. Here, using scanning tunneling microscopy, we visualize moiré-modulated spatial renormalization of flat bands in rhombohedral pentalayer and tetralayer graphene/hBN superlattices. We observe spatially hierarchical filling, manifested as periodic energy shifts of the flat bands at the moiré scale, leading to spatial reshaping of correlated states in the interacting regime. Remarkably, this modulation vanishes below a ~10 nm moiré period--the same threshold below which the FQAHE is absent. Theoretical modeling attributes this mechanism to atomic-corrugation-induced charge redistribution. Our work provides real-space visualization of moiré-engineered flat-band reconstruction, resolving a key link between moiré periodic potential and emergent topological order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）进行实空间可视化测量。；研究对象：菱方多层石墨烯（五层和四层）与六方氮化硼（hBN）形成的莫尔超晶格，具体关注其平带在莫尔势作用下的空间重整化行为，以及与之相关的分数量子反常霍尔效应（FQAHE）和超导等关联物态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在菱方石墨烯/hBN莫尔超晶格中，平带在莫尔尺度上发生周期性能量移动，导致空间分层的填充行为，从而在相互作用区间重塑关联态的空间分布；该调制在莫尔周期小于约10 nm时消失，与FQAHE缺失的临界尺度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在菱方石墨烯/hBN莫尔超晶格中，平带在莫尔尺度上发生周期性能量移动，导致空间分层的填充行为，从而在相互作用区间重塑关联态的空间分布；该调制在莫尔周期小于约10 nm时消失，与FQAHE缺失的临界尺度一致。；创新点：首次在实空间直接可视化莫尔工程调控的平带重构，建立了莫尔周期势与涌现拓扑序（FQAHE）之间的关键微观联系。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）实空间成像，结合理论建模（原子级褶皱诱导电荷重分布的机制分析）。

papers.title: Thermal diffuse scattering in TEM: complex absorptive potentials compared to the frozen phonon model
papers.abstract: In transmission electron microscopy, electrons undergo inelastic scattering primarily through phonon excitations, known as thermal diffuse scattering. To capture the inelastic scattering effects on the elastic scattering components, absorptive effects must be included in the modeling of electron propagation, accounting for the gradual depletion of the elastic channel of the electron beam. Several approaches to modeling this absorption exist. In this paper, we compare the widely used complex absorptive potentials method to the more elaborate frozen phonon model, based on correlated atomic motion and on the Einstein model of atomic motion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法对比文章。关键词：compare、modeling、complex absorptive potentials method、frozen phonon model。；研究对象：透射电子显微镜（TEM）中电子束的**热漫散射（thermal diffuse scattering）**，具体关注非弹性散射（声子激发）对弹性散射通道的耗损效应，即吸收效应的建模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文系统比较了两种模拟热漫散射吸收效应的途径——广泛使用的**复数吸收势方法**与更精细的**冻结声子模型**，并考察了基于关联原子运动和基于爱因斯坦模型（独立原子运动）两种原子运动描述下的差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文系统比较了两种模拟热漫散射吸收效应的途径——广泛使用的**复数吸收势方法**与更精细的**冻结声子模型**，并考察了基于关联原子运动和基于爱因斯坦模型（独立原子运动）两种原子运动描述下的差异。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其创新在于对两种主流吸收建模方法（复数势 vs. 冻结声子）在热漫散射描述上的系统对比，并明确区分了关联运动与爱因斯坦模型对结果的影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值对比。具体包括：复数吸收势方法（complex absorptive potentials）与冻结声子模型（frozen phonon model），后者分别采用**关联原子运动**（correlated atomic motion）和**爱因斯坦模型**（Einstein model）两种原子振动处理方式。

papers.title: Exciton fine structure in nanocrystals: effect of cuboidal and spheroidal shapes
papers.abstract: We present the theory of the band-edge exciton fine structure in nanocrystals (NCs) with spheroidal and cuboidal shapes. The effects of the cubic symmetry of the crystal lattice, the cubic shape of the NC, and NC uniaxial anisotropy on the hole energy states and electron-hole exchange interactions are considered non-perturbatively. Symmetry analysis yields an effective Hamiltonian for the exciton fine structure, parameterized by one constant for hole energy splitting and five independent constants for exchange interaction. Numerical calculations reveal that in uniaxially anisotropic zinc-blende NCs, the sign of the hole ground state splitting depends on the material parameters and on the orientation of the anisotropy axis relative to the crystallographic axes. Beyond the conventional bulk cubically-symmetric contribution to the exchange interaction, which originates from Bloch-function symmetry and is typically negligible, in nanocrystals, we identify the contribution arising from the cubic symmetry of the envelope wavefunction. This cubically symmetric envelope-induced short-range exchange is non-negligible in cuboidal NCs and induces a pronounced splitting of the dark exciton states. We further analyze the influence of uniaxial anisotropy of the exchange constants on both the exciton fine structure and the oscillator strength. Special attention is paid to NCs, where the anisotropy of the exchange constants is comparable to a relatively small hole energy anisotropic splitting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We present the theory”“Symmetry analysis yields”“Numerical calculations reveal”等表述，属于理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：纳米晶体（NCs）中的带边激子精细结构，具体针对椭球状（spheroidal）和立方体状（cuboidal）两种形状的纳米晶，考虑闪锌矿（zinc-blende）晶体结构、晶格立方对称性、纳米晶形状及单轴各向异性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单轴各向异性的闪锌矿纳米晶中，空穴基态劈裂的符号取决于材料参数及各向异性轴相对于晶轴的方向；此外，由包络波函数立方对称性诱导的短程交换作用在立方体纳米晶中不可忽略，会导致暗激子态产生显著劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单轴各向异性的闪锌矿纳米晶中，空穴基态劈裂的符号取决于材料参数及各向异性轴相对于晶轴的方向；此外，由包络波函数立方对称性诱导的短程交换作用在立方体纳米晶中不可忽略，会导致暗激子态产生显著劈裂。；创新点：首次识别出由包络波函数立方对称性（而非传统布洛赫函数对称性）诱导的短程交换作用贡献，该贡献在立方体纳米晶中不可忽略并导致暗激子态显著劈裂；同时系统分析了交换常数单轴各向异性对激子精细结构和振子强度的影响，特别关注交换各向异性与较小空穴各向异性劈裂可比的情形。
papers.method_zh: 采用非微扰（non-perturbative）对称性分析方法，构建激子精细结构的有效哈密顿量，并通过数值计算求解。有效哈密顿量由1个空穴能量劈裂常数和5个独立交换相互作用常数参数化。

papers.title: Long-Range Order and Composite Boson Condensation in Lattice Quantum Hall States
papers.abstract: Topological states of matter, such as quantum Hall states, are characterized by the absence of local order parameters. In the continuum, their topological order has been reinterpreted as the condensation of nonlocal composite bosons, but this condensation and the resulting long-range correlations have so far eluded direct confirmation beyond the simplest trial states. Here, we apply tensor-network methods to lattice Hamiltonians hosting quantum Hall states, revealing this exotic order directly in interacting ground states and demonstrating both the long-range correlations and the condensation of composite bosons. These correlations define a nonlocal order parameter that identifies phase transitions between trivial and topological phases, for both bosonic and fermionic models. The corresponding operators are accessible through site-resolved, local measurements on an extensive number of particles, making them directly probable in quantum simulators. Our work opens new avenues for microscopic studies of topological quantum matter beyond the reach of traditional solid-state approaches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“应用张量网络方法”（tensor-network methods）到格点哈密顿量，属于数值计算方法。；研究对象：格点量子霍尔态（lattice quantum Hall states），包括玻色子和费米子模型中的拓扑相与平凡相之间的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相互作用基态中直接展示了复合玻色子（composite bosons）的凝聚以及由此产生的长程关联，并证明这些关联可作为非局域序参量，用于识别拓扑相与平凡相之间的相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相互作用基态中直接展示了复合玻色子（composite bosons）的凝聚以及由此产生的长程关联，并证明这些关联可作为非局域序参量，用于识别拓扑相与平凡相之间的相变。；创新点：首次在非简单试探波函数的相互作用基态中，直接证实了复合玻色子凝聚及其长程关联（此前仅在最简单的试探态中可见）；并提出了可通过量子模拟器直接探测的非局域序参量。摘要未突出说明与传统方法相比的具体技术优势。
papers.method_zh: 张量网络方法（tensor-network methods），应用于格点哈密顿量；通过位点分辨的局域测量（site-resolved local measurements）在大量粒子上获取相应算符。

papers.title: Ideal Bose-Einstein condensation in the canonical ensemble: exact asymptotic estimates from large deviations
papers.abstract: In this work we present a large-deviations approach to the calculation of the canonical partition function for free bosons. Three-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensation is studied in the fixed-density ensemble as a function of the dimensionless density $\varrho = ρλ_T^3$, with $ρ=N/L^3$ the standard particle density, $λ_T$ the thermal wavelength, $L$ the linear size of the box and $N$ the total number of particles. A large-deviations approach in terms of the dimensionless parameter $\ell=L/λ_T$ allows us to provide exact asymptotic estimates of the canonical partition function both above and below the critical density $\varrho_c$ for Bose-Einstein condensation. We show how this approach allows to explicitly account for finite-size effects and how it fully captures the first-order aspects of the transition, allowing us to explicitate its driving mechanism in terms of the competing probabilities of normal and condensed phases. The proposed large-deviations approach allows then to obtain in all regimes explicit and simple analytical expressions, at the leading order in the large parameter $\ell$, for both the average fraction of particles in the ground state, the condensate fraction $\langle n_0(\varrho) \rangle = \langle N_0(\varrho) \rangle/N$, and for its fluctuations, $σ_0(\varrho) = \sqrt{\langle N_0^2(\varrho)\rangle - \langle N_0(\varrho)\rangle^2}/N$, retrieving for instance the anomalous scaling $σ_0(\varrho)\sim 1/V^{1/3}$ in the condensed regime, $\varrho > \varrho_c$. Our large-deviations asymptotic estimate, by analytically clarifying the mixed-order nature of Bose-Einstein condensation, allows then to reveal the similarity between this transition and other mixed-order transitions, as for instance the localization transition in the Discrete Non-Linear Schrödinger Equation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“large-deviations approach”“exact asymptotic estimates”“analytical expressions”等理论推导关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：三维自由玻色气体的理想玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC），具体研究在正则系综、固定密度条件下，凝聚体分数及其涨落随无量纲密度 ϱ = ρλ_T³ 的变化，以及有限尺寸效应和相变的一阶/混合阶特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过大偏差方法，在临界密度上下均获得了正则配分函数的精确渐近估计，明确揭示了BEC的混合阶（mixed-order）相变本质，并恢复了凝聚区中反常标度 σ₀(ϱ) ~ 1/V^{1/3}。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过大偏差方法，在临界密度上下均获得了正则配分函数的精确渐近估计，明确揭示了BEC的混合阶（mixed-order）相变本质，并恢复了凝聚区中反常标度 σ₀(ϱ) ~ 1/V^{1/3}。；创新点：首次将大偏差方法系统应用于自由玻色子正则系综的BEC问题，在全部密度区间（ϱ < ϱ_c 和 ϱ > ϱ_c）给出统一的解析渐近表达式，并明确将BEC与离散非线性薛定谔方程中的局域化相变等混合阶相变联系起来，揭示了其共同机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用大偏差理论框架，以无量纲参数 ℓ = L/λ_T 为控制参数，对自由玻色子的正则配分函数进行渐近分析；在ℓ的大参数极限下，解析计算基态粒子数平均分数 ⟨n₀(ϱ)⟩ 及其涨落 σ₀(ϱ)，并比较正常相与凝聚相的竞争概率。

papers.title: Engineering Plasmons in Oxide/Graphene Heterostructures via Interfacial Charge Transfer
papers.abstract: Interfacial charge transfer provides an effective route for tailoring the optical and electronic properties of two-dimensional materials. Here, we investigate infrared surface plasmon polaritons in oxide/graphene heterostructures using scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy. Ultrathin oxide overlayers deposited by physical vapor deposition enable systematic engineering of graphene plasmons through interfacial charge redistribution. MoOx strongly enhances the plasmonic response, producing a longer plasmon wavelength, stronger fringe contrast, and reduced damping, whereas a subsequently deposited ZnOx overlayer partially reverses these changes. Energy-dependent nano-infrared imaging combined with quantitative modeling reveals an increased graphene carrier density and the resulting modification of the plasmon dispersion. Thickness-dependent measurements show a rapid increase in charge-transfer doping at sub-nanometer MoOx thicknesses, followed by a weaker long-range contribution at larger overlayer thicknesses. Electrostatic gating further modulates the carrier density and produces a nonlinear response consistent with gate-dependent interfacial charge redistribution. In addition, an approximately 3-nm-thick MoOx overlayer stabilizes the plasmonic response for at least seven months under ambient conditions. These results establish oxide/graphene heterostructures as a robust platform compatible with scalable fabrication, providing a pathway toward stable and tunable infrared nanophotonic and optoelectronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）进行测量，并涉及物理气相沉积、静电门控等实验手段。；研究对象：氧化物/石墨烯异质结构（具体为MoOx/石墨烯和ZnOx/石墨烯异质结）中的红外表面等离激元极化激元，以及界面电荷转移对其光学和电子性质的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超薄MoOx覆盖层通过界面电荷转移显著增强石墨烯等离激元响应（更长的等离激元波长、更强的条纹对比度和更低的阻尼），而随后沉积的ZnOx覆盖层可部分逆转这些变化；约3 nm厚的MoOx覆盖层还能在环境条件下稳定等离激元响应至少7个月。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超薄MoOx覆盖层通过界面电荷转移显著增强石墨烯等离激元响应（更长的等离激元波长、更强的条纹对比度和更低的阻尼），而随后沉积的ZnOx覆盖层可部分逆转这些变化；约3 nm厚的MoOx覆盖层还能在环境条件下稳定等离激元响应至少7个月。；创新点：利用氧化物/石墨烯异质结中的界面电荷转移实现对石墨烯等离激元的系统性工程调控，展示了可规模化制备的稳定可调红外纳米光子平台，且MoOx覆盖层兼具增强和长期稳定等离激元响应的双重功能。
papers.method_zh: 散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）进行红外纳米成像；物理气相沉积制备超薄氧化物覆盖层；能量依赖的纳米红外成像结合定量模型分析；厚度依赖测量；静电门控调控载流子密度。

papers.title: Transport interpretation of entanglement Hamiltonian cumulants in integrable quantum quenches
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of the cumulants of the entanglement Hamiltonian in interacting integrable models following global quantum quenches. Building on recent results based on space-time duality, we show that these cumulants are exactly given by the cumulants of currents of suitable conserved charges evaluated in the macrostate selected by the initial state. This establishes a direct connection between entanglement dynamics and transport, providing a transport counterpart to the quasiparticle picture that successfully describes the evolution of the von Neumann entropy. In the free-fermion and conformal limits, our results reduce to the difference between the current cumulants carried by right- and left-moving excitations, recovering previously known expressions. In interacting integrable models, where a decomposition into independent right and left movers is no longer meaningful at the operator level, a similar structure survives at the level of the entanglement spectrum, yielding a unified description of entanglement Hamiltonian fluctuations across free, conformal, and interacting integrable systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study the dynamics”“we show that”“based on space-time duality”等理论推导性表述，且未提及任何实验手段或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：可积相互作用模型（interacting integrable models）在全局量子淬火（global quantum quenches）后纠缠哈密顿量（entanglement Hamiltonian）累积量（cumulants）的动力学行为，涵盖自由费米子、共形场论及相互作用可积系统三类体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纠缠哈密顿量的累积量在时间演化中精确等于由初态所确定的宏观态（macrostate）中相应守恒荷电流的累积量，从而在纠缠动力学与输运之间建立了直接对应关系，为已有的准粒子图像提供了输运层面的互补描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纠缠哈密顿量的累积量在时间演化中精确等于由初态所确定的宏观态（macrostate）中相应守恒荷电流的累积量，从而在纠缠动力学与输运之间建立了直接对应关系，为已有的准粒子图像提供了输运层面的互补描述。；创新点：首次将纠缠哈密顿量累积量的动力学精确映射为守恒荷电流累积量，建立了纠缠动力学与输运之间的直接联系；在相互作用可积模型中，尽管算符层面无法分解为独立的左右行激发，但在纠缠谱层面仍保留类似结构，从而统一描述了自由、共形及相互作用可积系统中的纠缠哈密顿量涨落。
papers.method_zh: 基于时空对偶性（space-time duality）的理论框架，结合可积模型中的广义吉布斯系综（GGE）宏观态描述，对纠缠哈密顿量累积量进行解析推导；在自由费米子和共形极限下退化为左右行激发电流累积量之差，并与已知结果对照验证。

papers.title: Thermal DMRG for quasi one-dimensional magnetic molecules and chains
papers.abstract: Density matrix renormalization group methods or tensor network methods in general can not only be used to determine ground states but also to evaluate thermal equilibrium properties. Although convergence is superior for one-dimensional quantum spin systems with nearest neighbor exchange and open boundary conditions, the hope is that these methods can as well be employed to approximate magnetic observables of magnetic molecules with more complex interaction patterns. Here, we study the accuracy that can realistically be achieved for several archetypical quasi one-dimensional structures using the TenPy suite. In our study, we aim at systems that are too large for exact diagonalization or Krylov space methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：DMRG（密度矩阵重正化群）、tensor network methods、TenPy suite。；研究对象：准一维磁性分子与自旋链体系，具体包括具有复杂交换作用模式的磁性分子，以及一维量子自旋系统（最近邻交换、开放边界条件）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出具体物理结论，主要关注点在于评估DMRG/张量网络方法在准一维磁性分子热平衡磁性观测量计算中的实际可达精度，并针对超出精确对角化或Krylov空间方法可处理规模的体系进行测试。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出具体物理结论，主要关注点在于评估DMRG/张量网络方法在准一维磁性分子热平衡磁性观测量计算中的实际可达精度，并针对超出精确对角化或Krylov空间方法可处理规模的体系进行测试。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其创新在于系统评估DMRG方法对具有更复杂交换作用模式（而非仅最近邻）的准一维磁性分子热力学性质的计算精度，并面向更大规模体系（超出精确对角化能力）进行基准测试。
papers.method_zh: 热DMRG（Thermal DMRG）方法，基于张量网络（tensor network）框架，使用TenPy软件套件进行数值模拟。对比对象为精确对角化（exact diagonalization）和Krylov空间方法。

papers.title: Interface-Controlled Defect Engineering in TiN/TaN Superlattices for Enhanced Hardness and Fracture Toughness
papers.abstract: TiNTaN superlattice coatings were designed to investigate how atomic-scale interface chemistry and defect-stabilized TaN layers govern hardness and fracture toughness. Guided by first-principles predictions identifying TaN-based layers as more damage tolerant than TiN, coherent superlattices with a bilayer period of 6 nm were synthesized by reactive magnetron sputtering and interfacially doped with C, B, or Si. Structural and chemical analyses reveal coherent fcc architectures with well-defined interfaces. Si segregates preferentially to the interfaces while incorporating into both TiN and TaN, whereas C and B predominantly diffuse into the TaN layers, modifying coherency strain, bonding, and defect populations. Consequently, hardness increases from 34 GPa for the undoped superlattice to 41 GPa for the Si-doped architecture, whereas fracture toughness increases from 2.8 to 4.0 MPam0.5 for the B-doped superlattice. First-principles calculations show that vacancy-stabilized TaxNy enhances elastic compliance and elastic contrast rather than intrinsic toughness, while the additional toughening induced by B indicates localized defect-assisted energy dissipation at chemically engineered interfaces. Thus, Si maximizes interface strengthening, whereas B provides the most favourable hardness-toughness balance while preserving high hardness, 38 GPa. These findings establish interface chemistry as an additional design parameter for tailoring the mechanical performance of ceramic nitride superlattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“reactive magnetron sputtering”实验合成与表征，以及“first-principles calculations”第一性原理计算。；研究对象：TiN/TaN超晶格涂层（陶瓷氮化物超晶格），重点研究原子尺度界面化学（C、B、Si界面掺杂）与缺陷稳定化TaN层对硬度与断裂韧性的调控机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过界面掺杂（Si、C、B）可独立调控超晶格的硬度与断裂韧性：Si掺杂使硬度从34 GPa提升至41 GPa，B掺杂使断裂韧性从2.8提升至4.0 MPa·m^0.5，同时保持38 GPa的高硬度。第一性原理计算表明，空位稳定的TaxNy增强弹性柔度与弹性对比度而非本征韧性，B的额外增韧机制源于化学工程界面处的局域缺陷辅助能量耗散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过界面掺杂（Si、C、B）可独立调控超晶格的硬度与断裂韧性：Si掺杂使硬度从34 GPa提升至41 GPa，B掺杂使断裂韧性从2.8提升至4.0 MPa·m^0.5，同时保持38 GPa的高硬度。第一性原理计算表明，空位稳定的TaxNy增强弹性柔度与弹性对比度而非本征韧性，B的额外增韧机制源于化学工程界面处的局域缺陷辅助能量耗散。；创新点：将界面化学（interface chemistry）确立为陶瓷氮化物超晶格力学性能的额外设计参数，实现了对硬度与断裂韧性的独立优化（Si最大化界面强化，B提供最佳硬度-韧性平衡），而非仅依赖层厚或组分调控。摘要未突出说明与以往超晶格研究的系统性对比。
papers.method_zh: - 实验：反应磁控溅射（reactive magnetron sputtering）合成共格外延超晶格（双层层厚6 nm），界面掺杂C、B、Si；结构/化学分析（确认fcc结构、界面清晰度、元素分布）。

papers.title: Disorder-tuned crossing of monopole and conventional pairing instabilities in multi-Weyl semimetals
papers.abstract: We study how non-magnetic impurity scattering affects the emergence and possible coexistence of pairing instabilities in a two-node multi-Weyl semimetal. Within an explicitly specified projected impurity kernel---valley diagonal and momentum independent across each Fermi pocket, the leading behaviour of non-magnetic disorder in the small-pocket window $q^{\max}_{\rm intra}ξ_{\rm dis}\ll1\ll|2\mathbf Q|ξ_{\rm dis}$, treated at leading order in Born and Abrikosov--Gor'kov theory---quenched disorder tunes the leading pairing instability from a topologically nontrivial monopole channel to a conventional ($s$-wave) one, extending our earlier clean-system analysis into the disordered regime. A Born self-energy calculation in the chiral band basis then gives: (i) a band-isotropic conventional channel that is Anderson protected against intra-node scalar disorder ($η_s=1$), introduced phenomenologically at the projected-band level; solving the competition for arbitrary $η_s$ yields the crossing criterion $(1-η_s)/(1-η_m)<T_{c0}^{(s)}/T_{c0}^{(m)}$, so the mechanism tolerates substantial loss of conventional-channel protection; and (ii) a rank-one monopole sector fixing $f_m$ as the exact eigenfunction with $η_m(J)=1/(J+2)$, exact given that kernel. The crossing location in $Γ_N/T_{c0}^{(m)}$ is set by $η_m(J)$, $η_s$, and $r=T_{c0}^{(s)}/T_{c0}^{(m)}$. From the clean projected BdG Hamiltonian the pure monopole nodes carry Berry charge $\pm J$, distinct from the gapped conventional solution; the clean nodal thermodynamics is charge-dependent, $N_{\rm SC}(E)\propto E^{2/J}$ and $C\propto T^{1+2/J}$, and the residual density of states shows a threshold only for $J=1$. The crossing lies in the moderately metallic regime, $μ/Γ_N\simeq11$--$14$ for the illustrative $T_{c0}^{(m)}/μ=0.133$ used in the figures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We study、Born self-energy calculation、theoretical analysis、BdG Hamiltonian。；研究对象：双节点多Weyl半金属（multi-Weyl semimetal）中的配对不稳定性，具体关注非磁性杂质散射对拓扑非平庸的monopole配对通道与常规s波配对通道之间竞争与交叉的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在特定投影杂质核下，非磁性无序可将主导配对不稳定性从拓扑非平庸的monopole通道调至常规s波通道；两通道的交叉判据为 (1−η_s)/(1−η_m) < T_{c0}^{(s)}/T_{c0}^{(m)}，且交叉发生在中等金属性区间（μ/Γ_N ≈ 11–14）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在特定投影杂质核下，非磁性无序可将主导配对不稳定性从拓扑非平庸的monopole通道调至常规s波通道；两通道的交叉判据为 (1−η_s)/(1−η_m) < T_{c0}^{(s)}/T_{c0}^{(m)}，且交叉发生在中等金属性区间（μ/Γ_N ≈ 11–14）。；创新点：将此前干净体系的多Weyl半金属monopole配对分析推广到无序区，明确给出了无序调控下monopole通道与常规通道交叉的定量判据，并揭示了monopole通道的秩一结构及其精确本征函数f_m（η_m(J)=1/(J+2)）。摘要未突出说明与实验的对照。
papers.method_zh: 采用Born近似和Abrikosov–Gor'kov理论处理无序，在手性能带基下做Born自能计算；使用投影杂质核（谷对角、每个费米口袋内动量无关）；基于干净的投影BdG哈密顿量分析节点拓扑性质与热力学。理论框架为平均场配对加无序微扰论。

papers.title: Intervalley Magnetotrions Tunable by Electric and Magnetic Fields in Buckled Two-Dimensional Materials
papers.abstract: We develop a theoretical framework for intervalley magnetotrions in buckled two-dimensional materials, including silicene, germanene, and stanene, subjected to perpendicular electric and magnetic fields. Within the effective-mass approximation, the three-particle Schrödinger equation is formulated with the Rytova--Keldysh interaction potential and analyzed in the high-magnetic-field regime. We demonstrate that intervalley trions with equal electron and hole effective masses constitute an exceptional case for which the center-of-mass and internal motions separate exactly. The center-of-mass motion is governed by a two-dimensional harmonic-oscillator Hamiltonian, leading to quantized Landau states whose energies form electrically tunable Landau surfaces controlled by the magnetic field and the electric-field dependence of the carrier effective masses. The internal motion is investigated by solving the three-body Schrödinger equation within the framework of the hyperspherical harmonics method. Numerical calculations reveal that the trion binding energy increases monotonically with both magnetic and electric fields owing to the combined effects of magnetic confinement and electric-field-induced enhancement of the effective masses. The strongest binding is obtained for silicene, followed by stanene and germanene. The present work provides a unified description of both the collective center-of-mass motion and the internal dynamics of magnetotrions in Xene monolayers, demonstrating that both degrees of freedom can be independently manipulated by external electric and magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a theoretical framework”“effective-mass approximation”“Schrödinger equation”“hyperspherical harmonics method”等理论推导与数值求解关键词。；研究对象：研究对象为翘曲二维材料（硅烯、锗烯、锡烯）中的谷间磁激子（intervalley magnetotrions），即由两个电子和一个空穴（或反之）组成的束缚三粒子态，在垂直电场和磁场作用下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 谷间三激子（trion）在电子和空穴有效质量相等时，质心运动与内部运动可严格分离；三激子束缚能随磁场和电场单调增大，其中硅烯中束缚最强，其次为锡烯和锗烯。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：谷间三激子（trion）在电子和空穴有效质量相等时，质心运动与内部运动可严格分离；三激子束缚能随磁场和电场单调增大，其中硅烯中束缚最强，其次为锡烯和锗烯。；创新点：首次对Xene单层中磁三激子的质心集体运动与内部动力学给出统一理论描述，并证明两者可分别通过外加电场和磁场独立调控；特别指出等有效质量情形下质心与内部运动的严格可分离性。
papers.method_zh: 采用有效质量近似，建立三粒子薛定谔方程，使用Rytova–Keldysh相互作用势描述层内库仑屏蔽；在高磁场区间下，质心运动化为二维谐振子问题，内部运动则用超球谐函数方法（hyperspherical harmonics method）数值求解三体薛定谔方程。

papers.title: Phoretic interactions in two-medium wedge geometries
papers.abstract: We investigate the diffusiophoretic motion of a chemically isotropic active colloid in a three-dimensional wedge formed by two distinct fluid media, in the limit of vanishing Péclet and Reynolds numbers. The concentration field is obtained using the Fourier-Kontorovich-Lebedev transform, yielding an exact representation for arbitrary wedge opening angles and interfacial contrasts. We introduce the interfacial parameter $Γ=(1-λ\ell)/(1+λ\ell)$, where $λ$ denotes the diffusivity contrast and $\ell$ the solute partition coefficient. For $Γ=\pm1$ and commensurate wedge angles, the solution reduces to finite image constructions, with distinct structures for even and odd commensurability. The general solution also recovers the planar-interface and semi-infinite-interface limits. The leading-order translational phoretic velocity is derived from the concentration field, revealing a strong interplay between wedge geometry and interfacial properties that governs both the magnitude and direction of particle motion. This work provides a framework for understanding and controlling phoretic transport in confined multiphase environments and offer a basis for extensions to finite-size geometries and mixed fluid--fluid and solid boundary conditions. Our results may find applications in the control of active-particle transport in confined multiphase environments, where interfacial properties and geometry can be exploited to tune phoretic motion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Fourier-Kontorovich-Lebedev变换”“精确表示”“推导”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：三维楔形几何中、由两种不同流体介质构成的界面附近的化学各向同性活性胶体，其扩散泳（diffusiophoretic）运动。具体物理现象为低Péclet数和低Reynolds数极限下的活性粒子输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 楔形几何与界面性质（由界面参数Γ表征）的强耦合共同决定活性胶体平移泳动速度的大小与方向；在Γ=±1且楔角可公度时，解可约化为有限镜像构造，且偶/奇可公度性对应不同结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：楔形几何与界面性质（由界面参数Γ表征）的强耦合共同决定活性胶体平移泳动速度的大小与方向；在Γ=±1且楔角可公度时，解可约化为有限镜像构造，且偶/奇可公度性对应不同结构。；创新点：首次给出两种不同流体介质构成的楔形几何中扩散泳运动的精确解析解，引入界面参数Γ统一描述扩散率对比与溶质分配系数的影响，并揭示有限镜像构造与楔角可公度性之间的偶/奇结构关系；同时恢复平面界面和半无限界面极限。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析方法：在零Péclet数和零Reynolds数极限下求解浓度场，采用Fourier-Kontorovich-Lebedev变换获得任意楔角和界面对比度下的精确解；从浓度场推导领头阶平移泳动速度。摘要未提及数值模拟或实验手段。

papers.title: Floquet engineering of spin-valley selective transport in jacutingaite
papers.abstract: We study electron transport through a monolayer jacutingaite (Pt$_2$HgSe$_3$) tunnel junction in which only the barrier is irradiated by off-resonant circularly polarized light, while the leads remain undriven. In the high-frequency regime, the driven barrier reduces to an effective static Dirac Hamiltonian with a photon-dressed, valley-dependent mass term. A staggered sublattice potential $V_z$ and a substrate-induced exchange field $m_s$ provide additional tunable mass terms. Using scattering theory, we compute spin- and valley-resolved transmission and reflection, as well as the Landauer conductance. Photon dressing shifts the barrier {Dirac masses} with opposite signs in the ($\boldsymbol{K}, \boldsymbol{K}'$) valleys and induces a splitting of the propagation thresholds. The finite barrier then produces channel-dependent Fabry--Pérot-type interference through the phase $q_x^{ηs_z}L$. We find broad parameter windows with near-perfect valley filtering ($|P_v|\simeq 100\%$) and substantial spin polarization ($|P_s|\sim 70\%$). The dominant spin and valley polarizations can be switched by tuning the drive amplitude $A_0$, $V_z$, and~$m_s$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“scattering theory”（散射理论）、“Landauer conductance”（兰道尔电导）等理论方法，且未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：单层jacutingaite（Pt₂HgSe₃）隧道结，其中仅势垒区域被非共振圆偏振光辐照，两侧电极保持无驱动。研究的是该体系中自旋-谷分辨的电子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Floquet工程，光子修饰在K和K'谷中产生符号相反的狄拉克质量位移，导致传播阈值劈裂，从而在有限势垒中实现近完美的谷过滤（|P_v|≈100%）和可观的自旋极化（|P_s|≈70%）。自旋和谷极化的主导方向可通过调节驱动幅度A₀、交错势V_z和交换场m_s进行切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Floquet工程，光子修饰在K和K'谷中产生符号相反的狄拉克质量位移，导致传播阈值劈裂，从而在有限势垒中实现近完美的谷过滤（|P_v|≈100%）和可观的自旋极化（|P_s|≈70%）。自旋和谷极化的主导方向可通过调节驱动幅度A₀、交错势V_z和交换场m_s进行切换。；创新点：首次将Floquet工程应用于jacutingaite单层隧道结，利用圆偏振光在势垒区域实现自旋-谷选择性输运调控，并展示了通过光驱动幅度与静态参数（V_z、m_s）协同调节极化方向的能力。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 高频近似下将驱动势垒约化为含光子修饰、谷依赖质量项的有效静态狄拉克哈密顿量；结合散射理论计算自旋分辨和谷分辨的透射/反射系数，以及兰道尔电导；分析有限势垒中通过相位q_x^{ηs_z}L产生的通道依赖的Fabry–Pérot型干涉。

papers.title: Dynamic quantum phase transitions in the two-leg Creutz ladder with long-range hopping
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate quantum quenches in the two-leg Creutz model with long-range hopping, where the hopping amplitudes decay with distance as a power law characterized by an exponent $ν$ and have a finite range $D$. We first obtain the exact solution of a generic two-band model in momentum space. This allows us to compute the Loschmidt amplitude and, consequently, the dynamical free energy $f(\texttt{t})$ of the two-band model. We also show how to determine the Yang-Lee Fisher (YLF) zeros by solving a nonlinear equation. We demonstrate that the two-leg Creutz model in momentum space is a special case of the generic two-band model. Using these results, we identify the non-analyticities in the dynamical free energy $f(\texttt{t})$ at critical times $\texttt{t}_{c}$. We find that the number of nontrivial critical times $N_{s}$ depends on both $ν$ and $D$. In particular, we show that for small $ν$ and large $D$ the critical times become increasingly dense, leading, in the appropriate regime, to non-analyticities at an increasingly dense set of times---similar to what was observed by Xavier and Hoyos [Phys. Rev. B, $\textbf{108}$, 214303 (2023)] in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model with long-range hopping terms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、exact solution、compute、demonstrate、identify，属于解析与数值结合的理论研究。；研究对象：具有长程跃迁的双腿 Creutz 梯子模型（two-leg Creutz ladder with long-range hopping），重点关注其量子淬火后的动态量子相变（DQPT）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在长程跃迁指数 ν 和有限跃迁范围 D 的调控下，动态自由能 f(t) 在临界时间 t_c 处出现非解析性；当 ν 较小且 D 较大时，临界时间变得密集，导致非解析性在时间轴上趋于稠密分布，与 SSH 模型中的长程行为类似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在长程跃迁指数 ν 和有限跃迁范围 D 的调控下，动态自由能 f(t) 在临界时间 t_c 处出现非解析性；当 ν 较小且 D 较大时，临界时间变得密集，导致非解析性在时间轴上趋于稠密分布，与 SSH 模型中的长程行为类似。；创新点：首次将长程跃迁（幂律衰减 + 有限截断）引入两腿 Creutz 梯子模型，并系统揭示 ν 和 D 对动态量子相变临界时间数目 N_s 及时间分布稠密度的调控规律，扩展了长程跃迁下 DQPT 的已知图景。
papers.method_zh: 先在动量空间对一般两带模型求精确解，计算 Loschmidt 振幅与动态自由能；通过求解非线性方程确定 Yang-Lee-Fisher（YLF）零点；再将两腿 Creutz 模型映射为该一般两带模型的特殊情形，从而解析地定位临界时间。

papers.title: Structure-Agnostic Prediction of the Electronic Density of States with a Chemical Language Model
papers.abstract: The electronic density of states (DOS) is conventionally computed from a relaxed crystal structure, which is unavailable for compounds that have been neither synthesized nor cataloged. Here we introduce DOSSIER ($\textbf{D}$ensity $\textbf{o}$f $\textbf{S}$tates from $\textbf{S}$to$\textbf{i}$chiometry with $\textbf{E}$ncoder $\textbf{R}$epresentations), a chemical language model that maps elemental composition directly to this spectrum. The encoder is pretrained by cross-modal knowledge distillation from a universal machine-learning interatomic potential; the transfer lowers the error by 11% when only 1,000 training examples are available. On the Mat2Spec benchmark, DOSSIER reaches a mean absolute error of 3.76 states eV$^{-1}$ against 3.64 for the best structure-aware model; on an extended Materials Project dataset, the predicted spectra yield band gaps and $\textit{d}$-band descriptors with useful accuracy. Screening 11,977 binary and 13,251 five-component high-entropy alloy compositions for a $\textit{d}$-projected DOS resembling that of NiPt$_{3}$ places known oxygen reduction electrocatalysts near the top of the ranking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“chemical language model”“machine-learning interatomic potential”“benchmark”“screening”等，均为计算与机器学习方法关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：材料的电子态密度（DOS），具体包括二元化合物、五元高熵合金（如NiPt₃相关成分）以及用于氧还原电催化的材料体系。研究对象是“成分→DOS”的直接映射，而非特定单一化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种仅从元素化学计量比（无需晶体结构）即可预测电子态密度的化学语言模型DOSSIER，其预测精度接近甚至媲美结构感知模型（MAE 3.76 vs 3.64 states eV⁻¹），并能有效筛选出已知的氧还原电催化剂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种仅从元素化学计量比（无需晶体结构）即可预测电子态密度的化学语言模型DOSSIER，其预测精度接近甚至媲美结构感知模型（MAE 3.76 vs 3.64 states eV⁻¹），并能有效筛选出已知的氧还原电催化剂。；创新点：实现了“结构无关”（structure-agnostic）的DOS预测——无需弛豫晶体结构，直接从化学式出发；利用跨模态蒸馏提升小样本（1000个训练样例）下的迁移性能，误差降低11%。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用化学语言模型（encoder架构），通过跨模态知识蒸馏（cross-modal knowledge distillation）从通用机器学习原子间势（universal machine-learning interatomic potential）中预训练编码器；在Mat2Spec基准和扩展的Materials Project数据集上评估，并用于高熵合金成分筛选。

papers.title: Disorder-induced conducting edges on Kagomé lattice
papers.abstract: Within a cluster extension of the coherent potential approximation, disorder averaging generates a non-local self-energy that renormalizes both diagonal and off-diagonal hopping terms of the non-interacting Kagome-lattice Hamiltonian. These renormalizations (of both nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor hopping amplitudes) drive the system between two topologically trivial insulating states through an intermediate gapless phase characterized by conducting edge modes over a broad range of impurity concentrations. Our results demonstrate that multiple-scattering effects alone can generate emergent effective spin-orbit interactions and qualitatively modify the edge spectrum of disordered Kagome systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“cluster extension of the coherent potential approximation”（团簇扩展的相干势近似）、“disorder averaging”（无序平均）等理论计算方法。；研究对象：Kagomé（笼目）晶格上的无序电子系统，具体关注无序诱导的边界导电态及其与体态拓扑性质的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无序平均产生的非局域自能会重正化Kagomé晶格哈密顿量中的近邻和次近邻跃迁项，从而等效地产生自旋轨道耦合效应，将系统在两个拓扑平庸的绝缘态之间驱动，并经过一个具有导电边界模的中间无隙相。该效应在较宽的杂质浓度范围内均存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序平均产生的非局域自能会重正化Kagomé晶格哈密顿量中的近邻和次近邻跃迁项，从而等效地产生自旋轨道耦合效应，将系统在两个拓扑平庸的绝缘态之间驱动，并经过一个具有导电边界模的中间无隙相。该效应在较宽的杂质浓度范围内均存在。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但核心新意在于：仅凭多重散射效应（无需真实自旋轨道耦合）即可产生等效自旋轨道相互作用，并定性改变无序Kagomé体系的边界谱，表明无序本身可作为调控拓扑边界态的机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用相干势近似（CPA）的团簇扩展形式，通过无序平均生成非局域自能，对非相互作用Kagomé晶格哈密顿量的对角和非对角跃迁项进行重正化分析，并研究边界模的演化。

papers.title: Plastic Relaxation without Dislocations in $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ Heteroepitaxy: A Structural Peculiarity of Ga$_2$O$_3$ Polymorphs
papers.abstract: $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ grows as three-dimensional islands on mismatched c-plane sapphire, often on a thin $α$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ wetting layer, and eventually forms a continuous film by island coalescence. Experiments reveal the $β$ film to be relaxed. Surprisingly no dislocations are observed, suggesting an unusual plastic relaxation path. We reveal the key mechanisms underlying this process by combining density functional theory, continuum nucleation theory, and molecular dynamics simulations. Plastic relaxation occurs through rearrangement of the Ga atoms beneath the oxygen plane shared by both the wetting layer and the (-201) $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ structures. A local $α$ to $β$-relaxed phase transition is thus realized within a single plane, allowing full relaxation of the $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ island.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+理论+模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“结合密度泛函理论、连续介质成核理论和分子动力学模拟”，属于计算与理论模拟研究。；研究对象：β-Ga₂O₃ 在蓝宝石（c面）衬底上的异质外延生长及其塑性弛豫机制，具体涉及 α-Ga₂O₃ 润湿层与 β-Ga₂O₃ 岛状结构之间的相变与应力释放过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: β-Ga₂O₃ 薄膜在无位错的情况下实现完全弛豫，其塑性弛豫通过氧平面下方 Ga 原子的局部重排实现，即在单个原子平面内完成从 α 相到 β-弛豫相的局域相变，从而释放失配应力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：β-Ga₂O₃ 薄膜在无位错的情况下实现完全弛豫，其塑性弛豫通过氧平面下方 Ga 原子的局部重排实现，即在单个原子平面内完成从 α 相到 β-弛豫相的局域相变，从而释放失配应力。；创新点：首次提出一种无需位错参与的塑性弛豫路径——通过单原子层内的局域 α→β 相变实现应力释放，这不同于传统外延薄膜中依赖位错滑移或攀移的弛豫机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）用于计算能量与结构稳定性；连续介质成核理论用于描述岛状成核与生长过程；分子动力学（MD）模拟用于揭示原子尺度弛豫动力学机制。

papers.title: Anomalous magnetocaloric effects in the quasi-one-dimensional antiferromagnet BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$
papers.abstract: We investigate the transverse-field thermodynamics of the quasi-one-dimensional Ising-like antiferromagnet BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$, whose tilted screw-chain geometry and anisotropic Landé $g$ tensor generate spatially modulated Zeeman couplings. Angle-resolved magnetocaloric-effect (MCE) measurements reveal a high-field temperature minimum near the transverse-field Ising critical field for $H\parallel[110]$ that persists and shifts only weakly upon field rotation. Tensor-network calculations show that the rotation-induced staggered transverse field rapidly lowers the Ising critical field and that the magnetic Grüneisen ratio changes sign near the high-field temperature minimum, consistent with experiment. Our results establish that a dominant MCE response can persist away from the Ising critical region, suggesting a route to magnetic cooling by tailoring anisotropic Zeeman-coupling configurations in quantum magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“Angle-resolved magnetocaloric-effect (MCE) measurements”（实验测量）和“Tensor-network calculations”（张量网络计算）。；研究对象：准一维Ising型反铁磁体BaCo₂V₂O₈，具体关注其倾斜螺旋链几何结构、各向异性Landé g张量导致的空间调制Zeeman耦合，以及横向磁场下的热力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在H∥[110]方向、接近横向场Ising临界场处出现高温温度极小值，该极小值在磁场旋转时持续存在且仅微弱移动；张量网络计算表明旋转诱导的交错横向场会迅速降低Ising临界场，且磁Grüneisen比在高温温度极小值附近改变符号，与实验一致。主要MCE响应可在远离Ising临界区域持续存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在H∥[110]方向、接近横向场Ising临界场处出现高温温度极小值，该极小值在磁场旋转时持续存在且仅微弱移动；张量网络计算表明旋转诱导的交错横向场会迅速降低Ising临界场，且磁Grüneisen比在高温温度极小值附近改变符号，与实验一致。主要MCE响应可在远离Ising临界区域持续存在。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于：证明通过调控量子磁体中各向异性Zeeman耦合构型，可在远离Ising临界区域获得显著的磁制冷响应，为磁冷却提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用角度分辨磁热效应（MCE）测量；理论上采用张量网络计算（tensor-network calculations），用于计算热力学量及磁Grüneisen比。

papers.title: Electronic cooling of a TiW alloy normal-metal island using Nb-based superconducting tunnel junctions
papers.abstract: TiW thin films remain non-superconducting down to millikelvin temperatures and are compatible with large-scale CMOS manufacturing, making them attractive for cryogenic and quantum tunnel-junction devices, such as normal-metal-insulator-superconductor (NIS) thermal sensors and electron refrigerators. We demonstrate significant electronic cooling of a TiW-based normal-metal island and electron thermometry by using TiW-Al-AlOx-Nb NIS tunnel-junction stacks. The NIS thermometer enables local electron temperature measurements from 0.5 to 8.32 K. NIS cooling is observed between 0.6 and 3.5 K, with maximum absolute and relative temperature reductions of 217 mK and 27%, respectively. Calculations using tunnel-junction parameters obtained independently from current-voltage fits reproduce the measured optimum-voltage scale, which lies substantially below the ideal low-temperature prediction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate”“measurements”“observed”等实验性词汇，并涉及器件制备与测量。；研究对象：TiW合金正常金属岛与Nb基超导隧道结组成的NIS（正常金属-绝缘体-超导体）隧道结器件，具体为TiW-Al-AlOx-Nb堆叠结构，研究其电子制冷与电子测温行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在TiW基NIS隧道结中实现了显著的电子制冷效果：在0.6–3.5 K温区内观察到NIS冷却，最大绝对温降为217 mK，相对温降为27%；同时利用同一NIS结实现了0.5–8.32 K范围内的局域电子温度测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在TiW基NIS隧道结中实现了显著的电子制冷效果：在0.6–3.5 K温区内观察到NIS冷却，最大绝对温降为217 mK，相对温降为27%；同时利用同一NIS结实现了0.5–8.32 K范围内的局域电子温度测量。；创新点：首次将CMOS兼容的TiW合金（在毫开尔文温度下仍保持非超导）用于NIS电子制冷器件，展示了其作为正常金属岛材料的可行性，并发现最优制冷电压显著低于理想低温理论预测值（摘要未给出该偏差的物理解释）。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备TiW-Al-AlOx-Nb NIS隧道结堆叠结构；通过电流-电压（I-V）特性拟合提取隧道结参数；利用NIS结作为电子温度计进行局域电子温度测量；通过对比实验观测与理论计算验证制冷电压标度。

papers.title: A colossal dielectric response of Bi1-xSmxFeO3 nanopowders
papers.abstract: The dielectric permittivity of the pressed powder samples of Bi1-xSmxFeO3, with Sm content "x" varying in the range 0 - 0.2, has been investigated in the temperature range from 20 to 400 C and the frequency range from 100 Hz to 100 kHz. We have shown that the Sm content impacts significantly the real and imaginary parts of effective dielectric permittivity, which have expanded diffuse maxima with a colossal magnitude up to 105 (for the real part) and up to 108 (for the imaginary one) at temperatures 300 - 400 K. Analysis of experimental data carried has shown that both the real and imaginary parts of effective dielectric permittivity may be comprehensively explained by considering a complex interplay of a diffuse ferroelectric-paraelectric phase transition and the Maxwell-Wagner-Sillars effects, which emerge from the formation of spatial charges at interfaces between nanograins and at the ferroelectric nanoparticle-air interface. Processing of experimental data for the real and imaginary parts of the effective dielectric permittivity within effective medium approach allows us to separate and analyze the colossal dielectric response of the nanoparticles itself. The main trends followed from experiments are supported by the theoretically simulated dependences, which reveal correlations between the temperature behavior of dielectric properties and phase state of the Bi1-xSmxFeO3 nanoparticles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“pressed powder samples”“investigated”“Processing of experimental data”等实验测量与数据分析关键词。；研究对象：Bi1-xSmxFeO3（钐掺杂铁酸铋）纳米粉体，Sm含量x在0–0.2范围内变化；研究其介电响应，特别是巨介电常数现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sm掺杂显著影响有效介电常数的实部和虚部，在300–400 K温度区间出现展宽的弥散极大值，实部高达10^5、虚部高达10^8，呈现巨介电响应。该响应源于弥散铁电-顺电相变与麦克斯韦-瓦格纳-西拉斯（Maxwell-Wagner-Sillars）效应的复杂耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sm掺杂显著影响有效介电常数的实部和虚部，在300–400 K温度区间出现展宽的弥散极大值，实部高达10^5、虚部高达10^8，呈现巨介电响应。该响应源于弥散铁电-顺电相变与麦克斯韦-瓦格纳-西拉斯（Maxwell-Wagner-Sillars）效应的复杂耦合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其新意在于：通过有效介质方法将纳米颗粒本征介电响应与界面空间电荷效应（MWS效应）分离，从而单独分析纳米颗粒自身的巨介电行为，并建立了介电温度行为与纳米颗粒相态之间的关联。
papers.method_zh: 介电谱测量：在20–400 °C温度范围、100 Hz–100 kHz频率范围内测量压制粉末样品的介电常数实部和虚部；采用有效介质近似（effective medium approach）对实验数据进行处理，以分离纳米颗粒本身的巨介电响应；并结合理论模拟（theoretically simulated dependences）对比验证实验趋势。

papers.title: Altermagnetic Anomalous Hall Effect and Spin--Edge-Locked Chiral Modes in a Modified Kane--Mele--Hubbard Model
papers.abstract: We establish a correlation-driven route to the altermagnetic anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and its associated \emph{spin--edge-locked} edge states in a modified Kane--Mele--Hubbard model. Using dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), we show that, at half-filling, increasing the Hubbard interaction drives the system from a metallic paramagnetic phase hosting antichiral edge states into an insulating in-plane Néel-type antiferromagnetic phase, in which a residual antiunitary symmetry forbids the AHE. Hole doping induces a spin-flop transition to an out-of-plane Néel-type antiferromagnetic phase, thereby breaking this symmetry and generating a finite anomalous Hall conductivity that persists into the strongly correlated regime. Distinct from a conventional spin-polarized Hall response in ferromagnets, the altermagnetic AHE receives equal and additive contributions from the two symmetry-related spin sectors and is accompanied by spin--edge-locked chiral states. Our results demonstrate that carrier doping and spin-rotationally invariant Hubbard interactions are sufficient to realize the altermagnetic AHE, without invoking an explicitly Ising-like interaction, and provide a realistic microscopic route toward its realization in correlated transition metal dichalcogenides monolayers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据：摘要明确使用 dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) 进行数值计算，属于强关联电子系统的理论模拟研究。；研究对象：修正的 Kane–Mele–Hubbard 模型，具体关注该模型在关联过渡金属二硫化物单层中的实现，以及交变磁（altermagnetic）反常霍尔效应（AHE）和自旋-边缘锁定手性边缘态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在修正的 Kane–Mele–Hubbard 模型中，通过空穴掺杂诱导自旋翻转（spin-flop）跃迁至面外 Néel 型反铁磁相，打破残余反幺正对称性，从而在强关联区产生有限的反常霍尔电导；该交变磁 AHE 由两个对称相关的自旋扇区等量相加贡献，并伴随自旋-边缘锁定的手性边缘态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在修正的 Kane–Mele–Hubbard 模型中，通过空穴掺杂诱导自旋翻转（spin-flop）跃迁至面外 Néel 型反铁磁相，打破残余反幺正对称性，从而在强关联区产生有限的反常霍尔电导；该交变磁 AHE 由两个对称相关的自旋扇区等量相加贡献，并伴随自旋-边缘锁定的手性边缘态。；创新点：证明了仅靠载流子掺杂和自旋旋转不变的 Hubbard 相互作用即可实现交变磁反常霍尔效应，无需显式的 Ising 型各向异性相互作用；为在关联过渡金属二硫化物单层中实现该效应提供了微观路径。
papers.method_zh: 动力学平均场理论（DMFT）。具体用于研究半填充和空穴掺杂下 Hubbard 相互作用驱动的金属-绝缘体相变、磁序转变以及反常霍尔电导的计算。

papers.title: Emergence of Stigmergic Transport in Granular Environments
papers.abstract: We show that stigmergic path formation emerges in a deformable environment through the interplay between environmental memory and geometrical crowding. Using experiments with robotic random walkers together with a minimal stochastic model, we demonstrate the onset of persistent self-reinforced transport pathways above a critical packing fraction $φ_c$, where environmental memory enhances walker mobility. As the jamming transition $φ_J$ is approached, increasing crowding progressively suppresses this transport enhancement despite the persistence of environmental memory. The resulting non-monotonic behavior reveals an optimal transport regime well below jamming. More generally, our work establishes how active agents can collectively build transport networks through purely mechanical interactions with a deformable substrate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论建模）。判断依据：摘要提及“experiments with robotic random walkers”以及“a minimal stochastic model”。；研究对象：可变形颗粒介质中的活性粒子输运现象，具体为“stigmergic path formation”（基于环境痕迹的路径形成）以及颗粒环境中的输运通道涌现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在颗粒环境中，当填充分数超过临界值 φ_c 时，会涌现出自我强化的持久输运路径；但随着体系接近堵塞转变 φ_J，拥挤效应会抑制这种输运增强，导致在远低于堵塞点处存在一个最优输运区间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在颗粒环境中，当填充分数超过临界值 φ_c 时，会涌现出自我强化的持久输运路径；但随着体系接近堵塞转变 φ_J，拥挤效应会抑制这种输运增强，导致在远低于堵塞点处存在一个最优输运区间。；创新点：首次展示了活性粒子可通过纯机械相互作用（而非化学或信息信号）在可变形基底上集体构建输运网络，并揭示了环境记忆与堵塞效应之间的竞争导致的非单调输运行为。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用机器人随机游走器在可变形颗粒环境中运动；理论上构建了一个最小随机模型（minimal stochastic model）来描述环境记忆与几何拥挤的相互作用。

papers.title: Exact autoregressive sampling of planar Ising spin glasses via the Kac--Ward theory
papers.abstract: Exact sampling from the Boltzmann distribution of spin glasses remains an outstanding challenge: Markov chain Monte Carlo methods suffer from critical slowing down and metastable trapping, while modern neural autoregressive samplers such as variational autoregressive networks are approximate and, in the absence of exact reference samples, cannot be rigorously benchmarked. Here we present an exact autoregressive sampling algorithm for planar Ising spin glasses based on the Kac--Ward theory. Under the chain-rule factorization, sequentially fixing spins induces boundary-localized external fields, which destroy the zero-field structure required for exact evaluation. By encoding these fields with a planarity-preserving auxiliary spin construction, the conditional partition functions are mapped to an extended zero-field Ising model and exactly evaluated using the Kac--Ward determinant formula. The method generates strictly independent and identically distributed samples with exact normalized likelihoods at a computational cost of $\mathcal{O}(N^{5/2})$ for $N$ spins, thereby providing an exact baseline for benchmarking neural autoregressive samplers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：exact sampling、algorithm、determinant formula。；研究对象：平面伊辛自旋玻璃（planar Ising spin glasses）的玻尔兹曼分布精确采样问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于Kac–Ward理论的精确自回归采样算法，能够以O(N^{5/2})的计算代价生成严格独立同分布、且具有精确归一化似然的样本，为神经自回归采样器提供精确基准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于Kac–Ward理论的精确自回归采样算法，能够以O(N^{5/2})的计算代价生成严格独立同分布、且具有精确归一化似然的样本，为神经自回归采样器提供精确基准。；创新点：首次将Kac–Ward理论用于自回归采样框架，解决了条件配分函数因边界场破坏零场结构而无法精确求值的问题，实现了对平面伊辛自旋玻璃的严格精确采样，可作为神经自回归采样器的无偏基准。
papers.method_zh: 利用链式法则分解联合概率，将顺序固定自旋产生的边界局域外场通过保平面性的辅助自旋构造编码，映射回零场伊辛模型，并用Kac–Ward行列式公式精确计算条件配分函数。

papers.title: Conformation-Mediated Kinetics of Polymer Chain Scission under Tension
papers.abstract: Chain scission is a key molecular process underlying damage and fracture in polymer networks. In this Letter, we develop a statistical-mechanical framework for predicting chain-scission kinetics while accounting for three-dimensional (3D) conformational fluctuations. Within transition-state theory, scission is formulated as a multichannel first-rupture problem, with bond-specific rates governed primarily by self-consistent potentials of mean force. In the freely jointed limit, the additional 3D configurational freedom enhances rupture relative to the collinear 1D reference. Finite bending stiffness introduces orientational correlations that can reverse this enhancement and, at high stiffness, reduce rupture rates by orders of magnitude. These correlations also make rupture bond-position dependent, with higher rates near the chain ends and a common interior rate. For sufficiently long chains, the interior contribution dominates, yielding linear scaling of the chain-scission rate with chain length. These molecularly resolved rates provide physically grounded inputs for future network-scale models of polymer damage and fracture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“statistical-mechanical framework”“transition-state theory”等理论框架，属于理论建模研究。；研究对象：聚合物网络在张力作用下的链断裂（chain scission）动力学，具体关注三维构象涨落对断裂速率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三维构象自由度在自由连接极限下增强断裂速率，但有限弯曲刚度引入的取向关联可逆转这一增强，并在高刚度下使断裂速率降低数个数量级；长链极限下断裂速率与链长呈线性标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三维构象自由度在自由连接极限下增强断裂速率，但有限弯曲刚度引入的取向关联可逆转这一增强，并在高刚度下使断裂速率降低数个数量级；长链极限下断裂速率与链长呈线性标度。；创新点：首次在链断裂动力学中系统纳入三维构象涨落及弯曲刚度效应，揭示了取向关联对断裂速率和键位置依赖性的非平凡影响，为网络尺度损伤模型提供了分子级速率输入。
papers.method_zh: 基于过渡态理论（transition-state theory）的统计力学框架，将断裂建模为多通道首次断裂问题，采用自洽平均力势（potentials of mean force）描述键特异性速率，并对比自由连接链与有限弯曲刚度链的构象统计。

papers.title: A hidden low-temperature transformation pathway in compositionally complex materials
papers.abstract: Most compositionally complex materials (CCMs, frequently referred to as high entropy alloys) are metastable and their attractive properties often belong to kinetically trapped states. However, pathways towards lower-free-energy phase states governing long-term stability, can remain hidden because diffusion-controlled atomic redistribution is too slow to be revealed at experimentally accessible timescales. This blind spot is acute in CCM design: enormous compositional spaces are screened for performance, yet the low-temperature kinetics and the associated transformation pathways determining whether that performance persists are rarely considered in material selection. Here we use defect-rich nanoscale volumes coupled with atom-probe tomography to access and reconstruct the hidden phase-evolution pathway in a metastable Ag24Au20Pd50Pt6 electrocatalyst, without relying on elevated temperatures to accelerate the transformation. By varying microstructural starting state, annealing temperature and time, we reveal precipitation of a Pt-rich phase within the fcc matrix, its coarsening and re-homogenization. The Pt-rich phase recurs after homogenization with delayed kinetic accessibility, while prolonged annealing extends the pathway to 300°C. Atomistic simulations independently predict the same Pt-rich phase selection. The transformation is accompanied by a 3.7-fold loss of catalytic activity for hydrogen evolution. These results establish hidden phase-evolution pathways as a materials-design variable: resolving them can guide the selection of metastable CCMs not only for their as-synthesized properties, but also for the phase states and associated functionalities they may access over time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，辅以原子模拟）。判断依据：摘要提及“atom-probe tomography”实验手段，以及“Atomistic simulations independently predict”计算验证。；研究对象：成分复杂材料（CCMs，即高熵合金类）中亚稳态Ag24Au20Pd50Pt6电催化剂，具体研究其面心立方（fcc）基体中的低温相变路径与相演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无需升温加速的条件下，通过缺陷富集的纳米尺度体积结合原子探针层析技术，揭示了亚稳态CCM中隐藏的低温相演化路径：Pt-rich相从fcc基体中析出、粗化并再均匀化，且该相在均匀化后延迟再现；此相变伴随析氢催化活性降低3.7倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无需升温加速的条件下，通过缺陷富集的纳米尺度体积结合原子探针层析技术，揭示了亚稳态CCM中隐藏的低温相演化路径：Pt-rich相从fcc基体中析出、粗化并再均匀化，且该相在均匀化后延迟再现；此相变伴随析氢催化活性降低3.7倍。；创新点：首次将“隐藏的低温相演化路径”确立为材料设计变量——不依赖高温加速相变，直接在可及时间尺度内重构亚稳态CCM的低温动力学路径，从而为筛选兼具初始性能与长期相态稳定性的CCM提供新准则。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用缺陷富集纳米体积（defect-rich nanoscale volumes）耦合原子探针层析（atom-probe tomography, APT），通过改变微观起始状态、退火温度和退火时间系统追踪相演化；计算上采用原子模拟（atomistic simulations）独立预测Pt-rich相的选择。

papers.title: Influence of the inter-orbital interaction and kinetic terms on superconductivity: a simple two-orbital Hubbard model
papers.abstract: We investigate a minimal two-orbital Hubbard model with intra- and inter-orbital nearest-neighbor hopping $t$ and $\tilde{t}$, as well as intra- and inter-orbital density-density interactions $U$ and $U'$ by means of variational ansätze based on Jastrow-Slater wave functions within quantum Monte Carlo techniques.
