To focus on the electronic mechanisms of superconductivity, we restrict the variational ansätze to uniform nonmagnetic states with an explicit pairing amplitude and compute the pairing correlations as a function of filling and model parameters. At $U/t=10$, superconducting correlations are highly enhanced by the presence of inter-orbital terms, $U'$ and $\tilde{t}$. For $\tilde{t}=0$, a finite value of $U'$ effectively screens the intra-orbital repulsion $U$, producing a shift in the superconducting dome. Consequently, inter-orbital repulsion yields a sizable increase in electron pairing compared to the single-orbital baseline. Furthermore, introducing a finite $\tilde{t}$ provides an additional boost to superconducting correlations, an effect driven by the simultaneous presence of flat and broad bands in the electronic structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用“variational ansätze”“quantum Monte Carlo techniques”等理论计算方法。；研究对象：一个包含轨道内与轨道间最近邻跳跃（t 与 t̃）以及轨道内与轨道间密度-密度相互作用（U 与 U′）的最小两轨道 Hubbard 模型，聚焦于电子机制驱动的超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 U/t=10 时，轨道间相互作用项（U′ 与 t̃）能显著增强超导关联；其中 U′ 可有效屏蔽轨道内排斥 U 并移动超导穹顶位置，而有限 t̃ 则因平带与宽带共存进一步促进电子配对。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 U/t=10 时，轨道间相互作用项（U′ 与 t̃）能显著增强超导关联；其中 U′ 可有效屏蔽轨道内排斥 U 并移动超导穹顶位置，而有限 t̃ 则因平带与宽带共存进一步促进电子配对。；创新点：系统分离并量化了轨道间库仑排斥 U′ 与轨道间跳跃 t̃ 对超导配对的独立贡献，揭示了轨道间排斥对单轨道基线的“屏蔽”效应，以及平带-宽带共存对配对的额外增强机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Jastrow-Slater 波函数的变分试探波函数，结合量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）技术；将变分空间限制为均匀非磁态并显式包含配对振幅，计算配对关联随填充和模型参数的变化。

papers.title: Josephson effect in bipolar magnetic semiconductors
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate equilibrium currents in a one-dimensional Josephson junction incorporating a bipolar magnetic semiconductor (BMS). We show that the intrinsic exchange splitting of the spin-resolved bands enables purely electrical control of the $0$--$π$ transition through gate-tunable modulation of the BMS chemical potential, eliminating the need for an external magnetic field. This provides a viable route toward electrically tunable $π$-junction behavior and highlights the potential of BMS-based Josephson devices for phase-controllable superconducting electronics. Furthermore, in the presence of Rashba spin--orbit coupling, we find an anomalous Josephson effect characterized by a finite equilibrium supercurrent at zero phase difference. This behavior originates from the intrinsic breaking of time-reversal symmetry associated with the spin-polarized electronic structure of the BMS. Interestingly, despite the simultaneous breaking of time-reversal and inversion symmetries---conditions often associated with nonreciprocal superconducting transport---we do not observe a Josephson diode effect. Our results therefore highlight an important distinction between anomalous Josephson transport and superconducting nonreciprocity: the former does not necessarily imply a finite critical-current asymmetry between opposite current directions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“theoretically investigate”，且研究基于模型计算（一维约瑟夫森结）。；研究对象：一维约瑟夫森结中的双极磁性半导体（BMS），具体研究其平衡超流、0–π跃迁、反常约瑟夫森效应及约瑟夫森二极管效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BMS的内禀交换劈裂可实现纯电学调控的0–π跃迁（无需外磁场）；在Rashba自旋轨道耦合下出现零相位差时有限平衡超流的反常约瑟夫森效应，但未观察到约瑟夫森二极管效应，表明反常约瑟夫森输运并不必然伴随临界电流的非互易性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BMS的内禀交换劈裂可实现纯电学调控的0–π跃迁（无需外磁场）；在Rashba自旋轨道耦合下出现零相位差时有限平衡超流的反常约瑟夫森效应，但未观察到约瑟夫森二极管效应，表明反常约瑟夫森输运并不必然伴随临界电流的非互易性。；创新点：首次提出利用BMS的内禀交换劈裂实现无需外磁场的电学可调π结；并明确指出反常约瑟夫森效应与约瑟夫森二极管效应（非互易输运）之间的物理区别——前者不必然导致后者。
papers.method_zh: 理论模型计算：一维约瑟夫森结的平衡电流计算，基于BMS自旋分辨能带的内禀交换劈裂，结合门电压调控化学势，并引入Rashba自旋轨道耦合进行分析。

papers.title: Critical bifurcation and deconfined quantum criticality in an interacting cluster Ising chain
papers.abstract: We investigate the cluster Ising chain with an additional nearest-neighbor interaction using tensor-network methods and a weak-coupling field theory. Without the interaction, the Jordan-Wigner transformation decomposes the model into a triplet of identical Majorana chains related by an exact $O(3)$ flavor symmetry. Their common mass vanishes at the $SU(2)_2$ Wess-Zumino-Novikov-Witten critical point with central charge $c = 3/2$ separating the symmetry-protected topological cluster phase from a ferromagnet. The interaction reduces $O(3)$ to its cyclic subgroup $C_3$, splitting the triplet into a singlet and a doublet whose gaps close separately, producing a critical bifurcation into Ising ($c = 1/2$) and Gaussian ($c = 1$) critical lines. A second ferromagnetic phase opens between these critical lines for repulsive interactions and a disordered phase for attractive ones. The Gaussian line then separates two Landau-incompatible ferromagnets, realizing a deconfined quantum critical line with emergent $O(2)$ symmetry, along which our independently extracted exponents vary continuously yet satisfy the parameter-free relation $β= (2ν- 1)/4$ of the eight-vertex weak universality class. At stronger repulsion this line opens into an extended gapless floating phase with incommensurate algebraic correlations, entered through Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transitions. All of these phases and the transitions between them are captured by the weak-coupling theory. Beyond its regime of validity, our simulations reveal a translation-symmetry-breaking antiferromagnet reached through first-order transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合型文章。判断依据：使用张量网络方法（tensor-network methods）和弱耦合场论（weak-coupling field theory）。；研究对象：具有额外最近邻相互作用的簇伊辛链（cluster Ising chain），一个一维量子自旋链模型。涉及对称性保护拓扑（SPT）簇相、铁磁相、去禁闭量子临界（deconfined quantum criticality）等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在相互作用驱动下发生临界分岔（critical bifurcation），产生Ising（c=1/2）和Gaussian（c=1）两条临界线；其中Gaussian临界线连接两个Landau不相容的铁磁相，实现了一条具有涌现O(2)对称性的去禁闭量子临界线，其临界指数满足八顶点弱普适类的无参数关系β=(2ν-1)/4。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在相互作用驱动下发生临界分岔（critical bifurcation），产生Ising（c=1/2）和Gaussian（c=1）两条临界线；其中Gaussian临界线连接两个Landau不相容的铁磁相，实现了一条具有涌现O(2)对称性的去禁闭量子临界线，其临界指数满足八顶点弱普适类的无参数关系β=(2ν-1)/4。；创新点：揭示了相互作用将O(3)对称性约化为循环子群C₃后，原先三重简并的Majorana链发生临界分岔，从而在簇Ising链中实现了去禁闭量子临界线，并建立了其与八顶点弱普适类的联系。摘要未突出说明与已有去禁闭量子临界研究的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 张量网络方法（tensor-network methods）用于数值模拟；弱耦合场论（weak-coupling field theory）用于解析分析。具体涉及Jordan-Wigner变换、SU(2)₂ Wess-Zumino-Novikov-Witten（WZNW）临界理论、Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）跃迁分析。

papers.title: Off-stoichiometric variable doping for exceptional power factors in L2$_1$ Fe$_2$VAlM$_x$ (M=Ti, W) epitaxial thin films
papers.abstract: We show that the addition of Ti or W to stoichiometric L2$_1$ Fe$_2$VAl thin films by sputter codeposition produces off stoichiometric thin film alloys with superior thermoelectric properties than their stoichiometric counterparts. Ti incorporation induces p-type semiconducting behavior, while W incorporation shifts the material toward n-type, hereby enabling simultaneous tuning of both carrier types within a single parent (Fe$_2$VAl) material system, making it highly desirable for thermoelectric devices. The introduction of both Ti and W partly substitutes V in the stoichiometric compound. The partial substitution of V in the stoichiometric alloy allows fine-tuning the band structure of the system and transport properties. With this approach we obtain exceptional maximum power factor values for p and n-type films of 1300 $μ$W/m$\cdot$K$^2$ and 2100 $μ$W/m$\cdot$K$^2$ ,respectively, yielding maximum figures of merit zT of 0.07 and 0.14, respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“sputter codeposition”（溅射共沉积）制备薄膜，并测量了热电性能（功率因子、zT值）。；研究对象：L2₁有序结构的Fe₂VAl基薄膜，通过非化学计量掺杂Ti或W（Fe₂VAlMₓ，M=Ti, W）形成的合金薄膜，研究其热电输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在化学计量比Fe₂VAl薄膜中掺入Ti或W可形成非化学计量合金薄膜，其热电性能优于化学计量比样品：Ti掺杂诱导p型半导体行为，W掺杂使材料转向n型，从而在同一母体材料体系中实现双载流子类型调控。p型和n型薄膜分别获得高达1300 μW/m·K²和2100 μW/m·K²的功率因子，对应zT值分别为0.07和0.14。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在化学计量比Fe₂VAl薄膜中掺入Ti或W可形成非化学计量合金薄膜，其热电性能优于化学计量比样品：Ti掺杂诱导p型半导体行为，W掺杂使材料转向n型，从而在同一母体材料体系中实现双载流子类型调控。p型和n型薄膜分别获得高达1300 μW/m·K²和2100 μW/m·K²的功率因子，对应zT值分别为0.07和0.14。；创新点：在单一母体材料（Fe₂VAl）中通过Ti和W的分别掺入实现p型和n型热电性能的同时调控，避免了传统热电材料需要不同母体体系分别优化p/n型的问题；且非化学计量掺杂可精细调节能带结构和输运性质，获得远超化学计量比样品的功率因子。摘要未突出说明与已有非化学计量掺杂工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 溅射共沉积（sputter codeposition）制备外延薄膜；通过Ti或W部分替代V实现非化学计量掺杂；测量热电输运性质（功率因子、zT值）。摘要未明确说明具体表征手段（如XRD、TEM等）或输运测量细节。

papers.title: Influence of Interface Energy Anisotropy on the Solid-state Instability in Ni-based Superalloy: A Multiscale Study
papers.abstract: The microstructural stability of nickel-based superalloys critically depends on the morphology and evolution of $γ'$-precipitates, which is governed by elastic and interfacial anisotropies at the atomic scale. Here, we present a novel quantitative multiscale framework that, for the first time, directly incorporates atomistically computed interface energy anisotropy into mesoscale phase-field simulations to elucidate morphological selection and instability in the Ni--Al system. We employ density functional theory (DFT) to accurately predict the orientation-dependent $γ/γ'$ interface energies for key crystallographic planes. A rigorous analytic mapping is then developed to systematically reduce the three-dimensional (3D) interface anisotropy landscape to the two-dimensional (2D) simulation plane. This enables quantitative transfer of DFT-informed anisotropy parameters into a continuum phase-field model that also accounts for elastic inhomogeneity and eigenstrain. Our simulations demonstrate that the explicit inclusion of DFT-based interface energy anisotropy fundamentally alters precipitate morphological evolution, robustly suppressing instability and faceting phenomena otherwise promoted by supersaturation and elastic effects. The framework bridges atomic- to mesoscale modeling, enabling predictive control of precipitate shapes and providing new insights into the interplay of elastic and interfacial contributions in Ni-based superalloys. This approach paves the way for quantitative microstructural design in advanced high-temperature alloys via first-principles-guided multiscale simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“density functional theory (DFT)”“phase-field simulations”“multiscale framework”等计算模拟关键词。；研究对象：镍基高温合金中γ′析出相的微观组织稳定性，具体为Ni–Al体系中γ/γ′界面能各向异性对析出相形态选择与失稳行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将基于DFT计算的界面能各向异性显式引入介观相场模拟后，会从根本上改变γ′析出相的形态演化，并有效抑制由过饱和和弹性效应所促进的不稳定性和小面化现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将基于DFT计算的界面能各向异性显式引入介观相场模拟后，会从根本上改变γ′析出相的形态演化，并有效抑制由过饱和和弹性效应所促进的不稳定性和小面化现象。；创新点：首次将原子尺度计算的界面能各向异性直接定量嵌入介观相场模拟，实现了从原子尺度到介观尺度的无缝衔接，为基于第一性原理指导的高温合金定量微观组织设计提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用多尺度计算框架：第一性原理DFT计算关键晶面的γ/γ′界面能；建立解析映射将三维界面能各向异性信息降维到二维模拟平面；将DFT参数定量传递到包含弹性不均匀性和本征应变的连续介质相场模型中。

papers.title: Two Microscopic Mechanisms of Piezomagnetism in CoF$_2$ from First-Principles Calculations
papers.abstract: Rutile-structured CoF$_2$ has long been recognized as a prototypical piezomagnetic material. Recently, it has attracted renewed interest as an altermagnet, exhibiting spin-split electronic bands even in the absence of spin-orbit coupling. Although the piezomagnetic response of CoF$_2$ has been extensively discussed from the viewpoint of magnetic symmetry, its microscopic origin has remained elusive. First-principles calculations reveal two distinct microscopic mechanisms of piezomagnetism in CoF$_2$. Under $xy$ shear strain, the local volumes of the CoF$_6$ octahedra surrounding the two Co sites become different, leading to unequal magnetic moments on the two sublattices and hence a net magnetization. In contrast, under $yz$ shear strain, the piezomagnetic response originates from spin canting induced by the Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction through spin-orbit coupling. The presence of two distinct microscopic mechanisms may be a general feature of piezomagnetic antiferromagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“First-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：金红石结构的CoF₂，一种典型的压磁材料，同时也是近期备受关注的交错磁体（altermagnet）。研究聚焦于其压磁效应的微观机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CoF₂中存在两种截然不同的压磁微观机制：在xy剪切应变下，两个Co位周围的CoF₆八面体局域体积发生不对称变化，导致两个子晶格磁矩不等，从而产生净磁化；而在yz剪切应变下，压磁响应则源于自旋轨道耦合驱动的Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用引起的自旋倾斜。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CoF₂中存在两种截然不同的压磁微观机制：在xy剪切应变下，两个Co位周围的CoF₆八面体局域体积发生不对称变化，导致两个子晶格磁矩不等，从而产生净磁化；而在yz剪切应变下，压磁响应则源于自旋轨道耦合驱动的Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用引起的自旋倾斜。；创新点：首次从微观电子结构层面揭示了CoF₂中压磁效应的两种不同物理起源，并指出“多种微观机制并存”可能是压磁反铁磁体的一般特征。摘要未突出说明与以往唯象对称性分析的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（密度泛函理论，DFT），具体用于分析不同剪切应变下的电子结构、局域磁矩变化以及自旋轨道耦合效应。

papers.title: Excitonic fingerprints of magnetic configurations and switching in multilayer CrSBr
papers.abstract: The coupling between electronic states and magnetism provides a route towards optical readout and control of magnetic information. In the magnetic semiconductor CrSBr, excitons are coupled to magnetic order, making their optical response sensitive to the underlying magnetization. Here, we show that the energy and oscillator strength of bulk and surface excitons provide distinct spectroscopic fingerprints of magnetic configurations and switching pathways. We distinguish domain-wall-mediated magnetization reversal, manifested by continuous spectral evolution as a domain wall traverses the optical spot, from abrupt, large-area magnetization reversal. Using the resulting excitonic fingerprints, we reconstruct successive magnetic configurations in 4- and 5-layer CrSBr during the transition from ferromagnetic to antiferromagnetic order. We further find that the sensitivity to magnetic order is strongly exciton-dependent: low-energy excitons resolve intermediate and surface-related configurations, whereas a higher-energy exciton predominantly exhibits a transfer of oscillator strength between ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic resonances. These results establish excitonic spectroscopy as a sensitive probe of layer-dependent magnetic configurations and their switching pathways in layered magnetic semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“we show”“we distinguish”“we reconstruct”等实验性表述，以及“optical response”“spectroscopic fingerprints”等光学测量手段。；研究对象：多层磁性半导体CrSBr（4层和5层），具体研究其激子光学响应与磁构型（铁磁→反铁磁转变）及磁化反转路径之间的耦合关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 体相和表面激子的能量与振子强度可提供磁构型和磁化反转路径的独特光谱指纹，能够区分畴壁介导的连续磁化反转与突变的面积型磁化反转，并据此重构多层CrSBr在铁磁→反铁磁转变过程中的逐层磁构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：体相和表面激子的能量与振子强度可提供磁构型和磁化反转路径的独特光谱指纹，能够区分畴壁介导的连续磁化反转与突变的面积型磁化反转，并据此重构多层CrSBr在铁磁→反铁磁转变过程中的逐层磁构型。；创新点：首次利用激子光谱指纹区分两种不同的磁化反转路径（畴壁介导的连续反转 vs. 大面积突变反转），并实现对多层CrSBr逐层磁构型的重构；同时发现不同能量激子对磁序的敏感度不同——低能激子分辨中间态和表面相关构型，高能激子主要体现铁磁/反铁磁共振间的振子强度转移。
papers.method_zh: 激子光谱学（光学反射/吸收光谱，通过激子能量和振子强度变化追踪磁构型），结合多层CrSBr样品（4层和5层）的磁化反转过程测量。摘要未明确说明具体光谱技术（如偏振分辨反射谱、磁光光谱等）的细节。

papers.title: A Minimal Thermodynamically Consistent Chemical Oscillator
papers.abstract: Inspired by the chemical reaction network considered as the smallest system featuring a Hopf bifurcation and its reversible extension, we introduce an even more minimal reaction network that is thermodynamically consistent and exhibits autonomous oscillations under nonequilibrium driving. The model combines three features that are rarely realized simultaneously in compact oscillator networks: a chemically plausible structure restricted to uni- and bimolecular reactions, reversibility of such reactions, and analytical tractability. The system consists of three internal species coupled to two chemostatted species and still undergoes a supercritical Hopf bifurcation when a chemostat concentration is varied. To analyze the dynamics and thermodynamics near the onset of oscillations, we employ the mathematical technique of normal-form reduction, which allows obtaining a controlled irreversible approximation that preserves the leading phase-space structure of the full reversible network while enabling explicit calculations. This framework provides analytical access to the bifurcation structure and the leading contributions governing thermodynamic observables. Within this setting, we use the onset of oscillations to characterize the thermodynamic response of the system. In particular, we offer an analytical description of key thermodynamic quantities such as the semi-grand Gibbs free energy and the non-conservative work rate, which exhibit a kink-like discontinuity at the Hopf bifurcation. We thus provide an analytical description of a phenomenon previously characterized only through numerical simulations of more complex networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“analytical tractability”“normal-form reduction”“explicit calculations”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：一个由三种内部化学物种和两种化学恒化物种（chemostatted species）组成的极小化学反应网络，该网络在非平衡驱动下呈现自主振荡，并在Hopf分岔附近表现出热力学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该最小反应网络在保持热力学一致性的前提下，通过改变恒化物种浓度可发生超临界Hopf分岔，并在分岔点处半巨Gibbs自由能和非保守功率等热力学量出现kink状不连续，首次以解析方式刻画了这一此前仅通过数值模拟观察到的现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该最小反应网络在保持热力学一致性的前提下，通过改变恒化物种浓度可发生超临界Hopf分岔，并在分岔点处半巨Gibbs自由能和非保守功率等热力学量出现kink状不连续，首次以解析方式刻画了这一此前仅通过数值模拟观察到的现象。；创新点：该模型同时具备化学上合理的单分子/双分子反应结构、反应可逆性以及解析可解性，这三个特征在紧凑振荡网络中很少同时实现；此外，首次对Hopf分岔处的热力学响应（如半巨Gibbs自由能和非保守功率的kink状不连续）给出解析描述，而此前仅能通过数值模拟研究更复杂网络。
papers.method_zh: 采用化学反应网络理论，结合Hopf分岔分析与正规形约化（normal-form reduction）技术，在保持完整可逆网络相空间结构的前提下获得可控的不可逆近似，从而解析计算分岔结构和热力学可观测量。

papers.title: Depth-Resolved Evolution of Buried Polar Topologies in a PbTiO3/SrTiO3 Superlattice
papers.abstract: Polar topologies in complex oxides gives rise to a rich spectrum of emergent functionalities and are fundamentally governed by three-dimensional (3D) atomic structures. However, direct experimental determination of buried 3D polar configurations remains a longstanding challenge because conventional (scanning) transmission electron microscopy ((S)TEM) provides primarily projected structural information with limited depth sensitivity. Here, we combine depth-sectioning low-angle annular dark-field (LAADF) STEM, high-angle ADF (HAADF) STEM, and multislice electron ptychography (MEP) to directly visualize the depth-dependent atomic structure and polarization topology in a PTO/STO superlattice. Depth-sectioning STEM reveals pronounced focal-depth-dependent contrast variations and apparent splitting of Pb atomic columns, indicating significant structural heterogeneity along the beam direction. MEP reconstruction simultaneously resolves the Pb, Ti, and O sublattices with nanometer-scale depth resolution, enabling quantitative mapping of atomic displacements throughout the reconstructed volume. The resulting 3D atomic model reveals substantial depth-dependent displacements of Pb, Ti, and O atoms and a corresponding evolution of the polarization topology. Vortex-like polarization structures are observed near the specimen surfaces but become strongly suppressed within the interior, where distinct polarization configurations emerge. These findings show that polarization patterns observed in conventional projection images can arise from the superposition of multiple depth-dependent polar states and may obscure the underlying 3D polarization texture. Our findings establish a direct experimental link between local atomic displacements and depth-dependent polarization topology, opening new opportunities for investigating and engineering buried functional states in complex oxide nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“directly visualize”“Depth-sectioning STEM”“MEP reconstruction”等实验观测与重构手段。；研究对象：PbTiO3/SrTiO3（PTO/STO）超晶格中埋藏的三维极化拓扑结构，特别是涡旋状极化构型及其随深度的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在PTO/STO超晶格中，涡旋状极化结构仅存在于样品表面附近，在内部被强烈抑制并转变为不同的极化构型；传统投影图像中观察到的极化图案实际上是多个深度依赖极化态的叠加，可能掩盖真实的三维极化纹理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在PTO/STO超晶格中，涡旋状极化结构仅存在于样品表面附近，在内部被强烈抑制并转变为不同的极化构型；传统投影图像中观察到的极化图案实际上是多个深度依赖极化态的叠加，可能掩盖真实的三维极化纹理。；创新点：首次通过实验直接实现了埋藏三维极化拓扑结构的深度分辨原子尺度成像，建立了局域原子位移与深度依赖极化拓扑之间的直接实验联系，揭示了投影成像中极化图案可能由多个深度态叠加所致的混淆效应。
papers.method_zh: 结合深度切片低角度环形暗场扫描透射电子显微镜（LAADF-STEM）、高角度环形暗场STEM（HAADF-STEM）以及多层电子叠层衍射成像（multislice electron ptychography, MEP），实现纳米级深度分辨的三维原子结构重构，并定量提取Pb、Ti、O原子位移。

papers.title: Frustration-induced degenerate spin state with up-up-down-down ordering in corner-connected Heisenberg square-plaquettes
papers.abstract: We investigate frustrated magnetism of a corner-connected square plaquette Heisenberg model with exchange interactions along the edges $(J_1)$, along inter-plaquette links $(J_2)$, and along square diagonals $(J_3)$. Using Luttinger--Tisza (LT) minimization of the Fourier interaction matrix $\mathcal J(\mathbf q)$ together with large-scale Monte Carlo (MC) simulations, we obtain a classical low-temperature magnetic phase diagram in the normalized plane $(J_1/|J_2|, J_3/|J_2|)$. The two methods play complementary roles: the LT analysis provides the zero-temperature candidate ordering wave vectors, while the MC simulations elucidate the resulting ordering tendencies under the hard-spin constraint at low but finite temperatures. Three regimes emerge at low temperatures, an antiferromagnetic phase (AF), a ferromagnetic phase (FM) and a degenerate spin state with \textit{up-up-down-down (uudd)} ordering (DS). For the frustrated degenerate spinstate, LT exhibits line-like minima along $q_x=\pm q_y$ in the $hk$-plane, revealing a highly degenerate spin configuration which violates the hard-spin constraint. The MC results uncover a state with quasi-two-dimensional ordering. The DS regime is intrinsically multi-$\mathbf{q}$: the ordered texture assembles itself from symmetry-related modes on the lines, producing a ``\textit{uudd}'' spin arrangement comprising of distinctive strong antiferromagnetic correlations on diagonals, ferromagnetic correlations on corner links, and highly suppressed correlations on the edges. The field-temperature phase diagram for a representative parameter point in the DS regime, determined by MC simulations, yields field induced distinct regions of negatively and positively correlated layers. These two regions are separated by a curve corresponding to negligible inter-layer correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Luttinger--Tisza (LT) minimization”和“large-scale Monte Carlo (MC) simulations”等理论计算方法。；研究对象：角连接正方形plaquette海森伯模型中的阻挫磁性，具体为具有边交换（J₁）、plaquette间交换（J₂）和对角线交换（J₃）的经典自旋系统，以及其低温磁有序和场-温度相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温下系统呈现三个区域：反铁磁（AF）、铁磁（FM）和一个具有up-up-down-down（uudd）有序的简并自旋态（DS）。DS态本质上是多q的，其自旋织构由对称性相关的模式组装而成，表现为对角线上强反铁磁关联、角连接上铁磁关联、边上关联被强烈抑制的准二维有序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温下系统呈现三个区域：反铁磁（AF）、铁磁（FM）和一个具有up-up-down-down（uudd）有序的简并自旋态（DS）。DS态本质上是多q的，其自旋织构由对称性相关的模式组装而成，表现为对角线上强反铁磁关联、角连接上铁磁关联、边上关联被强烈抑制的准二维有序。；创新点：揭示了LT分析中沿qₓ=±q_y的线状简并极小值（违反硬自旋约束）与MC模拟中实际出现的准二维uudd有序之间的互补关系，并首次刻画了DS区中场诱导的负/正关联层区域及其由层间关联可忽略的曲线分隔的相图结构。
papers.method_zh: Luttinger–Tisza（LT）方法对傅里叶相互作用矩阵𝒥(q)进行最小化，以获得零温候选有序波矢；大规模蒙特卡洛（MC）模拟用于研究硬自旋约束下有限低温的排序倾向，并确定场-温度相图。

papers.title: Geometric Thermodynamics of Scallop Motion with Two Control Parameters
papers.abstract: According to Purcell's scallop theorem, reciprocal single-degree-of-freedom shape deformations cannot achieve net propulsion in a viscous fluid. We show that this limitation is bypassed by thermal fluctuations in a two-parameter driven potential landscape. Formulating the stochastic shape dynamics via a Smoluchowski equation with position-dependent mobility $M_\mathrm{eff}(x)$, we utilize a generalized inverse operator to evaluate the slow-driving response. Cyclic modulation of the control parameters induces a non-zero Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman curvature $F_{12}(\bmθ)$, resulting in directed geometric propulsion. Simultaneously, the non-adiabatic excess dissipation is dictated by a Riemannian thermodynamic metric $g_{ij}(\bmθ)$. Our results provide a unified geometric foundation that bridges hydrodynamic friction, stochastic mechanics, and thermodynamic trade-offs in micro-swimmers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“Smoluchowski equation”“generalized inverse operator”“Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman curvature”“Riemannian thermodynamic metric”等理论推导与几何框架关键词，未提及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：微游泳者（micro-swimmers）在粘性流体中的随机形状动力学，具体为具有两个控制参数、位置依赖迁移率 \(M_\mathrm{eff}(x)\) 的驱动势能景观中的热涨落驱动运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双参数驱动势能景观中，热涨落可绕过Purcell扇贝定理的限制，通过循环调制控制参数产生非零的Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman曲率 \(F_{12}(\bm\theta)\)，从而实现定向几何推进；同时，非绝热过剩耗散由黎曼热力学度规 \(g_{ij}(\bm\theta)\) 决定，为微游泳器建立了统一几何热力学基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双参数驱动势能景观中，热涨落可绕过Purcell扇贝定理的限制，通过循环调制控制参数产生非零的Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman曲率 \(F_{12}(\bm\theta)\)，从而实现定向几何推进；同时，非绝热过剩耗散由黎曼热力学度规 \(g_{ij}(\bm\theta)\) 决定，为微游泳器建立了统一几何热力学基础。；创新点：将水动力摩擦、随机力学与热力学权衡统一在几何框架下，首次在双参数驱动势能景观中展示热涨落可突破扇贝定理限制，并同时给出定向推进与耗散的几何描述。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于Smoluchowski方程的随机形状动力学描述；利用广义逆算子评估慢驱动响应；引入几何曲率（Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman曲率）与黎曼热力学度规分析推进与耗散。

papers.title: Classification of Metal - Insulator Transitions: Relating characteristic Properties to Quantum Chemical Bonding Descriptors
papers.abstract: Pressure induced metal insulator transitions (MIT) are classified by the evolution of characteristic optoelectronic and vibrational properties calculated with density functional theory. Three classes emerge: ionic solids metallize continuously at band-gap closure with hardening phonons; covalent solids show discontinuous changes in atomic arrangement and optical phonon frequencies; a third class exhibits complete lattice softening and drastically enhanced electron phonon coupling. A one dimensional hydrogen chain reproduces this behavior and serves as a toy model of the underlying bonding mechanism, termed metavalent. Two quantum-chemical descriptors capture the distinct bonding changes behind the three classes. In metavalent solids, competing electron localization and delocalization yield soft optical modes and Peierls distortions on the insulating side, superconductivity on the metallic side, and low lattice thermal conductivity near the MIT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“calculated with density functional theory”（基于密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：压力诱导的金属-绝缘体转变（MIT），涵盖离子固体、共价固体以及第三类“金属价”（metavalent）固体，并引入一维氢链作为玩具模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金属-绝缘体转变可按其光电与振动性质随压力的演化分为三类：离子固体在带隙闭合时连续金属化且声子硬化；共价固体在原子排列和光学声子频率上出现不连续变化；第三类（金属价固体）表现出完全晶格软化与显著增强的电子-声子耦合。两个量子化学描述符可区分这三类转变背后的成键变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金属-绝缘体转变可按其光电与振动性质随压力的演化分为三类：离子固体在带隙闭合时连续金属化且声子硬化；共价固体在原子排列和光学声子频率上出现不连续变化；第三类（金属价固体）表现出完全晶格软化与显著增强的电子-声子耦合。两个量子化学描述符可区分这三类转变背后的成键变化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但明确提出了将MIT分类与量子化学成键描述符（尤其是“金属价”键合机制）直接关联的新框架，并用一维氢链复现三类行为，为理解金属价固体中软光学模、Peierls畸变、超导与低晶格热导率提供了统一机制解释。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，用于计算光电子与振动性质；一维氢链模型作为玩具模型；采用两个量子化学成键描述符（如电子局域化/离域化相关量）来表征成键机制。

papers.title: Phase-controlled perfect nonlocal spin and charge diode effects in a four-terminal Josephson junction with $p$-wave magnets
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate charge and spin transport in a four-terminal Josephson junction with a normal-metal barrier. The top and bottom superconducting leads are equal-spin triplet $p_y$-wave superconductors, while the left and right leads are $p$-wave magnets with proximity-induced conventional $s$-wave superconductivity. When the transverse macroscopic phase difference between the top and bottom leads is set to zero, a longitudinal phase bias generates a pure transverse spin current with perfect 100% nonreciprocity. Remarkably, a finite transverse phase difference preserves the perfect spin-diode effect while simultaneously inducing a perfect charge-diode effect, enabling fully nonreciprocal spin and charge transport. Moreover, the spin-diode efficiency exhibits sharp, step-like switching as a function of both the gate voltage applied to the barrier and the crystallographic orientation of the $p$-wave magnet, providing independent and experimentally accessible knobs for controlling the diode polarity. The diode response remains robust against asymmetric interface couplings, nonmagnetic disorder, variations in the relative singlet and triplet pairing strengths, temperature, and junction dimensions, demonstrating that the effect is not a consequence of fine-tuned parameters. These findings establish the proposed four-terminal junction as a highly tunable and structurally robust platform for dissipationless, phase-controlled spin and charge rectification, with potential applications in superconducting spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要使用“theoretically investigate”“we investigate”等表述，属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：四端约瑟夫森结，包含正常金属势垒、上下两个等自旋三重态 \(p_y\)-波超导电极，以及左右两个具有邻近诱导 \(s\)-波超导性的 \(p\)-波磁体电极。研究的是该体系中自旋与电荷的非互易输运（二极管效应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在纵向相位偏置下，体系可实现100%非互易的纯横向自旋电流（完美自旋二极管效应）；当引入有限横向宏观相位差时，在保持完美自旋二极管效应的同时，还诱导出完美的电荷二极管效应，实现自旋与电荷的全非互易输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在纵向相位偏置下，体系可实现100%非互易的纯横向自旋电流（完美自旋二极管效应）；当引入有限横向宏观相位差时，在保持完美自旋二极管效应的同时，还诱导出完美的电荷二极管效应，实现自旋与电荷的全非互易输运。；创新点：首次在含 \(p\)-波磁体的四端约瑟夫森结中实现相位调控的完美（100%）非互易自旋与电荷二极管效应，且自旋二极管极性可通过栅压和 \(p\)-波磁体晶向独立调控；效应在界面耦合不对称、非磁无序、配对强度变化、温度及结尺寸变化下均保持鲁棒，表明其非精细调参所致。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算框架，具体方法摘要未明确说明（未提及具体数值方法或解析技术，如散射矩阵、格林函数等）。

papers.title: Neutron scattering evidence for two-dimensionally coupled spin-dimerized antiferromagnetic lattice in α-Cu2P2O7
papers.abstract: The microscopic magnetic model of the low-dimensional quantum magnet alpha-Cu2P2O7 has remained controversial. We present a comprehensive study of its magnetic ground state and excitation spectrum using temperature-dependent inelastic neutron scattering, neutron diffraction, magnetization measurements, and comprehensive spin-wave modeling. Our results unambiguously establish alpha-Cu2P2O7 as a two-dimensionally coupled spin-dimerized antiferromagnetic (AF) lattice within the bc plane, with a dominant AF exchange J2 = 7.73 meV (hereafter referred to as "intradimer exchange") and weaker exchange couplings J1, J3, and J4 in the two-dimensional lattice (hereafter referred to as "interdimer exchange"), in agreement with LDA-based density functional theory and in contrast to previous GGA+U predictions. The dominant intradimer AF exchange is found between seventh-nearest-neighbor Cu-Cu ion pairs [d(Cu-Cu) = 5.125(3) A] rather than nearest-neighbor Cu-Cu ion pairs [d(Cu-Cu) = 3.014(1) A] of the structural dimers. Weak interlayer coupling (J5 = 0.03 meV) stabilizes long-range antiferromagnetic order below TN = 25 K. We further identify a weak single-ion anisotropy, associated with the distorted CuO5 polyhedra, that opens a gap in the spin-excitation spectrum and drives a field-induced metamagnetic transition. Systematic spin-wave calculations elucidate the distinct roles of interlayer coupling J5 and anisotropy term D in producing two distinct energy gaps at different antiferromagnetic zone centers. Complementary neutron diffraction and magnetization measurements as a function of applied magnetic field uncover a previously overlooked metamagnetic transition near 13 kOe and allow construction of the magnetic phase diagram in the H-T plane.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，辅以理论建模）。判断依据：使用了非弹性中子散射、中子衍射、磁化测量等实验手段，并结合自旋波计算（spin-wave modeling）和基于LDA的密度泛函理论（DFT）进行理论分析。；研究对象：低维量子磁体α-Cu2P2O7的磁性基态与自旋激发谱，具体关注其二维耦合的自旋二聚化反铁磁晶格结构、磁交换相互作用、磁各向异性及场致磁相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: α-Cu2P2O7被明确为bc平面内的二维耦合自旋二聚化反铁磁晶格，主导的“二聚体内”反铁磁交换J2 = 7.73 meV发生在结构二聚体中第七近邻Cu-Cu离子对之间（而非最近邻对），弱层间耦合J5 = 0.03 meV在TN = 25 K以下稳定长程反磁有序，并存在弱单离子各向异性导致自旋激发谱能隙及场致变磁转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：α-Cu2P2O7被明确为bc平面内的二维耦合自旋二聚化反铁磁晶格，主导的“二聚体内”反铁磁交换J2 = 7.73 meV发生在结构二聚体中第七近邻Cu-Cu离子对之间（而非最近邻对），弱层间耦合J5 = 0.03 meV在TN = 25 K以下稳定长程反磁有序，并存在弱单离子各向异性导致自旋激发谱能隙及场致变磁转变。；创新点：首次通过中子散射实验明确解决了α-Cu2P2O7磁性模型的争议，确立了主导交换发生在第七近邻Cu-Cu对而非结构二聚体最近邻对；发现了此前被忽视的约13 kOe处的变磁转变，并构建了H-T磁相图；通过自旋波计算阐明了层间耦合J5与各向异性项D在反铁磁区不同区中心产生两个不同能隙的各自作用。
papers.method_zh: 变温非弹性中子散射、中子衍射、磁化测量（含变场测量），以及系统的自旋波计算（spin-wave calculations）；理论对比采用基于LDA的密度泛函理论（DFT），并与之前的GGA+U预测进行对照。

papers.title: Bonding Signatures of Incipient Electron Localization in Topological Chiral Semimetals Near the Metal-Insulator Transition
papers.abstract: How do electronic localization and delocalization compete in solids beyond the traditional limiting cases of metals and iono-covalent insulators? Topological chiral semimetals (TCSMs), characterized by their unique crystal symmetry, offer an intriguing platform to explore this question. Here, we systematically compare TCSMs with covalent compounds, ordinary metals, and metavalent solids (incipient metals), and show that TCSMs occupy a distinct region in a multidimensional property fingerprint. Atom probe tomography reveals an unusual bond-rupture signature, consistent with a bonding regime intermediate between electron localization and delocalization. This interpretation is supported by measurements of optical properties showing a transfer of spectral weight from interband to intraband transitions. For highly conductive TCSMs, this transition is accompanied by the disappearance of the Born effective charge, a measure of chemical bond polarizability, while less conductive TCSMs retain a nonzero value. Together, these results identify a property based bonding perspective on TCSMs that distinguishes them from metals, covalent solids, and metavalent compounds. Although metavalent solids and TCSMs both lie near the metal-insulator transition and exhibit distorted crystal structures, ultrafast coherent phonon spectroscopy reveals fundamentally different lattice-dynamical responses: a phonon-driven Peierls-like instability in metavalent solids versus a robust chiral B20 bonding motif in TCSMs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，结合理论对比分析）。判断依据：摘要提及“Atom probe tomography”“optical properties”“ultrafast coherent phonon spectroscopy”等实验手段，同时涉及“multidimensional property fingerprint”和Born有效电荷等理论/计算分析。；研究对象：拓扑手性半金属（TCSMs），特别是其接近金属-绝缘体转变时的电子局域化与退局域化竞争行为，以及其与共价化合物、普通金属和金属价固体（incipient metals）的对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: TCSMs在性质指纹图中占据一个区别于金属、共价固体和金属价化合物的独特区域，其化学键介于电子局域化与退局域化之间；尽管与金属价固体都接近金属-绝缘体转变且具有畸变晶体结构，但二者在晶格动力学上表现出根本不同的响应：金属价固体具有声子驱动的Peierls类不稳定性，而TCSMs保持稳健的手性B20键合构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：TCSMs在性质指纹图中占据一个区别于金属、共价固体和金属价化合物的独特区域，其化学键介于电子局域化与退局域化之间；尽管与金属价固体都接近金属-绝缘体转变且具有畸变晶体结构，但二者在晶格动力学上表现出根本不同的响应：金属价固体具有声子驱动的Peierls类不稳定性，而TCSMs保持稳健的手性B20键合构型。；创新点：首次从化学键合角度系统建立TCSMs的多维性质指纹，将其与金属、共价固体和金属价化合物明确区分，并揭示TCSMs与金属价固体在近金属-绝缘体转变处截然不同的晶格动力学机制。
papers.method_zh: 原子探针断层扫描（APT）用于探测键断裂特征；光学性质测量用于分析带间到带内跃迁的光谱权重转移；Born有效电荷计算用于评估化学键极化率；超快相干声子谱学用于研究晶格动力学响应。

papers.title: Weaving Hopfions from Emergent Monopoles in a Chiral Magnet
papers.abstract: Recent advances in three-dimensional magnetization imaging techniques have opened new avenues for exploring topological spin textures beyond domain walls and skyrmions. Among them, magnetic hopfions are particularly promising, as their knotted topology is expected to give rise to unconventional dynamics and responses; however, their controlled creation remains challenging. Here we propose a simple mechanism for generating hopfions from magnetic torons, three-dimensional textures hosting an emergent monopole-antimonopole pair. Using Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations, we show that an electric current drives the annihilation of this pair, converting a toron into a hopfion. The initial toron length determines the number of generated hopfions, while the current direction selects the sign of the Hopf invariant. We further find that the threshold current depends sensitively on material parameters, indicating a close connection to skyrmion dynamics. Our results establish an experimentally accessible route to hopfion creation and reveal a pathway from monopole defects to knotted topological textures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Using Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations”（使用LLG模拟），属于微磁学计算。；研究对象：手性磁体（chiral magnet）中的三维拓扑自旋结构，具体为磁托龙（magnetic toron，包含一个涌现磁单极-反磁单极对）向磁霍普夫子（hopfion）的转化过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加电流，可以驱动磁托龙中涌现磁单极-反磁单极对的湮灭，从而将托龙转化为霍普夫子；初始托龙长度决定生成的霍普夫子数量，电流方向决定霍普夫子拓扑荷（Hopf不变量）的符号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加电流，可以驱动磁托龙中涌现磁单极-反磁单极对的湮灭，从而将托龙转化为霍普夫子；初始托龙长度决定生成的霍普夫子数量，电流方向决定霍普夫子拓扑荷（Hopf不变量）的符号。；创新点：提出了一种实验上可行的霍普夫子可控生成机制——利用电流驱动磁单极对湮灭，将拓扑缺陷（单极）转化为纽结拓扑结构（霍普夫子），并建立了与斯格明子动力学的联系。摘要未突出说明与已有霍普夫子生成方案的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 微磁学模拟，具体采用Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert（LLG）方程描述自旋动力学，模拟电流驱动的磁化演化过程。

papers.title: Composite fermions in the $ν=3$ fractional quantum spin Hall effect
papers.abstract: Well-understood fractional quantum Hall states in GaAs and graphene can be described in terms of weakly interacting composite fermions. It is natural to expect that the same unifying principle applies to the putative fractional quantum spin Hall effect in MoTe$_2$. Since the quantum spin Hall effect involves two spin components, two types of composite fermions must be present. We classify all two-component composite-fermion states at the filling factor $ν=3$. The classification includes the three classes of states, which were introduced from different physical perspectives in Refs. Sodemann Villadiego, Phys. Rev. B 110, 045114 (2024), Jian et al., Phys. Rev. X 15, 021063 (2025), and May-Mann et al., Phys. Rev. B 111, L201111, (2025), as well as two new classes of states. A majority of the composite-fermion states break the time-reversal symmetry. We review quasiparticle charges, statistics, and edge theories for each possible state. We also address a way of identifying the experimentally relevant state or states. This can be accomplished by combining three probes. First, the shot noise technique provides information about fractional charges. Second, thermal conductance helps count edge modes. The third probe is based on a new idea and involves transport between two quantum point contacts along a single edge. We find that the current from one contact to the other depends on the shape of the edge channel, which can be controlled with a side gate. The probe reveals the emergent symmetry group of the low-energy edge theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：classification（分类）、edge theories（边缘理论）、提出新探测方案。；研究对象：MoTe₂ 中填充因子 ν=3 的分数量子自旋霍尔效应，具体研究该体系中双分量复合费米子态的分类与性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 ν=3 分数量子自旋霍尔效应中，所有双分量复合费米子态可分为五类，其中包含文献中已提出的三类态和两个新类态；大多数此类复合费米子态会破坏时间反演对称性。此外，提出结合散粒噪声、热导和一种基于单边上两个量子点接触间输运的新探针，可鉴别实验上实际实现的具体态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 ν=3 分数量子自旋霍尔效应中，所有双分量复合费米子态可分为五类，其中包含文献中已提出的三类态和两个新类态；大多数此类复合费米子态会破坏时间反演对称性。此外，提出结合散粒噪声、热导和一种基于单边上两个量子点接触间输运的新探针，可鉴别实验上实际实现的具体态。；创新点：首次在 ν=3 分数量子自旋霍尔效应中给出所有双分量复合费米子态的统一分类，并发现两个新态类；提出一种全新的实验探针（基于单边上两个量子点接触间的输运），可探测边缘理论的涌现对称群，用于区分不同候选态。
papers.method_zh: 理论分类与对称性分析：基于复合费米子图像对双分量态进行系统分类；结合准粒子电荷、统计（分数统计）和边缘理论（低能边缘理论）分析；提出利用散粒噪声测量分数电荷、热导计数边缘模数，以及通过侧门调控边缘通道形状并测量两个量子点接触间电流来揭示低能边缘理论的涌现对称群。

papers.title: Scattering-Induced Magnon Layer-Hall Transport beyond Band Geometry
papers.abstract: The layer Hall effect has been exclusively attributed to layer-locked Berry curvature, posing a fundamental barrier to its realization in conventional magnets. Here we report a fundamentally distinct layer Hall effect for bosonic excitations, i.e., magnons, which originates solely from non-reciprocal dipolar scattering at heterointerfaces, thereby decoupling the phenomenon from geometric-phase mechanisms. Using a microscopic scattering theory, we demonstrate that a longitudinal temperature gradient drives opposite transverse thermal Hall currents in a nanowire atop a magnetic film, with the direction fully reconfigurable by the applied magnetic field. The effect yields a significant Hall angle of $\sim 6^{\circ}$ in conventional magnetic heterostructures, eliminating the need for topological engineering. Our findings establish a scattering-driven paradigm for layer Hall effect, extendable to ferrons and polar phonons, and predict a Hall response that is readily detectable in conventional magnetic heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“微观散射理论”（microscopic scattering theory）和理论推导，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：磁性异质结构中的磁子（magnon）层霍尔效应，具体体系为置于磁性薄膜之上的纳米线（nanowire atop a magnetic film），关注纵向温度梯度驱动的横向热霍尔输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁子层霍尔效应可以完全由异质界面处的非互易偶极散射产生，而非依赖于层锁定的贝里曲率；该效应在常规磁性异质结构中即可实现，霍尔角约为6°，且方向可由外加磁场重配置。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁子层霍尔效应可以完全由异质界面处的非互易偶极散射产生，而非依赖于层锁定的贝里曲率；该效应在常规磁性异质结构中即可实现，霍尔角约为6°，且方向可由外加磁场重配置。；创新点：首次将层霍尔效应从几何相位（贝里曲率）机制中解耦，提出散射驱动的层霍尔效应新范式，无需拓扑工程即可在常规磁性异质结构中实现，并预言该机制可推广至ferrons和极化声子。
papers.method_zh: 微观散射理论（microscopic scattering theory），用于分析界面散射对磁子输运的影响；通过温度梯度驱动并计算横向热霍尔电流。

papers.title: Quantum-geometry stabilization of dilute fractional Chern insulators
papers.abstract: Fractional Chern insulators have attracted broad interest as lattice analogs of fractional quantum Hall states without Landau levels. However, low-filling fractional Chern insulators are fragile because charge-ordered phases can compete strongly with the fractional topological liquid. Here, we propose a center-decorated kagome model, motivated by geometry-tunable artificial lattices, in which the center-site hopping $t_2$ provides a direct knob for the quantum geometry of an isolated $C=1$ flat band. Here quantum geometry refers to the Berry curvature and Fubini--Study metric, which determine the form factors of interactions projected into the Chern band. Exact diagonalization shows that tuning $t_2$ away from the flatness-optimized kagome limit reduces the trace-condition deviation, suppresses competing charge order, and enhances the many-body stability at both $ν=1/3$ and the more fragile $ν=1/5$ filling. At $ν=1/5$, this stability-enhanced window persists under nearby interaction profiles, including variations of the dominant third-neighbor repulsion and weak nearest-neighbor admixtures. Low-energy spectra, spectral flow, quasihole and entanglement counting, static structure factors, and the quantized total many-body Chern number $C_{\mathrm{tot}}=1$ consistently support Laughlin-like fractional Chern insulators. These results identify quantum-geometry engineering as a route to stabilizing dilute fractional Chern insulators beyond band-flatness optimization alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“Exact diagonalization”（精确对角化）、“many-body Chern number”（多体陈数）等数值计算方法关键词。；研究对象：中心装饰的kagome（蜂窝）晶格模型，具体研究低填充分数陈绝缘体（fractional Chern insulators）在ν=1/3和ν=1/5填充下的多体稳定性，以及量子几何（Berry曲率和Fubini–Study度规）对拓扑平带中相互作用投影的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节中心位点hopping参数t₂，可以优化量子几何（减小trace-condition偏差），从而抑制竞争性电荷序，在ν=1/3和更脆弱的ν=1/5填充下增强分数陈绝缘体的多体稳定性，实现Laughlin-like的拓扑态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节中心位点hopping参数t₂，可以优化量子几何（减小trace-condition偏差），从而抑制竞争性电荷序，在ν=1/3和更脆弱的ν=1/5填充下增强分数陈绝缘体的多体稳定性，实现Laughlin-like的拓扑态。；创新点：提出“量子几何工程”（quantum-geometry engineering）作为超越单纯能带平坦度优化的新策略，通过直接调控量子几何而非仅优化带平坦度来稳定低填充分数陈绝缘体。摘要未突出说明与其他具体理论方案的对比。
papers.method_zh: 精确对角化（exact diagonalization）方法，辅以低能谱分析、谱流（spectral flow）、准空穴和纠缠谱计数、静态结构因子以及多体陈数C_tot=1的计算。模型为kagome晶格中心位点装饰模型，t₂作为量子几何的直接调控旋钮。

papers.title: Engineering Dirac interface states
papers.abstract: We develop a low-energy theory of interface states in anisotropic multivalley Dirac systems whose masses and kinetic parameters are allowed to vary across an interface. For sharp interfaces, current-conserving matching conditions yield analytic expressions for the existence, localization and dispersion of the bound states. We show that the interface velocity is determined by the weighted tangential kinetic terms on the two sides of the seam. Their cancellation can suppress the linear velocity and generate an interface band that is flat to leading order near the projected Dirac point. For the special antisymmetric configuration in which both the Dirac mass and the tangential kinetic coefficient reverse sign with unchanged magnitude, the transparent sharp-interface solution is exactly dispersionless for all conserved momenta within the linear Dirac theory, while the surrounding bulk bands remain dispersive. We extend the theory to smooth interfaces, where the modified bound-state envelope changes the linear interface velocity through a spatial average of the tangential kinetic coefficient. We also investigate quadratic corrections in the kinetic \(σ_x\) and \(σ_y\) channels. To first order in their coefficients and through linear order in the interface momentum, these terms shift the interface-state energy but produce no additional correction to the linear velocity. Finally, we combine continuum and lattice models to show how interface modes from distinct valleys hybridize and how the resulting dispersions depend on microscopic interface properties. Our results establish design principles for controlling the dispersion, localization, and hybridization of Dirac interface states. We further examine two graphene-based mass-domain-wall models as experimentally inspired examples of dispersive copropagating and counterpropagating interface states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含连续模型与晶格模型结合分析，摘要中出现“low-energy theory”“matching conditions”“continuum and lattice models”等关键词，未涉及实验数据）。；研究对象：各向异性多谷狄拉克体系中的界面态，具体包括质量项和动能参数在界面两侧可变的体系，并以石墨烯质量域壁模型作为实验启发的示例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面态的线性速度由界面两侧的切向动能项加权决定，其相互抵消可产生在投影狄拉克点附近领头阶完全平坦的界面带；在反对称构型下，透明锐界面解在狄拉克线性理论内对所有守恒动量严格无色散，而体态仍保持色散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面态的线性速度由界面两侧的切向动能项加权决定，其相互抵消可产生在投影狄拉克点附近领头阶完全平坦的界面带；在反对称构型下，透明锐界面解在狄拉克线性理论内对所有守恒动量严格无色散，而体态仍保持色散。；创新点：建立了控制狄拉克界面态色散、局域化与杂化的设计原则，特别是揭示了切向动能项对界面速度的权重决定作用以及反对称构型下严格无色散界面的存在条件。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 低能有效理论推导，采用电流守恒的锐界面匹配条件解析求解束缚态的存在性、局域化与色散；推广至光滑界面时通过空间平均修正界面速度；并引入动能σ_x和σ_y通道的二次修正进行微扰分析；最后结合连续模型与晶格模型研究不同谷界面模的杂化。

papers.title: Arithmetic Tuning of Dynamical Critical Exponents in Quasiperiodic Localization Transitions
papers.abstract: The critical exponents and universality classes of localization transitions in quasiperiodic systems are of fundamental importance for understanding critical phenomena in aperiodic systems. Here we show that the dynamical critical behavior can be tuned without adding new terms or changing the form of the Hamiltonian, but solely by varying the incommensurate frequency of the quasiperiodic onsite potential. We construct a family of incommensurate frequencies from the limiting ratios of generalized Fibonacci sequences controlled by the parameters $(m,n)$, and use them to define the quasiperiodic onsite potential. By combining generalized fidelity susceptibility, localization-length scaling, and finite-size gap analysis, we find that the correlation-length exponent is insensitive to the choice of the incommensurate frequency and remains consistent with the correlation-length critical exponent, $ν\simeq 1$, in the localization transition of the standard Aubry--Andr'e--Harper model. In contrast, the dynamical exponent extracted from the low-energy gap scaling varies systematically with the incommensurate frequency. Our results show that changing the incommensurate frequency provides a simple way to tune dynamical critical scaling in deterministic aperiodic systems. Our results suggest instead that the arithmetic structure of an irrational number can serve as a control parameter for nonequilibrium quantum dynamics, enabling the tuning of dynamical critical behavior without changing the microscopic Hamiltonian or the physical spatial dimension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“construct a family of incommensurate frequencies”“combining generalized fidelity susceptibility, localization-length scaling, and finite-size gap analysis”，属于数值计算与标度分析，无实验手段。；研究对象：准周期系统中的局域化相变，具体为广义Fibonacci序列构造的准周期在位势下的Aubry–André–Harper型模型，关注其动力学临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过仅改变准周期在位势的非公度频率（由广义Fibonacci序列极限比控制），可以在不改变哈密顿量形式或空间维度的前提下，系统性地调节局域化相变的动力学临界指数；而关联长度临界指数保持为ν≈1，与标准AAH模型一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过仅改变准周期在位势的非公度频率（由广义Fibonacci序列极限比控制），可以在不改变哈密顿量形式或空间维度的前提下，系统性地调节局域化相变的动力学临界指数；而关联长度临界指数保持为ν≈1，与标准AAH模型一致。；创新点：首次证明非公度频率的算术结构（无理数的连分数/序列极限比）可作为调控动力学临界标度的控制参数，无需修改微观哈密顿量或物理维度即可实现动力学临界指数的“算术调谐”。
papers.method_zh: 广义Fibonacci序列参数(m,n)构造非公度频率；结合广义保真度磁化率（generalized fidelity susceptibility）、局域化长度标度（localization-length scaling）和有限尺寸能隙分析（finite-size gap analysis）提取临界指数。

papers.title: Tunable Mediated Interactions Near Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking: From Yukawa to Coulomb and Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya Interactions
papers.abstract: We propose a realization of tunable long-range mediated interactions generated by Nambu-Goldstone (NG) modes near spontaneous symmetry breaking. An effective exchange interaction emerges between two distinguishable impurities proportional to the retarded susceptibility mediated by the bath particles. The interaction is mediated by emergent NG modes associated with symmetry breaking in systems, namely the magnon mode in a repulsive two-component Fermi or Bose gas, or the goldstino mode in a Bose-Fermi mixture. When the NG mode is gapped by explicit symmetry breaking, the interaction has a Yukawa-type short-ranged interaction, whereas the gapless limit gives a Coulomb law. Above the NG mode threshold, the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya-like cross product coupling emerges in a long-range form. Our proposal paves a way towards the realization of a quantum simulator of spin models and polarons with controllable non-local interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出“propose a realization”，使用“effective exchange interaction emerges”等理论推导语言，未提及实验手段或数值计算。；研究对象：自发对称破缺附近由Nambu-Goldstone（NG）模式介导的可调长程相互作用，具体体系包括排斥性双组分费米气体或玻色气体中的磁振子模式，以及玻色-费米混合物中的goldstino模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自发对称破缺附近，两个可区分杂质之间可通过NG模式产生有效的可调长程交换相互作用：当NG模式因显式对称破缺而具有能隙时，相互作用呈Yukawa型短程形式；无能隙极限下呈Coulomb型长程形式；当能量超过NG模式阈值时，出现长程的Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya型叉积耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自发对称破缺附近，两个可区分杂质之间可通过NG模式产生有效的可调长程交换相互作用：当NG模式因显式对称破缺而具有能隙时，相互作用呈Yukawa型短程形式；无能隙极限下呈Coulomb型长程形式；当能量超过NG模式阈值时，出现长程的Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya型叉积耦合。；创新点：提出利用NG模式作为媒介实现可调长程相互作用，并首次指出在NG模式阈值之上可产生长程Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya型叉积耦合，为自旋模型和极化子的量子模拟器提供可控非局域相互作用的实现途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于延迟响应函数（retarded susceptibility）的有效交换相互作用推导，分析NG模式（磁振子、goldstino）在不同对称破缺情形（显式与自发）下的介导作用，并讨论能隙与无能隙极限下的相互作用形式。

papers.title: Bulk Phase Transition and Edge Behavior in Temporally Correlated Random Matrices
papers.abstract: We study long-range correlated Wigner-type matrices built from row-independent stationary Gaussian sequences. For exponentially decaying (AR(1)) correlations, the bulk spectral density deforms from the semicircle law via an explicit combinatorial "hub" mechanism, yet we verify the flatness and decay hypotheses of the matrix-Dyson-equation framework (MDE), with numerical evidence supporting Tracy-Widom edge universality for every fixed $ρ<1$ of the exponential decay correlations; the degenerate limit $ρ\to1^-$ reduces to a symmetrized Volterra operator, connecting to the singular-value cascade identified in a companion BBP analysis. For power-law correlations $dt\sim t^{-γ}$, we identify $γ_c=1/2$ as the critical point for divergence of the bulk fourth-moment, while $γ=1$ marks the breakdown of the flatness condition governing the MDE edge analysis. We prove the fourth-moment transition exactly and find numerically that the self-consistent edge varies smoothly across $γ=1$, with no evidence of a kink or discontinuity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。关键词：long-range correlated Wigner-type matrices、matrix-Dyson-equation framework、numerical evidence、prove the fourth-moment transition exactly。；研究对象：时间相关的随机矩阵系综，具体为行独立平稳高斯序列构造的长程相关Wigner型矩阵，研究其体态谱密度与边缘行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于指数衰减（AR(1)）相关，体态谱密度通过显式组合“hub”机制偏离半圆律，但MDE框架的平坦性与衰减假设仍成立；对于幂律相关，体态四阶矩发散临界点为γ_c=1/2，而γ=1是MDE边缘分析平坦性条件失效的临界点，但自洽边缘在γ=1处光滑变化，无扭结或间断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于指数衰减（AR(1)）相关，体态谱密度通过显式组合“hub”机制偏离半圆律，但MDE框架的平坦性与衰减假设仍成立；对于幂律相关，体态四阶矩发散临界点为γ_c=1/2，而γ=1是MDE边缘分析平坦性条件失效的临界点，但自洽边缘在γ=1处光滑变化，无扭结或间断。；创新点：首次系统研究时间相关（非独立）随机矩阵的体态相变与边缘行为，揭示指数相关与幂律相关下不同的临界行为，并建立与对称化Volterra算子及伴随BBP分析中奇异值级联的联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值模拟：显式组合“hub”机制推导谱形变；验证矩阵Dyson方程（MDE）框架的平坦性与衰减假设；数值检验Tracy-Widom边缘普适性；精确证明四阶矩跃迁；数值计算自洽边缘随γ的变化。

papers.title: Collective Order Decouples Boundary Selection from Macroscopic Chirality in Confined Active Matter
papers.abstract: Can a boundary determine the direction of circulation in a collectively moving active fluid? We study chiral self-propelled particles with nematic bulk alignment, confined by walls whose orientational coupling varies continuously from nematic to polar. For an isolated particle at a wall, we derive the exact parameter condition under which a stable orientation is tangent to the wall. With predominantly nematic wall coupling, however, the many-body circulation changes sign at a chirality that is nearly independent of the wall symmetry. This sign change follows a pronounced decrease in nematic order and disappears when bulk alignment is removed. As the polar wall coupling becomes dominant, opposite-handed circulation is suppressed and same-handed polar locking emerges. Thus local orientation at a wall and the direction of macroscopic circulation are selected by distinct physical processes: the wall determines the possible local orientations, whereas collective order determines whether those orientations control the global flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“derive the exact parameter condition”（推导精确参数条件）、“many-body circulation changes sign”（多体环流符号变化）等理论分析与数值模拟特征，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：受限活性物质（confined active matter）中的手性自驱动粒子（chiral self-propelled particles），具有向列型体相排列（nematic bulk alignment），并被取向耦合强度可调的壁面所约束。研究聚焦于壁面取向耦合从向列型到极型连续变化时，宏观环流方向与边界选择之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 壁面处局部取向与宏观环流方向由不同物理过程决定：壁面决定可能的局部取向，而集体有序度（collective order）决定这些取向是否控制全局流动。具体而言，在向列型壁面耦合占主导时，环流符号在某一手性值处反转，该手性值几乎与壁面对称性无关，且此反转伴随向列序的显著下降；当极型壁面耦合占主导时，相反手性的环流被抑制，出现同手性极型锁定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：壁面处局部取向与宏观环流方向由不同物理过程决定：壁面决定可能的局部取向，而集体有序度（collective order）决定这些取向是否控制全局流动。具体而言，在向列型壁面耦合占主导时，环流符号在某一手性值处反转，该手性值几乎与壁面对称性无关，且此反转伴随向列序的显著下降；当极型壁面耦合占主导时，相反手性的环流被抑制，出现同手性极型锁定。；创新点：首次揭示在受限活性物质中，壁面局部取向选择与宏观环流方向选择是解耦的——前者由壁面边界条件决定，后者由集体有序度决定。这一发现表明边界对称性并不直接决定宏观手性，挑战了“边界决定全局流动方向”的直觉预期。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体数值方法或理论框架，但涉及：对孤立粒子在壁面处稳定取向的精确参数条件推导（解析理论），以及多体系统的数值模拟（用于观察环流符号变化、向列序变化等）。具体算法（如布朗动力学、活性粒子模拟等）摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Jamming states in random sequential adsorption of diffusion-limited aggregates
papers.abstract: Motivated by the ubiquity of ramified fractal deposits in nature and engineered systems, we investigate the irreversible adsorption of diffusion-limited aggregation (DLA) clusters on a square lattice. We study the role of cluster shape diversity on jamming properties of the system by systematically controlling the number of distinct shapes used across and within realizations, encompassing both monodisperse and polydisperse model variants. Our large-scale simulations over a broad range of cluster sizes $2\leqslant k\leqslant4096$ show that the jamming density decreases with cluster size as a power-law $p_j(k)-p_j^\infty\sim k^{-α}$. Both $α$ and $p_j^\infty$ are found to depend on the degree of shape diversity, with $α$ ranging from $0.374(2)$ to $0.417(1)$. It is observed that increasing shape polydispersity promotes denser packing. Importantly, the fluctuations of the jamming density exhibit distinct scaling behavior: $σ(L)\sim1/L$ for a fixed pool of cluster shape(s), but remain $L$-independent when the pool of shape(s) is refreshed across different realizations. Furthermore, our results demonstrate that the differences between the model variants systematically diminish with increasing $k$ and are expected to vanish as $k\to\infty$ due to the statistical self-similarity of the DLA clusters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：large-scale simulations、随机顺序吸附模型、幂律拟合等关键词。；研究对象：扩散限制聚集（DLA）团簇在正方晶格上的不可逆随机顺序吸附过程，重点研究团簇形状多样性对体系堵塞（jamming）性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 堵塞密度随团簇尺寸增大按幂律 p_j(k)-p_j^∞ ~ k^{-α} 衰减，指数 α 和极限堵塞密度 p_j^∞ 均依赖于形状多样性程度；增大形状多分散性有利于更致密的堆积。此外，堵塞密度涨落的标度行为取决于形状池是否在多次实现间刷新。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：堵塞密度随团簇尺寸增大按幂律 p_j(k)-p_j^∞ ~ k^{-α} 衰减，指数 α 和极限堵塞密度 p_j^∞ 均依赖于形状多样性程度；增大形状多分散性有利于更致密的堆积。此外，堵塞密度涨落的标度行为取决于形状池是否在多次实现间刷新。；创新点：系统揭示了DLA团簇形状多样性对堵塞密度及其涨落标度行为的定量影响，并发现不同模型变体间的差异随 k 增大而消失，归因于DLA团簇的统计自相似性。摘要未突出说明与以往随机顺序吸附研究的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 大规模蒙特卡洛模拟，系统控制不同实现内及跨实现使用的不同形状数量，涵盖单分散与多分散两种模型变体，团簇尺寸范围 2 ≤ k ≤ 4096。

papers.title: Reentrance and temperature chaos in the $p$-spin Ising spin glass
papers.abstract: Reentrant transitions and temperature chaos are two unusual properties of spin glasses and had long been considered physically unrelated. We recently established a logical relation between these two phenomena [Phys. Rev. E 112, 044140 (2025)]. In the present paper, we provide an explicit example of this logical relation in the fully connected Ising $p$-spin glass with a ferromagnetic bias. By expanding the free energy around the triple point, we show analytically that the ferromagnetic--spin glass boundary is reentrant in the vicinity of the triple point throughout the examined range of finite $p>2$. It then follows from the above logical relation that there exists at least one pair of distinct temperatures in the spin glass phase for which the overlap of spin configurations vanishes. This is a necessary condition for temperature chaos, but it would be quite unusual for the overlap to vanish only for selected temperature pairs but not for others within a single spin glass phase. These results therefore strongly suggest the existence of temperature chaos in the sense that the overlaps of spin configurations vanish for all temperature pairs throughout the spin glass phase. Independent evidence for this behavior is provided by a two-temperature replica calculation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“analytically”“replica calculation”“free energy expansion”等关键词，属于解析理论与统计力学计算。；研究对象：全连接Ising p-自旋自旋玻璃模型，并带有铁磁偏置（ferromagnetic bias）。具体关注其重入相变（reentrant transition）与温度混沌（temperature chaos）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限p>2的整个考察范围内，铁磁—自旋玻璃相边界在三临界点附近是重入的；由此逻辑关系推断，自旋玻璃相中所有温度对的自旋构型重叠均可能为零，即存在温度混沌。两温度复制计算提供了独立证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限p>2的整个考察范围内，铁磁—自旋玻璃相边界在三临界点附近是重入的；由此逻辑关系推断，自旋玻璃相中所有温度对的自旋构型重叠均可能为零，即存在温度混沌。两温度复制计算提供了独立证据。；创新点：首次在全连接Ising p-自旋玻璃模型中给出“重入相变”与“温度混沌”之间逻辑关系的显式实例，并通过解析证明将两者在有限p>2范围内直接联系起来。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 围绕三临界点对自由能进行解析展开（free energy expansion around the triple point），结合作者此前建立的“重入—温度混沌”逻辑关系（Phys. Rev. E 112, 044140 (2025)），并辅以两温度复制计算（two-temperature replica calculation）作为独立验证。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium pulse dynamics and metastable latching in nonlinear kinetic inductance detectors
papers.abstract: Microwave kinetic inductance detectors are typically operated at high readout power to raise the detector signal above system noise. At sufficiently large readout power, the current-dependent kinetic inductance couples the detector response to its readout bias. Using a nonlinear resonator framework and time-domain circuit calculations, we show that the amplitude, shape, and relaxation time of the driven detector's response depend on both the absorbed energy and on the readout bias. Strongly driven bias points produce amplified, extended, and non-exponential pulse responses. Qualitative agreement between calculated and measured pulse responses indicates that these effects are dominated by the driven nonlinear resonator dynamics rather than by altered quasiparticle dynamics. Beyond resonance bifurcation, sufficiently large pulse events drive the resonator between stable branches, resulting in a metastable latched state which persists after the quasiparticle transient has decayed. The pulse energy required for branch switching is set by the readout bias, suggesting a mode of triggered detection with an in-situ tunable threshold. Although nonlinear operation requires calibration of the bias- and energy-dependent response, the enhanced pulse amplitude and duration, together with tunable latching and the ability to select these parameters via the readout operating state, are likely to be of interest for single-photon and rare-event experiments, especially those limited by amplifier or system noise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用非线性谐振器框架和时域电路计算”（nonlinear resonator framework and time-domain circuit calculations），并包含与实验测量的对比，但核心方法为理论建模与数值计算。；研究对象：微波动力学电感探测器（MKID，Microwave Kinetic Inductance Detector）在高读出功率下的非线性响应行为，具体研究其脉冲响应幅度、形状、弛豫时间以及分支切换（branch switching）导致的亚稳态锁定（metastable latching）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高读出功率下，探测器的脉冲响应由驱动非线性谐振器动力学主导，而非准粒子动力学改变；足够大的脉冲事件可使谐振器在分岔点之外发生分支切换，形成在准粒子瞬态衰减后仍持续存在的亚稳态锁定态，且触发切换所需的脉冲能量可由读出偏置原位调节。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高读出功率下，探测器的脉冲响应由驱动非线性谐振器动力学主导，而非准粒子动力学改变；足够大的脉冲事件可使谐振器在分岔点之外发生分支切换，形成在准粒子瞬态衰减后仍持续存在的亚稳态锁定态，且触发切换所需的脉冲能量可由读出偏置原位调节。；创新点：揭示了强驱动下MKID脉冲响应的非指数、放大和延长特性源于非线性谐振器动力学，并首次提出利用分支切换实现可调阈值的触发式探测模式（triggered detection with in-situ tunable threshold）。摘要未突出说明与传统线性响应模型相比的具体理论改进细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用非线性谐振器理论框架，结合时域电路计算（time-domain circuit calculations）模拟探测器响应；并与实验测量的脉冲响应进行定性对比验证。

papers.title: Quantum encoding of structured light into in-plane topological spin textures
papers.abstract: Structured light offers a powerful means of controlling light-matter interactions through multiple tunable optical degrees of freedom. Using micromagnetic simulations, we investigate the nucleation of asymmetric bimerons and antibimerons by pulsed Laguerre-Gaussian optical vortices in chiral ferromagnetic thin films with $C_{nv}$ and $D_{2d}$ symmetries, respectively. For optical vortices with orbital angular momentum (OAM) $|m|=1$, circularly polarized beams deterministically nucleate a single bimeron or antibimeron via the interplay of spin angular momentum, OAM, and magnetic chirality, whereas linearly polarized beams produce textures whose topological charge directly follows the OAM ($Q=m$). Optical vortices with OAM $|m|>1$ nucleate clusters and other configurations composed of multiple spin textures, whose morphology and topological charge depend sensitively on the optical quantum numbers and pulse parameters. These findings reveal a route to topology-selective writing through the encoding of optical quantum numbers into distinct in-plane topological magnetic states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“micromagnetic simulations”（微磁模拟）。；研究对象：手性铁磁薄膜（chiral ferromagnetic thin films），具体为具有 Cₙᵥ 和 D₂𝒹 对称性的体系；研究物理现象为脉冲拉盖尔-高斯光学涡旋（Laguerre-Gaussian optical vortices）诱导的非对称双半子（bimeron）和反双半子（antibimeron）等面内拓扑自旋织构的成核。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 携带轨道角动量（OAM）|m|=1 的圆偏振光涡旋可通过自旋角动量、OAM 与磁手性的协同作用，确定性成核单个双半子或反双半子；而线偏振光涡旋产生的织构拓扑荷直接等于 OAM（Q=m）。|m|>1 时则成核多织构团簇，其形貌与拓扑荷敏感依赖于光学量子数和脉冲参数，从而实现将光学量子数编码为不同面内拓扑磁态的拓扑选择性写入。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：携带轨道角动量（OAM）|m|=1 的圆偏振光涡旋可通过自旋角动量、OAM 与磁手性的协同作用，确定性成核单个双半子或反双半子；而线偏振光涡旋产生的织构拓扑荷直接等于 OAM（Q=m）。|m|>1 时则成核多织构团簇，其形貌与拓扑荷敏感依赖于光学量子数和脉冲参数，从而实现将光学量子数编码为不同面内拓扑磁态的拓扑选择性写入。；创新点：首次展示了通过光学涡旋的量子数（OAM、自旋角动量）与磁手性的耦合，实现对面内拓扑自旋织构（双半子/反双半子）的拓扑荷选择性写入，即“光学量子数→拓扑磁态”的编码路径。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations），具体为对脉冲拉盖尔-高斯光学涡旋与手性铁磁薄膜的相互作用进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Spectrally Programmable Spin-Polarized Photocurrents in WSe$_2$-NiPS$_3$ Magnetic van der Waals Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Efficient generation and control of spin-polarized currents in semiconductors remain central challenges for spin-based electronics, particularly due to impedance mismatch and the reliance on magnetic fields or ferromagnetic contacts. Here, we introduce a materials platform for spectrally programmable spin transport based on a van der Waals heterostructure combining the antiferromagnetic semiconductor NiPS$_3$ with WSe$_2$. In a p-n diode architecture, circularly polarized excitation produces pronounced photoconductive resonances with spin polarization reaching 80% near the Neel temperature and persisting at 30% at room temperature. Remarkably, selected spectral bands retain their polarization sign across the magnetic phase transition, evidencing robust, spectrally protected spin-polarized current generation. Polarization-resolved photogalvanic measurements reveal a dominant circular injection-current mechanism, confirming spin-polarized carrier transport. First-principles calculations show that an applied electric field induces interfacial hybridization and spin-layer locking, giving rise to localized symmetry breaking and enhanced optical absorption while preserving global time-reversal symmetry. These results establish spectral tuning of excitation as a new control knob for spin transport, enabling spin-current generation without magnetic fields or polarization switching. Our findings position magnetic van der Waals heterostructures as a versatile platform for opto-spintronic functionality and spectrally programmable spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“偏振分辨光电流测量”“第一性原理计算”等实验与计算手段。；研究对象：WSe₂-NiPS₃ 磁性范德华异质结，具体研究其 p-n 二极管结构中的自旋极化光电流产生与调控，以及磁相变（Neel温度附近）对自旋输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 WSe₂-NiPS₃ 异质结中，圆偏振光激发可产生自旋极化度高达80%（近Neel温度）且室温下仍保持30%的自旋极化光电流；特定光谱波段的自旋极化符号在磁相变前后保持不变，实现无需外磁场的光谱可编程自旋电流产生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 WSe₂-NiPS₃ 异质结中，圆偏振光激发可产生自旋极化度高达80%（近Neel温度）且室温下仍保持30%的自旋极化光电流；特定光谱波段的自旋极化符号在磁相变前后保持不变，实现无需外磁场的光谱可编程自旋电流产生。；创新点：提出“光谱调谐激发”作为自旋输运的新控制自由度，实现无需磁场或铁磁接触的自旋电流产生，且自旋极化符号在磁相变中受光谱保护；将磁性范德华异质结确立为光谱可编程自旋电子学平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用 p-n 二极管器件架构，进行圆偏振光激发下的光导共振测量、偏振分辨光电流（光电流效应）测量；理论上采用第一性原理计算，研究外加电场诱导的界面杂化与自旋-层锁定效应。

papers.title: Intertwined spin-charge stripe order and polar lattice distortion in La$_{3}$Ni$_{2}$O$_{7}$
papers.abstract: The low-temperature density-wave state of La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ hosts pronounced spin-density-wave (SDW) order, while recent experiments further reveal charge redistribution and a concomitant lattice-symmetry lowering. However, the microscopic relationship among spin, charge, and lattice remains unclear. Using first-principles calculations, we investigate the pressure evolution of the electronic structure and static spin susceptibility of La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$, together with the energetics and lattice response of representative magnetic configurations. We trace the SDW instability to strong Fermi-surface nesting and find that the high-pressure spin response closely tracks $T_{\mathrm C}$, suggesting spin-fluctuation-mediated pairing. Among the candidate magnetic states considered, the spin-charge-stripe states emerge as energetically favored and dynamically stable, developing pronounced disproportionation of both the local Ni moments and the Ni--O bond lengths. Remarkably, the lowest-energy a-stripe state spontaneously relaxes into the experimentally proposed polar Am2m structure through a polar distortion along the b axis. These results establish a unified picture in which spin, charge, and lattice responses are strongly intertwined in the low-pressure density-wave state, while spin fluctuations remain a plausible ingredient of superconductivity under pressure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到“使用第一性原理计算”（first-principles calculations），并涉及电子结构、静态自旋磁化率、能量学与晶格响应的计算分析。；研究对象：研究对象为双层镍氧化物 La₃Ni₂O₇，具体聚焦于其低温密度波态中自旋密度波（SDW）序、电荷重分布与晶格对称性降低之间的微观关联，以及压力下自旋涨落与超导电性的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: La₃Ni₂O₇ 的 SDW 不稳定性源于强费米面嵌套，且高压下的自旋响应紧密跟随超导转变温度 T_C，支持自旋涨落介导的超导配对机制；在候选磁构型中，自旋-电荷条纹态能量最优且动力学稳定，其中最低能的 a-条纹态自发弛豫为实验提出的极性 Am2m 结构，表明自旋、电荷与晶格响应在低压密度波态中强烈交织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：La₃Ni₂O₇ 的 SDW 不稳定性源于强费米面嵌套，且高压下的自旋响应紧密跟随超导转变温度 T_C，支持自旋涨落介导的超导配对机制；在候选磁构型中，自旋-电荷条纹态能量最优且动力学稳定，其中最低能的 a-条纹态自发弛豫为实验提出的极性 Am2m 结构，表明自旋、电荷与晶格响应在低压密度波态中强烈交织。；创新点：首次在 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中建立自旋-电荷条纹序与极性晶格畸变（Am2m 结构）之间的统一微观图像，将 SDW 不稳定性、电荷不均化（Ni 局域磁矩与 Ni–O 键长的显著分化）以及晶格对称性降低三者联系起来，并明确将高压下的自旋响应与 T_C 关联，支持自旋涨落介导的超导机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算方法，具体包括：计算电子结构、静态自旋磁化率（static spin susceptibility）随压力的演化；对代表性磁构型进行能量学比较与晶格响应分析；考察费米面嵌套（Fermi-surface nesting）与 SDW 不稳定性的关联；评估候选磁态的动力学稳定性。

papers.title: Can Strain or Anion Interchange Make an Unstable Structure Stable? Energetics, Lattice Dynamics and Strain-Tunable Band Gaps of Lithium Chalcohalide Antiperovskites (Li$_{3}$$BA$) and their Anion Interchange Variants (Li$_{3}$$AB$)
papers.abstract: Lithium chalcohalide antiperovskites are a promising, non-toxic alternative to lead halide perovskites, with potential as solid electrolytes for Li-ion batteries. we computationally investigate a relatively unexplored anion-interchange mechanism by which cubic Li$_{3}$$AB$ derivatives are obtained from the parent cubic antiperovskite Li$_{3}$$BA$ ($A$ = O, S, Se, Te, Po; $B$ = F, Cl, Br, I). The calculated relative energy landscape provides a useful guide for anion-site selectivity and its role in structural stability. The energetic stability results reveal that the smaller anion inside the octahedron stabilizes the structures. The lattice-dynamic calculations confirm that Li$_{3}$F$A$ ($A$ = Te, Po) and Li$_{3}$O$B$ ($B$ = Cl, Br, I), which are the most energetically stable compounds, are dynamically stable cubic phases without imaginary phonon modes. However, Li$_{3}$FS and Li$_{3}$FSe, while energetically stable, are dynamically unstable at equilibrium and become dynamically stable under triaxial compressive strain. In addition, we report the electronic structure and density of states (DOS) of all compounds, which show a substantial change in band gap upon anion interchange. The strain engineering of the lithium chalcohalide family illustrates how a few percent of the strain can tune the electronic band gap within the electrochemical stability window for solid battery applications. This study unveils essential characteristics of the anion site-interchange mechanism and provides a foundation for the understanding and design of lithium chalcohalide antiperovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要中明确使用“computationally investigate”“calculated relative energy landscape”“lattice-dynamic calculations”等关键词，属于第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：锂硫卤化物反钙钛矿材料Li₃BA（A = O, S, Se, Te, Po；B = F, Cl, Br, I）及其阴离子互换变体Li₃AB，重点关注其结构稳定性、晶格动力学、电子结构与应变调控的带隙。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 较小的阴离子占据八面体内部位置有利于结构稳定；Li₃FA（A = Te, Po）和Li₃OB（B = Cl, Br, I）是能量与动力学均稳定的立方相，而Li₃FS和Li₃FSe在平衡态动力学不稳定，但可通过三轴压缩应变实现动力学稳定。阴离子互换会显著改变带隙，且少量应变可在电化学稳定窗口内调控带隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：较小的阴离子占据八面体内部位置有利于结构稳定；Li₃FA（A = Te, Po）和Li₃OB（B = Cl, Br, I）是能量与动力学均稳定的立方相，而Li₃FS和Li₃FSe在平衡态动力学不稳定，但可通过三轴压缩应变实现动力学稳定。阴离子互换会显著改变带隙，且少量应变可在电化学稳定窗口内调控带隙。；创新点：系统研究了阴离子互换机制（Li₃BA → Li₃AB）对反钙钛矿结构稳定性、动力学稳定性及电子性质的影响，并揭示了应变可将本征动力学不稳定的化合物（Li₃FS、Li₃FSe）转变为稳定相，为锂硫卤化物反钙钛矿的设计提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算，具体包括：相对能量景观计算（用于评估阴离子位点选择性）、晶格动力学计算（声子谱分析，判断是否存在虚频）、电子结构计算（能带与态密度DOS），以及应变工程（三轴压缩应变）对动力学稳定性和带隙的调控模拟。

papers.title: Entropy Production Bounds the Accuracy of Computation in Markov Networks
papers.abstract: Biological and artificial networks compute by transforming time-dependent inputs into functional outputs. Because the internal state of a stochastic network relaxes on finite timescales, its output generally lags behind a changing environment, producing computational errors. We show that for reversible continuous-time Markov networks the error admits a universal thermodynamic bound. Decomposing the total error into representation and lag contributions, we derive an inequality relating the lag error to the entropy production rate and a memory time equal to the integrated equilibrium autocorrelation of the output observable. The bound implies that accurate dynamical computation requires either substantial dissipation or long-lived memory encoded in slowly relaxing modes. We demonstrate these principles in artificial Markov networks and in models of biochemical information processing. Our results establish a thermodynamic limit on information processing in stochastic networks and provide a quantitative framework for understanding the energetic costs of biological computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“universal thermodynamic bound”“derive an inequality”“theoretical framework”等理论推导关键词，且未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：随机马尔可夫网络中的计算过程，具体包括人工马尔可夫网络和生化信息处理模型（如生物网络中的信号转导与计算），关注的是网络在时变输入下输出误差与热力学耗散之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于可逆连续时间马尔可夫网络，计算误差（特别是滞后误差）存在一个普适热力学下界：误差受熵产生率与输出可观测量的平衡自相关积分（记忆时间）的乘积约束，即精确的动态计算必须要么消耗大量耗散，要么依赖慢弛豫模式提供的长时记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于可逆连续时间马尔可夫网络，计算误差（特别是滞后误差）存在一个普适热力学下界：误差受熵产生率与输出可观测量的平衡自相关积分（记忆时间）的乘积约束，即精确的动态计算必须要么消耗大量耗散，要么依赖慢弛豫模式提供的长时记忆。；创新点：首次将计算误差（而非仅信息论量如互信息）与热力学耗散直接建立定量不等式，给出了随机网络信息处理的热力学极限，为生物计算能耗提供了定量框架。摘要未突出说明与已有热力学信息论工作的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于可逆连续时间马尔可夫链的随机动力学，将总误差分解为“表示误差”和“滞后误差”两部分，利用熵产生率与平衡自相关函数建立不等式，并在人工马尔可夫网络和生化信息处理模型中进行验证（摘要未明确说明具体数值方法，如蒙特卡洛或精确对角化）。

papers.title: Weak irreducibility as a spectral criterion for phase coexistence
papers.abstract: Conventional finite-size theories describe first-order coexistence through free-energy competition and interfacial tunneling, but the distinct spectral roles of sector balance and inter-sector connectivity are not usually explicit. We show that pseudo-transitions and thermodynamic phase coexistence are governed by two spectral coordinates: sector imbalance locates balance, while connectivity determines whether that balance remains avoided. At balance, finite connectivity produces a unique dominant state with equal spectral weights in the symmetrized two-sector representation. For short-range systems with positive interface tension, interfacial costs suppress the connectivity exponentially, close the coexistence splitting, and asymptotically restore reducibility. Thus, genuine phase coexistence emerges as the singular limit of finite-size avoided coexistence, whereas one-dimensional pseudo-transitions retain finite connectivity. papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：finite-size theories、spectral coordinates、asymptotically restore reducibility、singular limit。；研究对象：一阶相共存（first-order coexistence）的有限尺寸谱学判据，以及伪相变（pseudo-transitions）与热力学相共存的关系；具体模型为装饰双层伊辛模型（decorated bilayer Ising model）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 相共存由两个谱坐标共同决定：扇区不平衡（sector imbalance）确定平衡位置，而扇区间连通性（connectivity）决定该平衡是否被避免。对于具有正界面张力的短程系统，界面代价使连通性指数压低，闭合共存劈裂并渐近恢复可约性，因此真正的相共存是有限尺寸避免共存（avoided coexistence）的奇异极限；而一维伪相变保持有限连通性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：相共存由两个谱坐标共同决定：扇区不平衡（sector imbalance）确定平衡位置，而扇区间连通性（connectivity）决定该平衡是否被避免。对于具有正界面张力的短程系统，界面代价使连通性指数压低，闭合共存劈裂并渐近恢复可约性，因此真正的相共存是有限尺寸避免共存（avoided coexistence）的奇异极限；而一维伪相变保持有限连通性。；创新点：明确区分了扇区平衡（sector balance）与扇区间连通性（inter-sector connectivity）在谱上的不同作用，提出弱不可约性（weak irreducibility）作为相共存的谱判据，并将伪相变与真实相共存统一在有限尺寸避免共存的框架下。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于有限尺寸谱理论，引入两个谱坐标（扇区不平衡与扇区间连通性），并在对称化两扇区表示中分析谱权重；具体模型为装饰双层伊辛模型，用于检验共存能隙行为。

papers.title: Tunable Magnetic Frustration in the Cu-Ru-based Double Perovskite La$_{2-x}$Sm$_x$CuRuO$_6$ (x = 0, 1, 2) Oxides
papers.abstract: In this study, we investigate structural, magnetic, and electronic properties of the copper-ruthenate based oxide double perovskite La$_{2-x}$Sm$_x$CuRuO$_6$ (x = 0, 1, 2), synthesized through the solid-state reaction method. X-ray diffraction analysis reveals that all compounds crystallize in a monoclinic symmetry, with varying degree of structural distortion that increases in moving from La$^{3+}$ to smaller size cation Sm$^{3+}$. Electrical resistivity studies indicate insulating behaviour in all compounds, with variable-range-hopping domination at low temperatures, due to presence of anti-site disorder. AC susceptibility and heat capacity measurements suggest suppression of frustration in Sm-bearing compounds, affecting the magnetic behavior. Our first-principles calculations suggest that the combined effects of lattice distortion and Sm magnetism play a crucial role in weakening magnetic frustration, thereby rationalizing the experimental observations. These findings shed light on the complex interplay of crystal structure and magnetism in Cu-Ru double perovskites, and open up an avenue for tuning of magnetic properties through rare-earth-ion substitution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“solid-state reaction method”“X-ray diffraction”“Electrical resistivity”“AC susceptibility and heat capacity”等实验手段，同时包含“first-principles calculations”理论计算。；研究对象：Cu-Ru基双钙钛矿氧化物 La₂₋ₓSmₓCuRuO₆（x = 0, 1, 2），重点研究其结构畸变、磁阻挫（magnetic frustration）及磁性行为随稀土离子替换的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在La₂₋ₓSmₓCuRuO₆体系中，用较小半径的Sm³⁺替换La³⁺会增强结构畸变，同时抑制磁阻挫效应；第一性原理计算表明，晶格畸变与Sm磁性的协同作用是削弱磁阻挫的关键机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在La₂₋ₓSmₓCuRuO₆体系中，用较小半径的Sm³⁺替换La³⁺会增强结构畸变，同时抑制磁阻挫效应；第一性原理计算表明，晶格畸变与Sm磁性的协同作用是削弱磁阻挫的关键机制。；创新点：通过稀土离子（La→Sm）替换实现对双钙钛矿中磁阻挫程度的连续调控，并揭示晶格畸变与稀土磁性协同削弱阻挫的物理机制，为通过稀土取代调控磁性提供了新途径。（摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。）
papers.method_zh: - 实验：固相反应法合成；X射线衍射（XRD）确定晶体结构；电阻率测量（确认绝缘行为及变程跳跃导电）；交流磁化率（AC susceptibility）和比热（heat capacity）测量表征磁性与阻挫。

papers.title: Observation of electron spin interactions between Rydberg atoms
papers.abstract: We report the observation of electron spin interactions between Rydberg atoms, which are driven by spin-orbit coupling through second-order dipole perturbation and exhibit a spatial anisotropy governed by the atomic configuration. Specifically, we observe coherent electron spin exchange dynamics, with the measured coupling strength agreeing well with both numerical calculations and theoretical models. Furthermore, we show that global microwave dressing enables active engineering and dynamical freezing of the spin exchange by introducing a differential AC Stark shift between the participating states. Additionally, we achieve tunability of the interaction by applying a stronger magnetic field, which effectively modifies the energy contributions of the underlying spin-orbit coupling channels. Finally, measuring spin dynamics in one-dimensional multi-atom chains aligned parallel or perpendicular to the magnetic field provides a self-consistent validation of the anisotropic XXZ framework. This electron spin interaction natively features spin-position coupling and enables a natural mapping onto the Heisenberg-Kitaev model. Our findings reveal a new class of electron spin-spin interactions among Rydberg atoms, expanding the scope of quantum simulation with Rydberg atom arrays.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We report the observation”“measured coupling strength”“measuring spin dynamics”等实验观测与测量关键词。；研究对象：里德伯原子体系中的电子自旋相互作用，具体为通过自旋-轨道耦合驱动的电子自旋交换动力学及其空间各向异性，以及一维多原子链中的自旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次观测到里德伯原子之间由自旋-轨道耦合经二阶偶极微扰驱动的电子自旋相互作用，该作用具有空间各向异性，并可通过微波缀饰或外加磁场进行主动调控；其自旋-位置耦合特性可自然映射到海森堡-基塔耶夫模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次观测到里德伯原子之间由自旋-轨道耦合经二阶偶极微扰驱动的电子自旋相互作用，该作用具有空间各向异性，并可通过微波缀饰或外加磁场进行主动调控；其自旋-位置耦合特性可自然映射到海森堡-基塔耶夫模型。；创新点：揭示了一类全新的里德伯原子间电子自旋-自旋相互作用，其本征的自旋-位置耦合特性为量子模拟提供了向海森堡-基塔耶夫模型自然映射的新途径，拓展了里德伯原子阵列量子模拟的适用范围。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用里德伯原子阵列，通过测量相干电子自旋交换动力学获取耦合强度；使用全局微波缀饰引入差分交流斯塔克位移以实现自旋交换的主动工程与动态冻结；施加强磁场调节自旋-轨道耦合通道的能量贡献；在一维多原子链中沿平行或垂直于磁场方向测量自旋动力学，以验证各向异性XXZ框架。理论方面与数值计算及理论模型进行对比验证。

papers.title: Universal Spin-Position Coupled Rydberg Interactions
papers.abstract: Strong interactions between $s$-orbital Rydberg atoms underpin atom-array-based quantum computation and quantum simulation. Typically, the spin dependence of these interactions is negligible and plays no practical role. In this Letter, we uncover that a strong electron-spin-dependent Rydberg interaction can emerge when the principal quantum numbers of the two $s$-orbital atoms differ by a sweet-spot value. This interaction originates from the fine-structure splitting of nearby $p$ orbitals, which endows it with distinct symmetry properties such that the electron spins are coupled to the relative position of the two atoms, featuring a spatially defined anisotropy. We further demonstrate that this interaction admits a universal form, independent of the principal quantum numbers, and highlight its fundamental distinction from conventional magnetic dipolar interactions, establishing it as a new type of native magnetic interaction in nature. Our findings introduce a new element to the Rydberg quantum simulation toolbox. As a concrete application, we propose a native realization of the Kitaev-Heisenberg model, which hosts an unusual stripe phase as a quantum many-body manifestation of spin-space locking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We uncover”“We further demonstrate”“We propose”等表述，且未提及实验手段或数值计算方法，属于理论提出与模型构建。；研究对象：Rydberg原子阵列中的电子自旋-空间位置耦合相互作用，具体为两个s轨道Rydberg原子在主量子数相差特定“甜点值”时产生的自旋依赖相互作用，以及其在量子模拟中的应用（Kitaev-Heisenberg模型）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当两个s轨道Rydberg原子的主量子数相差一个特定值时，会出现强的电子自旋依赖相互作用，该相互作用将电子自旋与原子相对位置耦合，具有空间各向异性，且其形式具有普适性（与主量子数无关），是一种不同于传统磁偶极相互作用的新型本征磁性相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当两个s轨道Rydberg原子的主量子数相差一个特定值时，会出现强的电子自旋依赖相互作用，该相互作用将电子自旋与原子相对位置耦合，具有空间各向异性，且其形式具有普适性（与主量子数无关），是一种不同于传统磁偶极相互作用的新型本征磁性相互作用。；创新点：首次揭示s轨道Rydberg原子间可存在强自旋依赖相互作用（此前认为可忽略），并证明其具有自旋-位置耦合的对称性特征和普适形式，区别于传统磁偶极相互作用；提出利用该相互作用原生实现Kitaev-Heisenberg模型，并预言其中出现自旋-空间锁定的条纹相。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析推导。摘要未明确说明具体计算框架（如是否使用微扰论、有效哈密顿量推导等），仅指出相互作用源于邻近p轨道的精细结构劈裂，并基于对称性分析给出相互作用形式及其普适性。

papers.title: Reality and Complexity of $F$-symbols in $2+1$d Topological Phases
