papers.abstract: The $F$-symbols of an anyon theory encode the associativity of fusion and constitute some of the theory's most fundamental and, simultaneously, subtle data. Much of the subtlety lies in the gauge-dependence of the $F$-symbols. Despite their generic complexity, many braided anyon theories admit gauges in which all $F$-symbols are real, a phenomenon for which no general organising principle has been known. We identify a physical mechanism underlying this reality. For a unitary ribbon fusion category admitting an appropriate braided charge-conjugation symmetry, we show that the complex-conjugated $F$-symbols are related to the original ones by a gauge transformation. Finding a real gauge is thereby reduced to a condition on these transformations. When the charge-conjugation symmetry is suitably "flat,'' or equivalently when the associated "twisted'' Frobenius-Schur (or "generalized'' Kawanaka-Matsuyama) data respects a grading, these local transformations can be trivialised and a real gauge exists. This framework unifies a broad range of previously disparate examples, including families of Chern-Simons theories whose $F$-symbols are difficult to directly compute. Finally, we exhibit a unitary ribbon category that realizes a novel obstruction to the existence of a real gauge and therefore has inherently complex $F$-symbols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论的是拓扑相中任意子理论的数学结构（F符号、规范变换、融合范畴），属于理论物理与数学物理交叉研究。；研究对象：2+1维拓扑相中的任意子理论，具体为幺正编织融合范畴（unitary ribbon fusion category）的F符号（即6j符号）的实性与复性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 任意子理论的F符号在满足适当编织电荷共轭对称性时，其复共轭可通过规范变换与原F符号关联；当该对称性满足“平坦”条件（或等价的广义Frobenius-Schur数据具有分级结构）时，存在实规范。同时，作者构造了一个幺正编织范畴，其中实规范的存在性受到新奇的阻碍，因此其F符号本质上是复的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：任意子理论的F符号在满足适当编织电荷共轭对称性时，其复共轭可通过规范变换与原F符号关联；当该对称性满足“平坦”条件（或等价的广义Frobenius-Schur数据具有分级结构）时，存在实规范。同时，作者构造了一个幺正编织范畴，其中实规范的存在性受到新奇的阻碍，因此其F符号本质上是复的。；创新点：首次提出F符号可实化的统一物理机制——将实规范的存在性归结为电荷共轭对称性的“平坦性”条件，统一了此前分散的各类例子（包括难以直接计算的Chern-Simons理论族），并首次构造出具有本质复F符号的幺正编织范畴，揭示了实规范存在性的新阻碍。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为拓扑量子场论与融合范畴理论。具体使用了：幺正编织融合范畴的规范变换分析、电荷共轭对称性下的F符号复共轭关系、Frobenius-Schur（Kawanaka-Matsuyama）广义数据的分级条件，以及Chern-Simons理论族作为实例验证。

papers.title: Raman Circular Dichroism Reveals Higher-Order Quantum Geometry of Magnons
papers.abstract: We develop a gauge-invariant theory of higher-order magnon quantum geometry probed by two-magnon Raman circular dichroism (RCD). The Raman operator decomposes into Berry connections, covariant derivatives, and products of Berry connections, giving rise to quantum geometric tensors beyond the quantum metric and Berry curvature. Applying this theory to a field-polarized Kitaev magnet, we show that higher-order geometric tensors govern the dichroic response. Our results establish RCD as a spectroscopic probe of generalized magnon quantum geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We develop a gauge-invariant theory”“Applying this theory”等表述，属于理论构建与计算分析。；研究对象：磁振子（magnon）的高阶量子几何，具体体系为场极化Kitaev磁体（field-polarized Kitaev magnet），物理现象为双磁振子拉曼圆二色性（two-magnon Raman circular dichroism, RCD）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高阶磁振子量子几何张量（超越量子度量和Berry曲率）主导了双磁振子拉曼圆二色性响应，从而将RCD确立为探测广义磁振子量子几何的光谱学手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高阶磁振子量子几何张量（超越量子度量和Berry曲率）主导了双磁振子拉曼圆二色性响应，从而将RCD确立为探测广义磁振子量子几何的光谱学手段。；创新点：首次将拉曼圆二色性（RCD）与磁振子的高阶量子几何（而非仅量子度量和Berry曲率）建立直接联系，提出RCD可作为探测广义磁振子量子几何的谱学探针。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为规范不变的磁振子量子几何理论：将Raman算符分解为Berry联络、协变导数及Berry联络乘积，由此构造高阶量子几何张量；并应用于场极化Kitaev磁体进行具体计算。

papers.title: Large scale theoretical investigation of the phase diagram of twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ at fractional fillings: agreements and contradictions with current experiments
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive exact-diagonalization study of interaction-driven phases in twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ across experimentally relevant twist angles ($2.13^\circ$--$4^\circ$) and hole fillings. Using continuum-model moiré bands, we compare the one-band-per-valley (1BPV) projection with a two-band-per-valley (2BPV) calculation that includes interaction-driven band mixing, and we benchmark both the widely used first-harmonic continuum model and a parameter-free DFT ``fitting-free'' model. At odd-denominator fillings, the 2BPV calculation reproduces the experimentally observed hierarchy of fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) around $θ\approx 3.7^\circ$, including robust incompressible states at $ν=-2/3$, $-3/5$, and $-4/7$ while correctly finding the absence of an FCI at $ν=-3/7$, and it favors a charge density wave ground state at $ν=-1/3$ over the FCI. At half filling $ν=-1/2$, the 1BPV calculation exhibits clear composite Fermi liquid (CFL) signatures, whereas the band mixing in 2BPV calculations destabilizes the CFL ground state. Finally, motivated by the Landau-level analogy at $θ\approx 2.13^\circ$, we test the proposed non-abelian Pfaffian state at $ν=-3/2$ in the fully-polarized spin sector but find no evidence for this state within the models and parameters studied. Our results establish a unified numerical benchmark for correlated and topological phases in twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ and clarify where multi-band physics is essential for a quantitative comparison with experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：exact-diagonalization study、continuum-model、DFT。；研究对象：扭转双层MoTe₂（twisted bilayer MoTe₂）在分数填充下的相图，涵盖不同扭转角（2.13°–4°）和空穴填充数下的关联拓扑态，包括分数量子反常霍尔（FCI）、复合费米液体（CFL）和电荷密度波等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在奇分母填充下，两带/谷（2BPV）计算能复现实验观测的FCI层级（ν=-2/3、-3/5、-4/7）并正确预测ν=-3/7无FCI，且ν=-1/3处基态为电荷密度波而非FCI；在半填充ν=-1/2处，带混合会破坏CFL基态；在θ≈2.13°、ν=-3/2处未发现非阿贝尔Pfaffian态的证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在奇分母填充下，两带/谷（2BPV）计算能复现实验观测的FCI层级（ν=-2/3、-3/5、-4/7）并正确预测ν=-3/7无FCI，且ν=-1/3处基态为电荷密度波而非FCI；在半填充ν=-1/2处，带混合会破坏CFL基态；在θ≈2.13°、ν=-3/2处未发现非阿贝尔Pfaffian态的证据。；创新点：建立了扭转双层MoTe₂中关联与拓扑相的统一数值基准，系统揭示了多带物理在定量对比实验中的必要性，并首次在统一框架下检验了FCI层级、CFL稳定性及Pfaffian态的存在性。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续模型莫尔能带，进行精确对角化（exact diagonalization）计算；对比单带/谷（1BPV）与两带/谷（2BPV）投影（后者包含相互作用驱动的带混合）；同时对比广泛使用的第一谐波连续模型与无参数DFT“免拟合”模型。

papers.title: Imaging atomic scale stochasticity: noise in the nearly commensurate charge density wave of 1T-TaS$_2$ for leaky-integrator-and-fire neuromorphic emulator
papers.abstract: Low-dimensional materials are promising materials for emulating neuron-like firing were understanding of the atomic-scale origin of this behavior can benefit integration into neurormophic hardware. Using scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) as a highly local probe of correlations in the charge density wave (CDW), we study atomic-scale CDW noise in $1T\text{-}\mathrm{TaS}_2$ at room temperature. We statistically analyze the tunnel-junction noise and, to explain the temporally correlated current bursts, introduce a mesoscopic model in which the fractal structure and reorganization of CDW discommensurations are related. This noise mimics leaky-integrate-and-fire neuron dynamics. Our results show that atomic-scale current bursts in the tunnel junction can act as effective nonlinear elements in spiking neural emulators, enabling bioinspired processing through rich CDW dynamics at room temperature and supporting the miniaturization of spiking devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要明确使用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）作为实验手段，并进行了隧道结噪声的统计分析。；研究对象：1T-TaS₂ 中近公度电荷密度波（CDW）的原子尺度噪声，以及该噪声对漏电积分-发放（leaky-integrate-and-fire）神经元仿真的模拟行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 室温下1T-TaS₂隧道结中的原子尺度电流突发（current bursts）具有时间相关性，其统计特性可模拟漏电积分-发放神经元动力学，表明CDW涨落可作为脉冲神经模拟器中的有效非线性元件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：室温下1T-TaS₂隧道结中的原子尺度电流突发（current bursts）具有时间相关性，其统计特性可模拟漏电积分-发放神经元动力学，表明CDW涨落可作为脉冲神经模拟器中的有效非线性元件。；创新点：首次将CDW的原子尺度噪声与漏电积分-发放神经元动力学直接关联，提出利用室温下CDW丰富的动力学行为实现仿生信息处理，为脉冲神经器件的小型化提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）作为局域探针测量CDW关联，对隧道结噪声进行统计分析，并引入介观模型将CDW失公度畴壁（discommensurations）的分形结构与重组过程与时间相关的电流突发联系起来。

papers.title: Randomized Block Davidson Eigensolvers for Plane-Wave Density-Functional Theory
papers.abstract: Iterative diagonalization is the dominant cost of plane-wave density-functional theory (DFT), with search-space orthogonalization scaling particularly quickly with problem size and the number of target states. We present a randomized block Davidson-type eigensolver that replaces Euclidean orthogonalization with randomized Gram-Schmidt in a sketched inner product, requiring only a single pass over the basis while keeping its conditioning bounded independently of the input vectors. This modification changes only the Rayleigh-Ritz step, which becomes a definite generalized Hermitian eigenproblem. Ritz extraction remains exact, preserving true Ritz pairs and the interlacing property that makes each band energy an upper bound on the true one. The method is implemented in mixed precision for CPUs and GPUs from a single Julia code, interfaces matrix-free with DFTK, and is released in the open-source RandESC library. On sparse test problems with a fixed number of eigenpairs, the sketched solver overtakes its deterministic counterpart beyond matrix dimensions of about $2\times 10^4$ and is $25\%$ faster at $5\times 10^5$. In full self-consistent field DFT calculations, however, both Davidson variants outperform the locally optimal block preconditioned conjugate gradient (LOBPCG) reference only by $5$ to $11\%$ in total time, while the additional benefit of sketching is limited. As the number of requested states grows with system size, orthogonalization savings are offset by the generalized eigenproblem. Therefore, the regime in which sketching pays off is set by how the number of wanted states scales with the problem dimension, not by the eigensolver as such.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法方法文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于迭代对角化算法、数值实现与性能测试，属于计算方法开发。；研究对象：平面波密度泛函理论（DFT）中的迭代对角化问题，即求解广义厄米特征值问题以获取Kohn-Sham本征态与带能量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种随机化块Davidson特征值求解器，通过草图内积中的随机化Gram-Schmidt替代欧氏正交化，在保持Ritz提取精确性的同时降低正交化成本；其性能优势取决于目标态数目与问题维度的相对标度关系，而非单纯由求解器本身决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种随机化块Davidson特征值求解器，通过草图内积中的随机化Gram-Schmidt替代欧氏正交化，在保持Ritz提取精确性的同时降低正交化成本；其性能优势取决于目标态数目与问题维度的相对标度关系，而非单纯由求解器本身决定。；创新点：将随机化草图技术引入块Davidson求解器，仅需对基组单次遍历即可完成正交化，且条件数不依赖于输入向量；同时保持Ritz对与交错性质（带能量为真实能量的上界）严格成立。摘要未突出说明与更早随机化特征值求解器（如随机化子空间迭代）的详细对比。
papers.method_zh: 随机化块Davidson迭代法，结合草图化内积与随机化Gram-Schmidt正交化；Rayleigh-Ritz步骤转化为确定型广义厄米特征值问题；混合精度实现，基于Julia语言编写，支持CPU与GPU，并通过矩阵自由接口与DFTK（Julia版DFT代码）集成；代码开源为RandESC库。测试包括稀疏特征值问题与完整自洽场DFT计算，并与确定性Davidson及LOBPCG对比。

papers.title: AlGaAs nanowires as a universal platform for GaAs, InGaAs, and InAs quantum dots
papers.abstract: Optical quantum dots (QDs) are central to photonic quantum technologies, with fabrication approaches tailored to different spectral ranges. A key challenge, however, is the realization of a unified platform$\unicode{x2014}$a single growth method combined with a host material offering a designable architecture$\unicode{x2014}$enabling wavelength tunability across the full emission range and co-integration of multiple quantum dots. Here, we introduce AlGaAs nanowires as a universal host for GaAs, InGaAs, and InAs QDs. Building on our previous demonstration of high-quality GaAs QDs, we realize InGaAs QDs with tunable emission by varying the growth duration from 2 to 5 s, achieving emission at 780 and 920 nm. We further showcase the platform's versatility for multi-quantum-dot devices by co-integrating two InGaAs QDs, as well as GaAs and InGaAs QDs within a single nanowire. Finally, we initiate a first step toward pure InAs QDs by growing a pristine InAs segment on AlGaAs nanowires, demonstrating material compatibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了材料生长（生长时长调控）、器件制备（共集成量子点）及光学表征（发射波长测量）。；研究对象：AlGaAs纳米线作为通用衬底材料，用于生长GaAs、InGaAs和InAs光学量子点，并研究其发射波长可调性及多量子点共集成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AlGaAs纳米线可作为通用平台，通过改变生长时长（2至5秒）实现InGaAs量子点发射波长在780 nm和920 nm之间的可调谐，并能将多个量子点（两个InGaAs QD，或GaAs与InGaAs QD）共集成于同一纳米线中；同时初步验证了纯InAs段在AlGaAs纳米线上的材料兼容性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AlGaAs纳米线可作为通用平台，通过改变生长时长（2至5秒）实现InGaAs量子点发射波长在780 nm和920 nm之间的可调谐，并能将多个量子点（两个InGaAs QD，或GaAs与InGaAs QD）共集成于同一纳米线中；同时初步验证了纯InAs段在AlGaAs纳米线上的材料兼容性。；创新点：首次提出AlGaAs纳米线作为通用宿主材料，统一了GaAs、InGaAs和InAs量子点的生长平台，实现跨波段发射可调性及多量子点单片共集成，克服了传统上不同光谱范围需不同制备方法的局限。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长AlGaAs纳米线及量子点结构；通过控制生长时长调节量子点尺寸；利用光致发光光谱表征发射波长；通过在同一纳米线中顺序生长不同组分量子点实现共集成。

papers.title: Tunable-Size Unruh-DeWitt Detector in a Multimode Cavity
papers.abstract: Quantum simulators based on Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) provide a powerful platform to study relativistic quantum-field phenomena in the lab and in particular emulate relativistic analog particle detectors. However, such detectors typically couple to excitations beyond the acoustic phonon regime, so that the nonlinear Bogoliubov dispersion introduces corrections that cause the effective relativistic description to break down. We propose to overcome this limitation using an intrinsically momentum-selective Unruh-DeWitt detector model in which a tweezer-trapped atom couples to the condensate through a multimode optical cavity. Although the atom is effectively pointlike, the cavity-mediated interaction kernel causes it to sample density fluctuations over a controllable finite region of the BEC equivalent to a finite-size detector. The effective detector size is tunable via the cavity mode structure determining a controllable momentum cutoff that filters out nonphononic excitations. We analytically calculate the response of such a detector for uniform linear acceleration and uniform circular motion and show that this momentum selectivity can enhance the signal at experimentally accessible accelerations. Compatible with existing cavity-QED platforms our scheme thus provides a versatile setting for analog quantum-field measurements or relativistic quantum-information protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose、analytically calculate、scheme。；研究对象：基于玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）的多模光腔量子模拟器中的Unruh-DeWitt探测器模型，具体研究该探测器在均匀线加速度和匀速圆周运动下的响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过多模光腔中介的动量选择性耦合，可实现尺寸可调的Unruh-DeWitt探测器，该动量选择性能够滤除非线性Bogoliubov色散带来的非声子激发，从而在实验可及的加速度下增强探测信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过多模光腔中介的动量选择性耦合，可实现尺寸可调的Unruh-DeWitt探测器，该动量选择性能够滤除非线性Bogoliubov色散带来的非声子激发，从而在实验可及的加速度下增强探测信号。；创新点：提出了一种内禀动量选择性的Unruh-DeWitt探测器方案，通过腔模结构实现可调的有限尺寸探测，克服了以往BEC模拟器中探测器耦合到非线性色散区导致相对论有效描述失效的局限。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析计算。具体为：构建一个阱中原子通过多模光腔与BEC耦合的探测器模型，利用腔模结构引入可控动量截断，解析计算探测器在均匀线加速度和匀速圆周运动下的响应函数。

papers.title: Towards Stirling cooler operable single-photon sources based on low-noise GaAs quantum dots
papers.abstract: For photonic quantum technology applications, sources capable of emitting photons with indistinguishability close to unity are essential. Ideally, these sources should not require demanding cooling systems. Here, we present temperature-dependent two-photon-interference measurements on photons produced by the radiative decay of the negative trion in a low-noise GaAs quantum dot, which are in quantitative agreement with theoretical calculations accounting for carrier-phonon interactions and coupling to excited states. While at at the lowest explored temperatures the emission linewidth reaches values only 6(2) % above the Fourier limit and the indistinguishability I between subsequently emitted photons reaches 0.966(6), the latter drops to 0.05(4) at 55 K. We show that this loss can be explained with the coupling with energetically close excited trion states and suggest that the photon indistinguishability at elevated temperatures can be increased by employing Purcell enhancement of the emission rate or by increasing the energy separation of the excited states. Using cavity-enhanced emission, we experimentally verify the first route and demonstrate an improvement in photon indistinguishability from 0.314(25) to 0.80(3) at 32 K, which - to our knowledge - is the highest reported value at such temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含理论对比与模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“temperature-dependent two-photon-interference measurements”“experimentally verify”，同时包含“theoretical calculations accounting for carrier-phonon interactions”。；研究对象：低噪声GaAs量子点中负三子（negative trion）辐射衰变产生的单光子源，重点研究其光子不可区分度（indistinguishability）随温度的变化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在最低温度下，GaAs量子点发射线宽仅比傅里叶极限高6(2)%，光子不可区分度达0.966(6)；但在55 K时不可区分度急剧下降至0.05(4)。通过腔增强（Purcell效应）可在32 K时将不可区分度从0.314(25)提升至0.80(3)，这是该温度下报道的最高值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在最低温度下，GaAs量子点发射线宽仅比傅里叶极限高6(2)%，光子不可区分度达0.966(6)；但在55 K时不可区分度急剧下降至0.05(4)。通过腔增强（Purcell效应）可在32 K时将不可区分度从0.314(25)提升至0.80(3)，这是该温度下报道的最高值。；创新点：定量解释了高温下光子不可区分度损失源于与能量相近的激发三子态的耦合，并实验验证了通过Purcell增强提升高温不可区分度的可行性，在32 K达到迄今报道的最高值。摘要未明确说明是否首次提出该理论解释或该温度记录，但“to our knowledge”表明后者为首次报道。
papers.method_zh: 温度依赖的双光子干涉（two-photon interference）测量；与考虑载流子-声子相互作用及激发态耦合的理论计算进行定量对比；采用腔增强（Purcell增强）方案提升发射率，实验验证该路线对不可区分度的改善。

papers.title: Nonlocal-nonlinear phonon polaritons
papers.abstract: When light is confined to deeply subwavelength volumes, optical responses can become nonlocal. Yet how nonlocality reshapes nonlinear light-matter interactions remains largely unexplored, particularly in dielectrics. Here, we theoretically uncover a new class of nonlinear optical processes arising from the interplay between optical-phonon propagation and ionic-bond anharmonicity in polar crystals. We show that, unlike conventional local nonlinearities, this mechanism enables second-order responses even in centrosymmetric materials. Moreover, these responses can be tuned by the confinement and resonantly enhanced near optical-phonon resonances. Using density functional perturbation theory, we quantify the resulting nonlocal second-order susceptibilities in representative polar crystals. Our results establish nonlocal-nonlinear optics as a new regime of light-matter interaction in dielectrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“theoretically uncover”（理论揭示）、“Using density functional perturbation theory”（使用密度泛函微扰理论）以及“we quantify”（量化计算）。；研究对象：极性晶体（polar crystals）中由光学声子传播（optical-phonon propagation）与离子键非谐性（ionic-bond anharmonicity）相互作用产生的非线性光学过程，具体为“非局域-非线性声子极化激元”（nonlocal-nonlinear phonon polaritons）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在极性晶体中，非局域非线性机制（源于光学声子传播与离子键非谐性的耦合）即使在中心对称材料中也能产生二阶非线性响应，且该响应可通过光场限制进行调控，并在光学声子共振附近获得共振增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在极性晶体中，非局域非线性机制（源于光学声子传播与离子键非谐性的耦合）即使在中心对称材料中也能产生二阶非线性响应，且该响应可通过光场限制进行调控，并在光学声子共振附近获得共振增强。；创新点：首次提出并系统研究了“非局域非线性光学”（nonlocal-nonlinear optics）这一介电材料中光-物质相互作用的新机制，突破了传统局域非线性光学对中心对称材料二阶响应为零的限制。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与第一性原理计算相结合。具体采用密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT，density functional perturbation theory）量化计算代表性极性晶体中的非局域二阶非线性极化率（nonlocal second-order susceptibilities）。

papers.title: Boundary Free Energies, Quenched Mixing, and Gibbs-State Selection in Disordered Ising Models
papers.abstract: We study boundary free energies and half-space responses in nearest-neighbor disordered Ising models. First, we prove the existence of fixed-depth tangential pressure and identify its derivative almost everywhere with the limiting boundary response. Second, under quenched exponential boundary-response mixing, we prove Gibbs-state selection independence and exponential convergence of finite-depth pressures. We further show that uniform one-spin mixing yields DLR uniqueness and Gaussian normal localization, and verify the required mixing conditions whenever $(2d-1)\mathbb E\tanh(β\vert{}J\vert{})<1$. Finally, we establish an all-face surface limit in the bounded Dobrushin regime and provide counterexamples that delimit general surface and stiffness claims.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“prove”“identify”“yield”“establish”等数学证明性动词，以及“Gibbs-state”“DLR uniqueness”等严格统计力学概念。；研究对象：无序伊辛模型（disordered Ising models），具体为最近邻相互作用、含随机耦合强度J的无序自旋系统，关注其边界自由能、半空间响应、Gibbs态选择等平衡统计力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无序伊辛模型中，证明了固定深度切向压力的存在性，并建立了边界响应与压力导数的几乎处处等同关系；在淬火指数边界响应混合条件下，证明了Gibbs态选择的独立性和有限深度压力的指数收敛。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无序伊辛模型中，证明了固定深度切向压力的存在性，并建立了边界响应与压力导数的几乎处处等同关系；在淬火指数边界响应混合条件下，证明了Gibbs态选择的独立性和有限深度压力的指数收敛。；创新点：首次将边界自由能、淬火混合与Gibbs态选择三者系统联系起来，给出了边界响应与压力导数的严格等同性证明，并提供了界定一般表面与刚度论断有效范围的显式反例。摘要未突出说明与具体物理体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 严格数学证明方法，属于统计力学严格分析。具体包括：固定深度切向压力的构造与极限分析、淬火指数混合条件下的压力收敛证明、均匀单自旋混合条件推导DLR唯一性、以及Dobrushin有界区域下的全表面极限分析。关键判据为(2d−1)E tanh(β|J|)<1。

papers.title: Stable rotating vortex clusters in three-dimensional quantum droplets
papers.abstract: We predict a new type of stable three-dimensional (3D) vortex quantum droplets in binary Bose-Einstein condensate arranged into ring clusters that per-sistently rotate in the external potential. In contrast to clusters composed from localized quantum droplets, the states introduced here represent interacting vortex lines with identical topological charges nested in common 3D envelope and existing in much broader parameter range in comparison with local-ized quantum droplets. The intricate interplay between mean-field nonlinearity of Bose-Einstein condensate, quantum fluctuations described by Lee-Huang-Yang correction, Coriolis force arising due to rotation, and external potential leads to substantial variations of cluster shape upon increase of its rotation frequency. Rotating vortex clusters bifurcate from single-vortex quantum droplets and exist only above critical value of the rotation frequency that decreases with increase of chemical potential and depends on the number of vortex lines in the cluster. The radius of the cluster decreases with increase of rotation frequency and weakly varies with chemical potential, which determines mostly localization of the individual vortices in cluster and overall width of its envelope. Vortex droplet clusters are very robust objects existing in stable form in wide intervals of the number of particles for any number (odd or even) of vortex lines forming them. Our results may open the route to observation of stable arrays of vortex lines of different configurations per-forming regular collective motion in condensate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要使用“predict”（预言）、“exist”（存在）等理论描述，未提及实验手段，属于理论预言与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）中的三维量子液滴，具体为在外部势阱中旋转的涡旋线环状团簇（vortex line ring clusters）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预言了一类新型稳定的三维旋转涡旋量子液滴团簇：由相同拓扑荷的相互作用涡旋线嵌套在共同三维包络中构成，其稳定存在的参数范围远宽于局域量子液滴团簇，且团簇形状随旋转频率增加发生显著变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预言了一类新型稳定的三维旋转涡旋量子液滴团簇：由相同拓扑荷的相互作用涡旋线嵌套在共同三维包络中构成，其稳定存在的参数范围远宽于局域量子液滴团簇，且团簇形状随旋转频率增加发生显著变化。；创新点：与已有由局域量子液滴构成的团簇不同，该工作首次提出由涡旋线（而非局域液滴）组成的旋转环状团簇，并揭示其从单涡旋量子液滴分岔的机制及临界旋转频率的存在。摘要未突出说明与具体实验平台的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 基于平均场非线性（Gross-Pitaevskii类方程）与Lee-Huang-Yang量子涨落修正相结合的理论框架，并引入旋转参考系中的科里奥利力项，通过数值求解研究团簇的稳定性与分岔行为。

papers.title: Time-Dependent Tunneling in the Thin-Barrier Limit
papers.abstract: The usual WKB analysis for quantum tunneling applies when the tunneling action is large, as it is for tall, wide potential barriers. In contrast we analyze tunneling when the action is small, as it is for tunneling across a tall, thin barrier. We develop a perturbative analysis where the control parameter is the inverse of the area under the potential barrier and apply our technique to several examples in $1+1$ dimensions. In resonant situations for bound particles we find that the tunneling probability grows with time as $\propto t^2$, while in non-resonant situations it grows linearly with time. We evaluate not only the tunneling probability but also the time-dependent tunneling wavefunction for a particle that escapes to infinity, {\it i.e.} from a quasi-bound state to the continuum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：WKB analysis、perturbative analysis、1+1 dimensions。；研究对象：量子隧穿现象，具体为薄势垒（tall, thin barrier）极限下的含时隧穿过程，涉及准束缚态到连续态的粒子逃逸。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在薄势垒极限下（隧穿作用量小），束缚粒子的隧穿概率在共振情形下随时间呈 ∝ t² 增长，非共振情形下随时间线性增长；同时给出了逃逸粒子的含时隧穿波函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在薄势垒极限下（隧穿作用量小），束缚粒子的隧穿概率在共振情形下随时间呈 ∝ t² 增长，非共振情形下随时间线性增长；同时给出了逃逸粒子的含时隧穿波函数。；创新点：传统 WKB 分析适用于高而宽的势垒（大作用量），本文则针对高而薄的势垒（小作用量）发展了一套微扰理论，填补了该极限下含时隧穿行为的理论空白。
papers.method_zh: 以势垒面积倒数为控制参数的微扰分析方法，在 1+1 维空间中应用于多个示例，并计算了含时隧穿概率与波函数。

papers.title: Quantifying the Biophysical Properties of Red Blood Cells in Gaucher Disease
papers.abstract: Gaucher disease (GD), the most common lysosomal storage disorder, alters red blood cell (RBC) mechanics and circulation, contributing to vascular occlusions, bone infarcts, and splenomegaly. However, the individual roles of GD-RBC biophysical properties in these processes remain unclear. Here, we present a combined computational-experimental investigation to quantitatively characterize GD-RBC biophysical properties and determine how specific mechanical parameters drive abnormal RBC behavior. Informed by experimental data, we independently quantify key RBC properties, including shear modulus (mu), surface-to-volume ratio (S/V), and bending modulus (k_c). Based on these parameters, we construct three GD-RBC subtypes (GD-RBC1-3) to systematically isolate their individual contributions. At the single-cell level, optical tweezers simulations show up to ~27% reduction in axial diameter and ~42% reduction in transverse compression. Tank-treading dynamics exhibit non-monotonic behavior, with rotation frequencies increasing by up to ~70% or decreasing under elevated bending rigidity. In confined flow, traversal times through microchannel constrictions increase by more than a factor of two, while splenic slit passage times rise from ~250 ms (control) to >1200 ms for the severe GD-RBC subtype, approaching a functional no-passage threshold. At the population level, viscosity simulations demonstrate that these alterations collectively elevate blood viscosity, with small fractions (~4.0%) of highly rigid cells disproportionately increasing flow resistance. Overall, this study provides a quantitative and mechanistic framework that disentangles the contributions of key RBC parameters to abnormal behavior in GD, linking cellular-scale biophysics to hematologic dysfunction and microvascular occlusion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算-实验联合研究）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combined computational-experimental investigation”，包含光学镊子模拟、受限流动模拟、黏度模拟等计算手段，以及实验数据支撑。；研究对象：戈谢病（Gaucher disease, GD）患者红细胞（RBC）的生物物理性质，具体包括剪切模量（μ）、表面积-体积比（S/V）和弯曲模量（k_c）等力学参数，以及这些参数对单细胞形变、坦克履带运动、微通道/脾窦穿行和血液黏度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 戈谢病红细胞的力学参数改变（如剪切模量升高、弯曲刚度增大）导致单细胞形变能力显著下降（轴向直径减少达~27%，横向压缩减少达~42%），在受限流动中穿行时间成倍增加（脾窦穿行时间从~250 ms增至>1200 ms），且少量（~4.0%）高刚性细胞即可不成比例地升高血液黏度，提示其与微血管闭塞和血流动力学障碍直接相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：戈谢病红细胞的力学参数改变（如剪切模量升高、弯曲刚度增大）导致单细胞形变能力显著下降（轴向直径减少达~27%，横向压缩减少达~42%），在受限流动中穿行时间成倍增加（脾窦穿行时间从~250 ms增至>1200 ms），且少量（~4.0%）高刚性细胞即可不成比例地升高血液黏度，提示其与微血管闭塞和血流动力学障碍直接相关。；创新点：该工作首次系统性地将戈谢病红细胞的多个关键力学参数（μ、S/V、k_c）独立解耦，构建三种亚型（GD-RBC1-3）以分别评估各参数的单独贡献，建立了从单细胞力学到群体血流动力学再到微血管闭塞的定量机制框架。摘要未突出说明与传统单一参数研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: - 光学镊子模拟（optical tweezers simulations）：用于单细胞形变分析；

papers.title: The Loss Floor of Denoising Score Matching: Fisher Geometry from Schrödinger Bridges
papers.abstract: Denoising score matching trains diffusion models by regressing onto a conditional score, although generation ultimately requires the marginal score. The two objectives share the same population minimizer, but the conditional target remains random at fixed noisy state and introduces an irreducible excess in the training loss. We isolate this excess and show that, for a general corruption kernel under mild regularity assumptions, it is exactly the trace of the Fisher--Rao metric of the conditional endpoint family, integrated along the diffusion trajectory. This gives an exact conditional-variance decomposition of the denoising objective and identifies the information geometry observed in diffusion latent spaces as an intrinsic component of the training loss. We derive the result from a Schr"odinger bridge variational principle, in which the ideal objective arises as excess path-space relative entropy. For corruption diffusions, the Fisher term is proportional to the rate at which the noisy state loses mutual information about the clean data, separating the loss floor into an information flow determined by the data and a weight determined by the corruption schedule and objective. In the Gaussian case, this yields a closed form for the floor, recovers reparametrization invariance of the continuous-time objective, and relates its high-SNR divergence to the information dimension of the data. Finally, we show that raw losses obtained with different noise ranges or weightings need not rank models consistently because they contain different additive floors, and contrast the second-order geometry seen by training with the third-order conditional statistics entering numerical sampling error.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“variational principle”“Fisher--Rao metric”“Schrödinger bridge”等理论推导与数学分析，未提及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：扩散模型（diffusion models）中的去噪分数匹配（denoising score matching）训练目标，特别是其训练损失下限（loss floor）与Fisher几何之间的关系。属于机器学习与统计物理交叉领域，而非传统凝聚态材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 去噪分数匹配的训练损失中，存在一个由条件端点族Fisher–Rao度量迹给出的不可约超额项（即损失下限），该超额项沿扩散轨迹积分，且与噪声状态对干净数据互信息的损失速率成正比。在Gaussian情形下，该下限有闭式表达式，并揭示了高信噪比发散与数据信息维度之间的联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：去噪分数匹配的训练损失中，存在一个由条件端点族Fisher–Rao度量迹给出的不可约超额项（即损失下限），该超额项沿扩散轨迹积分，且与噪声状态对干净数据互信息的损失速率成正比。在Gaussian情形下，该下限有闭式表达式，并揭示了高信噪比发散与数据信息维度之间的联系。；创新点：首次将去噪分数匹配的损失下限精确分解为条件方差项，并识别为Fisher–Rao度量的迹；通过Schrödinger桥变分原理建立了信息几何与训练损失的内在联系；证明了不同噪声范围或加权下的原始损失因包含不同加性下限而不能一致地排序模型性能。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：利用Schrödinger桥变分原理，将理想目标视为路径空间相对熵的超额部分；结合Fisher–Rao信息几何、互信息流分析以及Gaussian情形的解析推导。未使用具体数值或实验手段。

papers.title: Hartree--Fock coercivity for twisted bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: We study the minimisers of the Hartree--Fock functional for flat bands in the chiral model of twisted bilayer graphene introduced by Tarnopolsky, Kruchkov, and Vishwanath. Our model is a continuous version of the discrete model considered by Becker, Lin and Stubbs in previous works and the first result is a direct analogue of main theorems of those papers: at half filling of the flat band of multiplicity two, there are exactly two minimisers, obtained by occupying either one of the two sub-bands. (A more general version of this result, stressing its topological origins, was presented in Appendix A.8 of the Lecture Notes by Tao-Zworski.) The new contribution is the strict coercivity of the Hessian of the Hartree--Fock functional at the two minimisers. It is a consequence of the difference between the Chern numbers of the component bands and can be optimistically considered as a soft version of a ``spectral gap''.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及Hartree–Fock泛函的数学分析、极小值存在性与Hessian严格强制性证明，属于解析理论工作。；研究对象：手性模型（chiral model）中的扭转双层石墨烯（twisted bilayer graphene, TBG）平带系统，具体为Tarnopolsky–Kruchkov–Vishwanath提出的连续模型，关注半填充（half filling）时平带的基态结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在半填充（二重简并平带占据一个子带）时，Hartree–Fock泛函恰好存在两个极小值；且这两个极小值处Hessian具有严格强制性（strict coercivity），该强制性源于两个子带Chern数之差，可视为一种“软”谱隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在半填充（二重简并平带占据一个子带）时，Hartree–Fock泛函恰好存在两个极小值；且这两个极小值处Hessian具有严格强制性（strict coercivity），该强制性源于两个子带Chern数之差，可视为一种“软”谱隙。；创新点：首次证明了Hartree–Fock泛函在两个极小值处Hessian的严格强制性，并将其与子带Chern数差直接关联，为平带系统的“谱隙”提供了一种软性（soft）替代表述。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论方法：对连续Hartree–Fock泛函进行变分分析，研究平带极小值的存在性与唯一性；通过计算Hessian的强制性（coercivity）来证明基态的稳定性。该工作是对Becker–Lin–Stubbs离散模型结果的连续版本推广，并引用了Tao–Zworski讲义中的拓扑论证。

papers.title: Differential Learning for Robust Prediction of Thermal Stability with Application to Energetic Materials
papers.abstract: Predicting thermal stability during handling and storage is essential for the design of safe and reliable energetic materials. However, experimental measurements vary significantly across laboratories due to differences in protocols and analysis methods, making it difficult to train reliable predictive models. We address this challenge through differential learning. Rather than predicting absolute decomposition temperatures, we instead train message passing neural networks to predict relative differences between pairs of molecules. This approach reduces sensitivity to systematic experimental errors and achieves >85% accuracy in ranking compounds by thermal stability, outperforming conventional regression methods on the same heterogeneous dataset. To understand what drives these predictions, we compare neural network models with interpretable alternatives built from descriptors derived from ab initio calculations and cheminformatics software. This analysis identifies bond dissociation enthalpy as a key determinant of thermal stability rankings, providing further insight into the complex chemistry of thermal decomposition. The differential learning framework generalizes across model architectures, from graph neural networks to classical descriptor-based approaches. Our results demonstrate that learning relative properties rather than absolute values offers a practical solution for modeling noisy experimental data, with direct applications in materials design where thermal stability predictions inform safety protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：训练神经网络模型、消息传递神经网络、从头计算（ab initio）描述符、图神经网络等关键词。；研究对象：含能材料（energetic materials）的热稳定性，具体为分子分解温度及其排序预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过差分学习（differential learning）训练模型预测分子对之间的相对热稳定性差异，而非绝对分解温度，可在异质实验数据集上实现超过85%的排序准确率，优于传统回归方法；键解离焓（bond dissociation enthalpy）被识别为热稳定性排序的关键决定因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过差分学习（differential learning）训练模型预测分子对之间的相对热稳定性差异，而非绝对分解温度，可在异质实验数据集上实现超过85%的排序准确率，优于传统回归方法；键解离焓（bond dissociation enthalpy）被识别为热稳定性排序的关键决定因素。；创新点：提出差分学习框架，通过预测分子间相对差异来规避跨实验室系统性实验误差，该框架可推广至图神经网络和经典描述符模型等多种架构。摘要未突出说明与以往差分学习方法的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 消息传递神经网络（MPNN）用于差分学习；对比了基于从头计算和化学信息学软件（cheminformatics）描述符的可解释模型；采用相对差异（成对比较）训练策略，而非绝对温度回归。

papers.title: General Construction of Time-Dependent Integrable Chiral Field Theories
papers.abstract: We develop a general procedure for constructing time-dependent integrable chiral field theories from autonomous unitary difference-form $S$-matrices satisfying the Yang-Baxter equation. Spectral parameters are transported along the free right- and left-moving characteristics, defining a map from physical spacetime to spectral space on which the two-body scattering data are evaluated. Requiring spatially homogeneous right-left scattering forces the characteristic map to be affine. The inverse Cayley transform then determines the local contact interaction, while evaluation along the affine spectral trajectory fixes its time dependence. Thus, the nonautonomous interaction is determined by the autonomous scattering data together with chiral kinematics and spatial homogeneity, rather than being introduced independently. The Yang--Baxter equation supplies the factorized many-body transport, and on a spatial circle periodicity leads to quantum Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov (qKZ) equations whose compatibility defines a flat discrete transport in spectral space. Pulling the corresponding spectral-space amplitudes back to physical coordinates gives the time-dependent many-body wavefunctions. Rational $SU(N)$, trigonometric $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}}_2)$, and rational $O(N)$ scattering illustrate how the same mechanism generates distinct nonautonomous interactions. The resulting framework gives a geometric route from autonomous factorized scattering data to time-dependent integrable field theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：constructing、procedure、Yang-Baxter equation、integrable field theories。；研究对象：时依赖（非自治）可积手征场论的一般构造方法，涉及一维可积散射与量子场论中的多体波函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种通用程序，从满足杨-巴克斯特方程的自治幺正差分形式S矩阵出发，通过手征运动学与空间均匀性唯一确定非自治（时依赖）局域相互作用，从而构造出时依赖可积手征场论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种通用程序，从满足杨-巴克斯特方程的自治幺正差分形式S矩阵出发，通过手征运动学与空间均匀性唯一确定非自治（时依赖）局域相互作用，从而构造出时依赖可积手征场论。；创新点：非自治相互作用并非独立引入，而是由自治散射数据、手征运动学和空间均匀性共同决定，提供了一条从自治因子化散射数据到时依赖可积场论的几何构造路线。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：利用谱参数沿左右移动特征线输运，定义物理时空到谱空间的映射；要求空间均匀散射迫使该映射为仿射变换；通过逆Cayley变换确定局域接触相互作用，并沿仿射谱轨迹求值得到时间依赖项；在空间圆上利用周期性导出量子Knizhnik–Zamolodchikov（qKZ）方程，其相容性给出谱空间中的平坦离散输运，最终将谱空间振幅拉回物理坐标得到多体波函数。具体示例包括有理型SU(N)、三角型U_q(𝔰𝔩̂₂)和有理型O(N)散射。

papers.title: Classification of Non-Hermitian Flat Bands
papers.abstract: Exact flat bands provide a versatile setting for correlated and topological phenomena, yet their properties are controlled not only by their dispersion but also by the structure of their Bloch projectors. Here, we establish a projector-based classification of non-Hermitian flat bands. In contrast to Hermitian flat bands, non-Hermiticity introduces a biorthogonal projector whose left-right pairing permits a distinct norm-pole singularity. We identify four classes: analytic NH-A, continuous but nonanalytic NH-C, bounded but discontinuous NH-D, and pole-singular NH-E. We show that continuity of the biorthogonal projector preserves the locking of the right, left, and biorthogonal Chern numbers, $C_R=C_L=C_{\rm bi}$, thereby realizing non-Hermitian critical topological flat bands. Once continuity is lost, this locking can break down; in particular, a mismatch $C_R\neq C_L$ can occur in the NH-E class. Finally, we show that this Chern number mismatch ensures to produce an anomalous enhancement of resonant cross-orbital transfer. Our results establish biorthogonal projector regularity as the organizing principle linking compact localized states, topology, and driven response in non-Hermitian flat bands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“我们建立”“我们证明”等理论推导性表述，且核心内容为分类学与拓扑不变量分析，未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：非厄米平带（non-Hermitian flat bands）系统，具体关注其布洛赫投影算符（Bloch projectors）的数学结构、拓扑性质（Chern数）以及驱动响应（共振跨轨道转移）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米性引入双正交投影算符，其连续性决定了平带拓扑性质的锁定与否：连续时右、左、双正交Chern数相等（C_R=C_L=C_bi），实现非厄米临界拓扑平带；连续性破坏后锁定失效，NH-E类中可出现C_R≠C_L，并导致共振跨轨道转移的异常增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米性引入双正交投影算符，其连续性决定了平带拓扑性质的锁定与否：连续时右、左、双正交Chern数相等（C_R=C_L=C_bi），实现非厄米临界拓扑平带；连续性破坏后锁定失效，NH-E类中可出现C_R≠C_L，并导致共振跨轨道转移的异常增强。；创新点：首次建立非厄米平带的投影算符分类体系（NH-A/C/D/E四类），揭示双正交投影算符的正则性（连续性/解析性）作为统一组织原理，将紧致局域态、拓扑与驱动响应联系起来。摘要未突出说明与具体材料或实验体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为基于投影算符（projector）的数学分类方法，结合非厄米能带理论中的双正交（biorthogonal）形式，以及Chern数拓扑不变量分析。摘要未提及具体数值算法或实验技术。

papers.title: Multi-hour stable trapping and threshold steady state of non-laser-coolable ions with ultracold atoms in a hybrid trap
papers.abstract: We report multi-hour stable trapping and steady state of non-laser-coolable Cs$^{+}$ ions in a linear Paul trap, achieved via resonant charge-exchange (RCE) cooling with a precisely centered ultracold Cs cloud. Without cold atoms, all ions are lost within 3 minutes. With centered cold atoms, RCE cooling establishes a stable population of ions for 6 hours with no measurable decay -- more than two orders of magnitude longer hold times compared to prior hybrid atom-ion systems. We observe a threshold behavior in the steady-state number of ions ($N_{s}$): initial ion loadings above $N_{s}$ ions converge downward to $N_{s}$ ions and remain constant thereafter; initial loadings below $N_{s}$ ions show no measurable decay. The dynamics is governed by a competition between ion-ion rf heating and ion-atom collisional cooling. The prolonged, simultaneous ion-atom trapping suggests an upper bound on the three-body recombination-induced Cs$_{2}^{+}$ formation rate constant: $k_{3} << 1.4 \times 10^{-25} cm^{6} s^{-1}$. This remarkable realization of long-lived steady state overcomes a critical limitation of prior hybrid atom-ion systems and enables extended studies of ultracold ion-neutral chemistry, rare inelastic collisions, and sympathetic cooling routes for complex molecular ions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确报告了实验观测结果（“We report multi-hour stable trapping...”），并给出了具体的实验测量数据（如“6 hours with no measurable decay”）。；研究对象：混合离子-原子阱系统。具体为：非激光可冷却的铯离子（Cs⁺）与超冷铯原子（Cs）在混合阱（线性Paul阱 + 磁光阱/光偶极阱）中的共存与稳态动力学。核心物理现象包括共振电荷交换冷却、离子间射频加热与离子-原子碰撞冷却的竞争，以及三体复合过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实现了非激光可冷却的Cs⁺离子在超冷原子云中的多小时（6小时）稳定囚禁，且离子数达到阈值稳态；该稳态寿命比此前混合原子-离子系统长两个数量级以上。同时给出了三体复合诱导的Cs₂⁺生成速率常数的上限（k₃ << 1.4 × 10⁻²⁵ cm⁶ s⁻¹）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实现了非激光可冷却的Cs⁺离子在超冷原子云中的多小时（6小时）稳定囚禁，且离子数达到阈值稳态；该稳态寿命比此前混合原子-离子系统长两个数量级以上。同时给出了三体复合诱导的Cs₂⁺生成速率常数的上限（k₃ << 1.4 × 10⁻²⁵ cm⁶ s⁻¹）。；创新点：首次在混合原子-离子系统中实现了非激光可冷却离子的多小时稳定囚禁（此前此类离子通常在数分钟内损失殆尽），并揭示了阈值稳态行为（初始离子数高于Nₛ时向下收敛，低于Nₛ时无衰减）。这一长寿命稳态克服了此前混合系统的关键瓶颈，为超冷离子-中性分子化学、稀有非弹性碰撞及复杂分子离子 sympathetic 冷却研究打开了时间窗口。摘要未突出说明其他创新点（如技术细节上的改进）。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：线性Paul阱囚禁Cs⁺离子，与精确对准的超冷Cs原子云（磁光阱或光偶极阱）重叠；采用共振电荷交换（RCE）冷却机制；通过测量离子存活时间、稳态离子数（Nₛ）随初始装载数的变化来表征系统动力学。摘要未明确说明具体的离子探测手段（如荧光成像或飞行时间质谱），也未提及原子云的详细制备参数（如温度、密度）。

papers.title: On Split Forms of Fusion Categories
papers.abstract: We formulate split Galois descent for fusion categories through framed equivalences, reducing the existence of a split form to a group-theoretic splitting problem. The associated degree-two obstruction combines categorical coherence with stable descent of the simple objects, while fusion spaces impose index and parity restrictions. For quantum groups at roots of unity, we use the quasi-$R$-matrix to make the bar involution tensor-compatible and prove that the underlying fusion category $\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)$, associated with the simply connected root datum, has a split form over the maximal totally real subfield of the cyclotomic field generated by the quantum parameter. The same holds for all its cyclotomic Galois conjugates; in particular, every $\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)$ has a split real form. By contrast, no split real form exists for the standard braiding except on $\mathcal C(E_8,1)$ and $\mathcal C(D_{4m},1)$, $m \geq 1$. We further show that associative zesting can destroy real descent of $\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)$, while every braided zesting of $\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)$ still admits a split real form as an underlying fusion category. Applications to pointed and finite-group representation categories give criteria for real descent in terms of cohomology and Frobenius--Schur indicators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及“Galois descent”“framed equivalences”“obstruction”“fusion categories”等纯数学物理理论概念，无实验或数值计算关键词。；研究对象：融合范畴（fusion categories）的“分裂形式”（split forms），特别是与量子群在单位根处相关的融合范畴 \(\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)\) 及其在最大全实子域上的实形式（real forms），以及辫子结构、zesting 操作对实下降的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了与单连通根数据相关的融合范畴 \(\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)\) 及其所有分圆 Galois 共轭均存在分裂形式（从而存在分裂实形式）；但标准辫子结构仅在 \(\mathcal C(E_8,1)\) 和 \(\mathcal C(D_{4m},1)\) 上允许分裂实形式。此外，结合性 zesting 可破坏实下降，而所有辫子 zesting 仍保留分裂实形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了与单连通根数据相关的融合范畴 \(\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)\) 及其所有分圆 Galois 共轭均存在分裂形式（从而存在分裂实形式）；但标准辫子结构仅在 \(\mathcal C(E_8,1)\) 和 \(\mathcal C(D_{4m},1)\) 上允许分裂实形式。此外，结合性 zesting 可破坏实下降，而所有辫子 zesting 仍保留分裂实形式。；创新点：首次将分裂 Galois 下降系统化为 framed equivalences 框架，并利用准 \(R\)-矩阵构造张量相容的 bar 对合，从而统一证明量子群融合范畴及其 Galois 共轭的实形式存在性；同时揭示了辫子结构对实形式存在性的强限制，以及 zesting 操作对实下降的不同影响。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：分裂 Galois 下降（split Galois descent）通过 framed equivalences 表述，将分裂形式的存在性归结为群论分裂问题；使用准 \(R\)-矩阵（quasi-\(R\)-matrix）使 bar 对合与张量结构相容；结合范畴相干性、简单对象的稳定下降、融合空间（fusion spaces）的指标与奇偶性限制；对 pointed 和有限群表示范畴应用上同调与 Frobenius–Schur 指示子判据。

papers.title: Hamiltonian Learning at Scale
papers.abstract: Learning a quantum system's Hamiltonian is crucial for understanding and controlling its dynamics and has recently become a topic of widespread interest. To understand the learning protocol's error tolerances, i.e. its stability in the presence of inevitable errors, this work utilizes tensor network techniques to emulate Hamiltonian learning workflows at scale and with noise. Specifically, we employed a Hamiltonian learning technique based on approximate stationary states which are constructed using matrix product tools. We provide analytic bounds on the Hamiltonian learning estimation errors and perform numerical simulations that highlight learning error's stability under two families of errors. Using our workflow, we are able to scale up the protocol and learn mixed-field Ising model Hamiltonians of an $N=300$ site spin chain. By simulating the protocol at large scale, and empirically studying its practical limitations, our analysis of how errors affect the Hamiltonian learning process provides valuable lessons for future experiments. We conclude by discussing the avenues our work opens as well as future work that can support Hamiltonian learning experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“utilizes tensor network techniques”“perform numerical simulations”“provide analytic bounds”，属于数值模拟与理论分析结合。；研究对象：量子系统的哈密顿量学习（Hamiltonian learning）协议，具体体系为N=300格点的混合场伊辛模型（mixed-field Ising model）自旋链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作利用张量网络技术将哈密顿量学习协议扩展到300格点的大尺度，并证明在两类误差存在下学习误差具有稳定性；同时给出了学习估计误差的解析界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作利用张量网络技术将哈密顿量学习协议扩展到300格点的大尺度，并证明在两类误差存在下学习误差具有稳定性；同时给出了学习估计误差的解析界。；创新点：首次将哈密顿量学习协议扩展到300格点的大尺度系统，并通过大规模模拟实证研究了误差对学习过程的影响，为未来实验提供了关于误差容限的实用指导。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于矩阵乘积态（matrix product states）构造近似稳态，结合张量网络模拟哈密顿量学习流程；对混合场伊辛模型自旋链进行大规模数值模拟，并辅以解析误差界推导。

papers.title: Renormalization Group Flow Matching for Scalable Local Generative Modeling
papers.abstract: Despite their remarkable success in modeling complex data, generative models face a fundamental tradeoff. Global approaches can capture full structural coherence but suffer from high computational costs, while local models are efficient but often fail to reproduce long-range correlations and global coherence. The renormalization group (RG) bridges this gap by seamlessly connecting spatial structures across different length scales, retaining quasi-local descriptions at each step while preserving long-range correlations. We introduce renormalization group flow matching (RGFM), a generative framework that systematically structures data generation across different spatial scales. By using an exact RG flow as the probability path, RGFM progressively generates data from long- to short-wavelength structures. To reconcile scalability with global structure, we exploit two key properties of the RG: quasi-locality and scale separation. We rigorously show that the RGFM probability flow can be accurately approximated by local velocity fields acting over a spatial range $O(Λ^{-1}[\ln L+\ln(1/\varepsilon)])$ for RG wavenumber scale $Λ$, linear system size $L$, and prescribed error tolerance $\varepsilon$. This property enables local generative modeling with patches of size $O(\ln L)$ and a computational cost that scales nearly linearly with the system volume. We numerically demonstrate that local RGFM reproduces long-range correlations far beyond its receptive field in representative one-dimensional distributions, while conventional local flow matching exhibits substantial errors at long distances. On FFHQ images, RGFM yields far more coherent and higher-quality samples than local flow matching at 64x64 and 256x256. Our results establish RG-guided probability flows as a promising route toward scalable generative modeling that captures long-range structure using only local computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论框架构建（RG flow作为概率路径）、严格数学证明（rigorously show）、以及数值模拟（numerically demonstrate）。；研究对象：生成模型中的多尺度数据生成问题，具体应用于一维分布和FFHQ图像（64x64和256x256）。物理背景为重整化群（RG）理论在空间尺度连接中的应用，但研究对象本身并非特定凝聚态材料或量子系统，而是生成建模的数学结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出重整化群流匹配（RGFM）框架，证明其概率流可由局域速度场在空间范围O(Λ⁻¹[ln L + ln(1/ε)])内精确近似，从而以近线性计算成本实现长程关联的生成；数值上，局域RGFM在远超出感受野的距离上仍能复现长程关联，而传统局域流匹配在长距离上误差显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出重整化群流匹配（RGFM）框架，证明其概率流可由局域速度场在空间范围O(Λ⁻¹[ln L + ln(1/ε)])内精确近似，从而以近线性计算成本实现长程关联的生成；数值上，局域RGFM在远超出感受野的距离上仍能复现长程关联，而传统局域流匹配在长距离上误差显著。；创新点：首次将重整化群流作为生成模型的概率路径，利用RG的准局域性实现局域计算下的全局结构保持，严格证明了局域速度场近似的可行性，并展示了在图像生成中相比传统局域流匹配的显著优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：以精确RG流作为概率路径，利用RG的准局域性和尺度分离性质；数学证明：推导局域速度场近似的误差界；数值模拟：一维代表性分布上的长程关联测试，以及FFHQ图像上的64x64和256x256生成实验，与常规局域流匹配对比。

papers.title: TRACE: Transition-Aware Residual Control for Multi-Objective Materials Discovery
papers.abstract: Multi-objective materials discovery with LLM agents is often limited not only by how many candidates can be proposed, but by how effectively each costly property evaluation informs the next search step. Existing agents mainly store evaluated candidates and their scores, so they know which materials succeeded but not which executable edits caused useful property changes. This makes local refinement difficult when objectives compete and an edit that improves one property may damage another. We propose TRACE, a transition-aware residual control framework that treats evaluated edits as the basic unit of feedback. TRACE records each local refinement as a parent-edit-child transition with observed property deltas, aggregates transition evidence to estimate reusable edit effects, and ranks future edits by their predicted ability to reduce the current candidate's remaining constraint violations while avoiding damage to already satisfied objectives. In a controlled same-backbone comparison, TRACE improves over LLEMA, the state-of-the-art LLM-agent baseline, raising macro-average hit rate from 18.13\% to 25.96\%.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于LLM智能体框架设计、反馈机制与命中率提升，属于机器学习驱动的材料发现方法研究，而非实验或传统物理理论。；研究对象：多目标材料发现（multi-objective materials discovery），即需同时优化多个相互冲突的材料属性（如某一性质提升会损害另一性质）的候选材料体系。摘要未明确指定具体材料类别。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出TRACE框架，将“局部编辑（parent-edit-child transition）”作为反馈基本单元，通过聚合编辑前后属性变化（property deltas）来估计可复用的编辑效果，从而在保持已满足目标的同时减少剩余约束违反。在相同主干模型对比中，TRACE将宏平均命中率从18.13%提升至25.96%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出TRACE框架，将“局部编辑（parent-edit-child transition）”作为反馈基本单元，通过聚合编辑前后属性变化（property deltas）来估计可复用的编辑效果，从而在保持已满足目标的同时减少剩余约束违反。在相同主干模型对比中，TRACE将宏平均命中率从18.13%提升至25.96%。；创新点：将反馈单元从“已评估候选及其分数”细化为“可执行的编辑及其属性变化”，使智能体不仅知道哪些材料成功，还知道哪些具体修改导致了有用的性质变化，从而在目标竞争时实现更有效的局部精修。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于LLM智能体的材料发现框架，具体包括：①将每次局部优化记录为“父结构-编辑-子结构”三元组并附带观测到的属性差值；②聚合多次编辑证据以估计可复用编辑效应；③按预测的“减少剩余约束违反且不损害已满足目标”的能力对候选编辑排序。基线为LLEMA（state-of-the-art LLM-agent方法）。

papers.title: Ultracold Neutron Sources: An Essentially Enhanced Optimal Operation Temperature for Ortho-Deuterium-Based Superthermal Converters
papers.abstract: There is a longstanding dogma in the physics of ultracold neutrons (UCN): The optimal temperature of ortho-deuterium based UCN-sources must not exceed $5\,\mathrm{K}$. This value has been established by the pioneering work of Golub et al. decades ago, utilizing previously established cross sections for solid ortho-deuterium. But recently, an improved calculation of the crucial 1-phonon up-scattering cross section - using the so-called corrected Incoherent Approximation - leads to a new upper limit for the optimal operation temperature of ortho-deuterium based UCN sources. After a discussion of the relevant cross sections of the \(\mathrm{D}_2\)-molecule we conclude that the optimal temperature lies between $10\,\mathrm{K}$ and $12\,\mathrm{K}$, a factor 2 higher than estimated earlier. This offers significantly relaxed cryogenic conditions for UCN experiments with solid ortho-deuterium and especially for the operation of ortho-deuterium based ultracold neutron sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要提到“improved calculation of the crucial 1-phonon up-scattering cross section”，属于基于已有实验截面的理论计算与重新分析。；研究对象：固态正氘（ortho-deuterium, o-D₂）基超热转换型超冷中子（UCN）源，具体关注其最佳工作温度以及D₂分子的相关散射截面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 正氘基UCN源的最佳工作温度并非长期公认的不超过5 K，而是应提高至10–12 K，约为此前估计值的两倍。这一结论源于对关键的单声子升散射截面的改进计算（采用修正的非相干近似）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：正氘基UCN源的最佳工作温度并非长期公认的不超过5 K，而是应提高至10–12 K，约为此前估计值的两倍。这一结论源于对关键的单声子升散射截面的改进计算（采用修正的非相干近似）。；创新点：推翻了数十年来“正氘基UCN源工作温度不得超过5 K”的既有定论，将最佳温度上限提升至10–12 K，从而显著放宽了固态正氘UCN实验所需的低温条件。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算：使用“修正的非相干近似”（corrected Incoherent Approximation）重新计算固态正氘中1-声子升散射截面，并结合对D₂分子相关散射截面的讨论，推导最佳工作温度上限。

papers.title: Compact nondestructive generator for microsecond-class ultrafast pulsed magnetic fields
papers.abstract: The sweep rate of pulsed magnetic fields is a key factor in exploring of nonequilibrium phenomena in matter. However, the nondestructive generation of ultrafast pulsed magnetic fields is challenging because of the large time constants associated with the large inductance and capacitance of conventional pulsed magnetic field generators, as well as the residual inductance of the power devices and the system itself. We have developed a new compact pulsed magnetic field generator using commercially available state-of-the-art ultrafast power devices, enabling the generation of ultrafast pulsed magnetic fields up to approximately 1 T with a pulse duration of 3.8 μs. We present the performance of the newly developed system and compare the experimentally obtained magnetic field waveforms with the results of a simple circuit simulation. In addition, we demonstrate magnetization measurements on cobalt powder and Faraday rotation measurements on CdS single crystal using the developed system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了新系统的开发、性能展示、实验波形与电路模拟对比，以及实际测量演示（关键词：developed、experimentally obtained、demonstrate magnetization measurements、Faraday rotation measurements）。；研究对象：脉冲磁场发生器及其产生的超快脉冲磁场（约1 T、脉宽3.8 μs），并用于钴粉的磁化测量和CdS单晶的法拉第旋转测量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用商用超快功率器件构建的紧凑型脉冲磁场发生器，可实现非破坏性的微秒级（3.8 μs）超快脉冲磁场，峰值约1 T，并成功用于实际物性测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用商用超快功率器件构建的紧凑型脉冲磁场发生器，可实现非破坏性的微秒级（3.8 μs）超快脉冲磁场，峰值约1 T，并成功用于实际物性测量。；创新点：通过采用商用超快功率器件，显著降低了传统脉冲磁场发生器因大电感和电容带来的时间常数问题，实现了紧凑、非破坏性的微秒级超快脉冲磁场产生。摘要未突出说明与传统方案在具体器件架构上的差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用商用超快功率器件搭建紧凑型脉冲磁场发生器；通过实验测量磁场波形并与简单电路模拟结果对比；利用该系统对钴粉进行磁化测量、对CdS单晶进行法拉第旋转测量。

papers.title: Flux-induced Aharonov-Bohm Oscillation in the Tunneling Spectroscopy of Kitaev Spin Liquids
papers.abstract: Identifying emergent flux excitations and signatures of their mutual statistics with itinerant Majorana fermions remains a central challenge in Kitaev spin liquids. We show that an isolated $π$ flux imprints an intrinsic Aharonov-Bohm-like interference pattern on the charge-neutral Majorana continuum. Spatially resolved scanning tunneling microscopy with inelastic electron tunneling spectroscopy (STM-IETS) probes this oscillation in the local dynamical spin response as a function of both bias voltage and tip-flux separation, reflecting the $π$ phase acquired by Majorana trajectories encircling the flux. We show that large-scale exact diagonalization of the Kitaev honeycomb model and a complementary low-energy continuum theory yield consistent radial oscillations. These results provide a finite-energy, spatially resolved tunneling signature of a preexisting flux and a diagnostic of fermion-flux mutual statistics without requiring manipulation of individual anyons in the Kitaev spin liquid.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“large-scale exact diagonalization of the Kitaev honeycomb model”和“low-energy continuum theory”，属于数值与解析理论结合的研究，未涉及实验数据。；研究对象：Kitaev蜂巢晶格自旋液体中的π通量（flux）激发，以及其与巡游Majorana费米子之间的互统计（mutual statistics）在隧穿谱中的表现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 一个孤立的π通量会在电中性Majorana连续谱上留下固有的Aharonov-Bohm型干涉振荡图案；该振荡可通过空间分辨的STM-IETS在局域动态自旋响应中观测，反映Majorana轨迹环绕通量所获得的π相位。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：一个孤立的π通量会在电中性Majorana连续谱上留下固有的Aharonov-Bohm型干涉振荡图案；该振荡可通过空间分辨的STM-IETS在局域动态自旋响应中观测，反映Majorana轨迹环绕通量所获得的π相位。；创新点：首次提出利用有限能量、空间分辨的隧穿谱（STM-IETS）作为预先存在通量的直接探测手段，并以此诊断费米子-通量互统计，无需对Kitaev自旋液体中的单个任意子进行操控。
papers.method_zh: 大规模精确对角化（exact diagonalization）求解Kitaev蜂巢模型，辅以低能连续场论（low-energy continuum theory）进行互补分析；理论预测与数值结果在径向振荡上一致。

papers.title: Spinor condensate persistent currents in an atomtronic Josephson necklace
papers.abstract: The investigation of superflow in multi-junction Josephson circuits is currently a leading frontier of physics research, probing the fundamental manifestations of macroscopic phase coherence and enabling applications to quantum simulation, metrology and computing. In this work, we extensively investigate the stability and dynamics of persistent currents of a spinor atomic Bose-Einstein condensate on a ring with multiple Josephson junctions. Specifically, we examine the effects of positive and negative interspecies interactions, co- and counter-rotation, population and Manakov asymmetry, as well as Rabi coupling on the persistent currents carried by the two components. Our analysis reveals that the presence of a second species offers multiple mechanisms for unprecedented manipulation of supercurrents on the ring, including phase-slip engineering, stability control, current-inversion switching and supercurrent pumping. Our study provides a roadmap for the engineering of persistent currents in binary ring condensates in necklace potentials, with significant implications for atomtronics, matter-wave interferometry and sensing using atomic Bose gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“investigate”“analysis reveals”“provides a roadmap”等理论分析性表述，未提及实验手段或设备。；研究对象：自旋or（二元）原子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensate, BEC）在含多个约瑟夫森结的环形势阱（“原子电路约瑟夫森项链”）中的持续流（persistent currents）及其稳定性与动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二元（自旋or）凝聚体中第二组分的存在为环上超流的操控提供了多种新机制，包括相位滑移工程、稳定性控制、电流反转开关和超流泵浦，从而实现对持续流的前所未有的调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二元（自旋or）凝聚体中第二组分的存在为环上超流的操控提供了多种新机制，包括相位滑移工程、稳定性控制、电流反转开关和超流泵浦，从而实现对持续流的前所未有的调控。；创新点：系统性地揭示了在项链势（多结环）中二元凝聚体持续流的多重操控机制（相位滑移工程、稳定性控制、电流反转、超流泵浦），为二元环状凝聚体的超流工程提供了路线图。摘要未突出说明与单组分或均匀环情形的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析（摘要未明确说明具体数值方法，如Gross-Pitaevskii方程求解或变分法，但属于多组分BEC动力学与稳定性分析框架）。具体考察了正/负种间相互作用、同向/反向旋转、粒子数不对称、Manakov对称性破缺以及Rabi耦合对两分量持续流的影响。

papers.title: Quaternionic Hermitian Band Geometry in Four Dimensions: Realization on $S^4$ and Obstruction on $T^4$
papers.abstract: We establish a realization-obstruction dichotomy for quaternionic Hermitian band geometry in four-dimensional parameter spaces: the minimal-charge lowest Landau level on $S^{4}$ provides a global realization, whereas an everywhere nondegenerate saturated realization induced by a single occupied quaternionic band is obstructed on $T^{4}$. An antiunitary symmetry $\mathcal{J}$ satisfying $\mathcal{J}^{2}=-1$ makes the occupied doublet a quaternionic band. Within this setting, we formulate the quaternionic Wirtinger inequality as a band-geometric bound involving the quantum metric and the second Chern density. At every nondegenerate saturation point, the canonical geometry of the quaternionic projective space pulls back to a compatible quaternionic structure on the parameter space; if these conditions hold everywhere, the parameter space acquires quaternionic Hermitian band geometry. On $S^{4}$, we express the minimal-charge states as quaternionic Perelomov coherent states and establish everywhere nondegenerate saturation, thereby realizing quaternionic Hermitian band geometry. On $T^{4}$, by contrast, a minimal four-band system saturates the inequality everywhere, but topology forces the quantum metric to become degenerate somewhere, obstructing a globally induced quaternionic structure. An explicit lattice Dirac Hamiltonian exhibits this obstruction. Adding unoccupied bands cannot remove this obstruction when the inequality is saturated everywhere, since the image of any nondegenerate saturated projector remains confined to a fixed $\mathbb{H}P^{1}$. These results provide a symmetry-aware framework for non-Abelian band geometry and show how parameter-space topology constrains the global realization of quaternionic Hermitian band geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及数学不等式推导、拓扑论证、模型哈密顿量构造，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：四维参数空间中的四元数厄米能带几何，具体体系包括S⁴球面上的最低朗道能级（最小电荷态）以及T⁴环面上的四带晶格狄拉克哈密顿量模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 四元数厄米能带几何在四维参数空间中存在“可实现—受阻”二分法：在S⁴上可全局实现（处处非简并饱和），而在T⁴上被拓扑阻碍（量子度规必然在某处简并，无法全局诱导四元数结构）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：四元数厄米能带几何在四维参数空间中存在“可实现—受阻”二分法：在S⁴上可全局实现（处处非简并饱和），而在T⁴上被拓扑阻碍（量子度规必然在某处简并，无法全局诱导四元数结构）。；创新点：首次建立了四元数厄米能带几何在四维参数空间中的可实现性判据，揭示了参数空间拓扑（S⁴与T⁴的区别）对全局四元数结构实现的根本约束，并将反幺正对称性𝒥（𝒥²=−1）与四元数能带结构及非阿贝尔能带几何联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：四元数Wirtinger不等式（将量子度规与第二陈密度联系起来的能带几何不等式）、四元数Perelomov相干态构造、四元数射影空间ℍP¹的拉回几何分析、显式晶格狄拉克哈密顿量模型，以及拓扑阻碍论证（利用饱和投影算符像空间被限制在固定ℍP¹的性质）。

papers.title: Non-Abelian Spin Counting of Ordered Stochastic Trajectories: Reentrant Finite-Time Chern Numbers
papers.abstract: Conventional full counting statistics assigns commuting phases to integrated stochastic currents and therefore resolves net transport but not, in general, the temporal ordering of events associated with different cycles. We introduce a non-Abelian counting construction in which crossings of two fundamental cycles rotate an auxiliary spin about different axes. The resulting ordered trajectory statistic has an exact finite-dimensional evolution equation for its first moment. The two rotation angles form a counting torus, and whenever the mean spin is nonzero its normalized direction defines a map $\mathbb T^2\to\mathbb S^2$, equivalently a complex eigenline bundle with a Chern number. Our main analytical result is a Chern--parity correspondence. Reflection symmetry equips this eigenline with a real structure and expresses $C_T\bmod2$ through first Stiefel--Whitney classes on the circles fixed by reflection. When the transverse polarization has no additional zeros along the reflection-fixed circles, these classes reduce to ordinary current-parity statistics at the four high-symmetry counting points. For a five-state nonequilibrium figure-eight network, varying only the observation time produces four polarization-gap closings and the reentrant sequence $C_T=0\to-1\to0\to-1\to0$. Every transition occurs at $(π,π)$ and coincides with a sign reversal of $\mathbb E[(-1)^{Q_1+Q_2}]$, while the full integer Chern number is obtained independently from the two-dimensional spin texture. Finite observation time can therefore organize a fixed stochastic process into distinct topological sectors of its ordered path ensemble.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“non-Abelian counting construction”“exact finite-dimensional evolution equation”“analytical result”等理论推导关键词，未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：随机轨迹的有序统计（ordered stochastic trajectories）及其拓扑分类，具体体系为一个五态非平衡figure-eight网络（five-state nonequilibrium figure-eight network）。属于随机过程/非平衡统计物理与拓扑物理交叉领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了非阿贝尔计数构造，使有限观测时间能将同一随机过程组织成不同的拓扑扇区，并发现随观测时间变化出现重入的有限时间Chern数序列：C_T = 0 → −1 → 0 → −1 → 0。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了非阿贝尔计数构造，使有限观测时间能将同一随机过程组织成不同的拓扑扇区，并发现随观测时间变化出现重入的有限时间Chern数序列：C_T = 0 → −1 → 0 → −1 → 0。；创新点：首次将非阿贝尔计数统计引入有序随机轨迹的拓扑分类，建立了Chern数奇偶性与反射固定圆上Stiefel–Whitney类及高对称计数点处普通电流奇偶统计的联系；发现仅改变观测时间即可驱动拓扑相变（极化能隙闭合与重入Chern数序列），表明有限时间观测本身可作为拓扑序的调控参数。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为非阿贝尔全计数统计（non-Abelian full counting statistics）：将两个基本循环的穿越映射为辅助自旋绕不同轴的旋转，建立第一矩的精确有限维演化方程；利用计数环面T²到球面S²的映射定义Chern数；通过反射对称性建立Chern数奇偶性与第一Stiefel–Whitney类的对应关系（Chern–parity correspondence）。

papers.title: Run-and-tumble particles with preferred reorientation
papers.abstract: Run-and-tumble particles (RTPs) are canonically modeled with uniform reorientation probabilities, an assumption that breaks down for many biological microswimmers. In this work, we investigate the dynamics of RTPs with arbitrary non-uniform tumble distributions. By deriving an exact Doi-Peliti field theory, we explicitly calculate a wide array of spatial and orientational observables. Notably, we demonstrate that the spatial dynamics exhibit an effective persistence and chirality governed entirely by the first Fourier modes of the tumble distribution, establishing a formal mapping to the dynamics of chiral active Brownian particles. Furthermore, our field-theoretic framework provides a systematic method to compute spatial moments to arbitrary order, allowing for the complete characterization and identification of complex tumbling dynamics. We illustrate the framework with wrapped Gaussian and bimodal Gaussian distributions, demonstrating explicit control over persistence and chirality. We further extend the field theory to $d$ dimensions, recovering the mean squared displacement in terms of a single effective tumble rate. Our results establish a direct link between the shape of the tumble distribution and the emergent dynamics, and provide a foundation for the study of interacting RTPs with non-uniform reorientation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact Doi-Peliti field theory（精确场论推导）、formal mapping（形式映射）、field-theoretic framework（场论框架）。；研究对象：具有任意非均匀翻转（tumble）分布的run-and-tumble粒子（RTPs），即生物微游泳者的运动动力学，重点关注空间与取向自由度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RTPs的空间动力学表现出由翻转分布的第一傅里叶模式完全决定的有效持久性和手性，并可与手性活性布朗粒子（chiral ABPs）建立形式映射；同时，该场论框架可系统计算任意阶空间矩，从而完整刻画复杂翻转动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RTPs的空间动力学表现出由翻转分布的第一傅里叶模式完全决定的有效持久性和手性，并可与手性活性布朗粒子（chiral ABPs）建立形式映射；同时，该场论框架可系统计算任意阶空间矩，从而完整刻画复杂翻转动力学。；创新点：首次为任意非均匀翻转分布的RTPs建立了精确场论，揭示了翻转分布形状与涌现动力学（持久性、手性）之间的直接联系，并提供了计算任意阶空间矩的系统方法，为研究非均匀重取向的相互作用RTPs奠定了基础。
papers.method_zh: 推导了精确的Doi-Peliti场论，利用该框架解析计算多种空间与取向可观测量；并推广到d维，得到用单一有效翻转率表示的平均平方位移。示例分布采用包裹高斯分布和双峰高斯分布。

papers.title: Large Jahn-Teller shifts and splittings observed in halide perovskite CsPbBr3
papers.abstract: Despite the fundamental role of Jahn-Teller effects of first and second order in shaping structural and electronic properties, there is hardly any observation in angle-resolved photoemission of solids. In oxide and halide perovskites, band structure replicas have occasionally been reported as fingerprints of Jahn-Teller effects, but no accompanying energy shifts or splittings that would allow a conclusion about their origin. In CsPbBr3, we uncover both key signatures: Upon cooling, orthorhombic replica bands emerge which had eluded earlier studies. This includes an extra valence band maximum at Γ which can even be distinguished at room temperature. Most importantly, band narrowing along Γ-M, a splitting at Γ, and the lifting of degeneracy between nonequivalent M points, all of several 100 meV, become apparent. Temperature-dependent x-ray diffraction, used as input for band structure calculations, links these effects directly to tilts and rotations of the PbBr6 octahedra. Our results uncover a strong electron-lattice interaction which is at the heart of so-far unresolved questions concerning polaronic transport, dynamic disorder, and exciton trapping in halide perovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合能带计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“angle-resolved photoemission”（角分辨光电子能谱）、“Temperature-dependent x-ray diffraction”（变温X射线衍射）等实验手段，同时提及“band structure calculations”（能带结构计算）作为辅助。；研究对象：卤化物钙钛矿CsPbBr3，具体关注其Jahn-Teller效应（一阶和二阶）引起的电子结构与晶格畸变之间的耦合，以及由此产生的能带复制、劈裂和简并解除现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CsPbBr3中观测到数百meV量级的能带复制、能带变窄、Γ点劈裂以及不等价M点简并解除，这些现象直接源于PbBr6八面体的倾斜与旋转，揭示了强电子-晶格相互作用，为理解卤化物钙钛矿中的极化子输运、动态无序和激子俘获提供了关键线索。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CsPbBr3中观测到数百meV量级的能带复制、能带变窄、Γ点劈裂以及不等价M点简并解除，这些现象直接源于PbBr6八面体的倾斜与旋转，揭示了强电子-晶格相互作用，为理解卤化物钙钛矿中的极化子输运、动态无序和激子俘获提供了关键线索。；创新点：首次在卤化物钙钛矿CsPbBr3中同时观测到Jahn-Teller效应的两个关键特征——能带复制伴随明确的能量位移和劈裂（数百meV），且这些特征在室温下即可部分分辨（如Γ点额外价带顶），此前研究仅报道过能带复制而未给出能量尺度信息。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）用于观测能带结构；变温X射线衍射（XRD）用于获取不同温度下的晶体结构参数；以XRD结构为输入进行能带结构计算，将实验观测与晶格畸变直接关联。

papers.title: Momentum-resolved EELS study of collective charge excitations in 1$T$-TaS$_2$
papers.abstract: We use momentum-resolved electron energy-loss spectroscopy (M-EELS) to study the low-energy charge excitations of 1$T$-TaS$_2$ across the nearly commensurate-to-commensurate charge-density-wave (CDW) transition. Single-crystal x-ray diffraction and elastic M-EELS measurements confirm the expected rotation of the CDW wave vector upon entering the commensurate phase. In the nearly commensurate phase, the low-energy M-EELS spectra reveal an acoustic phonon branch and two optical phonon features whose energies and dispersions are broadly consistent with previous calculations and inelastic x-ray measurements. Across the transition, the optical phonon energies remain nearly unchanged, while their spectral intensity develops a pronounced temperature dependence near the CDW ordering wave vector. At higher energies, the finite-momentum charge response undergoes a substantial redistribution of spectral weight below the transition, consistent with the opening of an energy gap. These results demonstrate that M-EELS provides simultaneous access to lattice dynamics and finite-momentum valence band charge excitations in 1$T$-TaS$_2$, revealing their evolution across the commensurate CDW transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用动量分辨电子能量损失谱（M-EELS）、单晶X射线衍射、弹性M-EELS等实验手段。；研究对象：1T-TaS₂ 中近公度到公度电荷密度波（CDW）相变过程中的低能集体电荷激发（声子与电子激发）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: M-EELS 可同时探测 1T-TaS₂ 的晶格动力学和有限动量价带电荷激发，并揭示在公度 CDW 相变下光学声子谱权重在 CDW 波矢附近出现显著温度依赖，同时高能区电荷响应谱权重发生大幅重分布，与能隙打开一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：M-EELS 可同时探测 1T-TaS₂ 的晶格动力学和有限动量价带电荷激发，并揭示在公度 CDW 相变下光学声子谱权重在 CDW 波矢附近出现显著温度依赖，同时高能区电荷响应谱权重发生大幅重分布，与能隙打开一致。；创新点：首次利用 M-EELS 在同一实验中同时获取 1T-TaS₂ 的声子色散和有限动量价带电荷激发，并追踪它们在公度 CDW 相变前后的演化。摘要未突出说明与以往非弹性X射线散射相比的具体优势细节。
papers.method_zh: 动量分辨电子能量损失谱（M-EELS）、单晶X射线衍射、弹性M-EELS（用于确认CDW波矢旋转）。

papers.title: Reaching the thermodynamic limit of wicking on textured surfaces
papers.abstract: Wicking in a capillary tube could happen as long as the liquid contact angle is smaller than 90 degree, making it possible for weak hydrophilic liquids to spontaneously invade the tube. For textured surfaces, energy minimization argument predicts the same. However, wicking of weak hydrophilic liquids on textured surfaces has not been possible due to energy barriers induced by the textures. We demonstrate how these barriers could be avoided by adjusting the shape and arrangement of the pillars, thus the wettability required for wicking reaches the theoretical limit. An unprecedented wicking contact angle of 82 degree is reported. More surprisingly, wicking coefficients of such surfaces can be larger than that of rectangular grooves at the same porosity. These findings may significantly advance biomedical and thermal management technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了实际演示（“We demonstrate”）、报道了具体实验数据（“An unprecedented wicking contact angle of 82 degree is reported”），并涉及表面制备与测量。；研究对象：纹理化表面（textured surfaces）上的毛细浸润（wicking）现象，具体为弱亲水液体在具有微柱阵列（pillars）的固体表面上的自发渗吸行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调整微柱的形状和排列方式，可以消除纹理诱导的能垒，使弱亲水液体在纹理表面的浸润所需接触角达到理论极限（82°），且该表面的浸润系数可高于相同孔隙率的矩形沟槽表面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调整微柱的形状和排列方式，可以消除纹理诱导的能垒，使弱亲水液体在纹理表面的浸润所需接触角达到理论极限（82°），且该表面的浸润系数可高于相同孔隙率的矩形沟槽表面。；创新点：首次实现了弱亲水液体（接触角远大于传统90°阈值以下但接近理论极限）在纹理表面上的自发浸润，突破了此前因纹理能垒导致的浸润不可能性；并发现非矩形柱体排列可超越传统矩形沟槽的浸润效率。摘要未突出说明具体柱形设计细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备了不同形状和排列的微柱纹理表面，测量了液体的浸润接触角及浸润动力学系数（wicking coefficient）。摘要未明确说明具体制备工艺（如光刻、蚀刻等）或表征手段。

papers.title: Emergent Noncollinearity and Near-Degenerate Magnetic Superlattices in AT6X6 Kagome Metals
papers.abstract: Ferromagnetic AT6X6 Kagome compounds are a popular class of systems in which quantum magnetism with topological features has been observed. These systems allow easy chemical substitution, creating an opportunity to fine-tune their properties. In this paper, we present electronic-structure and magnetic ground-state studies of several AT6X6 compounds with relatively low magnetic-ground-state stability. We find unusual magnetic orderings, including complex spin-spiral states and the formation of magnetic long-range superstructures. While LiFe6Ga6 and TiMn6Ge6 retain collinear AFM ground states with low-energy FM/AFM layer sequences, competing spin-spiral and long-period antiferromagnetic structures in MgFe6Ga6 and a double-spin-spiral ground state in TiFe6Ga6 were determined. Magnetism in all these systems appears local, with adiabatic energy profiles suggesting non-Heisenberg long-range interactions, including a strong biquadratic term. In TiMn6Ge6, we found the conditions for magnetic tunneling. Our results show that, in addition to traditional magnetic topological features in such FM Kagome systems, near-degenerate magnetic superstructures suitable for spintronic switching applications can form naturally. Overall, these systems represent a potentially rich playground for neutron diffraction and spintronics experimental studies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“electronic-structure and magnetic ground-state studies”“adiabatic energy profiles”，属于第一性原理电子结构计算与磁性基态分析。；研究对象：AT₆X₆ 型 Kagome 金属化合物，具体包括 LiFe₆Ga₆、TiMn₆Ge₆、MgFe₆Ga₆ 和 TiFe₆Ga₆，关注其低磁基态稳定性下的非常规磁有序（自旋螺旋、长周期磁超结构）及磁相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在这些磁性基态稳定性较低的 AT₆X₆ Kagome 金属中，出现了复杂的自旋螺旋态和长周期磁超结构，包括 MgFe₆Ga₆ 中的竞争性自旋螺旋与长周期反铁磁结构、TiFe₆Ga₆ 中的双自旋螺旋基态；磁性表现为局域磁矩，且存在非海森堡长程相互作用（含强双二次项），并在 TiMn₆Ge₆ 中发现了磁隧穿条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在这些磁性基态稳定性较低的 AT₆X₆ Kagome 金属中，出现了复杂的自旋螺旋态和长周期磁超结构，包括 MgFe₆Ga₆ 中的竞争性自旋螺旋与长周期反铁磁结构、TiFe₆Ga₆ 中的双自旋螺旋基态；磁性表现为局域磁矩，且存在非海森堡长程相互作用（含强双二次项），并在 TiMn₆Ge₆ 中发现了磁隧穿条件。；创新点：在传统铁磁 Kagome 体系中，除了已知的磁性拓扑特征外，发现可自然形成的近简并磁超结构，适用于自旋电子学开关应用；并揭示了非海森堡（双二次）长程相互作用在稳定这些非常规磁序中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理电子结构计算与磁性基态分析，包括对磁有序态的绝热能量剖面（adiabatic energy profiles）计算，以评估不同磁构型的能量竞争与相互作用形式。

papers.title: Competing Extended-$s$- and $d$-Wave Pairing from Distinct Spin-Fluctuation Channels in Stoichiometric $\mathrm{FeTe}$
papers.abstract: The recent observation of superconductivity in stoichiometric $\mathrm{FeTe}$ raises the question of how pairing develops in this tetragonal 11-type chalcogenide once interstitial Fe is removed. We construct an experimentally constrained five-orbital tight-binding model from first-principles calculations and treat electronic correlations and pairing within the fluctuation-exchange approximation. The linearized Eliashberg equation yields competing extended-$s$- and $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave spin-singlet pairing instabilities. Near stoichiometric filling, spin fluctuations near $(π,0)$ and $(0,π)$ in the unfolded one-Fe Brillouin zone connect the $Γ/M$ hole pockets with the $X/Y$ electron pockets and favor an extended-$s$ gap that changes sign between the hole and electron sheets. Upon electron doping, depletion of the hole pockets shifts the dominant scattering toward the $X$--$Y$ channel near $(π,π)$, making the $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave state the leading instability, with nodal lines that avoid most of the Fermi surface. The relative strengths of the two pairing channels vary with filling and interaction strength as the dominant spin-fluctuation channel changes. Under matched interaction strength, temperature, and filling, the extended-$s$ eigenvalue is larger in $\mathrm{FeTe}$ than in $\mathrm{FeSe}$ throughout the range considered, while the $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave eigenvalue is also generally larger, particularly under electron doping. These results give concrete gap structures against which spectroscopic measurements of stoichiometric $\mathrm{FeTe}$ can be compared.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“five-orbital tight-binding model from first-principles calculations”“fluctuation-exchange approximation”“linearized Eliashberg equation”，均为理论计算方法。；研究对象：化学计量比FeTe（stoichiometric FeTe）这一四方11型硫族化合物中的超导配对机制，具体关注去除间隙Fe后配对如何形成，以及不同自旋涨落通道对配对对称性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在化学计量比FeTe中，自旋涨落可导致竞争性的扩展s波和d_{x²-y²}波自旋单态配对失稳：近化学计量填充时扩展s波占优（能隙在空穴与电子口袋间变号），电子掺杂后d_{x²-y²}波成为主导失稳通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在化学计量比FeTe中，自旋涨落可导致竞争性的扩展s波和d_{x²-y²}波自旋单态配对失稳：近化学计量填充时扩展s波占优（能隙在空穴与电子口袋间变号），电子掺杂后d_{x²-y²}波成为主导失稳通道。；创新点：首次针对去除间隙Fe后的化学计量比FeTe系统，系统研究了不同自旋涨落通道（(π,0)/(0,π)与(π,π)）如何随填充和相互作用强度变化而主导不同的配对对称性，并给出了与FeSe的定量对比，为光谱实验提供了具体的能隙结构预言。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理构建实验约束的五轨道紧束缚模型，采用涨落交换近似（fluctuation-exchange approximation）处理电子关联与配对，通过线性化Eliashberg方程求解配对失稳。

papers.title: Cramer-Rao Inequality Generalizes the Equilibrium Energy Fluctuation-Response Relation to Nonequilibrium Steady States
papers.abstract: Equilibrium steady states are fully characterized by the Boltzmann distribution, which depends only on the energy and the temperature. In contrast, nonequilibrium steady states, which describe a wide range of physical and biological phenomena, are generically much more complex, and their stationary distributions can depend on a zoo of kinetic parameters. A central challenge of nonequilibrium statistical mechanics is the identification of universal relations that hold for nonequilibrium steady states despite this complexity. We show here that a form of the Cramer-Rao inequality applies to arbitrary nonequilibrium steady-state distributions and contains no explicit dependence on kinetic parameters. A main original feature in our observation is that this inequality becomes a well-known fluctuation-response relation in equilibrium. The inequality involves three well-defined quantities: the fluctuations of the energy, the response given by the derivative of the average energy with respect to the inverse temperature, and the Fisher information with respect to the inverse temperature. We illustrate this inequality using three representative models: an active particle in a harmonic potential, a simple scheme for kinetic proofreading, and a one-dimensional model for heat conduction between two baths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确讨论不等式推导、统计力学理论框架，并用模型进行说明（“We show here that a form of the Cramer-Rao inequality applies…”），未涉及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：非平衡稳态系统，包括活性粒子、动力学校对（kinetic proofreading）以及两热浴间的一维热传导模型。摘要未明确说明具体材料或化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cramér-Rao不等式可适用于任意非平衡稳态分布，且不显式依赖动力学参数；该不等式在平衡极限下退化为已知的涨落-响应关系，从而将平衡态能量涨落-响应关系推广到非平衡稳态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cramér-Rao不等式可适用于任意非平衡稳态分布，且不显式依赖动力学参数；该不等式在平衡极限下退化为已知的涨落-响应关系，从而将平衡态能量涨落-响应关系推广到非平衡稳态。；创新点：首次指出Cramér-Rao不等式在非平衡稳态下不依赖动力学参数，且其平衡极限恰好恢复经典的涨落-响应关系，从而为复杂非平衡稳态提供了普适的不等式约束。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用Cramér-Rao不等式建立非平衡稳态下能量涨落、平均能量对逆温度的导数（响应）以及Fisher信息三者之间的不等式关系；并用三个代表性模型（谐振子势中的活性粒子、动力学校对方案、一维热传导模型）进行验证说明。

papers.title: One micron length scale controls kinetic stability of low energy glasses
papers.abstract: AC nanocalorimetry was used to measure the reversing heat capacity Cp of low energy indomethacin glasses as they isothermally transform into the supercooled liquid. As the film thickness increases from 75 to 600 nm, the transformation time increases by more than an order of magnitude, consistent with a surface-initiated transformation mechanism. Eventually, the transformation time becomes constant for films between 1.4 and 30 microns indicating a distinct bulk transformation pathway. The observation of size-dependent transformation kinetics for glass samples approaching 1 micron is unprecedented. We interpret the crossover in thickness dependence at 1 micron to signify the average distance between transformation initiation sites in the bulk low energy glass.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“AC nanocalorimetry was used to measure...”，属于实验测量手段。；研究对象：低能态吲哚美辛（indomethacin）玻璃薄膜，具体研究其等温转变为过冷液体过程中的动力学稳定性，以及薄膜厚度对转变动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低能玻璃的等温转变时间随薄膜厚度增加（75 nm至600 nm）而延长一个数量级以上，表明转变由表面引发；但当厚度达到1.4至30微米时，转变时间趋于恒定，表明存在不同的体相转变路径。1微米处的厚度依赖性交叉被解释为体相低能玻璃中转变引发位点之间的平均距离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低能玻璃的等温转变时间随薄膜厚度增加（75 nm至600 nm）而延长一个数量级以上，表明转变由表面引发；但当厚度达到1.4至30微米时，转变时间趋于恒定，表明存在不同的体相转变路径。1微米处的厚度依赖性交叉被解释为体相低能玻璃中转变引发位点之间的平均距离。；创新点：首次观察到接近1微米厚度的玻璃样品仍表现出尺寸依赖的转变动力学，这一现象在以往研究中未见报道。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 交流纳米量热法（AC nanocalorimetry），用于测量低能吲哚美辛玻璃在等温转变过程中的可逆热容Cp。

papers.title: Highly Stable Glasses of cis-Decalin and cis/trans-Decalin Mixtures
papers.abstract: In situ AC nanocalorimetry was used to measure the reversing heat capacity of vapor-deposited glasses of decahydronaphthalene (decalin). Glasses with low heat capacity and high kinetic stability, as compared to the corresponding liquid-cooled glass, were prepared from cis-decalin and from several cis/trans-decalin mixtures. This is the first report of highly stable glass formation for molecular mixtures. The 50/50 cis/trans-decalin mixture is the highest fragility material reported to produce an ultrastable glass. The 50/50 mixture exhibited high kinetic stability, with an ~500 nm film deposited at 116 K (0.86 Tg,) displaying a transformation time equivalent to 104.4 times the structural relaxation time of the supercooled liquid at the annealing temperature. Cis-decalin and the decalin mixture formed stable glasses that had heat capacities as much as 4.5% lower than the liquid-cooled glass.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“In situ AC nanocalorimetry was used to measure...”，即使用原位交流纳米量热法进行实验测量。；研究对象：气相沉积制备的十氢化萘（decalin）玻璃，具体包括顺式十氢化萘（cis-decalin）以及不同比例的顺式/反式十氢化萘混合物（cis/trans-decalin mixtures）。研究聚焦于这些玻璃的热容和动力学稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次报道了分子混合物可形成高动力学稳定玻璃。其中50/50顺/反式十氢化萘混合物是目前报道的形成超稳定玻璃中脆度（fragility）最高的材料，其薄膜在退火温度下的转变时间相当于过冷液体结构弛豫时间的10^4.4倍；顺式十氢化萘及其混合物形成的稳定玻璃热容比液冷玻璃低达4.5%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次报道了分子混合物可形成高动力学稳定玻璃。其中50/50顺/反式十氢化萘混合物是目前报道的形成超稳定玻璃中脆度（fragility）最高的材料，其薄膜在退火温度下的转变时间相当于过冷液体结构弛豫时间的10^4.4倍；顺式十氢化萘及其混合物形成的稳定玻璃热容比液冷玻璃低达4.5%。；创新点：首次实现并报道了分子混合物体系的高稳定玻璃形成（此前仅见于单组分体系）；同时，50/50混合物作为迄今报道的脆度最高的超稳定玻璃形成材料，拓展了超稳定玻璃的制备范围。
