papers.method_zh: 原位交流纳米量热法（in situ AC nanocalorimetry），用于测量气相沉积玻璃的可逆热容（reversing heat capacity），并与液冷玻璃（liquid-cooled glass）进行对比。

papers.title: Interaction-mediated Co-existence of Altermagnetism and Topology
papers.abstract: We study an extended Hubbard model on Lieb lattice at electron filling 2 and 4, and demonstrate that the interactions lead to the simultaneous emergence of altermagnetic order and a topological gap. Using unrestricted Hartree-Fock theory, we evaluate both the altermagnetic and topological order parameters and show that they co-exist with an associated quantum spin Hall effect in a large region of the phase diagram, which we further support using exact diagonalization. Moreover, we demonstrate that inversion-symmetry breaking terms can also mediate second-order topological phases with associated corner modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“unrestricted Hartree-Fock theory”和“exact diagonalization”等理论计算方法。；研究对象：Lieb晶格上的扩展Hubbard模型，在电子填充数2和4的情况下，研究交替磁性（altermagnetism）与拓扑性质的共存现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 相互作用可在Lieb晶格中同时诱导交替磁有序和拓扑能隙，二者在相图的大片区域中稳定共存，并伴随量子自旋霍尔效应；此外，破缺反演对称性的项还可诱导二阶拓扑相及角态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：相互作用可在Lieb晶格中同时诱导交替磁有序和拓扑能隙，二者在相图的大片区域中稳定共存，并伴随量子自旋霍尔效应；此外，破缺反演对称性的项还可诱导二阶拓扑相及角态。；创新点：首次在Lieb晶格相互作用模型中展示交替磁性与拓扑非平凡态（包括量子自旋霍尔效应和二阶拓扑相）的相互作用介导共存。摘要未突出说明与具体材料或实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 无约束Hartree-Fock理论（用于计算交替磁序参量和拓扑序参量），以及精确对角化（用于验证相图结论）。

papers.title: Defect-Mediated Nucleation and Dynamics across the Phase Transition in the Excitonic Insulator Candidate Ta2NiSe5
papers.abstract: Ta2NiSe5 is a quasi-one-dimensional material that exhibits a structural and electronic phase transition from a low-temperature monoclinic (semiconductor) to a high-temperature orthorhombic (semimetal) phase at approximately TC = 326 K. Here, we used variable-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy to resolve the phase transition spatially, identifying the distinct spectroscopic signatures of the monoclinic and orthorhombic phases in pristine regions and near isolated point-defects and step edges. Although the phase transition of Ta2NiSe5 is generally regarded as second-order, it has previously been described as exhibiting martensitic-like characteristics. This implies that the transformation may proceed via spatial phase coexistence and domain boundaries rather than through a continuous evolution. Our surface-sensitive measurements confirm this scenario, retrieving the coexistence and evolution of monoclinic and orthorhombic domains in real space. Upon heating through TC, we find that the two phases coexist as spatially segregated regions over extended timescales, separated by well-defined boundaries that evolve via localized nucleation and growth, rather than a spatially uniform transformation. In pristine regions, the orthorhombic phase nucleates anisotropically, perpendicular to the Ta-Ni-Ta chains, whereas point-defects and step edges act as local nucleation centers that promote the transition and suppress this intrinsic anisotropy. These results provide direct real-space visualization of how surface-specific structural and electronic variations, together with local disorder, modify the martensitic-like phase transition in Ta2NiSe5.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用变温扫描隧道显微镜/扫描隧道谱（variable-temperature STM/STS）进行实验测量。；研究对象：激子绝缘体候选材料Ta₂NiSe₅，具体研究其在约TC = 326 K处从低温单斜（半导体）相到高温正交（半金属）相的结构与电子相变，以及缺陷对该相变过程的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ta₂NiSe₅的相变并非空间均匀转变，而是通过单斜相与正交相在实空间中共存并形成清晰畴界，以局域成核与生长的方式演化；本征区域中正交相沿垂直于Ta-Ni-Ta链的方向各向异性成核，而点缺陷和台阶边缘作为局域成核中心促进相变并抑制该本征各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ta₂NiSe₅的相变并非空间均匀转变，而是通过单斜相与正交相在实空间中共存并形成清晰畴界，以局域成核与生长的方式演化；本征区域中正交相沿垂直于Ta-Ni-Ta链的方向各向异性成核，而点缺陷和台阶边缘作为局域成核中心促进相变并抑制该本征各向异性。；创新点：首次在实空间直接可视化Ta₂NiSe₅中类马氏体相变的畴共存与畴界演化过程，并揭示了表面缺陷（点缺陷、台阶边缘）如何作为局域成核中心改变相变的各向异性特征，将表面结构/电子不均匀性与相变动力学联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 变温扫描隧道显微镜（variable-temperature STM）和扫描隧道谱（STS），在原子尺度上对相变过程进行空间分辨成像与谱学表征，区分单斜相与正交相的谱学特征，并对比本征区域与缺陷附近的成核行为。

papers.title: Comparison of mechanical and molecular measures of mobility during constant strain rate deformation of a PMMA glass
papers.abstract: We performed constant strain rate deformation and stress relaxation on a poly(methyl methacrylate) glass at Tg - 19 K, utilizing three strain rates and initiating the stress relaxation over a large range of strain values. Following previous workers, we interpret the initial rate of decay of the stress during the relaxation experiment as a purely mechanical measure of mobility for the system. In our experiments, the mechanical mobility obtained in this manner changes by less than a factor of 3 prior to yield. During these mechanical experiments, we also performed an optical measurement of segmental mobility based upon the reorientation of a molecular probe; we observe that the probe mobility increases up to a factor of 100 prior to yield. In the post-yield regime, in contrast, the mobilities determined mechanically and by probe reorientation are quite similar and show a similar dependence upon the strain rate. Dynamic heterogeneity is found to initially decrease during constant strain rate deformation and then remain constant in the post-yield regime. These combined observations of mechanical mobility, probe mobility, and dynamic heterogeneity present a challenge for theoretical modeling of polymer glass deformation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了实际进行的“constant strain rate deformation and stress relaxation”实验，以及“optical measurement”等实验手段。；研究对象：研究对象为聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯（PMMA）玻璃，具体物理现象为玻璃在玻璃化转变温度以下（Tg - 19 K）恒应变率变形过程中的分子迁移率（mobility）与力学迁移率的变化及其关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在屈服前，力学迁移率变化小于3倍，而分子探针测得的链段迁移率可增大至100倍；屈服后两者趋于一致且均依赖应变率。动态异质性在变形初期下降，屈服后保持恒定。这些结果对聚合物玻璃变形的理论模型构成挑战。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在屈服前，力学迁移率变化小于3倍，而分子探针测得的链段迁移率可增大至100倍；屈服后两者趋于一致且均依赖应变率。动态异质性在变形初期下降，屈服后保持恒定。这些结果对聚合物玻璃变形的理论模型构成挑战。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其创新在于同时对比力学迁移率与分子探针迁移率在屈服前后的巨大差异，并联合动态异质性测量，为理论建模提供多维度约束。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法包括：恒应变率拉伸/压缩变形实验（三种应变率）、应力松弛实验（在较大应变范围内启动），以及基于分子探针再取向的光学测量（用于表征链段迁移率）。力学迁移率通过应力松弛初期衰减速率获得。

papers.title: Resistive Switching and Neuromorphic Computing in Metal/Nb:SrTiO$_3$: Mechanisms, Interface Physics, and Charge Transport
papers.abstract: Resistive switching (RS) in Nb-doped SrTiO$_3$ (Nb:STO) based memristive devices has attracted sustained interest in information processing and novel computing because of its forming-free operation, large on/off ratio, and gradual conductance modulation. Metal/Nb:STO Schottky junctions have emerged as a prototypical system for understanding RS mechanisms. Despite more than two decades of research, the physical origin of RS remains controversial, with proposed mechanisms including charge trapping and detrapping, oxygen vacancy migration, tunneling, interfacial redox reactions, and conductive filament formation. In this review, we examine these seemingly competing mechanisms and show that many experimental observations can be understood within a unified framework centered on the formation and evolution of an extrinsic interfacial layer at the metal/Nb:STO interface. We discuss how interface quality and defect-mediated processes, including proton incorporation, oxygen vacancy dynamics, and tunneling, govern Schottky barrier modulation and RS behavior. We further summarize how fabrication conditions, measurement protocols, and aging influence the interface formation and switching characteristics. This review establishes an integrated picture of M/Nb:STO heterojunctions and provides design principles for reliable oxide memristive devices through interface and defect engineering in M/Nb:STO and M/oxide/Nb:STO systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。判断依据：摘要中明确出现“In this review”“we examine”“This review establishes”等关键词，属于对已有研究的系统性总结与统一框架构建。；研究对象：金属/Nb掺杂SrTiO₃（M/Nb:STO）异质结忆阻器件中的电阻开关（RS）现象，重点聚焦于肖特基结界面物理、缺陷介导的电荷输运机制及其在神经形态计算中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多种看似竞争的RS机制（电荷俘获/去俘获、氧空位迁移、隧穿、界面氧化还原、导电细丝）可在“金属/Nb:STO界面处外在界面层的形成与演化”这一统一框架下得到理解；界面质量与缺陷过程（质子掺入、氧空位动力学、隧穿）共同调控肖特基势垒调制与RS行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多种看似竞争的RS机制（电荷俘获/去俘获、氧空位迁移、隧穿、界面氧化还原、导电细丝）可在“金属/Nb:STO界面处外在界面层的形成与演化”这一统一框架下得到理解；界面质量与缺陷过程（质子掺入、氧空位动力学、隧穿）共同调控肖特基势垒调制与RS行为。；创新点：提出一个统一的理论框架，将过去二十余年中相互竞争的RS机制整合到“外在界面层形成与演化”这一核心物理图像中，并据此给出M/Nb:STO及M/氧化物/Nb:STO体系的界面与缺陷工程设计原则，为可靠氧化物忆阻器件提供设计指导。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段或理论计算方法，属于综述性总结，涵盖对已有实验观测（如界面表征、电输运测量、制备条件与老化效应）的归纳与统一框架构建。具体技术细节摘要未列出。

papers.title: Mapping metallic d-wave altermagnetism across the TiNiSi structural family
papers.abstract: The prospect of using altermagnets as switchable sources of perpendicularly polarized spin currents has intensified the search for candidate materials, yet metallic d-wave systems with sizable spin-splitter responses remain scarce. Here, we identify an empirical magnetic motif that supports metallic d-wave altermagnetism in the TiNiSi structural family: ferromagnetically ordered zigzag chains with antiferromagnetic interchain coupling in a relatively low-symmetry crystal environment. The TiNiSi structure type combines this motif with broad chemical flexibility and competing magnetic ground states. By combining first-principles screening of thermodynamic stability and magnetic ground states across 280 ternary systems, we identify 16 metallic d-wave altermagnets. This set recovers four experimentally known members---WFeB, NbMnP, TaMnP, and NbMnAs---and yields 12 new predictions, of which ScMnP, TaMnAs, ScMnAs, MoMnAs, MoMnSi, and WMnSi are the most promising. Noncollinear calculations indicate that the collinear altermagnetic configuration is the ground state across them. Each of the six leading new candidates has a nonzero spin-splitter angle and a finite anomalous Hall conductivity. Notably, ScMnP and TaMnAs exhibit strong spin-splitter responses despite modest altermagnetic band splitting. These results establish TiNiSi-type metallic d-wave altermagnets as a chemically versatile platform for efficient charge-to-spin conversion and provide an empirical magnetic-motif-guided route to identifying further candidates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles screening”（第一性原理筛选）、“noncollinear calculations”（非共线计算），属于第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：TiNiSi结构家族中的金属d波交错磁体（metallic d-wave altermagnets），具体涉及280个三元体系，重点候选材料包括ScMnP、TaMnAs、ScMnAs、MoMnAs、MoMnSi和WMnSi等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在TiNiSi结构家族中识别出一个经验磁性基元——铁磁有序的锯齿链与反铁磁链间耦合，在低对称晶体环境中支持金属d波交错磁性。通过筛选280个三元体系，共发现16个金属d波交错磁体，其中12个为新预测，6个最具前景的候选材料均具有非零自旋劈裂角和有限反常霍尔电导率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在TiNiSi结构家族中识别出一个经验磁性基元——铁磁有序的锯齿链与反铁磁链间耦合，在低对称晶体环境中支持金属d波交错磁性。通过筛选280个三元体系，共发现16个金属d波交错磁体，其中12个为新预测，6个最具前景的候选材料均具有非零自旋劈裂角和有限反常霍尔电导率。；创新点：提出了一个经验性的“磁性基元”设计准则（铁磁锯齿链+反铁磁链间耦合+低对称环境），以此为指导在TiNiSi结构家族中系统筛选出多个新型金属d波交错磁体，建立了该家族作为化学可调、高效的电荷-自旋转换材料平台。摘要未突出说明与已有d波交错磁体候选材料筛选方法的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算：热力学稳定性筛选、磁性基态计算（涵盖280个三元体系）、非共线磁性计算以验证共线交错磁构型为基态，以及自旋劈裂角和反常霍尔电导率的计算。

papers.title: The principle of detailed balance between electrons and phonons in presence of excitonic effects
papers.abstract: Based on a many-body formulation, we derive an electron-phonon coupling including excitonic effects that preserves thermodynamic detailed balance between electronic and phononic scattering processes. We start from the microscopic electron-nucleus Hamiltonian, expand around the Born-Oppenheimer equilibrium geometry, and construct an effective action for the electronic and phononic propagators. From the same effective action, we derive both electronic and phononic self-energies in terms of a nonlocal vertex $\mathcal G^{\textrm{s}}$ including excitonic effects, which generalizes the usual local interaction vertex $g^{\textrm{s}}$. When electrons and phonons are well-defined quasiparticles in the screened-exchange approximation and $\mathcal G^{\textrm{s}}$ is taken in its static limit, both self-energies reduce to Fermi-golden-rule expressions containing the same $\mathcal G^{\textrm{s}}$, thereby ensuring detailed balance. As an application, we compute electronic and phononic linewidths in graphene and illustrate this common-vertex construction. We analyze the competition between the reduced scattering phase space induced by the screened-exchange band structure and the enhancement of the electron-phonon vertex due to excitonic effects, finding that the vertex enhancement can compensate for and overcome the phase-space reduction in both electronic and phononic linewidths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：many-body formulation、effective action、self-energies、推导。；研究对象：电子-声子耦合体系，特别关注激子效应对电子与声子散射过程的影响；具体应用体系为石墨烯。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在包含激子效应的多体框架下，推导出同时保证电子和声子散射过程满足细致平衡的电子-声子耦合顶点；在石墨烯中，激子效应导致的顶点增强可以补偿甚至超过由屏蔽交换能带结构引起的相空间缩减，从而同时增强电子和声子线宽。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在包含激子效应的多体框架下，推导出同时保证电子和声子散射过程满足细致平衡的电子-声子耦合顶点；在石墨烯中，激子效应导致的顶点增强可以补偿甚至超过由屏蔽交换能带结构引起的相空间缩减，从而同时增强电子和声子线宽。；创新点：提出了一个统一的非局域顶点G^s，同时进入电子和声子自能，推广了通常的局域相互作用顶点g^s，从而在存在激子效应时严格保持细致平衡；并首次在石墨烯中定量分析了激子顶点增强与屏蔽交换相空间缩减的竞争关系。
papers.method_zh: 基于微观电子-原子核哈密顿量，在Born-Oppenheimer平衡几何附近展开，构建电子与声子传播子的有效作用量；从同一有效作用量出发，推导出包含激子效应的非局域顶点G^s，并分别得到电子和声子自能；在静态极限和屏蔽交换近似下，将自能约化为含同一顶点的费米黄金规则形式。应用计算为石墨烯的电子和声子线宽。

papers.title: Free-Energy Differences from Nonequilibrium Fluctuations in High Dissipation
papers.abstract: Equilibrium free-energy differences can be measured from nonequilibrium work fluctuations using fluctuation theorems, such as the Jarzynski equality and the Crooks fluctuation theorem. However, these approaches become statistically inefficient in high-dissipation regimes because their convergence requires trajectories with negative entropy production, events that occur exponentially rarely. Here, we demonstrate that repeated measurements of trajectory fluctuations are sufficient to determine entropy production without relying on such rare events, or to determine a lower bound on it when only partial measurements are available. This information then yields exact estimates of free-energy differences, or rigorous bounds. We validate this approach, named EquiNET, with numerical simulations, including one of biomolecular folding and unfolding, showing that it recovers accurate free-energy estimates even in regimes where conventional approaches fail.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate”“numerical simulations”，涉及理论推导（fluctuation theorems）与数值验证。；研究对象：非平衡统计物理中的自由能差测量问题，具体针对高耗散（high-dissipation）体系中的轨迹涨落，并以生物分子折叠/去折叠过程作为数值模拟对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高耗散区域，仅通过重复测量轨迹涨落即可确定熵产生（或部分测量时给出其下界），从而精确估计自由能差或给出严格界限，无需依赖传统涨落定理所需的稀有负熵产生轨迹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高耗散区域，仅通过重复测量轨迹涨落即可确定熵产生（或部分测量时给出其下界），从而精确估计自由能差或给出严格界限，无需依赖传统涨落定理所需的稀有负熵产生轨迹。；创新点：传统涨落定理在高耗散下因负熵产生事件指数稀少而统计失效，EquiNET通过重复轨迹测量绕开这一瓶颈，在常规方法失效的区域内仍能恢复准确自由能估计。摘要未突出说明其具体算法实现细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于涨落定理（Jarzynski等式与Crooks涨落定理）的理论框架，提出名为EquiNET的新方法，并通过数值模拟（包括生物分子折叠/去折叠模拟）进行验证。

papers.title: FUCrIMODo: structure recovery from atomistic descriptors via multi-stage genetic algorithms
papers.abstract: Data-driven approaches to materials discovery rely on numerical representations of atomic structures as input for machine learning models. Inverting these descriptors - recovering atomic structures from their representations - is essential for most generative material design pipelines, yet it remains challenging, particularly for periodic systems. Existing inversion methods are either tailored to specific invertible descriptors or require candidate structures with similar atomic arrangements and compositions, limiting the exploration of novel regions in chemical and configurational space. Here, we propose a generalizable, similarity-driven sampling approach, powered by a novel stage-wise optimization strategy, to recover atom types, atomic positions, and unit cell shapes directly from a descriptor. Our approach requires only descriptor features and parameters as input without any prior structural knowledge. The capability of our method is demonstrated by the averaged Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP) descriptor.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法类文章。判断依据关键词：data-driven approaches、machine learning models、optimization strategy、genetic algorithms。；研究对象：材料原子结构的描述符（descriptor）逆问题，具体针对周期性体系，以平均SOAP（Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions）描述符为演示对象。不涉及特定化合物或物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无需任何先验结构知识、仅凭描述符特征和参数即可恢复原子类型、原子位置和晶胞形状的通用反演方法，并通过平均SOAP描述符验证了其可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无需任何先验结构知识、仅凭描述符特征和参数即可恢复原子类型、原子位置和晶胞形状的通用反演方法，并通过平均SOAP描述符验证了其可行性。；创新点：现有反演方法要么针对特定可逆描述符定制，要么需要提供与目标结构相似的候选结构；本工作提出的方法不依赖可逆描述符，也不需要任何候选结构或先验结构知识，可推广至更广泛的化学与构型空间探索。
papers.method_zh: 多阶段遗传算法（multi-stage genetic algorithms），采用分阶段（stage-wise）优化策略，结合相似性驱动的采样（similarity-driven sampling）来搜索原子构型空间。具体实现细节（如适应度函数形式、遗传算子）摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: A DQMC study of the spectral and conductive properties of the two-dimensional Holstein model
papers.abstract: We study the dynamical properties of the two-dimensional square lattice Holstein Hamiltonian using numerically exact determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations. In particular, we report systematic calculations of the model's single-particle spectral function and optical conductivity over a range of phonon energies, electron-phonon coupling strengths, carrier concentrations, and temperatures. In doing so, we map the evolution of the system from a dressed metallic phase to a (bi)polaron liquid/insulator to a charge-density-wave insulator as the carrier concentration is tuned from dilute values to half-filling. We corroborate these results using several equal-time correlation measurements and related proxy quantities reconstructed from time-displaced correlation measurements. This paper is also accompanied by an extensive open data set, covering over 16,640 unique parameter values.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用“numerically exact determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations”（数值精确的行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：二维正方晶格Holstein模型，重点关注其单粒子谱函数和光导率等动力学性质，以及从稀掺杂到半填充过程中金属、极化子液体/绝缘体、电荷密度波绝缘体等不同物相的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过系统调节载流子浓度，系统从 dressed 金属相演化为（双）极化子液体/绝缘体，再演化为电荷密度波绝缘体；并利用等时关联测量和时间位移关联测量重构的代理量佐证了这一相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过系统调节载流子浓度，系统从 dressed 金属相演化为（双）极化子液体/绝缘体，再演化为电荷密度波绝缘体；并利用等时关联测量和时间位移关联测量重构的代理量佐证了这一相图。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但明确提及了覆盖超过16,640组参数值的大规模开放数据集，这为后续研究提供了重要资源。
papers.method_zh: 数值精确的行列式量子蒙特卡洛（DQMC）模拟，系统计算单粒子谱函数和光导率，并辅以等时关联函数及由时间位移关联重构的代理量。

papers.title: Giant Surface-driven Nonlinear Hall Effect in BiTeCl at Room Temperature
papers.abstract: The nonlinear Hall effect (NLHE) provides a pathway to generate a Hall response in time-reversal-symmetric yet inversion-symmetry-broken systems. NLHE can rectify an alternating current into a transverse direct voltage, making it attractive for radio-frequency rectification, energy harvesting, and terahertz detection, applications for which device miniaturization remains a central pursuit. In this context, the inherent inversion symmetry breaking at surfaces is particularly appealing: because symmetry is necessarily broken at the surface of any crystal, irrespective of whether its bulk is centrosymmetric, surface-driven nonlinear responses lift the stringent constraint on bulk symmetry and open a route toward compact device architectures. Here we report the observation of a giant, surface-driven second-order nonlinear Hall effect in the Rashba-type polar semiconductor BiTeCl at room temperature. The determined second-order nonlinear Hall susceptibility at 300 K reaches 1.68 $μ$mV$^{-1}$, which is 80 times larger than that of the best previously reported surface-dominated systems. We attribute this giant response to the synergistic interplay between BiTeCl's polar crystal structure and its rich surface states: the polar stacking renders the top and bottom surfaces inequivalent, so that the nonlinear response originates from a single surface without compensation from the other. Symmetry and scaling analyses suggest that both skew-scattering and side-jump mechanisms contribute to the observed effect. Our findings not only identify BiTeCl as a promising platform for future applications utilizing the NLHE, but also establish the asymmetry between the opposite surfaces of a polar crystal as a general design principle for discovering surface-driven materials with larger nonlinear Hall responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“observation”“determined”“symmetry and scaling analyses”等实验测量与分析关键词。；研究对象：Rashba型极性半导体BiTeCl，具体研究其表面驱动的二阶非线性霍尔效应（NLHE）及其室温下的输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温（300 K）下，BiTeCl中观测到巨大的表面驱动二阶非线性霍尔效应，其二阶非线性霍尔磁化率高达1.68 μmV⁻¹，比此前最优的表面主导体系大80倍。该巨大响应源于极性晶体结构使上下表面不等价，从而非线性响应来自单一表面而不被另一表面抵消。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温（300 K）下，BiTeCl中观测到巨大的表面驱动二阶非线性霍尔效应，其二阶非线性霍尔磁化率高达1.68 μmV⁻¹，比此前最优的表面主导体系大80倍。该巨大响应源于极性晶体结构使上下表面不等价，从而非线性响应来自单一表面而不被另一表面抵消。；创新点：首次在室温下于极性半导体BiTeCl中实现表面驱动的巨大非线性霍尔效应，并提出“极性晶体上下表面不对称性”作为设计更大非线性霍尔响应表面驱动材料的一般性原则。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量二阶非线性霍尔效应（输运测量），结合对称性分析和标度分析（scaling analyses）来区分散射机制（skew-scattering与side-jump）。摘要未明确说明具体生长方法或光谱手段。

papers.title: Determination of the ferrimagnetic structure of monoclinic TbFe$_{2}$D$_{4.2}$ deuteride and its evolution versus temperature and high magnetic field
papers.abstract: The magnetic properties of monoclinic TbFe$_{2}$D$_{4.2}$ have been investigated by combining different magnetic measurements, including those involving a high pulsed magnetic field, with neutron diffraction experiments versus temperature and applied field. TbFe$_{2}$D$_{4.2}$ displays a ferrimagnetic ground state with M$_{Tb}$ = 8.2(2) $μ$$_{B}$ and M$_{Fe}$ = 2.1(2) $μ$$_{B}$. At 4.2 K a large magnetic anisotropy related to the Tb moments is observed, as saturation is not reached at 50 T. In addition, two metamagnetic transitions are observed for fields of 3 and 29 T. Upon heating, the Tb moment decreases progressively whereas the Fe moment remains constant up to 150 K. At 160 K both Tb and Fe moments sharply decrease, and a 0.38% contraction of the cell volume is observed due to an itinerant electron metamagnetic behavior of the Fe sublattice. This transition temperature is 76 K higher than that of YFe$_{2}$D$_{4.2}$ due to an increase in cell volume, as well as exchange interactions between the Fe and Tb moments. The deuteride becomes paramagnetic above 220 K.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“magnetic measurements”（磁测量）、“neutron diffraction experiments”（中子衍射实验），以及涉及“high pulsed magnetic field”（高脉冲磁场）的实验手段。；研究对象：单斜晶系TbFe₂D₄.₂氘化物（monoclinic TbFe₂D₄.₂ deuteride）的亚铁磁结构及其随温度和磁场的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: TbFe₂D₄.₂在基态呈现亚铁磁有序，Tb磁矩为8.2(2) μ_B，Fe磁矩为2.1(2) μ_B；在4.2 K下存在强磁各向异性（50 T仍未饱和），并在3 T和29 T处观察到两个变磁转变。升温至160 K时，Tb和Fe磁矩均急剧下降，伴随0.38%的晶胞体积收缩，该转变温度比YFe₂D₄.₂高76 K。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：TbFe₂D₄.₂在基态呈现亚铁磁有序，Tb磁矩为8.2(2) μ_B，Fe磁矩为2.1(2) μ_B；在4.2 K下存在强磁各向异性（50 T仍未饱和），并在3 T和29 T处观察到两个变磁转变。升温至160 K时，Tb和Fe磁矩均急剧下降，伴随0.38%的晶胞体积收缩，该转变温度比YFe₂D₄.₂高76 K。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于首次确定了单斜TbFe₂D₄.₂的亚铁磁结构，并揭示了Fe亚晶格巡游电子变磁行为导致的体积收缩及其对转变温度的提升作用。
papers.method_zh: 结合多种磁测量手段（包括高脉冲磁场下的测量）与变温、变场中子衍射实验。

papers.title: Anomalous stabilization of excitons by metallic proximity
papers.abstract: Metallic environments are generally expected to suppress excitons through strong dielectric screening, yet their influence can differ in composite systems where metallic and insulating regions coexist. Here, we investigate excitonic states in PdxCu1-xCrO2 thin films across a percolation-driven metal-insulator transition. Optical spectroscopy and many-body GW calculations show that CuCrO2 hosts strongly bound excitons with a binding energy of about 489 meV. With increasing Pd substitution, the system approaches an insulator-to-metal transition near x = 0.5, consistent with the site-percolation threshold of a triangular lattice. In the pre-percolation regime, the excitonic resonance redshifts by 241 meV while the Tanguy continuum onset remains nearly unchanged, consistent with a substantial increase in exciton binding energy before metallization. An image-charge-based excitonic hydrogen model shows that isolated metallic regions can enhance electron-hole binding through image-charge interactions, whereas conventional screening is recovered once a continuous metallic network forms. Although this model provides a possible interpretation of the observed excitonic evolution, an alternative scenario in which metallic and excitonic responses originate from electronically distinct states and evolve independently cannot be excluded. These results reveal unusual metallic-excitonic coexistence near a percolation-driven metal-insulator transition and suggest nanoscale metallic proximity as a possible route for modifying excitonic interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Optical spectroscopy”（光学光谱实验）和“many-body GW calculations”（多体GW计算），同时包含“image-charge-based excitonic hydrogen model”（基于镜像电荷的激子氢模型）这一理论建模。；研究对象：PdxCu1-xCrO2薄膜体系，具体研究其在渗流驱动的金属-绝缘体转变（MIT）附近的激子态行为，以及金属区域与激子共存时的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在渗流驱动的金属-绝缘体转变前（pre-percolation regime），金属纳米区域的邻近效应可通过镜像电荷相互作用增强电子-空穴束缚，导致激子结合能显著增大（激子共振红移241 meV），而非传统预期的介电屏蔽抑制激子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在渗流驱动的金属-绝缘体转变前（pre-percolation regime），金属纳米区域的邻近效应可通过镜像电荷相互作用增强电子-空穴束缚，导致激子结合能显著增大（激子共振红移241 meV），而非传统预期的介电屏蔽抑制激子。；创新点：首次在渗流驱动的金属-绝缘体转变体系中观察到金属邻近效应反常稳定激子的现象，提出纳米尺度金属区域可通过镜像电荷相互作用增强激子结合能这一不同于传统介电屏蔽的物理机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用光学光谱（optical spectroscopy）测量激子共振和Tanguy连续谱边；计算上采用多体GW方法计算激子结合能（约489 meV）；理论上构建了基于镜像电荷的激子氢模型（image-charge-based excitonic hydrogen model）来解释金属区域对激子结合能的增强效应。

papers.title: Absence of lateral domain wall mobility in Zn1-xMgxO thin films
papers.abstract: Polarization reversal in ferroelectrics arises from the coupled processes of domain nucleation and subsequent growth, yet the governing mechanisms differ fundamentally between classical perovskite oxides and emerging wurtzite ferroelectrics. While switching in perovskites is typically governed by mobile domain walls whose field-driven propagation dominates macroscopic kinetics, here we show that polarization reversal in wurtzite Zn1-xMgxO proceeds through a qualitatively different pathway. Using scanning oscillator microscopy, in combination with point pulse-imaging methods, we directly map local switching events and domain wall responses, revealing that domain walls in Zn1-xMgxO exhibit negligible lateral mobility (sub 10nm) and that polarization reversal proceeds predominantly through the nucleation of vertically extended columnar filaments with a lateral size on the order of the grains. This nucleation-controlled switching contrasts sharply with the growth-mediated dynamics characteristic of perovskite ferroelectrics and explains the abrupt, spatially localized switching behavior observed in wurtzite systems. These results establish nucleation-dominated filamentary reversal as a defining switching mechanism in Zn1-xMgxO and point towards the need for further studies to understand correlation lengths and nucleation processes across a range of grain sizes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用扫描振荡显微镜”和“点脉冲成像方法”等实验手段。；研究对象：纤锌矿结构铁电薄膜 Zn₁₋ₓMgₓO（锌镁氧）中的极化反转机制，具体关注畴壁迁移行为与成核主导的开关过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Zn₁₋ₓMgₓO 中畴壁的横向迁移率可忽略不计（小于 10 nm），极化反转主要通过垂直延伸的柱状丝状畴的成核进行，而非传统钙钛矿铁电体中畴壁驱动的生长过程。该成核主导的开关机制解释了纤锌矿体系中 abrupt、空间局域的开关行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Zn₁₋ₓMgₓO 中畴壁的横向迁移率可忽略不计（小于 10 nm），极化反转主要通过垂直延伸的柱状丝状畴的成核进行，而非传统钙钛矿铁电体中畴壁驱动的生长过程。该成核主导的开关机制解释了纤锌矿体系中 abrupt、空间局域的开关行为。；创新点：首次直接实验证明纤锌矿铁电体 Zn₁₋ₓMgₓO 的极化反转是成核主导的丝状反转机制，与经典钙钛矿铁电体的畴壁迁移主导机制形成鲜明对比，确立了成核主导的丝状反转作为该体系的特征开关机制。
papers.method_zh: 扫描振荡显微镜（scanning oscillator microscopy）结合点脉冲成像方法（point pulse-imaging methods），用于直接测绘局域开关事件和畴壁响应。

papers.title: Quantum Geometry Driven Optical Responses in 1T-MX$_2$ Monolayers: A Symmetry-Constrained Slater-Koster Tight-Binding Approach
papers.abstract: Centrosymmetric 1T-MX$_2$ monolayers(MLs) have attracted considerable attention owing to their intriguing transport properties and potential technological applications arising from the interplay among quantum geometry, electronic band structure, and band-gap characteristics. Despite this rich physics, a comprehensive microscopic tight-binding(TB) description that simultaneously captures these properties remains insufficiently established, while first-principles approaches can be computationally demanding for systematic investigations across different materials and perturbations. Here, we develop a transferable eleven-band Slater-Koster TB description of ML 1T-MX$_2$ TMDs and use it to establish a connection among their microscopic electronic structure, quantum geometry, and optical response. The model is constructed in an orthogonal orbital basis from the crystal geometry and symmetry-constrained SK parameters, with material-specific parametrizations obtained from DFT calculations for ML ZrS$_2$ and HfS$_2$. The resulting geometry-based Hamiltonian accurately describes the low-energy electronic structures and provides a natural framework for extending the analysis to the broader isostructural 1T-MX$_2$ family. We find that the pristine MLs possess a finite quantum metric, with the dominant contribution concentrated in the two highest occupied bands owing to the small near-gap energy separation and strong metal-chalcogen $p$-$d$ hybridization. Furthermore, we verify the interband $f$-sum rule, which directly relates the integrated optical spectral weight to the Brillouin-zone-averaged quantum metric. Our results establish optical spectral weight as an experimentally accessible probe of the quantum geometry of occupied Bloch states and provide a unified microscopic framework for connecting electronic structure, quantum geometry, and measurable optical responses across the 1T-MX$_2$ family.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“tight-binding(TB) description”“DFT calculations”“Slater-Koster TB approach”等理论建模与第一性原理计算关键词。；研究对象：单层1T相过渡金属二硫属化物（1T-MX₂，具体以ZrS₂和HfS₂为代表）的电子结构、量子几何（quantum metric）与光学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 中心对称的1T-MX₂单层具有有限的量子度量，其主要贡献集中在最高占据的两条能带，源于近带隙小能量间隔与强金属-硫族p-d杂化；同时验证了带间f-sum rule，将积分光学谱权重与布里渊区平均量子度量直接关联，从而确立光学谱权重可作为量子几何的实验可测探针。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：中心对称的1T-MX₂单层具有有限的量子度量，其主要贡献集中在最高占据的两条能带，源于近带隙小能量间隔与强金属-硫族p-d杂化；同时验证了带间f-sum rule，将积分光学谱权重与布里渊区平均量子度量直接关联，从而确立光学谱权重可作为量子几何的实验可测探针。；创新点：首次建立了同时涵盖电子结构、量子几何与光学响应的统一微观紧束缚框架，适用于整个同构1T-MX₂家族，并提出了用光学谱权重实验探测量子几何的可行途径，克服了第一性原理方法在系统扫描不同材料与微扰时的计算负担。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个可迁移的十一带Slater-Koster紧束缚模型，基于晶体几何与对称性约束的SK参数，在正交轨道基上构造哈密顿量；材料特定参数通过对ZrS₂和HfS₂的DFT计算获得。随后利用该模型分析低能电子结构、量子度量及光学响应，并验证f-sum rule。

papers.title: Enhanced intrinsic spin-orbit driving of a Loss-DiVincenzo qubit near the spin-valley hotspot in Si/SiGe
papers.abstract: In most Si/SiGe-based spin qubit implementations, high-fidelity single-qubit gates are achieved using micromagnets, which enable the use of electric spin dipole resonance via synthetic spin-orbit coupling (s-SOC). In contrast, intrinsic spin-orbit coupling (i-SOC) in silicon is generally considered to be weak. However, in Si/SiGe heterostructures, theory predicts a substantial enhancement when the Zeeman splitting approaches the valley splitting if symmetry is reduced by an imperfect interface. Here, we demonstrate a Si/SiGe Loss-DiVincenzo qubit driven by i-SOC close to this so-called spin-valley hotspot. In particular, we characterize the Rabi frequency as a function of the energy detuning from the hotspot by sweeping both the magnetic field and quantum dot position. We observe the predicted enhancement of the Rabi frequency near the hotspot, but also find an asymmetry that deviates from existing theoretical models as well as distortions of the Chevron patterns near the hotspot. While we achieve an average single-qubit Clifford fidelity of 98.6 %, the strong variability of the valley splitting may impede the use of i-SOC-based control as a scalable operational strategy; understanding its effect is nevertheless important for reproducible high-fidelity control. Our results provide an empirical basis for refining current theoretical models of spin-valley physics in Si/SiGe heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“demonstrate”“characterize”“we observe”“we achieve”等实验性表述，且涉及量子点器件操作与测量。；研究对象：Si/SiGe异质结中的Loss-DiVincenzo自旋量子比特，具体研究其在本征自旋-轨道耦合（i-SOC）驱动下、靠近自旋-谷热点（spin-valley hotspot）时的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Si/SiGe量子点中，当塞曼劈裂接近谷劈裂时，本征自旋-轨道耦合驱动的Rabi频率出现显著增强，但实验观测到的增强不对称性及Chevron图案畸变与现有理论模型不符；单比特Clifford保真度平均为98.6%，但谷劈裂的强变异性可能阻碍基于i-SOC的控制方案的可扩展应用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Si/SiGe量子点中，当塞曼劈裂接近谷劈裂时，本征自旋-轨道耦合驱动的Rabi频率出现显著增强，但实验观测到的增强不对称性及Chevron图案畸变与现有理论模型不符；单比特Clifford保真度平均为98.6%，但谷劈裂的强变异性可能阻碍基于i-SOC的控制方案的可扩展应用。；创新点：首次实验演示了在Si/SiGe中利用本征自旋-轨道耦合（而非微磁体产生的合成自旋-轨道耦合）在自旋-谷热点附近驱动Loss-DiVincenzo量子比特，并揭示了现有理论模型未能预言的Rabi频率不对称性和Chevron图案畸变，为修正自旋-谷物理理论提供了实验依据。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过同时扫描外磁场和量子点位置，系统测量Rabi频率随与热点能量失谐量的变化关系；利用Loss-DiVincenzo量子点器件进行自旋操控，并提取单比特Clifford保真度。摘要未明确说明具体器件制备工艺或测量温度等细节。

papers.title: FDTBX - Computational Tools for Simulation of X-ray Fiber Diffraction Patterns from Atomic Coordinates
papers.abstract: Fiber diffraction is one of the few experimental techniques capable of resolving molecular structure in partially ordered, non-crystalline systems such as fibrous proteins, biopolymers, and synthetic polymers. Because fiber diffraction patterns are complex, exhibiting paracrystalline order, packing defects, and broad, overlapping reflections, their interpretation relies on model-based refinement, in which theoretical patterns simulated from candidate atomic models are iteratively compared with experiment. We present fdtbx, a modern, open, and extensible Python toolbox for simulating X-ray fiber diffraction patterns directly from atomic coordinates. Built on the library cctbx and structured for readability and multicore execution, fdtbx computes structure factors from a PDB model and constructs realistic reciprocal-space reflection profiles that incorporate the principal physical broadening mechanisms of fiber diffraction: finite crystallite size, orientational disorder (with Gaussian, Lorentzian, and Voigt angular peak shapes), and paracrystalline (second-kind) lattice disorder in Hosemann's formulation. A per-reflection shell-quadrature scheme evaluates the required convolutions at arbitrary query points rather than on a fixed grid, giving direct control over the trade-off between accuracy and speed, and an analytic Ewald-projection routine maps each sampled reflection, with an appropriate Lorentz correction, onto a flat detector to produce a simulated pattern for direct comparison with measured images. We illustrate the toolbox on cellulose I-alpha/I-beta, alpha-chitin, and cellulose triacetate, and outline a practical simulation workflow. By providing a transparent, well-documented, and parallelizable implementation of the specialized algorithms of fiber diffraction, fdtbx lowers the barrier to reproducible model-based analysis and serves as both a research and a teaching resource.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法学文章。判断依据：摘要描述的是“Python toolbox”“computational tools”“simulation”，属于开发计算工具的方法学工作。；研究对象：部分有序、非晶态体系（如纤维蛋白、生物聚合物、合成聚合物）的X射线纤维衍射图案模拟，具体示例材料包括纤维素Iα/Iβ、α-甲壳素和三乙酸纤维素。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了名为fdtbx的现代开源Python工具箱，能够直接从原子坐标（PDB模型）模拟X射线纤维衍射图案，并纳入有限晶粒尺寸、取向无序和次晶格无序等主要物理展宽机制，实现与实验图像的定量对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了名为fdtbx的现代开源Python工具箱，能够直接从原子坐标（PDB模型）模拟X射线纤维衍射图案，并纳入有限晶粒尺寸、取向无序和次晶格无序等主要物理展宽机制，实现与实验图像的定量对比。；创新点：提供了一个透明、文档完善、可并行化的开源实现，将纤维衍射的专业算法封装为易用的Python工具箱，降低了基于模型的可重复分析门槛，兼具科研与教学用途。摘要未突出说明与既有软件（如FibreFix、CLEARER等）的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于cctbx库构建，采用多核并行计算；计算结构因子后，通过逐反射壳层求积方案在任意查询点评估卷积（而非固定网格），并利用解析Ewald投影程序（含Lorentz校正）将采样反射映射到平面探测器。取向无序支持Gaussian、Lorentzian和Voigt角峰形，次晶格无序采用Hosemann公式。

papers.title: Electrostatic control of Li+ density and transport rate in double-gated van der Waals devices
papers.abstract: Ion transport in crystalline hosts is controlled by an applied potential that simultaneously sets ionic distribution and transport rate, restricting operation to a one-dimensional control space. Here we show that the transport rate of Li+ ions in double-gated van der Waals devices can be modulated while the system occupies fixed ionic-density states. We measure the ionic current along the van der Waals interface between hexagonal boron nitride and graphene or MoS2 while simultaneously monitoring the in-plane electronic response. The ionic current exhibits pronounced hysteresis, with plateaus marking discrete ionic-density states balanced by electronic charge, while an independently tuneable electrochemical-potential drop controls the ionic transport rate. The devices sustain over 1,000 switching cycles and function as hybrid ionic-electronic transistors capable of logic operations and memory retention, with ON/OFF ratios exceeding two orders of magnitude. This work demonstrates a two-dimensional control space for ion transport in layered materials, opening new operating regimes for energy storage and ion-based computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We measure the ionic current”“The devices sustain over 1,000 switching cycles”等实验测量与器件表征描述。；研究对象：双栅极范德华异质结器件中Li+离子沿六方氮化硼（hBN）与石墨烯或MoS2界面的输运行为，以及离子密度与输运速率的独立调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双栅极范德华器件中，Li+离子的输运速率可在系统保持固定离子密度态的条件下被独立调制，实现了离子输运的二维控制空间；该器件可作为混合离子-电子晶体管，具备逻辑运算与存储功能，开关比超过两个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双栅极范德华器件中，Li+离子的输运速率可在系统保持固定离子密度态的条件下被独立调制，实现了离子输运的二维控制空间；该器件可作为混合离子-电子晶体管，具备逻辑运算与存储功能，开关比超过两个数量级。；创新点：突破了传统单参数（外加电位）同时控制离子分布与输运速率的限制，首次在层状材料中展示了离子输运的二维控制空间（固定离子密度态下独立调节输运速率），并实现了基于该机制的高开关比混合离子-电子晶体管。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量：沿hBN/石墨烯或hBN/MoS2界面测量离子电流，同时监测面内电子响应；通过双栅极结构独立调控电化学势降与离子密度；进行了超过1000次循环的开关稳定性测试。

papers.title: Predicted High $n$-Type $zT$ and Ultralow Lattice Thermal Conductivity in A$_2$AgIrCl$_6$ (A = Cs, Rb)
papers.abstract: A useful thermoelectric device must impede heat flow without impeding charge transport. Here, we examine how closely cubic Cs$_2$AgIrCl$_6$ and Rb$_2$AgIrCl$_6$ approach this balance using first-principles calculations of structural stability, chemical bonding, elastic response, lattice dynamics, and scattering-resolved carrier transport. Both materials satisfy the cubic elastic-stability criteria, and neither harmonic phonon spectrum contains an imaginary mode. Replacing Cs with Rb mainly exerts chemical pressure: the lattice contracts by 1.34\% and the Ag--Cl and Ir--Cl bonds strengthen, whereas the band-edge topology changes little. HSE06 calculations including spin--orbit coupling yield direct X-point gaps of 1.597 and $1.637\,\mathrm{eV}$ for Cs$_2$AgIrCl$_6$ and Rb$_2$AgIrCl$_6$, respectively. The three symmetry-equivalent X valleys have light electron masses of $0.43$--$0.57\,m_0$, whereas the hole masses span $2.10$--$4.68\,m_0$. For Cs$_2$AgIrCl$_6$ and Rb$_2$AgIrCl$_6$, respectively, the modified Debye--Callaway model gives lattice thermal conductivities of 0.346 and $0.428\,\mathrm{W\,m^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$ at 300 K, decreasing to 0.118 and $0.150\,\mathrm{W\,m^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$ at 800 K. Treating acoustic-deformation-potential, ionized-impurity, and polar-optical-phonon scattering with AMSET gives peak $n$-type $zT$ values of 2.81 and 2.36 at 800 K near $6\times10^{19}\,\mathrm{cm^{-3}}$. This response arises from the convergence of light, valley-degenerate electrons, intermediate doping, and weak lattice heat transport rather than from a single exceptional coefficient. The predicted values are experimentally testable targets, contingent on retaining the cubic phases and controlled electron doping at elevated temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“HSE06 calculations”（HSE06杂化泛函计算）、“modified Debye–Callaway model”（修正的德拜-卡洛威模型）以及“AMSET”输运计算。；研究对象：立方相双钙钛矿材料 Cs₂AgIrCl₆ 和 Rb₂AgIrCl₆，具体研究其热电性能，包括晶格热导率、载流子输运性质及 n 型热电优值（zT）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两种材料均具有极低的晶格热导率（Cs₂AgIrCl₆ 在 300 K 时为 0.346 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹），且由于轻电子有效质量、多谷简并和中等掺杂浓度的协同作用，在 800 K 时预测获得很高的 n 型 zT 值（Cs₂AgIrCl₆ 为 2.81，Rb₂AgIrCl₆ 为 2.36）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两种材料均具有极低的晶格热导率（Cs₂AgIrCl₆ 在 300 K 时为 0.346 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹），且由于轻电子有效质量、多谷简并和中等掺杂浓度的协同作用，在 800 K 时预测获得很高的 n 型 zT 值（Cs₂AgIrCl₆ 为 2.81，Rb₂AgIrCl₆ 为 2.36）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于预测了 A₂AgIrCl₆（A = Cs, Rb）这一特定双钙钛矿体系同时具备超低晶格热导率和高 n 型 zT，并指出其优异性能源于多因素协同而非单一系数。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（结构稳定性、化学键、弹性响应、晶格动力学）；HSE06 杂化泛函计算并包含自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）以获取电子能带结构；修正的 Debye–Callaway 模型计算晶格热导率；AMSET 软件处理声学形变势、电离杂质和极性光学声子散射，计算载流子输运和 zT 值。

papers.title: The Achilles tendon enthesis rebuilds its mineralization front on reloading but retains a nanoscale imprint of unloading
papers.abstract: The enthesis is a graded fibrocartilaginous interface that transfers load between tendon and bone, yet the nanoscale mechanisms stabilizing its mineralization front remain unclear. Here, we combine multimodal 2D/3D X-ray imaging with nonlinear optical microscopy to map structural, crystalline and extracellular matrix organization across the murine Achilles tendon enthesis under unloading and reloading. Unloading reduces the tidemark-associated two-photon fluorescence (2PF) peak and is accompanied by diffuse mineralization into previously unmineralized fibrocartilage. This unloading-associated mineral exhibits increased apparent crystallite size, an enlarged c-axis lattice parameter, reduced crystalline texture and a diminished collagen order gradient, consistent with an altered mineralization environment. Upon reloading, the 2PF peak recovers, but a new tidemark forms ~20 um from the original boundary, creating a zone with a persistent nanoscale imprint in the mineral tessellation. These findings establish the enthesis as a mechanically governed graded interface in which matrix-mediated boundary control constrains mineral formation and in which a record of mechanical history is imprinted into the nanostructure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combine multimodal 2D/3D X-ray imaging with nonlinear optical microscopy”，属于多模态实验表征。；研究对象：小鼠跟腱止点（Achilles tendon enthesis）这一肌腱-骨骼之间的梯度纤维软骨界面，具体关注其矿化前沿（mineralization front）在卸载（unloading）和再加载（reloading）条件下的结构、晶体学及细胞外基质组织变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 卸载导致矿化前沿的荧光峰减弱并出现弥散性矿化，伴随晶体尺寸增大、c轴晶格参数扩大、晶体织构减弱及胶原有序梯度降低；再加载后荧光峰恢复，但新形成的潮标（tidemark）位于原边界约20 μm处，在矿物镶嵌结构中留下持久的纳米尺度印记，表明止点是一种受力学调控的梯度界面，其纳米结构记录了力学历史。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：卸载导致矿化前沿的荧光峰减弱并出现弥散性矿化，伴随晶体尺寸增大、c轴晶格参数扩大、晶体织构减弱及胶原有序梯度降低；再加载后荧光峰恢复，但新形成的潮标（tidemark）位于原边界约20 μm处，在矿物镶嵌结构中留下持久的纳米尺度印记，表明止点是一种受力学调控的梯度界面，其纳米结构记录了力学历史。；创新点：首次将卸载-再加载循环下止点矿化前沿的宏观力学响应与纳米尺度矿物晶体学特征（晶粒尺寸、晶格参数、织构）及胶原基质有序性梯度联系起来，揭示了力学历史在矿物纳米结构中的“印记”效应。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 多模态二维/三维X射线成像（2D/3D X-ray imaging）结合非线性光学显微镜（nonlinear optical microscopy），用于同时表征结构、晶体学（如晶粒尺寸、c轴晶格参数、晶体织构）和细胞外基质（胶原有序梯度）的组织分布。具体技术细节（如同步辐射光源、具体X射线技术名称）摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Universality of superdiffusion in simple random graphs
papers.abstract: Random walks with long-range jumps can drive superdiffusive transport, replacing ordinary diffusion with an effective long-range kinetic operator. Such superdiffusive kinetics is also central to critical phenomena, notably the self-avoiding walk with long-range jump statistics, or Lévy-SAW. This work investigates how the critical behavior is affected when the long-range connectivity itself becomes random. We study self-avoiding walks (SAWs) on a one-dimensional long-range random ring graph, where bonds are independently generated with Bernoulli probability $\sim|i-j|^{-(1+σ)}$. We term this walk Sparse-SAW. The same random bonds are responsible for both long-range superdiffusive transport and quenched disorder, with both simultaneously controlled by the single parameter $σ$, placing the problem beyond the conventional Harris and Weinrib-Halperin frameworks. Through large-scale Monte Carlo simulations and a Gaussian-truncated field theory, we show that Sparse-SAW belongs to the same universality class as the clean superdiffusive Lévy-SAW. The random bonds generate short-range uncorrelated and long-range correlated mass disorder while simultaneously producing the long-range kinetic operator. Under coarse-graining, the latter dominates, restoring the clean critical behavior. Our study suggests that the full non-Gaussian Bernoulli statistics may lead to disorder physics beyond the conventional theory of quenched disorder, while establishing random graphs as an efficient platform for extracting the critical exponents of the clean superdiffusive Lévy-SAW universality class.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要明确提到“大规模蒙特卡洛模拟”和“高斯截断场论”，属于计算与理论结合的研究。；研究对象：一维长程随机环图（long-range random ring graph）上的自回避行走（SAW），即“Sparse-SAW”模型。该体系同时涉及长程超扩散输运、淬火无序以及临界现象，特别是与Lévy-SAW（带长程跳跃统计的自回避行走）的普适类相关。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sparse-SAW与干净（无无序）的超扩散Lévy-SAW属于同一普适类。随机键在粗粒化过程中产生的长程动力学算符主导了临界行为，从而恢复了干净的临界行为，尽管随机键同时引入了短程无关联和长程关联的质量无序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sparse-SAW与干净（无无序）的超扩散Lévy-SAW属于同一普适类。随机键在粗粒化过程中产生的长程动力学算符主导了临界行为，从而恢复了干净的临界行为，尽管随机键同时引入了短程无关联和长程关联的质量无序。；创新点：该工作将长程超扩散输运与淬火无序同时由单一参数σ控制，超越了传统的Harris和Weinrib-Halperin无序判据框架。此外，摘要指出完整的非高斯伯努利统计可能产生超出传统淬火无序理论的物理，并首次提出随机图可作为提取干净超扩散Lévy-SAW普适类临界指数的有效平台。
papers.method_zh: 大规模蒙特卡洛模拟（large-scale Monte Carlo simulations）以及高斯截断场论（Gaussian-truncated field theory）。具体模拟中，随机键按伯努利概率~|i−j|^−(1+σ)独立生成。

papers.title: Quantics tensor cross interpolation for high-order strong-coupling expansions
papers.abstract: Real-time impurity solvers enable the study of transport phenomena and the description of nonequilibrium lattice systems within the framework of dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). They also provide direct access to the spectral functions of both equilibrium and nonequilibrium systems. A widely used approach is the self-consistent strong-coupling expansion, whose lowest-order implementation corresponds to the non-crossing approximation. Higher-order implementations, however, are computationally demanding because the number of diagram topologies grows factorially with expansion order, while the evaluation of self-energies and Green's functions requires increasingly high-dimensional integrations. Here, we demonstrate that the latter challenge can be mitigated by employing quantics tensor cross interpolation in a variable-separated framework. Compared with the previously used scale-separated approach, the new scheme yields substantially lower bond dimensions and capacitates self-consistent steady-state DMFT calculations up to fourth order. We illustrate its performance with representative results for both equilibrium and photo-doped systems. In addition, we analyze the convergence of the strong-coupling expansion in the challenging noninteracting limit by computing diagrams up to sixth order. At this order, the onset of the asymptotic regime of the strong-coupling expansion becomes apparent, which allows the application of extrapolation techniques.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“impurity solvers”“strong-coupling expansion”“tensor cross interpolation”“DMFT calculations”等数值与理论方法关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：强关联量子杂质系统及其在动力学平均场理论（DMFT）框架下的平衡态与非平衡态晶格系统，具体包括平衡态和光掺杂（photo-doped）体系中的输运现象与谱函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用quantics张量交叉插值（quantics tensor cross interpolation）的变量分离框架，可显著降低强耦合展开高阶计算中的张量键维数（bond dimensions），从而将自洽稳态DMFT计算推进到第四阶；在非相互作用极限下计算至第六阶时，强耦合展开的渐近行为开始显现，可应用外推技术。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用quantics张量交叉插值（quantics tensor cross interpolation）的变量分离框架，可显著降低强耦合展开高阶计算中的张量键维数（bond dimensions），从而将自洽稳态DMFT计算推进到第四阶；在非相互作用极限下计算至第六阶时，强耦合展开的渐近行为开始显现，可应用外推技术。；创新点：相较于此前使用的尺度分离方法，quantics张量交叉插值方案在相同精度下获得更低的键维数，从而将稳态DMFT强耦合计算从更低阶扩展到第四阶，并首次在第六阶观察到强耦合展开渐近区的起始，为外推技术的应用提供了可能。
papers.method_zh: 基于自洽强耦合展开（self-consistent strong-coupling expansion）的实时杂质求解器，其最低阶对应非交叉近似（non-crossing approximation, NCA）。本文引入quantics张量交叉插值方法替代此前使用的尺度分离（scale-separated）方案，用于处理高阶自能和格林函数所需的高维积分，并执行稳态DMFT自洽计算。

papers.title: First-Principles Spin-Lattice Coupling from Downfolded Electron-Phonon Interaction
papers.abstract: We present a method to calculate spin-phonon coupling parameters from first-principles perturbation theory by downfolding the electron-phonon coupling (EPC). We exploit the localized nature of magnetic moments and atomic displacements by working in the Wannier representation of the electronic Hamiltonian and the EPC matrix. The spin system is mapped to a classical Heisenberg Hamiltonian, whose parameters are obtained by treating local spin rotations as a perturbation within a Green's-function formalism. The spin and phonon perturbations are connected through the EPC parameters, which enter as lattice-induced perturbations to the tight-binding Hamiltonian. By combining these lattice perturbations with local spin rotations, we obtain real-space derivatives of magnetic exchange parameters without performing displaced magnetic supercell calculations. We illustrate the method on SrMnO$_3$ and show that it can be integrated directly into standard workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“first-principles perturbation theory”“downfolding”“Green's-function formalism”等理论推导与第一性原理计算关键词。；研究对象：自旋-声子耦合（spin-phonon coupling）参数，具体以钙钛矿锰氧化物 SrMnO₃ 为示例体系，研究磁性交换参数在晶格扰动下的实空间导数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种从第一性原理微扰论出发、通过降维（downfolding）电子-声子耦合来计算自旋-声子耦合参数的方法，无需进行位移磁超胞计算即可获得磁交换参数的实空间导数，并在 SrMnO₃ 上验证了可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种从第一性原理微扰论出发、通过降维（downfolding）电子-声子耦合来计算自旋-声子耦合参数的方法，无需进行位移磁超胞计算即可获得磁交换参数的实空间导数，并在 SrMnO₃ 上验证了可行性。；创新点：首次将电子-声子耦合的降维技术应用于自旋-声子耦合参数计算，避免了传统方法中需要构造位移磁超胞的昂贵计算，实现了自旋与晶格扰动在同一微扰框架下的统一处理。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Wannier 表示的电子哈密顿量和电子-声子耦合矩阵；将自旋系统映射为经典海森堡哈密顿量；利用 Green 函数形式将局域自旋旋转作为微扰处理；将晶格扰动与自旋旋转通过电子-声子耦合参数连接，从而得到磁交换参数的实空间导数。属于第一性原理微扰论方法，可集成到标准计算流程中。

papers.title: Impact of Carbon Contamination on the Low-Temperature Electric Conduction of the Spark-Plasma Sintered Barium Titanate Ceramics
papers.abstract: The dielectric and electric conduction properties of BaTiO3 samples fabricated by the spark plasma sintering with additional contamination by different content of carbon have been investigated in the temperature range from 77 through 408 K in small non-heating electric fields and in the range of 77 - 200K under strong electric fields up to 20 kV/cm. The effective dielectric permittivity of the samples with additional carbon achieves colossal values at low frequency, up to several units per 106 at 393 K. In the low temperature range, it remains very high magnitude, 10^4 -10^5 at low frequency and is strongly dependent on the carbon content. The electric conduction in the range of 77 - 200 K bears the hopping conduction and obeys the Mott law. We also studied electric conduction and effective dielectric permittivity vs electric field strength in the range of 77 - 200 K. The results are explained within the frames of hopping conduction theory and suggestion on different constituents in polarization processes and electric conduction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“investigated”（研究）、“fabricated”（制备）以及具体的实验测量条件（温度范围、电场强度）。；研究对象：通过放电等离子烧结（Spark Plasma Sintering, SPS）制备的钛酸钡（BaTiO3）陶瓷，并人为引入不同含量的碳污染。研究聚焦于该材料在低温（77–408 K）下的介电与导电特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 额外碳污染的BaTiO3陶瓷在低频下表现出巨介电常数（393 K时可达10^6量级），且在低温（77–200 K）下电导遵循Mott变程跳跃（hopping conduction）机制，电导率和介电常数强烈依赖于碳含量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：额外碳污染的BaTiO3陶瓷在低频下表现出巨介电常数（393 K时可达10^6量级），且在低温（77–200 K）下电导遵循Mott变程跳跃（hopping conduction）机制，电导率和介电常数强烈依赖于碳含量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于系统研究了SPS工艺中常见的碳污染对BaTiO3低温电输运和巨介电响应的定量影响，并利用跳跃电导理论统一解释了低温强场下的电导与介电行为。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：放电等离子烧结制备样品、不同碳含量人为掺杂；在77–408 K温度范围内、小非加热电场下测量介电常数和电导率；在77–200 K、强电场（最高20 kV/cm）下测量电导和有效介电常数随电场强度的变化。理论分析基于跳跃电导理论和极化过程多组分贡献的假设。

papers.title: Multiscale Quasiparticle Electronic Structure and Excitonic Properties of CdSe Nanoclusters
papers.abstract: Quantum confinement in stoichiometric $\mathrm{Cd}_n\mathrm{Se}_n$ nanoclusters dramatically attenuates electronic screening, driving a delicate, size-dependent competition between quasiparticle self-energy corrections ($Δ_{\mathrm{QP}}$) and exciton binding energies ($E_b$). Here, we present a $GW$/BSE study across a representative size series ($n = 3, 6, 13, 33$) and leverage it to validate a scalable atomistic tight-binding (TB) framework derived from first principles. Our results demonstrate that 1-2 eV spectral blueshifts previously reported in the literature arise from single-particle $GW$ convergence artifacts rather than deficiencies in the electron--hole kernels. We show that the near-perfect cancellation between $Δ_{\mathrm{QP}}$ and $E_b$ breaks down as cluster volume increases, driven by the rapid onset of dielectric screening attenuating $E_b$ faster than $Δ_{\mathrm{QP}}$ and leading to a pronounced divergence from mean-field predictions. Spatial inverse participation ratio analysis of the electronic structure reveals that optical suppression of fundamental pre-peaks stems from a severe spatial mismatch between localized valence orbitals and delocalized conduction states. Finally, we demonstrate that the confinement-induced scaling of the quasiparticle gap and the optical onset is accurately reproduced by a scissor-corrected, DFT-parameterized TB model. As such, this work provides a quantitative multiscale roadmap for embedding effective many-body effects kernels into computationally efficient models, enabling reliable optical predictions for realistic semiconducting nanostructures containing up to thousands of atoms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：GW/BSE study、atomistic tight-binding (TB) framework、DFT-parameterized TB model。；研究对象：化学计量比 CdₙSeₙ 纳米团簇（n = 3, 6, 13, 33）的准粒子电子结构、激子性质及量子限域效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 文献中报道的 1–2 eV 光谱蓝移源于单粒子 GW 收敛伪影而非电子-空穴核缺陷；准粒子自能修正与激子结合能之间的近完美抵消随团簇体积增大而破坏，导致与平均场预测的显著偏离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：文献中报道的 1–2 eV 光谱蓝移源于单粒子 GW 收敛伪影而非电子-空穴核缺陷；准粒子自能修正与激子结合能之间的近完美抵消随团簇体积增大而破坏，导致与平均场预测的显著偏离。；创新点：建立了从 GW/BSE 到可扩展 TB 模型的多尺度定量框架，证明该 TB 模型能准确复现限域诱导的准粒子带隙和光学起峰标度关系，可推广至含数千原子的真实半导体纳米结构。
papers.method_zh: GW 近似 + Bethe-Salpeter 方程（GW/BSE）计算；基于第一性原理参数化的原子级紧束缚（TB）模型；空间逆参与比（inverse participation ratio）分析；剪刀修正的 DFT 参数化 TB 模型。

papers.title: Probing the transport properties of Cantor-Wu alloys by means of femtosecond and nanosecond laser ablation
papers.abstract: Single-pulse laser ablation thresholds of selected equiatomic Cantor-Wu alloys - FeNi, CoNi, CrFeNi, CrCoNi, and CrMnFeCoNi - are measured for femtosecond and nanosecond pulse durations and interpreted through first-principles calculations of the electronic structure, the electron-phonon coupling, and the electronic thermal conductivity. Alloy synthesis, ablation experiments, and theory are performed consistently on the same set of samples. The absorbed femtosecond thresholds decrease systematically by up to 36 % from FeNi to the Cr-containing alloys, a trend that reflectance variations cannot explain. Two-temperature-model scaling of the thresholds with the electronic thermal conductivity and the electron-phonon coupling, with all parameters taken from the spin-disordered phase, reproduces the measured hierarchy. The nanosecond thresholds instead probe the thermal equilibrium conductivity averaged along the heating path. The apparent outlier of CoNi, whose room-temperature transport over-predicts its thresholds by up to a factor of two for both pulse durations, is resolved quantitatively by the collapse of its conductivity upon loss of ferromagnetic order. Single-pulse ablation thresholds thereby emerge as sensitive, contact-free probes of electronic transport and of its magnetic-phase dependence in compositionally complex alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“measured”（实验测量）和“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算），且强调“实验与理论在同一组样品上一致进行”。；研究对象：等原子比Cantor-Wu合金系列（FeNi、CoNi、CrFeNi、CrCoNi、CrMnFeCoNi），具体研究其飞秒和纳秒单脉冲激光烧蚀阈值与电子输运性质（电子热导率、电子-声子耦合）及磁相变之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 飞秒激光烧蚀阈值从FeNi到含Cr合金系统性降低（最高达36%），该趋势无法用反射率变化解释，但可由两温模型结合自旋无序相的电子热导率和电子-声子耦合参数定量重现；纳秒阈值则反映沿加热路径的热平衡电导率平均值。CoNi的“异常”行为由其铁磁序丧失时电导率的坍缩定量解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：飞秒激光烧蚀阈值从FeNi到含Cr合金系统性降低（最高达36%），该趋势无法用反射率变化解释，但可由两温模型结合自旋无序相的电子热导率和电子-声子耦合参数定量重现；纳秒阈值则反映沿加热路径的热平衡电导率平均值。CoNi的“异常”行为由其铁磁序丧失时电导率的坍缩定量解释。；创新点：首次将单脉冲激光烧蚀阈值作为成分复杂合金中电子输运性质及其磁相依赖性的灵敏、非接触式探针，并通过同一组样品的实验与理论自洽对比，定量解释了CoNi的输运-烧蚀阈值“异常”。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：合金合成、飞秒（fs）和纳秒（ns）单脉冲激光烧蚀阈值测量；理论上：第一性原理电子结构计算、电子-声子耦合计算、电子热导率计算，以及两温模型（Two-Temperature Model）标度分析。所有参数取自自旋无序相。

papers.title: Z1 oscillations and charge state in electronic stopping power from first principles
papers.abstract: The energy transfer rate from a projectile nucleus to the electrons of the matter it traverses depends on the charge of that projectile, Q= e Z1. At low projectile velocities the friction coefficient is known to oscillate with atomic number Z1, since core electrons travel with the projectile screening its charge. The effective charge increases with velocity and oscillations disappear. That effect is studied here calculating electronic stopping power from first principles for O and Mg projectiles shooting through bulk Al, using real-time time-dependent density-functional theory. Both projectiles represent maximum and minimum of the first Z1 oscillation, respectively. The oscillation is found to be very sensitive to the direction of propagation, in spite of Al being quite an ideal metal for many purposes. The critical velocity for the oscillation disappearance ranges between below 0.1 a.u. and beyond 1 a.u. for the explored trajectories. The charge state is independently quantified with Hirshfeld and Voronoi analyses, offering remarkably consistent results in spite of their very different partition methods, as well as with an effective definition based on the stopping power itself. They display a gradual undressing of the projectile's core electrons with increasing velocity in qualitative accordance with expectations. However, electron density plots in real space present a richer picture in which the undressing is partly due to the electrons trailing behind the projectile, suggesting possible phenomenological descriptions correcting for the deformation of the density in terms of multipoles beyond the net charge. The plots also offer insights into dissipation by core electrons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要明确使用“first principles”“real-time time-dependent density-functional theory”等第一性原理计算方法。；研究对象：O和Mg弹丸离子穿过体相Al金属时的电子阻止本领，以及弹丸有效电荷态随速度的变化，聚焦于Z1振荡现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Z1振荡对弹丸的传播方向非常敏感，即使Al是近理想金属；振荡消失的临界速度在0.1 a.u.到1 a.u.以上之间，取决于具体轨迹。弹丸核心电子的“脱衣”过程随速度增加而渐进发生，但实空间电子密度图显示脱衣部分源于电子在弹丸后方拖尾，而非简单的净电荷屏蔽。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Z1振荡对弹丸的传播方向非常敏感，即使Al是近理想金属；振荡消失的临界速度在0.1 a.u.到1 a.u.以上之间，取决于具体轨迹。弹丸核心电子的“脱衣”过程随速度增加而渐进发生，但实空间电子密度图显示脱衣部分源于电子在弹丸后方拖尾，而非简单的净电荷屏蔽。；创新点：首次从第一性原理出发，针对Z1振荡的最大值和最小值（Mg和O）系统研究其方向依赖性和临界速度范围，并利用多种电荷定义交叉验证；揭示电子密度形变（多极拖尾）对有效电荷的贡献，提出超越净电荷的多极修正现象学描述可能性。
papers.method_zh: 实时含时密度泛函理论（real-time TDDFT）计算电子阻止本领；使用Hirshfeld和Voroni两种电荷布居分析独立量化弹丸电荷态，并基于阻止本领本身定义有效电荷；结合实空间电子密度图分析。

papers.title: Three-dimensional Ising superconductors designed via inversion-symmetry breaking in intercalated NbSe$_2$ and NbTe$_2$
papers.abstract: Ising superconductors exhibit in-plane upper critical fields far exceeding the Pauli paramagnetic limit, a hallmark first established in two-dimensional (2D) monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs). This field resilience requires the coexistence of strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC) and broken inversion symmetry, yet three-dimensional (3D) bulk realizations remain scarce because equilibrium stacking typically restores inversion symmetry. Here we demonstrate that intercalation provides a practical route to break this symmetry, systematically designing 16 NbSe$_2$- and NbTe$_2$-based compounds from four intercalants (In, Sn, Pb, Bi) across two polytypes: non-centrosymmetric $P\bar{6}m2$ and centrosymmetric $P6_3/mmc$. Four compounds in the $P\bar{6}m2$ phase, InNbSe$_2$, SnNbSe$_2$, PbNbSe$_2$, and PbNbTe$_2$, emerge as promising 3D Ising superconductors. They exhibit SOC splittings of 80-100 meV near the Fermi level, dominant out-of-plane spin polarization, and anisotropic superconductivity with $T_c=2.6$-$5.4$ K. Notably, spin-texture analysis reveals that the efficiency of Ising protection is governed not by the magnitude of SOC splitting alone but by the out-of-plane spin purity on the Fermi surface. Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) calculations predict in-plane upper critical fields reaching 4-7 times the Pauli limit. These findings establish intercalation as a promising symmetry-engineering strategy for realizing 3D Ising superconductors in TMDs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“systematically designing”“Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) calculations”“spin-texture analysis”等，均为第一性原理计算与理论预测手段，未涉及实验合成或测量。；研究对象：基于插层NbSe₂和NbTe₂的三维Ising超导体。具体为16种由四种插层剂（In、Sn、Pb、Bi）插入两种多型（非中心对称P̄6m2和中心对称P6₃/mmc）构成的化合物，重点关注其中四种P̄6m2相候选材料（InNbSe₂、SnNbSe₂、PbNbSe₂、PbNbTe₂）的超导与自旋轨道耦合性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 插层可有效打破三维TMD块体材料的中心反演对称性，设计出三维Ising超导体。其中四种P̄6m2相化合物具有80–100 meV的SOC劈裂、面外自旋极化主导的自旋织构，以及Tc=2.6–5.4 K的各向异性超导；BdG计算预测其面内上临界场可达Pauli极限的4–7倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：插层可有效打破三维TMD块体材料的中心反演对称性，设计出三维Ising超导体。其中四种P̄6m2相化合物具有80–100 meV的SOC劈裂、面外自旋极化主导的自旋织构，以及Tc=2.6–5.4 K的各向异性超导；BdG计算预测其面内上临界场可达Pauli极限的4–7倍。；创新点：提出插层作为一种实用的对称性工程策略，在三维块体TMD中实现Ising超导；并揭示Ising保护效率并非由SOC劈裂大小单独决定，而是由费米面上自旋的**面外纯度**（out-of-plane spin purity）主导——这一判据是对传统二维Ising超导认知的重要拓展。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理电子结构计算（用于SOC劈裂、自旋织构分析）、对称性分析与多型结构设计（P̄6m2 vs P6₃/mmc）、Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）方程求解（用于预测上临界场与Ising保护效率）。

papers.title: Interplay of Magnetic Order, Structural Stability, and Orbital Ordering in BaFe2X3 (X = S and Se)
papers.abstract: BaFe2X3 (X= S and Se) are quasi-one-dimensional Mott insulators with a ladder structure that exhibit Stripe- and Block-type antiferromagnetic order, respectively. The ladder arrangement of Fe atoms and strong electron correlations give rise to rich magnetic and orbital phenomena, including pressure-induced superconductivity and orbital-selective electronic states. Both compounds also show resistivity anomalies above the Neel temperature, suggesting that orbital degrees of freedom play an important role in their electronic properties. To clarify the interplay among magnetic order, structural stability, orbital ordering, and transport properties, we performed resistivity measurements and first-principles calculations for BaFe2S3 and BaFe2Se3, systematically comparing candidate magnetic and crystal structures. We find that the magnetic configuration strongly influences the stable crystal structure, orbital ordering, and transport anisotropy, providing a microscopic understanding of the contrasting electronic properties of the two compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“resistivity measurements”（电阻率测量）和“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：准一维梯子结构Mott绝缘体BaFe₂X₃（X = S和Se），具体涉及条纹型（Stripe）与块状型（Block）反铁磁序、轨道有序、结构稳定性及其与输运性质的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁构型强烈影响稳定晶体结构、轨道有序和输运各向异性，从而微观上解释了BaFe₂S₃与BaFe₂Se₃两种化合物截然不同的电子性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁构型强烈影响稳定晶体结构、轨道有序和输运各向异性，从而微观上解释了BaFe₂S₃与BaFe₂Se₃两种化合物截然不同的电子性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 电阻率测量（resistivity measurements）结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），系统比较候选磁结构与晶体结构。

papers.title: X-ray driven displacive excitation of coherent phonons
papers.abstract: Modulating electron-phonon coupling offers a route to control structural displacements and tune material functionality. Valence-to-conduction band transitions, however, provide limited leverage over the driving force. Here, we demonstrate coherent lattice dynamics in trigonal tellurium using free-electron laser pulses tuned to the Te N4,5-edge. Over a broad fluence range, the oscillation amplitude obeys the displacive excitation of coherent phonons framework, extended to core resonance with twice the driving efficiency of a visible pump. Ab initio calculations decompose the force into competing multiband contributions, inaccessible to optical excitation, whose balance shifts as carriers relax. Tunable extreme-ultraviolet and X-ray pulses thus open a regime in which the displacive response is set by band-dependent coupling to the lattice, not by the number and temperature of the photocarriers alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate coherent lattice dynamics using free-electron laser pulses”（实验）以及“Ab initio calculations decompose the force”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：三角相碲（trigonal tellurium）中的相干声子动力学，具体为X射线驱动的位移激发（displacive excitation）过程，涉及电子-声子耦合的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用自由电子激光脉冲调谐至Te N4,5-edge，可在三角碲中激发相干晶格动力学，其振荡幅度在宽通量范围内遵循位移激发相干声子（DECP）框架，且驱动效率是可见光泵浦的两倍。第一性原理计算表明，该驱动力由多个能带贡献竞争决定，其平衡随载流子弛豫而改变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用自由电子激光脉冲调谐至Te N4,5-edge，可在三角碲中激发相干晶格动力学，其振荡幅度在宽通量范围内遵循位移激发相干声子（DECP）框架，且驱动效率是可见光泵浦的两倍。第一性原理计算表明，该驱动力由多个能带贡献竞争决定，其平衡随载流子弛豫而改变。；创新点：首次将DECP框架扩展到核共振（core resonance）激发条件，并证明X射线激发下位移响应由能带依赖的电子-声子耦合决定，而非仅由光生载流子的数量和温度决定。这一机制在光学激发下不可及。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用自由电子激光（FEL）产生的可调谐极紫外/X射线脉冲（共振于Te N4,5-edge）进行泵浦-探测测量，分析相干声子振荡幅度与泵浦通量的关系。理论上采用第一性原理（ab initio）计算，将驱动力分解为多能带贡献。

papers.title: Displacement-field-driven reconstruction of low energy transport in few-layer PtSe2
papers.abstract: In layered semiconductors, a perpendicular displacement field generates an interlayer potential difference that competes with interlayer hybridization, modifying both the band gap and the finite-density electronic states that carry current. Resolving this interplay requires a material lying close to the semiconductor-to-semimetal transition, where moderate electric fields can strongly reshape the low-energy electronic structure. Here, we investigate displacement-field-driven transport in dual-gated semiconducting PtSe2, whose pronounced thickness-dependent electronic structure provides access to this low-band-gap regime. Unlike thinner layers, the displacement-field response is strong in six-layer PtSe2, which lies at the verge of the semiconductor-to-semimetal crossover with only a small residual transport gap. Even weak displacement fields rapidly suppress this residual gap near charge neutrality, driving the system toward a band-overlap regime. At the same time, the conductivity decreases in the heavily hole-doped regime, demonstrating that the displacement field modifies not only the gap but also the conducting valence-band states. Fixed-relaxation-time Wannier transport calculations reproduce both responses, showing that they originate from field-induced band overlap together with reconstruction of the valence-band dispersion. These results establish finite-density transport as a sensitive probe of displacement-field-driven electronic structure reconstruction and extend electrical control beyond conventional band-gap engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合计算验证）。判断依据：摘要提及“dual-gated”器件输运测量，以及“Fixed-relaxation-time Wannier transport calculations”作为理论佐证，属于实验与计算混合类型。；研究对象：少层PtSe₂（六层）半导体，在垂直位移场作用下的低能电子结构重构与输运性质，特别是半导体-半金属转变临界区的带隙与价带态调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在六层PtSe₂中，即使很弱的位移场也能迅速压制电荷中性点附近的残余输运带隙，驱动体系进入能带交叠（半金属）区域；同时位移场会重构价带色散，导致重空穴掺杂区电导下降，表明位移场不仅调控带隙，还改变导电的价带态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在六层PtSe₂中，即使很弱的位移场也能迅速压制电荷中性点附近的残余输运带隙，驱动体系进入能带交叠（半金属）区域；同时位移场会重构价带色散，导致重空穴掺杂区电导下降，表明位移场不仅调控带隙，还改变导电的价带态。；创新点：将有限密度（非电荷中性点）输运作为位移场驱动电子结构重构的灵敏探针，展示了超越传统带隙工程的电学调控手段——即通过位移场同时调控带隙和价带色散，而非仅改变带隙大小。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比差异。
papers.method_zh: 双栅（dual-gated）场效应器件输运测量，施加垂直位移场；配合固定弛豫时间（fixed-relaxation-time）的Wannier函数输运计算，对比实验与理论结果。

papers.title: Discovery of New Zintl Films and Nanowires Grown by Topotaxy Conversion of III-V Semiconductors
papers.abstract: Zintl phases draw broad interest for their diverse structural, magnetic, thermoelectric, topological and optical properties. Recently, Zintl Eu$_3$In$_2$As$_4$ and Eu$_5$In$_2$As$_6$ nanowires with axion magneto-topology have been synthesized by molecular beam epitaxy via topotactic conversion of InAs wurtzite and zincblende nanowires. Here we extend this methodology, demonstrating that topotaxial mutual-exchange growth applies not only to a broader set of III-V semiconductors beyond InAs but also to three-dimensional substrates whose surfaces are converted into Zintl thin films, as well as to nanowires. We report the growth of two new compounds: Eu$_5$Ga$_2$As$_6$ thin films converted from GaAs substrates, and Eu$_5$Al$_2$As$_6$ thin films from AlAs films. We also convert GaAs nanowires of both wurtzite and zincblende structures into Eu$_5$Ga$_2$As$_6$ nanowires. Though the stoichiometry is the same as in the previously reported Eu$_5$In$_2$As$_6$ case, microscopy and diffraction reveal a single-phase Pnma symmetry group rather than Pbam, highlighting symmetry-guided topotactic pathways to new Zintl frameworks. The compounds host an intricate magnetic phase diagram with three magnetic transitions, including two distinct antiferromagnetic orders and a canted antiferromagnetic phase that evolves into another antiferromagnetic phase under applied field through a spin-flop transition. Ab initio calculations predict that both Zintls are semiconductors with gaps of 0.79 eV in Eu$_5$Ga$_2$As$_6$ and 0.90 eV in Eu$_5$Al$_2$As$_6$. The lower symmetry and increased structural complexity suggest suppressed lattice thermal conductivity, pointing to thermoelectric potential alongside prospects in spintronics and detector technologies. These results give an epitaxy-compatible route for discovering and integrating magnetic Zintl thin films and nanowires directly from relevant III-V semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“molecular beam epitaxy”（分子束外延）、“microscopy and diffraction”（显微与衍射）等实验手段，同时包含“Ab initio calculations”（从头计算）。；研究对象：新型Zintl相薄膜与纳米线：Eu₅Ga₂As₆（由GaAs衬底/纳米线转化）和Eu₅Al₂As₆（由AlAs薄膜转化），以及它们的磁性、电子结构与热输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过拓扑互换（topotactic mutual-exchange）方法，成功将III-V族半导体（GaAs、AlAs）转化为两种新的Zintl相Eu₅Ga₂As₆和Eu₅Al₂As₆（薄膜及纳米线），二者具有Pnma对称性（不同于此前Eu₅In₂As₆的Pbam），并表现出复杂的多步磁相变（两个反铁磁序、一个倾斜反铁磁相及场致自旋翻转转变），理论预测为带隙0.79 eV和0.90 eV的半导体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过拓扑互换（topotactic mutual-exchange）方法，成功将III-V族半导体（GaAs、AlAs）转化为两种新的Zintl相Eu₅Ga₂As₆和Eu₅Al₂As₆（薄膜及纳米线），二者具有Pnma对称性（不同于此前Eu₅In₂As₆的Pbam），并表现出复杂的多步磁相变（两个反铁磁序、一个倾斜反铁磁相及场致自旋翻转转变），理论预测为带隙0.79 eV和0.90 eV的半导体。；创新点：将拓扑互换算方法从InAs拓展到更广泛的III-V族半导体（GaAs、AlAs），并首次实现三维衬底表面转化为Zintl薄膜以及不同晶体结构（纤锌矿和闪锌矿）纳米线的转化；发现相同化学计量比下通过对称性引导可获得新的Pnma Zintl框架，并指出其低对称性可能抑制晶格热导率，具有热电应用潜力。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长及拓扑互换算转化；透射/扫描电子显微术与衍射（确定晶体结构对称性）；磁性测量（磁相图、自旋翻转转变）；第一性原理计算（预测电子能带带隙）。

papers.title: Coarse-grained kinetic scale tightens thermodynamic spectral bounds of Markov cycles
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic bounds on the spectrum of a Markov cycle depend on the cycle affinity and maximum escape rate, but they ignore how the local transition rates are distributed around the cycle. In this work, we show that a single additional cycle-wide kinetic quantity, the geometric means of forward and backward rates, yields a strictly stronger bound for every nonuniform cycle. By comparing each winding sector of the eigenmode with a product-matched uniform cycle, we bound oscillation frequencies, tighten the admissible spectral region, and show that only uniform cycles can saturate the Uhl-Seifert boundary. Our results show that retaining a coarse-grained kinetic scale can sharpen thermodynamic spectral bounds without requiring knowledge of the full generator. Our method also provides a complex-analytic framework which unifies generator-specific kinetic information with established affinity-winding bounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“thermodynamic bounds”“spectral bounds”“complex-analytic framework”等理论推导与数学分析关键词，未提及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：马尔可夫环（Markov cycles）的动力学谱（spectrum）与热力学约束之间的关系，属于随机热力学/非平衡统计物理范畴，不涉及具体凝聚态材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入一个额外的环级动力学量——前向与后向速率的几何平均值——可以严格收紧所有非均匀马尔可夫环的热力学谱界，且只有均匀环才能饱和 Uhl-Seifert 边界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入一个额外的环级动力学量——前向与后向速率的几何平均值——可以严格收紧所有非均匀马尔可夫环的热力学谱界，且只有均匀环才能饱和 Uhl-Seifert 边界。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但明确指出其新意在于：仅需一个粗粒化的环级动力学量（几何平均速率）即可显著收紧谱界，无需知道完整生成元，且提供了统一生成元特异信息与亲和力-绕数界的复分析框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析理论框架：将每个本征模的绕数扇区（winding sector）与一个“乘积匹配的均匀环”进行比较，从而约束振荡频率并收紧可允许谱区域；同时构建了一个复分析框架，将生成元特异的动力学信息与已有的亲和力-绕数界统一起来。

papers.title: Composition- and Ordering-Dependent Evolution of Simulated Kikuchi Patterns of Au-Ni Alloys
papers.abstract: Understanding how Kikuchi patterns behave with subtle material variations is essential for developing machine learning (ML) based indexing methods for structurally and chemically complex cases, such as phases with potential sub-lattice order or (meta)stable defects with segregation (defect phases). Simulated Kikuchi patterns of the binary Au-Ni system were systematically analysed to investigate the effects of lattice parameter, chemical composition, partial site occupancy and ordering. The full compositional range from pure nickel to pure gold was considered, including a hypothetical ordered L$1_2$ Au$_3$Ni structure. Simulation parameters were optimised by comparison with experimental patterns. Normalized cross correlation showed limited sensibility to subtle differences between patterns. EMsoft simulation results revealed a systematic increase in mean intensity and more reflections contribute significantly as gold content increases. A surprising four-fold increase in mean intensity from 99 % gold to the pure gold sample highlighted limitations of partial site occupancy simulation by EMsoft. Difference maps showed enhanced normalised intensity along the {111} and {200} bands for the sample with 20 % gold compared to higher gold compositions. By isolating lattice parameter and chemical composition effects, chemical composition contributes predominantly to the mean intensity and strong reflections count, although the normalised intensity distribution was affected by both. Introducing L$1_2$ ordering increased the number of strong reflections and mean intensity, and redistributed normalised intensity along {111} and {200} bands and selected zone axis. Normalised intensity distribution and band width, are key descriptions to distinguish the Kikuchi patterns, which can be incorporated in future representation learning based indexing methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：关键词为“Simulated Kikuchi patterns”“EMsoft simulation”“simulation parameters”。；研究对象：Au-Ni二元合金体系，涵盖从纯镍到纯金的完整成分范围，并包含一种假设的有序L1₂ Au₃Ni结构。研究聚焦于Kikuchi花样随晶格参数、化学成分、部分占位及有序度的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Kikuchi花样的平均强度和强反射数量随金含量增加而系统性增大，且化学成分对平均强度和强反射数量的贡献占主导；归一化强度分布和带宽是区分不同Kikuchi花样的关键描述量，可用于未来基于表示学习的索引方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Kikuchi花样的平均强度和强反射数量随金含量增加而系统性增大，且化学成分对平均强度和强反射数量的贡献占主导；归一化强度分布和带宽是区分不同Kikuchi花样的关键描述量，可用于未来基于表示学习的索引方法。；创新点：系统性地将Kikuchi花样演化与成分、有序度、部分占位等微观参数关联，并指出归一化强度分布和带宽可作为机器学习索引方法的有效特征描述。摘要未突出说明与传统索引方法相比的具体性能优势。
papers.method_zh: 使用EMsoft软件进行Kikuchi花样的动力学模拟；通过归一化互相关（normalized cross correlation）比较花样差异；采用差分图（difference maps）分析归一化强度分布；通过隔离晶格参数与化学成分效应进行变量解耦分析。

papers.title: Revised symmetry rule and intrinsically time-reversal symmetry breaking pairing in multi-orbital superconductors
papers.abstract: We investigate the basic symmetry rule for the particle permutation in superconducting (SC) pairing states by examining the numerical solution of the linearized Eliashberg equation for Sr$_2$RuO$_4$. We find that the general multi-band, frequency-dependent SC gap function does not simply transform to itself up to the minus sign with either orbital ($\hat{O}$) or frequency ($\hat{T}$) exchange between two pairing electrons, contradicting the common assumption which has been used without verification. It originates from the fact that paring interactions are not invariant under the $\hat{O}$ or $\hat{T}$ operation, and is demonstrated to be essential to correctly interpret and understand multi-band SC states. One of unique properties implied by our newly found symmetry rule is the possibility of the complex eigenvalue in the linearized gap equation where the corresponding gap functions $Δ$ always have real and imaginary components both non-zero in real frequencies, inherently breaking the time-reversal symmetry. Our numerical results suggest the possibility of this unique pairing in a real material, Sr$_2$RuO$_4$, for which the Hundness of the material is found to play a key role. The revised symmetry rule not only leads us to more comprehensive understanding of the known SC states, but also opens new possibilities into exotic and unique states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“numerical solution of the linearized Eliashberg equation”（线性化Eliashberg方程的数值解），属于第一性原理/强关联计算与理论分析结合的工作。；研究对象：多轨道超导体中的配对态对称性规则，具体以Sr₂RuO₄为研究对象，并涉及Hund耦合（Hundness）对配对的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多带、频率依赖的超导能隙函数在粒子交换下并不简单地按轨道（Ô）或频率（T̂）交换变换为自身（仅差一个负号），这推翻了此前未经验证的常见假设；该修正的对称性规则允许线性化能隙方程出现复本征值，对应的能隙函数在实频率下实部和虚部均非零，从而内禀地破缺时间反演对称性。数值结果提示Sr₂RuO₄可能实现这种独特配对，其中Hund耦合起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多带、频率依赖的超导能隙函数在粒子交换下并不简单地按轨道（Ô）或频率（T̂）交换变换为自身（仅差一个负号），这推翻了此前未经验证的常见假设；该修正的对称性规则允许线性化能隙方程出现复本征值，对应的能隙函数在实频率下实部和虚部均非零，从而内禀地破缺时间反演对称性。数值结果提示Sr₂RuO₄可能实现这种独特配对，其中Hund耦合起关键作用。；创新点：提出并验证了修正的粒子置换对称性规则，指出多带、频率依赖配对态中常见的“能隙函数在轨道或频率交换下仅变号”假设不成立；并由此预言了内禀时间反演对称性破缺的配对态在真实材料（Sr₂RuO₄）中存在的可能性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 线性化Eliashberg方程的数值求解（针对Sr₂RuO₄），结合对配对相互作用在轨道/频率交换操作下不变性的分析。

papers.title: Spontaneous currents determine capillary rise in active matter
papers.abstract: The capillary rise of simple passive fluids in a tube is controlled by the force balance between surface tension and gravity --Jurin's law of capillary action. For fluids composed of active particles interacting via pairwise forces, mechanical surface tension is negative, but a capillary rise was nevertheless reported and remains unexplained. We establish the active form of Jurin's law from the microscopic dynamics. It includes a drag emerging from particle currents that we find responsible for capillary rise. These active currents, alongside negative surface tension, lead to complex and counterintuitive capillary action phenomena that are impossible in equilibrium. In particular the capillary rise of active fluids depends on the shape of the tube, not solely on the tube diameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“from the microscopic dynamics”建立理论模型，推导出活性形式Jurin定律，属于理论推导研究。；研究对象：活性物质（由成对相互作用力相互作用的活性粒子组成的流体）在管中的毛细上升现象，特别是活性流体中自发粒子流驱动的毛细作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性流体的毛细上升由粒子自发电流产生的拖曳力控制，而非传统表面张力与重力的平衡；活性毛细上升依赖于管道的形状（不仅是直径），且伴随负表面张力，导致平衡态不可能出现的复杂毛细现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性流体的毛细上升由粒子自发电流产生的拖曳力控制，而非传统表面张力与重力的平衡；活性毛细上升依赖于管道的形状（不仅是直径），且伴随负表面张力，导致平衡态不可能出现的复杂毛细现象。；创新点：首次从微观动力学解释了活性流体毛细上升的机制，指出自发电流是毛细上升的驱动力，并揭示毛细上升对管道形状的依赖——这是平衡态毛细作用中不存在的现象。
papers.method_zh: 从微观动力学出发建立活性Jurin定律的理论推导，分析活性粒子间成对力产生的机械表面张力与自发电流的拖曳效应。

papers.title: Fidelity susceptibility of Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with further neighbour hopping term
papers.abstract: In this study, topological phase transition in Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model with a further neighbour hopping term has been studied in terms of fidelity susceptibility. Topological phase transition point in the standard SSH model has been identified before by noting the divergence of fidelity susceptibility. The same approach has been employed here where fidelity susceptibility is found to diverge at the phase transition points. Additionally, effect of staggered potential on the fidelity susceptibility has been explored. Analytic expression for fidelity susceptibility has been obtained along with its numerical estimation on finite chains by exact diagonalization. Fidelity susceptibility exhibits sharp peaks at the phase transition points in both approaches. Scaling exponent of this divergence has been obtained numerically which is found to agree to that of the standard SSH model without further neighbour terms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“analytic expression”“numerical estimation”“exact diagonalization”“scaling exponent”等理论推导与数值计算关键词。；研究对象：含次近邻跳跃项的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型，具体研究其拓扑相变及交错势（staggered potential）对保真度磁化率（fidelity susceptibility）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在含次近邻跳跃项的SSH模型中，保真度磁化率在拓扑相变点处发散，且该发散行为的标度指数与标准SSH模型（无次近邻项）一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在含次近邻跳跃项的SSH模型中，保真度磁化率在拓扑相变点处发散，且该发散行为的标度指数与标准SSH模型（无次近邻项）一致。；创新点：将保真度磁化率方法推广到含次近邻跳跃项的SSH模型，并首次考察了交错势对该量的影响；摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导保真度磁化率的表达式，并利用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）对有限链进行数值计算，同时数值提取发散行为的标度指数。

papers.title: Note on Boltzmann's H-Theorem and Detailed Balance Dynamics
