papers.abstract: The Boltzmann H-theorem states that entropy of an ensemble of thermodynamic states increases until all states become equally probable. The evolution randomly picks one of the states in the ensemble and brings every other state to have the same probability as the selected state. Different realizations of evolution yield a distribution of selected states. We study this distribution numerically and discuss its relevance for equilibrium fluctuations in thermal as well as non thermal systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/数值计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We study this distribution numerically”，即采用数值方法研究。；研究对象：玻尔兹曼H定理所描述的系综熵增过程，以及该过程中“被选中态”的分布统计。该研究不针对特定材料，而是针对热力学系综的演化动力学，并讨论其在热系统与非热系统平衡涨落中的意义。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在玻尔兹曼H定理描述的演化过程中，每次随机选择一个态作为目标，使其他态的概率与该态一致；不同演化实现会导致被选中态形成一个分布，该分布与平衡涨落相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在玻尔兹曼H定理描述的演化过程中，每次随机选择一个态作为目标，使其他态的概率与该态一致；不同演化实现会导致被选中态形成一个分布，该分布与平衡涨落相关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作将H定理的确定性熵增描述与随机选择过程的统计分布联系起来，并探讨该分布对热与非热系统平衡涨落的普适意义，但具体创新点需结合正文判断。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟方法。摘要未明确说明具体算法（如蒙特卡洛、分子动力学等），仅说明“numerically”研究该分布。

papers.title: Observation of current-induced orbital quadrupole accumulation
papers.abstract: Spintronics and orbitronics rely on current-induced accumulations of magnetic dipoles: spin and orbital angular momentum. However, electronic orbitals inherently carry multipoles beyond the dipole, with the rank-2 orbital quadrupole as the leading term. Here we use polarization-resolved Kerr microscopy to observe current-induced orbital-quadrupole accumulation at the surfaces of Ti and Pt, metals with markedly different spin--orbit-coupling strengths. By separating the symmetric and antisymmetric components of the off-diagonal optical conductivity, we isolate the time-reversal-even quadrupolar response from the conventional time-reversal-odd magnetic-dipolar one, and find that the quadrupolar optical response exceeds the dipolar one in both metals. First-principles analysis of the measured responses indicates that the quadrupole accumulations are of the same order of magnitude in the two metals despite their widely different spin--orbit-coupling strengths, consistent with a previously unidentified channel of charge-to-orbital conversion that does not require spin--orbit coupling. Our findings establish that current-induced orbital polarization is fundamentally multipolar, expanding current-induced phenomena from the dipolar to the multipolar regime and opening a route to electrical control of orbital-ordered phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合第一性原理计算分析）。判断依据：使用“polarization-resolved Kerr microscopy”进行实验观测，并辅以“First-principles analysis”对测量响应进行分析。；研究对象：电流诱导的轨道四极矩（orbital quadrupole）在金属Ti和Pt表面的积累现象，涉及自旋电子学与轨道电子学中的电流诱导磁多极响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Ti和Pt表面观测到电流诱导的轨道四极矩积累，且其光学响应强度超过传统的磁偶极响应；两种金属中四极矩积累量级相近，表明存在一种不依赖自旋-轨道耦合的电荷-轨道转换新通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Ti和Pt表面观测到电流诱导的轨道四极矩积累，且其光学响应强度超过传统的磁偶极响应；两种金属中四极矩积累量级相近，表明存在一种不依赖自旋-轨道耦合的电荷-轨道转换新通道。；创新点：首次实验观测到电流诱导的轨道四极矩积累，将电流诱导现象从偶极（dipolar）扩展到多极（multipolar）范畴，并揭示了一种无需自旋-轨道耦合的电荷-轨道转换机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 偏振分辨Kerr显微术（polarization-resolved Kerr microscopy）；通过分离非对角光学电导率的对称与反对称分量，区分时间反演偶（quadrupolar）与时间反演奇（magnetic-dipolar）响应；结合第一性原理计算分析测量响应。

papers.title: Antidot superlattices in two-dimensional topological insulators
papers.abstract: We investigate the electronic properties of a two-dimensional topological insulator patterned with an array of circular holes. The band structures of the topological insulator superlattices are calculated using the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang model, discretized with the finite element method. The band topology is studied using the Fukui-Hatsugai-Suzuki method, exploiting the fact that topological charge is conserved when a band gap closes and reopens. We find that when the holes are close to each other and the edge states overlap significantly, the material loses its topological character and becomes a trivial insulator. The results show that patterning topological insulators changes their properties, and this can be achieved with a feature size compatible with current lithographic techniques. This shows the potential to incorporate patterned topological insulators in future electronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“calculated”“finite element method”“Fukui-Hatsugai-Suzuki method”等计算与数值方法关键词。；研究对象：二维拓扑绝缘体（基于Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang模型描述）中刻蚀周期性圆形孔洞阵列形成的“反点超晶格”（antidot superlattices）体系，研究其电子能带结构与拓扑性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当孔洞间距足够小、边缘态波函数显著重叠时，体系会失去拓扑特性，转变为平庸绝缘体；即图案化（打孔）可以调控甚至消除二维拓扑绝缘体的拓扑相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当孔洞间距足够小、边缘态波函数显著重叠时，体系会失去拓扑特性，转变为平庸绝缘体；即图案化（打孔）可以调控甚至消除二维拓扑绝缘体的拓扑相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于：将拓扑绝缘体图案化为反点超晶格，并证明在现有光刻技术可实现的特征尺寸下即可改变其拓扑性质，为未来将图案化拓扑绝缘体集成到电子器件中提供了可行性依据。
papers.method_zh: 采用Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang（BHZ）模型描述二维拓扑绝缘体，并用有限元方法（finite element method）对模型进行离散化以计算超晶格能带结构；利用Fukui-Hatsugai-Suzuki方法计算拓扑不变量（拓扑荷），通过带隙闭合与再打开过程中拓扑荷的守恒性来判定能带拓扑性质。

papers.title: Extreme mixing enables broadband high-temperature electromagnetic absorption in high-entropy perovskites
papers.abstract: Developing oxide absorbers with broadband high-temperature electromagnetic absorption performance has long been desirable in the electromagnetic absorption field, yet their absorption performance has remained unsatisfactory. Here, through an extreme mixing strategy, we successfully develop an ultrabroad effective absorption bandwidth (EAB) of 9.3 GHz in high-entropy perovskites up to 600 degree celsius, surpassing the previously reported oxide absorbers. Specifically, we achieve the extreme mixing in high-entropy perovskites by the successful incorporation of up to 13 cation elements, with 8 and 5 cations occupying the A- and B-sites, respectively, using a laser-driven controllable synthesis technique. Such extreme mixing maximally promotes the formation of atomic-scale interfaces to markedly amplify atomic-level interfacial polarization loss for the effective dissipation of electromagnetic wave energy, thereby giving rise to a remarkably broad EAB of 9.3 GHz in high-entropy perovskites up to 600 degree celsius. Owing to the profoundly increased electrical conductivity that causes impedance mismatch at elevated temperatures, however, their EAB deteriorates to 4.6 GHz at 700 degree celsius. This work establishes a new extreme mixing design paradigm for enabling high-entropy oxide absorbers with unprecedented high-temperature EM absorption performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了材料合成（“laser-driven controllable synthesis technique”）和性能测试（吸收带宽、温度依赖性等）。；研究对象：高熵钙钛矿氧化物（high-entropy perovskites），具体为A位和B位分别容纳8种和5种阳离子（共13种）的氧化物体系，研究其高温宽带电磁波吸收性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过“极端混合”策略，在高熵钙钛矿中实现了9.3 GHz的超宽有效吸收带宽（EAB），且该性能可保持至600°C，超越了此前报道的所有氧化物吸波材料；但在700°C时EAB退化至4.6 GHz，原因是电导率升高导致阻抗失配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过“极端混合”策略，在高熵钙钛矿中实现了9.3 GHz的超宽有效吸收带宽（EAB），且该性能可保持至600°C，超越了此前报道的所有氧化物吸波材料；但在700°C时EAB退化至4.6 GHz，原因是电导率升高导致阻抗失配。；创新点：首次提出“极端混合”设计范式，通过将多达13种阳离子（A位8种、B位5种）同时引入高熵钙钛矿，最大化原子级界面数量，从而显著增强原子级界面极化损耗，实现前所未有的高温宽带电磁波吸收性能。
papers.method_zh: 激光驱动的可控合成技术（laser-driven controllable synthesis technique），用于实现多达13种阳离子的极端混合；通过原子级界面极化损耗机制分析电磁波能量耗散；测量了不同温度下的有效吸收带宽（EAB）和电导率变化。

papers.title: A Topological Magnonic Black-White Hole Crystal
papers.abstract: The low-energy dynamics of antiferromagnetic spin waves map onto a massive Klein-Gordon scalar field, providing a solid-state platform for analogue-horizon physics. We show that an inhomogeneous spin current generates an effective magnon flow capable of forming black- and white-hole horizons. Horizon-pair cavities exhibit resonant transport and superradiant-like amplification mediated by magnon-antimagnon mixing. Our central result is that a periodic arrangement of submagnonic and supermagnonic regions forms a non-reciprocal magnonic crystal in which entering the supermagnonic regime makes negative-norm propagating channels available and enables the bulk gap to close and reopen. This drives a topological transition characterized by a change in the Zak phase and the emergence of a hybrid magnon-antimagnon edge state. These results establish a direct connection between analogue-horizon physics and topological magnonics, providing an electrically tunable route for controlling magnonic band topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中关键词为“map onto”“show that”“exhibit”“drives a topological transition”，均为理论推导与模型分析语言，未提及实验手段或数值计算方法。；研究对象：反铁磁自旋波（magnon）体系中的类比视界物理与拓扑能带结构，具体为通过非均匀自旋流构造的黑洞-白洞视界对及其周期性排列形成的“黑-白洞晶体”。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 周期性排列的亚磁振子（submagnonic）与超磁振子（supermagnonic）区域可形成非互易磁振子晶体，进入超磁振子区后负模传播通道开启，体带隙闭合再打开，驱动以Zak相位变化和混合磁振子-反磁振子边缘态出现为标志的拓扑相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：周期性排列的亚磁振子（submagnonic）与超磁振子（supermagnonic）区域可形成非互易磁振子晶体，进入超磁振子区后负模传播通道开启，体带隙闭合再打开，驱动以Zak相位变化和混合磁振子-反磁振子边缘态出现为标志的拓扑相变。；创新点：首次将类比视界物理与拓扑磁振子学直接联系起来，提出通过电学可调的非均匀自旋流实现对磁振子能带拓扑的调控，为拓扑磁振子能带工程提供了新的物理机制和调控途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为反铁磁自旋波的低能有效场论——有质量Klein-Gordon标量场映射；分析工具包括视界对腔体的共振输运、磁振子-反磁振子混合导致的超辐射类放大，以及体带拓扑不变量（Zak相位）计算。摘要未提及具体数值方法（如紧束缚模型、第一性原理计算等）。

papers.title: Mechanistic Phase-Field Modelling of Woven-Domain Formation in Ferroelectric Material
papers.abstract: A recent experimental study reports the spontaneous formation of a three-dimensional woven ferroelectric domain fabric in bulk KTN:Li during sufficiently slow cooling through the ferroelectric transition. The present work develops a nondimensional phase-field framework to examine a physically plausible route by which such a state can emerge. A large-area two-dimensional model first resolves the cooling-rate-dependent formation of a frustrated crossing precursor by combining first-order ferroelectric thermodynamics, electrostatic and elastic interactions, compositional modulation, and effective charge screening. Slow cooling produces a persistent population of charge-associated crossings, whereas the corresponding fast-cooling pathway does not. A three-dimensional extension then incorporates cubic gradient anisotropy, flexoelectric coupling, and strain-gradient regularization to examine whether the planar precursor can develop a genuine woven topology. Within the explored nondimensional parameter regime, slow cooling produces a directly resolved geometrical separation and exchange of depth ordering between the intersecting wall families, whereas the corresponding fast-cooling pathway does not. This distinction is reproduced across independent realisations and remains robust to timestep refinement and changes in computational domain size. The simulations suggest that slow cooling provides a kinetic window for topological selection and that global charge relaxation can coexist with strong local charge concentration at surviving crossings. The model is not calibrated to material-specific KTN:Li coefficients and does not reproduce the experimentally observed low-temperature disappearance of the woven state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“phase-field framework”“two-dimensional model”“three-dimensional extension”“simulations”等关键词，属于数值模拟研究。；研究对象：铁电材料KTN:Li（铌酸钾锂）中，在缓慢冷却通过铁电相变时自发形成的三维编织畴结构（woven ferroelectric domain fabric），以及其形成的动力学机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 慢速冷却为拓扑选择提供了动力学窗口，可使平面交叉前驱体发展为具有真实编织拓扑的三维畴结构，而快速冷却路径则不能；全局电荷弛豫可与局域强电荷聚集共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：慢速冷却为拓扑选择提供了动力学窗口，可使平面交叉前驱体发展为具有真实编织拓扑的三维畴结构，而快速冷却路径则不能；全局电荷弛豫可与局域强电荷聚集共存。；创新点：首次在相场框架中直接解析了铁电畴壁族之间深度排序的几何分离与交换，揭示了慢冷条件下编织畴拓扑形成的动力学机制；摘要未突出说明与实验对比的定量改进。
papers.method_zh: 非维度化相场模拟（phase-field modelling）。二维模型结合一级铁电热力学、静电与弹性相互作用、成分调制和有效电荷屏蔽，研究冷却速率依赖的受阻交叉前驱体形成；三维扩展引入立方梯度各向异性、挠曲电耦合和应变梯度正则化，考察编织拓扑的形成。

papers.title: Weak coupling theory of nickel-based 327 superconductors
papers.abstract: This review provides a comprehensive survey of weak-coupling theoretical approaches applied to understand the emergent superconductivity in the pressurized nickelate bilayer system $La_{3}Ni_{2}O_{7}$. Following the landmark discovery of its high-Tc superconductivity under pressure, this material has rapidly become a new paradigmatic platform in the field of unconventional superconductivity, joining cuprates and iron-based systems. We focus on three pivotal theoretical frameworks: the random phase approximation (RPA), the fluctuation-exchange approximation (FLEX), and the functional renormalization group (FRG). These methods are deployed to analyze the effective pairing interactions and emergent instabilities arising from the low-energy electronic structure, which is commonly modeled by a bilayer two-orbital Hubbard Hamiltonian incorporating the Ni $d_{x^2-y^2}$ and $d_{3z^2-r^2}$ orbitals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（综述）。判断依据：摘要明确说明是“对弱耦合理论方法的综合评述”，涉及RPA、FLEX、FRG等理论框架。；研究对象：加压镍基双层超导体La₃Ni₂O₇（327体系），具体研究其低压电子结构（由Ni dₓ²₋ᵧ²和d₃z²₋ᵣ²轨道构成的双层双轨道Hubbard模型）所导致的有效配对相互作用和涌现不稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了弱耦合理论方法（RPA、FLEX、FRG）在理解La₃Ni₂O₇压力诱导高温超导电性方面的应用，表明这些方法能够从低能电子结构中分析出有效的配对相互作用和超导不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该综述系统梳理了弱耦合理论方法（RPA、FLEX、FRG）在理解La₃Ni₂O₇压力诱导高温超导电性方面的应用，表明这些方法能够从低能电子结构中分析出有效的配对相互作用和超导不稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该综述将镍基327体系与铜氧化物和铁基超导体并列，作为非常规超导领域的新范式平台，系统整合了三种弱耦合理论方法在该材料上的应用。
papers.method_zh: 弱耦合理论框架，具体包括：随机相位近似（RPA）、涨落交换近似（FLEX）、泛函重整化群（FRG）。这些方法基于双层双轨道Hubbard模型（包含Ni dₓ²₋ᵧ²和d₃z²₋ᵣ²轨道）进行分析。

papers.title: A Novel Decoupling Method for Investigating Distinct Domain Evolution in Ferroelectric Film
papers.abstract: Conventional polarization characterization techniques provide only the averaged response of ferroelectric films, limiting the investigation of domain-dependent reliability mechanisms in HfO2-based ferroelectrics. In this work, a new domain decoupling method is proposed to separately analyze ferroelectric domains with distinct switching behaviors. A three-domain model consisting of upward non-switchable domains, downward non-switchable domains, and switchable domains (Pd) is first introduced to describe heterogeneous domain populations during electrical cycling. By combining complementary switching-current measurements, the responses of different domain populations can be selectively extracted and reconstructed. The proposed method enables quantitative tracking of individual domain populations during cycling. As a demonstration, the method is further applied to analyze the time-dependent evolution of domain populations after electrical cycling. This approach provides a new route for investigating imprint, fatigue, and other reliability-related phenomena in ferroelectric devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“conventional polarization characterization techniques”“complementary switching-current measurements”，属于实验表征与数据分析方法。；研究对象：HfO2基铁电薄膜中的铁电畴，具体研究不同开关行为的畴群体（向上不可翻转畴、向下不可翻转畴、可翻转畴）在电循环过程中的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种新的畴解耦方法，能够定量追踪铁电薄膜中不同畴群体在电循环及循环后的时间演化，从而为研究印记、疲劳等可靠性现象提供新途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种新的畴解耦方法，能够定量追踪铁电薄膜中不同畴群体在电循环及循环后的时间演化，从而为研究印记、疲劳等可靠性现象提供新途径。；创新点：首次提出将铁电薄膜中的畴群体解耦为三类并分别定量追踪的方法，突破了传统极化表征仅能提供平均响应的局限，为畴分辨的可靠性机制研究提供了新工具。
papers.method_zh: 提出三畴模型（向上不可翻转畴、向下不可翻转畴、可翻转畴Pd），结合互补的开关电流测量（switching-current measurements），对不同畴群体的响应进行选择性提取与重构。

papers.title: Role of d-electron density of states in the quantum size effect of Pt-Ni and Pt-Pd nanoparticles
papers.abstract: We investigated the quantum size effect (QSE) in bimetallic Pt$_{1-x}$Pd$_x$ and Pt$_{1-x}$Ni$_x$ nanoparticles, using $^{195}$Pt nuclear magnetic resonance measurements. The temperature and size dependencies of the anomaly in the nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate divided by temperature $1/T_1T$ in the Pt$_{1-x}$Pd$_x$ nanoparticles suggest similar electron states between Pt and Pd atoms and are well understood by the QSE. The temperature and composition variations of $1/T_1T$ and Knight shift reveal a systematic increase in the density of states and reduction of the characteristic energy scale $T^*$ with increasing Ni content, consistent with the Kubo gap $δ_{\mathrm{Kubo}}$. In contrast to Pt$_{1-x}$Cu$_x$ nanoparticles where the QSE is suppressed, the Pt$_{1-x}$Ni$_x$ nanoparticles exhibit clear signatures of quantum energy discretization. This discrepancy highlights the essential role of $d$-electrons in the manifestation of the QSE. Furthermore, analysis of the modified Korringa parameter $K(α)$ suggests enhanced ferromagnetic correlations with increasing Ni concentration, approaching a ferromagnetic quantum critical regime. These results provide experimental evidence that $d$-electron density of states plays a crucial role in the manifestation of the QSE in the nanoparticles formed by the metallic $d$-electron atoms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用¹⁹⁵Pt核磁共振测量（nuclear magnetic resonance measurements）。；研究对象：双金属Pt₁₋ₓPdₓ和Pt₁₋ₓNiₓ纳米颗粒中的量子尺寸效应（QSE），重点关注d电子态密度在QSE表现中的作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Pt₁₋ₓNiₓ纳米颗粒中随Ni含量增加，电子态密度系统增大、特征能量尺度T*减小，且呈现清晰的量子能级离散化特征；与Pt₁₋ₓCuₓ中QSE被抑制形成对比，表明d电子态密度对QSE的显现起关键作用。此外，修正Korringa参数K(α)分析显示随Ni浓度增加铁磁关联增强，接近铁磁量子临界区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Pt₁₋ₓNiₓ纳米颗粒中随Ni含量增加，电子态密度系统增大、特征能量尺度T*减小，且呈现清晰的量子能级离散化特征；与Pt₁₋ₓCuₓ中QSE被抑制形成对比，表明d电子态密度对QSE的显现起关键作用。此外，修正Korringa参数K(α)分析显示随Ni浓度增加铁磁关联增强，接近铁磁量子临界区域。；创新点：通过对比Pt-Pd、Pt-Ni与Pt-Cu双金属纳米颗粒的QSE行为差异，首次从实验上直接证明d电子态密度在金属d电子原子形成的纳米颗粒QSE显现中起决定性作用。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: ¹⁹⁵Pt核磁共振（NMR）测量，包括核自旋-晶格弛豫率除以温度（1/T₁T）的温度与尺寸依赖测量、Knight位移测量，以及修正Korringa参数K(α)分析。

papers.title: Parity-dependent coupling of molecular spin chains to a superconductor
papers.abstract: Topological order can fractionalize the quantum numbers of the underlying particles. A paradigmatic example is the spin-1/2 states at the edges of an antiferromagnetic integer-spin chain, protected by a topological Haldane gap in the bulk and mutually coupled in short chains. Owing to their topological protection, they are natural building blocks for hybrid spin-superconductor quantum systems. Whether fractionalization survives the coupling to a superconducting condensate, however, remains an open question. Here we grow molecular Haldane chains of antiferromagnetically coupled spin-1 triangulene units on a proximitized Au(111)/Nb(110) surface and resolve a parity-dependent coupling of their spin-1/2 edge states to the superconducting condensate by scanning tunnelling spectroscopy. Odd-length chains host Yu-Shiba-Rusinov bound states inside the superconducting gap, originating from the net S=1 ground state, whereas even-length chains form an S=0 ground state decoupled from the superconductor. A two-site superconductor model reveals that this alternation arises from the sign and strength of the inter-edge interaction, a mechanism independently validated by extra-gap spin excitations in tunnelling spectra. Collective many-body spin excitation modes are also detected decoupled from the superconductor by the much larger Haldane gap. The length-tunable coupling of the edge spins to the superconductor opens a route toward molecular spin qubits based on $π$-conjugated carbon architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“grow molecular Haldane chains”（分子生长）、“scanning tunnelling spectroscopy”（扫描隧道谱）等实验手段，并结合了理论模型（“two-site superconductor model”）进行解释，属于实验与理论结合的类型。；研究对象：生长在近邻化 Au(111)/Nb(110) 表面上的分子 Haldane 链，由反铁磁耦合的自旋-1 triangulene 单元构成。研究聚焦于该分子链的分数化自旋-1/2 边缘态与超导凝聚体的耦合行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 奇偶长度依赖的耦合行为：奇数长度的 Haldane 链因净自旋 S=1 基态，在超导能隙内产生 Yu-Shiba-Rusinov 束缚态；偶数长度的链形成 S=0 基态，与超导体退耦合。这种交替行为源于边缘间相互作用的符号与强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：奇偶长度依赖的耦合行为：奇数长度的 Haldane 链因净自旋 S=1 基态，在超导能隙内产生 Yu-Shiba-Rusinov 束缚态；偶数长度的链形成 S=0 基态，与超导体退耦合。这种交替行为源于边缘间相互作用的符号与强度。；创新点：首次在分子 Haldane 链体系中实验验证了分数化边缘自旋与超导凝聚体耦合的奇偶依赖效应，并展示了通过链长调控边缘自旋与超导耦合的可行性，为基于 π 共轭碳结构的分子自旋量子比特提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用分子束外延（或类似表面生长方法）在近邻化 Au(111)/Nb(110) 表面生长分子链，并用扫描隧道谱（STS）探测超导能隙内的束缚态及能隙外的自旋激发。理论上使用两格点超导体模型（two-site superconductor model）解释奇偶效应，并通过额外能隙外自旋激发谱独立验证。

papers.title: Chiral Phonons and Giant Anisotropic Photoresponse in Quasi-1D van der Waals Semiconductor ZrSnS3
papers.abstract: Low-dimensional van der Waals semiconductors with reduced symmetry provide a unique platform for exploring anisotropic physical properties. The quasi-one-dimensional family MXQ$_3$ (M = Hf, Zr; X = Sn; Q = S, Se) exhibits notable structural anisotropy, where zigzag atomic chains influence optical phenomena such as birefringence. This study investigates anisotropic lattice dynamics in ZrSnS$_3$ using angle- and polarization-dependent Raman spectroscopy. Temperature-dependent measurements reveal anharmonic phonon behavior, indicating strong phonon-phonon coupling. Density functional theory calculations show good agreement with the experimentally observed Raman spectra, validating the microscopic description of the lattice dynamics. We also observe a helicity-dependent intensity and a reversal in phonon intensity between lower- and higher-frequency modes under circularly polarized light, which is characteristic of chiral phonons governed by the polarization of the Zr/Sn chains. Our first-principles analysis further shows that angular-momentum-like phonon textures can emerge away from the $Γ$-point near mode-hybridization and avoided-crossing regions, providing microscopic insight into the observed helicity-dependent Raman signatures. Furthermore, we fabricate an optoelectronic device from a thin ZrSnS$_3$ nanowire, demonstrating a photoresponsivity of 50~mA/W under 520~nm laser excitation (1~mW/cm$^2$). The device exhibits a pronounced, power-scalable anisotropic photoresponse with a clear preferred polarization direction. These results highlight the coupling mechanisms between polarization, lattice vibrations, and charge carriers in ZrSnS$_3$, establishing it as a promising material for polarization-sensitive optoelectronics and directional quantum transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“angle- and polarization-dependent Raman spectroscopy”“temperature-dependent measurements”等实验手段，以及“density functional theory calculations”“first-principles analysis”等计算方法。；研究对象：准一维范德华半导体 ZrSnS₃（属于 MXQ₃ 家族，M=Hf, Zr；X=Sn；Q=S, Se），具体研究其手性声子、各向异性晶格动力学以及基于纳米线的光电器件的光响应特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 ZrSnS₃ 中观测到由 Zr/Sn 链极化决定的手性声子行为（圆偏振光下声子强度随螺旋度反转），并制备了薄纳米线光电器件，实现了 50 mA/W 的光响应度（520 nm，1 mW/cm²）以及显著且功率可调的偏振敏感各向异性光响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 ZrSnS₃ 中观测到由 Zr/Sn 链极化决定的手性声子行为（圆偏振光下声子强度随螺旋度反转），并制备了薄纳米线光电器件，实现了 50 mA/W 的光响应度（520 nm，1 mW/cm²）以及显著且功率可调的偏振敏感各向异性光响应。；创新点：首次在 ZrSnS₃ 中结合实验拉曼光谱与第一性原理计算，揭示了远离 Γ 点处由模式杂化/避免交叉产生的手性声子纹理，并将其与圆偏振光下的螺旋度依赖拉曼信号直接关联；同时展示了该材料在偏振敏感光电子学中的器件级应用潜力。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用角度和偏振依赖的拉曼光谱、变温拉曼光谱（用于研究非谐声子行为），并制备 ZrSnS₃ 纳米线光电器件进行光电响应测量；理论上采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算拉曼光谱，并通过第一性原理分析声子角动量纹理（angular-momentum-like phonon textures）在 Γ 点附近模式杂化和避免交叉区域的出现。

papers.title: Collective self-sorting on a chip
papers.abstract: We harness two established ingredients for collective demixing: differential speed and curvature to create a self-sorting device. In binary mixtures, motility differences drive spontaneous spatial segregation, while confinement geometry determines how rapidly and strongly this demixing develops. Using particle based simulations, we systematically identify the geometrical conditions that promote efficient segregation and use these results to guide the design of a finite sorting architecture. We then translate these physical mechanisms into a sequence of curved microfluidic units that progressively amplify the separation of the two species and direct them toward distinct collection regions. Experiments with binary Quincke-roller mixtures confirm that an initially mixed suspension progressively demixes as it propagates through the device, leading to strong enrichment downstream. Our results demonstrate how collective active demixing can be converted into a functional continuous sorting strategy, providing a route toward autonomous microfluidic separation based on particle motility and confinement geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算模拟+实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“particle based simulations”（基于粒子的模拟）和“Experiments with binary Quincke-roller mixtures”（二元Quincke转子混合物的实验）。；研究对象：活性二元混合物的集体去混（demixing）现象，具体为利用差异速度和曲率几何实现微流控芯片上的自分类（self-sorting）器件，实验体系为Quincke转子二元混合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合差异速度和限制几何曲率，二元活性混合物在微流控器件中传播时能自发渐进去混，实现下游的强富集，从而将集体活性去混转化为连续分类策略。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合差异速度和限制几何曲率，二元活性混合物在微流控器件中传播时能自发渐进去混，实现下游的强富集，从而将集体活性去混转化为连续分类策略。；创新点：将集体活性去混（由运动性差异驱动）与限制几何（曲率）相结合，设计出有限尺寸的分选架构，并转化为可连续运行的微流控分选器件，实现基于粒子运动性和几何约束的自主微流控分离。摘要未突出说明与已有微流控分选方法（如惯性分选、确定性侧向位移等）的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 粒子基模拟（particle-based simulations）系统扫描几何条件以确定高效分离的参数区间；实验上采用二元Quincke-roller混合物（电驱动活性粒子体系）在弯曲微流控单元序列中验证分离效果。

papers.title: High-throughput identification of ferromagnetic Kagome candidates in the AT6X4 and AT6X5 families
papers.abstract: We present a systematic high-throughput density-functional theory study of the thermodynamic stability, collinear magnetic ground states, and electronic structures of layered kagome compounds in the AT6X4 and AT6X5 families. Using the experimentally reported structure types as templates, we screened 78 substitutional compositions in each family. Our calculations reproduce the stability and antiferromagnetic character of the known Fe-based Ge compounds and identify six additional stable candidates with robust ferromagnetism. Within collinear spin configurations, we find a clear chemistry-dependent trend: stable Fe-based Ge compounds predominantly adopt AFM2 ground states, whereas stable Mn-based Ge compounds consistently favor ferromagnetic order. Exchange analysis further shows that the magnetic phase space is governed by competing interlayer interactions, consistent with the mechanism established for AT6X6 kagome magnets. Representative ferromagnetic members from the two structural families also retain kagome-derived dispersive band features near K, although the AT6X5 phase exhibits stronger band folding and hybridization. Overall, these results establish AT6X4 and AT6X5 as promising layered kagome families for realizing ferromagnetism and kagome-derived electronic states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“high-throughput density-functional theory study”（高通量密度泛函理论研究）。；研究对象：层状kagome化合物，具体为AT6X4和AT6X5两个家族，共78种替代组分，重点关注其热力学稳定性、共线磁基态和电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在AT6X4和AT6X5家族中识别出6种具有稳健铁磁性的新稳定候选材料；稳定Fe基Ge化合物以AFM2反铁磁基态为主，而稳定Mn基Ge化合物一致倾向于铁磁序，且磁相空间由层间相互作用的竞争主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在AT6X4和AT6X5家族中识别出6种具有稳健铁磁性的新稳定候选材料；稳定Fe基Ge化合物以AFM2反铁磁基态为主，而稳定Mn基Ge化合物一致倾向于铁磁序，且磁相空间由层间相互作用的竞争主导。；创新点：首次系统性地对AT6X4和AT6X5两个kagome家族进行高通量筛选，建立了化学组分（Fe vs Mn）与磁基态（反铁磁 vs 铁磁）之间的明确关联，并将层间相互作用竞争机制从已知的AT6X6家族推广到这两个新家族。
papers.method_zh: 高通量密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，包括热力学稳定性评估、共线自旋构型下的磁基态搜索、交换相互作用分析，以及电子能带结构计算。

papers.title: Structural disorder and critical voltage scaling in Al/AlOx/Al Josephson junction arrays
papers.abstract: The insulating state of one-dimensional Josephson junction (JJ) arrays is governed by collective charge dynamics and disorder-induced pinning, resulting in a finite critical voltage under dc bias. Here, we investigate the influence of fabrication-induced structural defects on the critical-voltage scaling of small-capacitance Aluminium-Aluminium oxide-Aluminium (Al/AlOx/Al) JJ arrays. Controlled variation of the aluminium evaporation rate produces pronounced changes in grain morphology and room-temperature junction resistance. Despite these substantial structural modifications, the normalised critical-voltage scaling is preserved, demonstrating that the collective transport behaviour is remarkably robust against this class of fabrication-induced defects. In contrast, the deliberate introduction of nanoscale gaps into the junctions introduces additional junction-to-junction structural variations that systematically modify the normalised scaling behaviour. Likewise, in situ postfabrication oxidation alters the scaling coefficient while preserving the functional form of the scaling law, indicating that the collective transport is sensitive to specific classes of structural modifications. These results establish which fabrication-induced structural defects influence the collective transport in insulating Al/AlOx/Al Josephson junction arrays, providing new insight into the role of fabrication-induced structural disorder and practical guidance for the design of future Quantum Phase Slip (QPS) devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Controlled variation of the aluminium evaporation rate”“in situ postfabrication oxidation”等实验制备与表征手段。；研究对象：一维铝/氧化铝/铝（Al/AlOx/Al）约瑟夫森结阵列，具体关注其绝缘态中的集体电荷动力学、无序诱导钉扎以及临界电压标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 制备过程中铝蒸发速率变化引起的结构缺陷（如晶粒形貌和结电阻改变）不会改变归一化临界电压标度行为，说明集体输运对此类缺陷具有鲁棒性；但人为引入的纳米级间隙和原位后氧化会系统性地改变标度系数，表明集体输运对特定类型的结构修饰敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：制备过程中铝蒸发速率变化引起的结构缺陷（如晶粒形貌和结电阻改变）不会改变归一化临界电压标度行为，说明集体输运对此类缺陷具有鲁棒性；但人为引入的纳米级间隙和原位后氧化会系统性地改变标度系数，表明集体输运对特定类型的结构修饰敏感。；创新点：系统区分了不同类别制备诱导结构缺陷对约瑟夫森结阵列集体输运的影响，明确了哪些缺陷会改变临界电压标度行为，为量子相位滑移（QPS）器件的设计提供了制备层面的指导。
papers.method_zh: 通过控制铝蒸发速率改变晶粒形貌和室温结电阻；在结中人为引入纳米级间隙；进行原位后氧化处理；测量直流偏置下的临界电压并分析归一化标度行为。

papers.title: Shapes, forces, and torques of compressed elastic fluid interfaces: beyond axisymmetric configurations
papers.abstract: Inspired by the classical Plateau-Douglas problem for soap films bounded by two closed curves, we solve an analogous problem for fluid interfaces with fixed surface area and resistance to out-of-plane bending. The boundaries are planar but need not be symmetric or concentric. The equilibrium surfaces minimize the Willmore bending energy and generalize minimal surfaces such as the catenoid while also exhibiting characteristic features of confined elastic interfaces such as buckling. We systematically classify all possible buckling modes and solution branches by performing a weakly nonlinear analysis and developing a fully nonlinear spectral solver. Our mathematical framework provides insight into the forces and torques required to stabilize cellular membranes and other soft materials and shows that physically relevant asymmetric states can arise even in symmetric systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“weakly nonlinear analysis”（弱非线性分析）和“fully nonlinear spectral solver”（全非线性谱求解器），属于理论建模与数值求解。；研究对象：具有固定表面积和抗面外弯曲能力的流体界面（如细胞膜等软材料界面），在平面但非对称、非同心边界约束下的平衡形状、受力与力矩问题，是经典Plateau–Douglas问题的推广。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在对称边界条件下，系统也能出现物理上相关的非对称平衡态；所有可能的屈曲模式和解分支被系统分类，揭示了受限弹性界面（如细胞膜）的屈曲特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在对称边界条件下，系统也能出现物理上相关的非对称平衡态；所有可能的屈曲模式和解分支被系统分类，揭示了受限弹性界面（如细胞膜）的屈曲特征。；创新点：将经典肥皂膜Plateau–Douglas问题推广到具有弯曲刚度、固定面积且边界非对称/非同心的一般情形，并系统分类了所有屈曲模式与解分支，同时给出了稳定化细胞膜所需的力与力矩的定量框架。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用Willmore弯曲能量极小化框架，结合弱非线性分析（用于分类屈曲模式）和全非线性谱求解器（用于求解完整平衡解分支）。

papers.title: Signatures of localization on the edge of a fractional topological insulator
papers.abstract: Recent experiments in van der Waals moiré materials have reported realizations of two-dimensional fractional topological insulators (FTIs). We study transport properties of FTI edges at filling factors $ν_{\text{FTI}} = 2(1\pm 1/n)$ with integer $n \geq 2$ (even or odd), each of which supports four counter-propagating edge modes. The edge modes can undergo partial localization, leaving two of the four edge modes conducting. We identify three distinct partial-localization channels and, for each channel, determine the reduced theory describing the remaining conducting modes, from which we obtain the minimal quasiparticle charge. We further explore transport properties of each partially localized phase and in particular determine the corresponding edge conductances. We demonstrate that measurements of the conductance together with the minimal quasiparticle charge provide a fingerprint that uniquely distinguishes the three partially localized phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study transport properties”“We identify”“we determine”“We demonstrate”等理论推导与预言性表述，未提及实验数据或数值模拟。；研究对象：范德华莫尔材料中二维分数量子拓扑绝缘体（FTI）的边缘态，具体为填充因子 ν_FTI = 2(1 ± 1/n)（n ≥ 2 整数）的 FTI 边缘，该边缘支持四条反向传播的边缘模，并研究其部分局域化现象及输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FTI 边缘的四条边缘模可发生部分局域化，仅剩两条模导电；存在三种不同的部分局域化通道，每种通道对应不同的约化理论、最小准粒子电荷和边缘电导。测量边缘电导与最小准粒子电荷可唯一区分这三种部分局域化相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FTI 边缘的四条边缘模可发生部分局域化，仅剩两条模导电；存在三种不同的部分局域化通道，每种通道对应不同的约化理论、最小准粒子电荷和边缘电导。测量边缘电导与最小准粒子电荷可唯一区分这三种部分局域化相。；创新点：首次系统分类了 FTI 边缘（ν_FTI = 2(1 ± 1/n)）的部分局域化通道，并建立了“边缘电导 + 最小准粒子电荷”联合测量作为区分不同部分局域化相的指纹判据。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于边缘模的局域化通道分类，推导约化边缘理论（描述剩余导电模的低能有效理论），并计算最小准粒子电荷与边缘电导。摘要未提及具体数值方法（如 DMRG、蒙特卡洛等）。

papers.title: Anomalous dynamical energy flows via nonlinear phononics in spin-Peierls chains
papers.abstract: We investigate the nonequilibrium spin-phonon dynamics and energy cascades in a strongly dimerized spin-Peierls chain using a multi-tiered nonlinear phononics architecture. To bypass linear selection rules prohibiting the direct excitation of the Raman-active dimerization mode, a terahertz laser drives an infrared mode that nonlinearly couples to the Raman lattice displacement, subsequently modulating the magnetic exchange. Employing a bond-operator formalism with a second-order cumulant expansion of the Lindblad master equation, we show that maximum energy transfer into the magnetic sector is governed by a dynamical impedance-matching condition rather than the unperturbed triplon density of states. We find that the sustained energy input of continuous-wave driving builds high excitation densities that severely back-act on the lattice, overdamping the primary phonon and smearing magnetic features via power broadening. Conversely, the small time-integrated energy of a pulse keeps the response perturbative, terminating before back-action accumulates and preserving sharp Fano-like quantum interferences. These insights establish limits for controlling dynamic magnetic states without quenching the driving lattice modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：bond-operator formalism、second-order cumulant expansion、Lindblad master equation、nonlinear phononics architecture。；研究对象：强二聚化的自旋-Peierls链（spin-Peierls chain）中的非平衡自旋-声子动力学与能量级联过程，具体涉及太赫兹激光驱动的红外声子模式与拉曼活性二聚化模式之间的非线性耦合，以及该耦合对磁交换作用的调制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最大能量向磁子（triplon）扇区的转移由动力学阻抗匹配条件决定，而非未扰动的triplon态密度；连续波驱动会因高激发密度对晶格产生强烈反作用，导致主声子过阻尼和磁特征功率展宽，而脉冲驱动则保持微扰响应并保留尖锐的Fano-like量子干涉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最大能量向磁子（triplon）扇区的转移由动力学阻抗匹配条件决定，而非未扰动的triplon态密度；连续波驱动会因高激发密度对晶格产生强烈反作用，导致主声子过阻尼和磁特征功率展宽，而脉冲驱动则保持微扰响应并保留尖锐的Fano-like量子干涉。；创新点：揭示了在自旋-Peierls体系中，通过非线性声子学绕过线性选择规则实现磁激发控制的动力学阻抗匹配机制，并阐明了连续波与脉冲驱动下晶格反作用对磁态调控的截然不同影响——这为在不淬灭驱动晶格模式的前提下控制动态磁态设定了边界条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用多层非线性声子学架构（multi-tiered nonlinear phononics architecture），结合键算符形式（bond-operator formalism）与Lindblad主方程的二阶累积展开（second-order cumulant expansion），对非平衡自旋-声子动力学进行理论求解。

papers.title: Estimating the Fisher information from ARPES in general two-band models
papers.abstract: The Quantum Fisher information is frequently studied in the fields of quantum sensing and quantum metrology, as it specifies the sensitivity of a sensor through the Crámer-Rao bound, and in condensed matter physics where it relates to the quantum metric. Measuring the quantum Fisher information is therefore of significant current interest. In this work, we propose a scheme for measuring the quantum Fisher information with respect to any parameter in a general two-band solid state system using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy with carefully tuned incidence angles and light polarization. We investigate conditions under which this can be related back to information about the ground state of the material itself changing with system parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/方法提案文章。判断依据：摘要提出“scheme for measuring”（测量方案），属于理论框架设计，而非直接实验或计算。；研究对象：一般二能带（two-band）固体系统，具体材料未指定。物理现象为量子Fisher信息（Quantum Fisher information）的测量，及其与量子度规（quantum metric）和基态性质变化的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种利用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES），通过精细调节入射角和光偏振来测量一般二能带系统中任意参数的量子Fisher信息的方案，并探讨了该测量结果与材料基态随系统参数变化之间可建立联系的条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种利用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES），通过精细调节入射角和光偏振来测量一般二能带系统中任意参数的量子Fisher信息的方案，并探讨了该测量结果与材料基态随系统参数变化之间可建立联系的条件。；创新点：首次提出在一般二能带固体系统中，用ARPES直接测量量子Fisher信息的通用方案，并明确了该测量可反推基态信息的适用条件。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论方案设计，基于ARPES（角分辨光电子能谱）的测量框架，涉及对入射角和光偏振的调控。摘要未提及具体数值计算或模拟方法。

papers.title: Time reversal of complex evolution on a quantum computer
papers.abstract: The Boltzmann-Loschmidt dispute in 1876-1877 discussed the problem of time reversal of ther- malization from time reversible classical equations of motion. Here, 150 years later, we highlight this problem in the frame of quantum computing. A quantum protocol is proposed that allows to perform a time reversal of complex evolution in the regime of many-body quantum chaos with many qubits. The system represents an evolution of qubits on a square lattice with inter-qubit next-nearest static couplings with a driven pulsed magnetic field. The system entropy grows rapidly to maximal values but returns to initial small values after time reversal. This time reversal is shown to be stable with respect to quantum gate imperfections. However, similar to the Lorenz butterfly effect, there is the butterfly effect of qubit when inversion of only one qubit breaks time reversibility of the whole system. It is argued that this protocol is accessible to nowadays quantum computers and annealers with hundreds of qubits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提出量子协议（quantum protocol），讨论量子计算模拟，未提及实验数据或材料制备。；研究对象：多体量子混沌体系中的时间反演问题，具体为方形晶格上具有次近邻静态耦合、受驱动脉冲磁场作用的多量子比特系统（qubits on a square lattice with inter-qubit next-nearest static couplings with a driven pulsed magnetic field）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该量子协议可在多体量子混沌（多量子比特）体系中实现复杂演化的时间反演：系统熵快速增长至最大值，但时间反演后能回到初始小值；该时间反演对量子门缺陷具有稳定性，但单个量子比特的反转会破坏整个系统的时间可逆性（量子蝴蝶效应）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该量子协议可在多体量子混沌（多量子比特）体系中实现复杂演化的时间反演：系统熵快速增长至最大值，但时间反演后能回到初始小值；该时间反演对量子门缺陷具有稳定性，但单个量子比特的反转会破坏整个系统的时间可逆性（量子蝴蝶效应）。；创新点：将150年前玻尔兹曼-洛施密特争议（经典可逆运动方程下热化时间反演问题）引入量子计算框架，提出可在当前含数百量子比特的量子计算机和量子退火机上实现的协议，并揭示量子版本的时间反演蝴蝶效应。摘要未突出说明与已有量子时间反演方案的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论提出量子计算协议，基于量子门操作实现时间反演；通过系统熵的演化来表征热化与时间反演行为；分析量子门缺陷（imperfections）和单比特翻转对时间反演稳定性的影响。摘要未提及具体数值方法（如张量网络、精确对角化等）。

papers.title: Strain-driven spin-flop transition and collapse of the giant magnon gap in the bilayer iridate Sr$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$
papers.abstract: The bilayer iridate Sr$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ is a $c$-axis collinear antiferromagnet, held there by a giant interlayer pseudodipolar anisotropy, whereas single-layer Sr$_2$IrO$_4$ cants in the $ab$ plane. We show from first principles that biaxial compression of a few percent ($\varepsilon_c\approx-2.4\%$) flops the easy axis of Sr$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ into the plane. A magnetic model Hamiltonian built from Wannier functions with no fitted parameter---reproducing the giant magnon gap of the bulk, so far known only from fits to experiment---identifies the mechanism. Compression collapses the interlayer exchange channel, whose straight Ir--O--Ir path weakens as the bent in-plane path strengthens. Hund's exchange sets the scale of the anisotropy and, beyond $J/U\approx0.15$, removes the collinear state altogether. The flop is not a rigid rotation---the ordered moments of the two states cross at $\varepsilon_c$---and it carries a stark fingerprint, in that the giant easy-axis magnon gap collapses to a gapless, Goldstone-like spectrum. Compressively strained films thus sit on a metamagnetic phase boundary ending in a zero-temperature bicritical point, a charge-neutral handle on the moment direction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“from first principles”（第一性原理计算）、“magnetic model Hamiltonian built from Wannier functions”（基于Wannier函数的磁性模型哈密顿量），且无实验测量手段描述。；研究对象：双层钙钛矿铱氧化物Sr₃Ir₂O₇，具体研究其在外加双轴压缩应变下的磁各向异性转变（自旋翻转）及巨磁振子能隙的塌缩行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 约2.4%的双轴压缩应变可使Sr₃Ir₂O₇的易轴从c轴翻转到ab平面内，同时伴随巨磁振子能隙闭合为无能隙的Goldstone型谱。该翻转并非刚性旋转，而是两个磁态的序参量在临界应变处交叉，体系处于一个终止于零温双临界点的变磁相边界上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：约2.4%的双轴压缩应变可使Sr₃Ir₂O₇的易轴从c轴翻转到ab平面内，同时伴随巨磁振子能隙闭合为无能隙的Goldstone型谱。该翻转并非刚性旋转，而是两个磁态的序参量在临界应变处交叉，体系处于一个终止于零温双临界点的变磁相边界上。；创新点：首次从第一性原理出发（无需拟合参数）定量再现Sr₃Ir₂O₇的巨磁振子能隙，并揭示应变通过削弱层间Ir–O–Ir直线交换通道、增强面内弯曲通道来驱动自旋翻转的微观机制；同时指出Hund耦合（J/U≈0.15）是各向异性标度的关键，超过该阈值共线磁序完全消失。摘要未突出说明与其他理论工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT）结合基于Wannier函数构建的无拟合参数磁性模型哈密顿量。该模型成功复现了块体材料中此前仅能通过实验拟合得到的巨磁振子能隙，用于识别应变驱动的机制。

papers.title: A test drive for exchange-correlation functionals on noncollinear magnets: Mn$_3$Ir, Mn$_3$Ge, NiS$_2$, and YMnO$_3$
papers.abstract: A first-principles description of noncollinear magnets is challenging, and the practical behavior of genuinely noncollinear exchange-correlation approximations is largely untested. Spin-current density-functional theory (SCDFT) admits noncollinear approximations constrained by local U(1)$\times$SU(2) gauge invariance, an exact condition unavailable in the more restrictive framework of spin-DFT (SDFT). Using the Vienna ab initio simulation package (VASP), we compare two recently developed noncollinear SCDFT functionals, NCMSCAN and LFNCBR89-NCCS, against locally collinear SDFT extensions of four common functionals (PZ, PW92, PBE, and SCAN) for several noncollinear $d$-electron systems. The key finding is that among all tested functionals, only the SCDFT functionals recover the spin texture of the experimental ground state of NiS$_2$, and they do so at a cost comparable to standard semi-local approximations. Yet the two SCDFT functionals differ in equilibrium volumes, band gaps, and on-site magnetic moments. Overall, this survey illustrates the usefulness of SCDFT in capturing noncollinear physics with the tested approximations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“first-principles description”“Vienna ab initio simulation package (VASP)”“functionals”等第一性原理计算关键词。；研究对象：非共线磁性材料体系，具体包括 Mn₃Ir、Mn₃Ge、NiS₂ 和 YMnO₃ 四种 d 电子体系，以及非共线磁序的自旋织构描述问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在所有测试的泛函中，只有基于自旋流密度泛函理论（SCDFT）的两个非共线泛函（NCMSCAN 和 LFNCBR89-NCCS）能够恢复 NiS₂ 实验基态的自旋织构，且计算成本与标准半局域近似相当；但这两个 SCDFT 泛函在平衡体积、带隙和局域磁矩上存在差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在所有测试的泛函中，只有基于自旋流密度泛函理论（SCDFT）的两个非共线泛函（NCMSCAN 和 LFNCBR89-NCCS）能够恢复 NiS₂ 实验基态的自旋织构，且计算成本与标准半局域近似相当；但这两个 SCDFT 泛函在平衡体积、带隙和局域磁矩上存在差异。；创新点：系统性地测试了真正非共线的交换关联泛函（SCDFT 泛函）在多种非共线磁性 d 电子体系中的表现，揭示了 SCDFT 相比传统 SDFT 局域共线近似在捕捉非共线自旋织构方面的优势，填补了非共线交换关联近似实际行为缺乏系统测试的空白。
papers.method_zh: 采用 VASP 软件包进行第一性原理计算，对比了两类泛函：(1) 两个新发展的非共线 SCDFT 泛函 NCMSCAN 和 LFNCBR89-NCCS；(2) 四种常见泛函（PZ、PW92、PBE、SCAN）的局域共线 SDFT 扩展。SCDFT 框架受局域 U(1)×SU(2) 规范不变性约束，而 SDFT 不具备这一精确条件。

papers.title: Flexo-Strain Engineering of Phonons and Ferrons in Thin Films of Van der Waals Ferrielectrics
papers.abstract: The influence of the flexoelectric coupling on the fluctuations of electric polarization and elastic strains can lead to the principal changes of the dispersion law of soft optical and acoustic phonons and ferrons in a bulk van der Waals ferrielectrics. Since the size, gradient and strain effects determine phase diagrams and polarization behavior in thin films, it is reasonable to assume that the flexocoupling and mismatch strains should have a strong influence on the dispersion of phonons and ferrons in thin films of van der Waals ferroelectrics. Using the Landau-Ginzburg-Devonshire approach, in this work we reveal that the dispersion of soft phonons and ferrons is strongly dependent on the sign and magnitude of elastic strains, which originate from the lattice constants mismatch in thin strained films of van der Waals ferrielectric CuInP2S6. In particular, the frequency of acoustic phonons and ferrons tends to zero at nonzero wavevectors k>k_cr, where the critical value of the wavevector k_cr is determined by the mismatch strain, flexoelectric coupling strength and temperature. Zeroing of the acoustic phonon frequency, that appears with increase of tensile strains, indicates a possible emergence of a spatially modulated incommensurate polar phase induced by the flexo-strain effects. Analytical results, derived in this work, open the way for flexo-strain engineering of soft phonon and ferron dispersion in thin films of van der Waals ferrielectrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Landau-Ginzburg-Devonshire approach”进行解析推导，并强调“Analytical results”。；研究对象：范德瓦尔斯铁电薄膜（具体为CuInP2S6）中软光学声子、声学声子与ferron（铁电畴壁涨落量子）的色散关系，以及挠曲电耦合与失配应变对其的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在应变薄膜CuInP2S6中，软声子与ferron的色散强烈依赖于由晶格失配产生的弹性应变的符号与大小；在非零波矢k>k_cr处，声学声子与ferron频率可趋于零，表明拉伸应变下可能出现由挠曲-应变效应诱导的空间调制非公度极性相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在应变薄膜CuInP2S6中，软声子与ferron的色散强烈依赖于由晶格失配产生的弹性应变的符号与大小；在非零波矢k>k_cr处，声学声子与ferron频率可趋于零，表明拉伸应变下可能出现由挠曲-应变效应诱导的空间调制非公度极性相。；创新点：首次揭示挠曲电耦合与失配应变联合调控范德瓦尔斯铁电薄膜中软声子与ferron色散的机制，提出“挠曲-应变工程”（flexo-strain engineering）概念，并预言了由挠曲应变效应诱导的非公度极性相的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 采用Landau-Ginzburg-Devonshire（LGD）唯象理论框架，解析计算挠曲电耦合对极化涨落和弹性应变涨落的影响，并分析薄膜中失配应变、挠曲电耦合强度及温度对声子与ferron色散的作用。

papers.title: Diagnosing and narrowing the simulation-to-real gap in powder X-ray diffraction with a wet-dry agentic loop
papers.abstract: Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) is the routine probe of crystalline matter, yet its analysis is the rate-limiting step as laboratories automate acquisition. Deep-learning analyzers excel on simulated patterns and degrade on measured ones. This simulation-to-real gap is structural, not additive: synthetic denoising gives no measurable lift on real spectra, whereas correcting a small peak-position drift more than doubles median retrieval correlation. Real-spectrum fine-tuning, peak-aligned reranking, and recalibration narrow what remains and restore the coverage synthetic anchors lose. Xtalyst integrates these in an agent-orchestrated system spanning phase identification, refinement, and calibrated property prediction. On a frozen held-out partition (n=534) each module measured on both splits reproduces its development finding -- including the synthetic-anchor under-coverage, whose magnitude differs between the two pools -- while held-out refinement converges and preserves symmetry without reaching profile-quality fits, and on a diffractometer its wet-dry recommend-rescan-reanalyze loop flips a blinded silicon standard to a gated PASS and changes which minor phase is resolved on a multi-metal alloy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算/算法）。判断依据：摘要涉及深度学习模型、模拟数据与真实数据的对比（计算/算法），同时包含在衍射仪上的实际测试（实验验证）。；研究对象：粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）数据的自动化分析，具体涉及晶体物相鉴定、精修及性质预测。材料体系包括硅标准样品和多金属合金。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PXRD分析中的“模拟-真实差距”是结构性的而非加性的：简单的合成数据去噪对真实谱图无提升，而修正小范围的峰位漂移可使中位检索相关性翻倍以上。真实谱图微调、峰对齐重排序和重新校准可进一步缩小差距，并恢复合成锚点丢失的覆盖度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PXRD分析中的“模拟-真实差距”是结构性的而非加性的：简单的合成数据去噪对真实谱图无提升，而修正小范围的峰位漂移可使中位检索相关性翻倍以上。真实谱图微调、峰对齐重排序和重新校准可进一步缩小差距，并恢复合成锚点丢失的覆盖度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明单一算法创新，但整体创新在于：将模拟-真实差距的诊断（区分结构性vs加性）与多模块智能体系统（Xtalyst）结合，并引入闭环“湿-干”实验流程来主动缩小差距，而非仅被动后处理。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个名为“Xtalyst”的智能体编排系统，整合了物相鉴定、精修和校准性质预测模块。具体手段包括：深度学习分析器（在模拟谱上训练）、真实谱图微调、峰位对齐重排序、重新校准，以及“湿-干”循环（推荐-重扫-再分析）的闭环实验策略。

papers.title: Dataset Complexity Shapes Finite-Distance Loss Geometry in Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Finite datasets can share the same size and low-order statistics while differing strongly in structural complexity. We connect this dataset complexity to loss-landscape geometry by pairing local label mixing across neighborhood scales with local entropy around trained neural-network solutions. Adapted from the Franz--Parisi construction in spin-glass theory, local entropy measures the effective volume of low-loss, solution-like parameter configurations at each distance from a reference. We estimate it in finite networks using adaptive sequential Monte Carlo. In a controlled synthetic sweep, greater dataset complexity produces a larger decrease in local entropy near the reference. Farther away, its radial derivative becomes weak and nearly common across conditions. Dataset complexity therefore changes where the effective solution volume contracts, rather than making it decrease uniformly faster. Experiments on real image data show the same qualitative trend, with label randomization further amplifying the effect. These results show that dataset structure shapes how low-loss neighborhoods are organized across finite distances from trained solutions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要涉及理论框架（Franz–Parisi构造、自旋玻璃理论）、计算方法（自适应序贯蒙特卡洛）以及合成数据与真实图像数据的实验验证。；研究对象：神经网络损失函数景观（loss landscape）的几何结构，具体研究有限数据集的结构复杂度如何影响训练后解附近的低损失区域组织方式。属于机器学习与统计物理交叉领域，非传统凝聚态材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 数据集复杂度越高，训练后解附近的局部熵下降越显著；但在远离参考解处，局部熵的径向导数变弱且在不同复杂度条件下趋于一致。即数据集复杂度改变的是有效解体积收缩的位置，而非使其整体均匀加速收缩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：数据集复杂度越高，训练后解附近的局部熵下降越显著；但在远离参考解处，局部熵的径向导数变弱且在不同复杂度条件下趋于一致。即数据集复杂度改变的是有效解体积收缩的位置，而非使其整体均匀加速收缩。；创新点：将数据集的结构复杂度（而非仅大小或低阶统计量）与损失景观的有限距离几何直接联系起来，揭示了复杂度对解体积收缩空间分布的差异化影响，而非简单的全局加速。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用自旋玻璃理论中的Franz–Parisi构造定义局部熵，用以度量距参考解不同距离处低损失参数构型的有效体积；使用自适应序贯蒙特卡洛（adaptive sequential Monte Carlo）在有限神经网络中估计该量；通过控制合成数据集的复杂度进行系统扫描，并在真实图像数据上验证，同时引入标签随机化增强效应。

papers.title: Collective dynamics of chemo-mechanical colloidal chains with active tips
papers.abstract: We report a study of the emergent dynamics arising in two-dimensional suspensions of semi-flexible chains whose tip is chemically active, generating a phoretic field. By varying the chain length (number of monomers per chain $N_{pc}$), the area fraction $φ$, and the sign of the phoretic coupling $J_0$, we map out a rich non-equilibrium phase diagram in the presence of phoretic interactions. For repulsive phoretic interactions ($J_0 > 0$) between the chains, we find that short chains ($N_{pc} = 2$) develop a transient chaotic flow state that crosses over at long times to a global polar flock with super-diffusive mean-squared displacement and long-ranged velocity correlations. Surprisingly, we find this state to have suppressed density fluctuations, indicating the emergence of hyperuniformity. At intermediate chain lengths ($N_{pc} \sim 4$-$8$), the repulsive chemical field drives chaotic mesoscale flows -- a dry route to active turbulence -- without the need for hydrodynamic interactions or steric alignment interactions. For attractive phoretic interactions ($J_0 < 0$), chains self-organise into hedgehog-like micellar aggregates with heads forming the core and flexible tails radiating outward, in structural analogy with amphiphile micellisation but driven entirely by non-equilibrium self-propulsion. A coarse-grained theory of a tip-emitting active rod predicts the onset of the flocking of dimers, though overestimates the presence of polar order for longer chains. Our results establish phoretic tip activity as a minimal, experimentally realisable mechanism for a spectrum of collective states hitherto attributed to hydrodynamic interactions or steric alignment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“coarse-grained theory”（粗粒化理论）、“phase diagram”（相图）以及数值模拟特征（如链长、面积分数参数扫描），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维悬浮体系中的半柔性胶体链，其末端具有化学活性，可产生趋化（phoretic）场。研究聚焦于链长（N_pc）、面积分数（φ）和趋化耦合符号（J_0）对集体动力学的影响，涉及活性湍流、极性絮凝（flocking）和胶束状自组装等非平衡现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于排斥性趋化相互作用（J_0>0），短链（N_pc=2）从瞬态混沌流演化为全局极性絮凝态，该态具有超扩散位移、长程速度关联和抑制的密度涨落（超均匀性）；中等长度链（N_pc~4-8）则产生无流体动力学相互作用或立体取向对齐的“干性”活性湍流。对于吸引性趋化相互作用（J_0<0），链自组织成刺猬状胶束聚集体，头部成核、柔性尾向外辐射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于排斥性趋化相互作用（J_0>0），短链（N_pc=2）从瞬态混沌流演化为全局极性絮凝态，该态具有超扩散位移、长程速度关联和抑制的密度涨落（超均匀性）；中等长度链（N_pc~4-8）则产生无流体动力学相互作用或立体取向对齐的“干性”活性湍流。对于吸引性趋化相互作用（J_0<0），链自组织成刺猬状胶束聚集体，头部成核、柔性尾向外辐射。；创新点：确立化学活性尖端（phoretic tip activity）作为一种最小化、实验上可实现的机制，能够产生此前被认为需要流体动力学相互作用或立体取向对齐才能实现的多种集体态（如活性湍流、极性絮凝、超均匀性、胶束状自组装）。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系或定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（具体算法摘要未明确说明，如布朗动力学或分子动力学类型未提及）结合粗粒化理论模型——尖端发射活性杆（tip-emitting active rod）理论，用于预测二聚体絮凝的起始条件。通过系统扫描链长N_pc、面积分数φ和趋化耦合符号J_0绘制非平衡相图。

papers.title: Machine-learning-guided molecular dynamics simulations of point defect evolution in beta-Ga2O3 during ion implantation and annealing
papers.abstract: In beta-gallium oxide (beta-Ga2O3), Ga-ion implantation and annealing induce abundant point defects. To overcome conventional Wigner-Seitz (WS) defect analysis limitations, a defect identification algorithm based on similarity matching and DBSCAN clustering is developed for beta-Ga2O3. It distinguishes lattice atoms from defects at high concentrations and identifies eight Ga interstitial configurations (Gaia to Gaih). Comparing SRIM and MD data highlights electronic stopping effects: neglecting them overestimates ion range and defect concentration. Across five fluences (1 to 5 x 10^14 cm-2), 1373 K is the optimal recovery temperature. Multiscale analyses using hydrostatic stress, PRDF, and defect concentration reveal defect evolution. Ga interstitials (Gai) occupy tetrahedral and octahedral sites, driving a defect-mediated phase transition from beta- to gamma-Ga2O3. Increasing fluences reduce beta-phase recovery and increase gamma-phase transformation irreversibly. Oxygen interstitial (Oi) migration is sensitive to annealing temperature, which enhances O-sublattice recrystallization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“machine-learning-guided molecular dynamics simulations”（机器学习引导的分子动力学模拟），并涉及SRIM与MD数据对比，属于计算模拟研究。；研究对象：β-Ga₂O₃（β相氧化镓）在Ga离子注入及退火过程中产生的点缺陷及其演化行为，包括Ga间隙原子、O间隙原子以及β→γ相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 1373 K是五种注量下最佳的缺陷恢复温度；Ga间隙原子占据四面体和八面体位置，驱动β→γ-Ga₂O₃的缺陷介导相变，且注量增加会使γ相变不可逆并降低β相恢复能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：1373 K是五种注量下最佳的缺陷恢复温度；Ga间隙原子占据四面体和八面体位置，驱动β→γ-Ga₂O₃的缺陷介导相变，且注量增加会使γ相变不可逆并降低β相恢复能力。；创新点：针对β-Ga₂O₃开发了适用于高缺陷浓度下区分晶格原子与缺陷的聚类识别算法，并首次系统揭示了Ga间隙原子构型（Gai_a至Gai_h共八种）与β→γ相变之间的关联；同时量化了电子阻止效应对离子射程和缺陷浓度的影响。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习辅助的分子动力学（MD）模拟；开发了基于相似性匹配和DBSCAN聚类的缺陷识别算法（替代传统Wigner-Seitz分析）；结合SRIM（stopping and range of ions in matter）模拟对比电子阻止效应；采用多尺度分析手段：静水应力、偏径向分布函数（PRDF）、缺陷浓度分析。

papers.title: Engineering exact mobility edges in quasiperiodic Aharonov-Bohm chains
papers.abstract: We investigate localization phenomena and exact mobility edges in a quasiperiodic Aharonov-Bohm chain, where the 1D canonical diagonal and off-diagonal Aubry-André-Harper models are laterally coupled to an auxiliary sublattice threaded by a synthetic magnetic flux. By analytically computing the Lyapunov exponent via Avila's global theory of one-frequency Schrödinger operators, we derive exact expressions for mobility edges. In the diagonal limit, the coupling to the auxiliary sublattice generates hyperbolic mobility edges that exhibit a sign-changing divergence and can be continuously tuned by the magnetic flux. In the off-diagonal regime, the interference between quasiperiodic hopping and indirect tunneling through the auxiliary sublattice gives rise to exact anomalous mobility edges that separate critical and extended states. Critical states and anomalous mobility edges emerge even in the absence of incommensurately distributed zeros in the hopping modulation, a behavior distinct from that of conventional off-diagonal models. Our results establish a rigorous theoretical framework for engineering controllable mobility edges, with the synthetic flux providing a tunable experimental knob that paves the way for realizations in platforms such as superconducting quantum circuits and photonic waveguides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically computing the Lyapunov exponent via Avila's global theory”，属于解析理论推导，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：准周期Aharonov-Bohm链，即一维对角和非对角Aubry-André-Harper模型与一个辅助子晶格横向耦合，并穿过合成磁通。研究其中的局域化现象和精确迁移率边。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准周期Aharonov-Bohm链中，通过解析计算Lyapunov指数，推导出迁移率边的精确表达式：对角极限下产生可由磁通连续调谐的双曲型迁移率边；非对角情形下出现分隔临界态与扩展态的异常迁移率边，且临界态可在跳跃调制不含非公度零点时出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准周期Aharonov-Bohm链中，通过解析计算Lyapunov指数，推导出迁移率边的精确表达式：对角极限下产生可由磁通连续调谐的双曲型迁移率边；非对角情形下出现分隔临界态与扩展态的异常迁移率边，且临界态可在跳跃调制不含非公度零点时出现。；创新点：首次在准周期Aharonov-Bohm链中实现精确可解的迁移率边，并证明合成磁通可作为连续调控迁移率边的实验旋钮；此外，非对角情形下临界态的出现不依赖于传统非对角模型中所需的非公度零点分布，这一行为与常规非对角模型显著不同。
papers.method_zh: 采用Avila的一维频率Schrödinger算子全局理论，解析计算Lyapunov指数，从而精确推导迁移率边的表达式。未使用数值模拟或实验手段。

papers.title: Anomalous metallic states at magnetic interfaces in an antiferromagnetic topological insulator candidate DyPtBi with ferroquadrupolar order
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnetic topological insulators provide a fertile platform where symmetry-breaking magnetic order is intertwined with topological electronic states. In particular, magnetic domain walls have attracted much attention, as they can be easily controlled by external fields as in general magnets, and moreover, host nontrivial electronic states distinct from those in bulks and sample surfaces. Here, we report a new antiferromagnetic topological insulator candidate DyPtBi, which hosts conductive magnetic domain walls controllable by uniaxial stress and magnetic field. We find that the resistivity exhibits abrupt increase upon the magnetic and structural phase transition. Concomitantly, the transverse ultrasonic mode shows remarkable softening of 6 %, indicating that the Dy 4f ferroquadrupolar order plays a vital role in the phase transition. Furthermore, we reveal by neutron experiments that applying compressive uniaxial stress aligns the magnetic domain state, leading to the strong resistivity enhancement of 14 % while eliminating the conductive magnetic domain walls. These findings demonstrate that DyPtBi exhibits topological electronic states entangled with multipolar degrees of freedom, providing a promising route for in situ control of topological properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：resistivity（电阻率测量）、neutron experiments（中子实验）、ultrasonic mode（超声模式）。；研究对象：反铁磁拓扑绝缘体候选材料 DyPtBi，特别是其磁性界面（磁畴壁）中的反常金属态，以及 Dy 4f 电子铁四极（ferroquadrupolar）序与拓扑电子态的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DyPtBi 中存在可通过单轴应力和磁场调控的导电磁畴壁；在磁与结构相变处电阻率突增，伴随横向超声模式 6% 的显著软化，表明 Dy 4f 铁四极序在相变中起关键作用。施加压缩单轴应力可消除导电磁畴壁并使电阻率增强 14%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DyPtBi 中存在可通过单轴应力和磁场调控的导电磁畴壁；在磁与结构相变处电阻率突增，伴随横向超声模式 6% 的显著软化，表明 Dy 4f 铁四极序在相变中起关键作用。施加压缩单轴应力可消除导电磁畴壁并使电阻率增强 14%。；创新点：首次在具有多极（铁四极）序的反铁磁拓扑绝缘体候选材料中实现磁畴壁导电性的原位调控，揭示了拓扑电子态与多极自由度的纠缠，为拓扑性质的原位操控提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 电阻率输运测量（电阻突增与 14% 增强）、横向超声模式弹性常数测量（6% 软化）、中子散射/衍射实验（用于磁畴状态表征）、单轴应力与磁场调控实验。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Study of Charge-Carrier Mobility in Double Lateral-Gate Silicon Junctionless Transistors
papers.abstract: We give in depth overview of charge-carrier mobility in p-type silicon double lateral-gate junctionless transistors (DLGJLT) through a mix of computer simulations and experimental results. The devices were built on low-doped silicon-on-insulator substrates using atomic force microscope nanolithography. Because the design uses air-gap side gates instead of a gate-oxide layer or junction, it allows electrical current to flow through a lightly doped silicon channel. This setup reduces impurity scattering and protects transport quality from interface damage. We used three-dimensional TCAD Sentaurus simulation tool to model the device's electrical behavior and confirm our experimental data for transconductance and drain conductance. We attempt to give a comprehensive view on the charge transition within the device.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要中同时提到“computer simulations and experimental results”，以及“three-dimensional TCAD Sentaurus simulation tool”和“confirm our experimental data”。；研究对象：p型硅双横向栅极无结晶体管（DLGJLT）中的电荷载流子迁移率，具体涉及低掺杂绝缘体上硅（SOI）衬底上通过原子力显微镜纳米光刻制备的器件，以及空气间隙侧栅设计下的轻掺杂硅沟道输运特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过空气间隙侧栅替代传统栅氧化层和结，有效降低了杂质散射并保护了输运质量，从而在轻掺杂硅沟道中实现了良好的电荷载流子迁移率；实验测得的跨导和漏导数据与三维TCAD模拟结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过空气间隙侧栅替代传统栅氧化层和结，有效降低了杂质散射并保护了输运质量，从而在轻掺杂硅沟道中实现了良好的电荷载流子迁移率；实验测得的跨导和漏导数据与三维TCAD模拟结果一致。；创新点：采用无栅氧化层、无结的空气间隙侧栅设计，在轻掺杂硅沟道中实现输运，从而减少杂质散射并避免界面损伤对输运质量的影响。摘要未突出说明与传统器件性能的定量对比或具体迁移率数值。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用原子力显微镜纳米光刻技术在低掺杂SOI衬底上制备器件；计算上使用三维TCAD Sentaurus模拟工具对器件电学行为进行建模，并与实验测得的跨导和漏导数据进行对比验证。

papers.title: Coordinate transformations and matter waves cloaking
papers.abstract: Transformation method provides an efficient tool to control wave propagation inside the materials. Using the coordinate transformation approach, we study invisibility cloaks with sphere, cylinder and ellipsoid structures for electronic waves propagation. The underlying physics behind this investigation is the fact that the Schrödinger equation with position-dependent mass tensor and potentials has a covariant form that follows the coordinate transformation. Using this technique we obtain the exact spatial form of the mass tensor and potentials for a variety of cloaks with different shapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Transformation method”“coordinate transformation approach”等理论工具，并讨论方程的协变形式，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：电子波（物质波）在隐身 cloak（隐身衣）结构中的传播，具体研究了球形、圆柱形和椭球形三种几何形状的隐身 cloak 体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过坐标变换方法，可以精确构造出适用于电子波传播的隐身 cloak 所需的空间依赖质量张量和势能分布，从而实现电子波在 cloak 结构中的隐身效果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过坐标变换方法，可以精确构造出适用于电子波传播的隐身 cloak 所需的空间依赖质量张量和势能分布，从而实现电子波在 cloak 结构中的隐身效果。；创新点：将原本常用于电磁波和声波的坐标变换隐身方法推广到电子波（物质波）领域，并给出了球形、圆柱形和椭球形 cloak 的精确解析形式。摘要未突出说明与已有电子波隐身工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 坐标变换方法（transformation method）。具体而言，利用具有位置依赖质量张量和势能的薛定谔方程在坐标变换下的协变形式，推导出不同形状 cloak 的质量张量和势能的空间分布表达式。

papers.title: Oxygen stoichiometry directs rutile-anatase phase selection through kinetic control of nucleation
papers.abstract: Synthesis of a target polymorph remains more empirical than predictive because crystallization often selects the most accessible nucleation pathway rather than the thermodynamically most stable phase. Here, we show that oxygen stoichiometry converts this empirical synthesis variable into a kinetic control parameter for anatase-rutile selection in TiO$_{2-x}$. Enhanced-sampling simulations reveal that oxygen content alters the nucleation-barrier landscape, switching the relative accessibility of anatase and rutile, even while rutile remains thermodynamically favored. Molecular dynamics simulations show the presence of a diffuse intermediate shell around the nucleus, where oxygen deficiency alters Ti-O coordination and connectivity and drives shell-local motif evolution from anatase-like toward rutile-like environments. A coupled-flux model that integrates barrier competition with shell-mediated attachment/exchange yields a relative nucleation-rate map consistent with reported oxygen-dependent synthesis trends. These results establish stoichiometry-controlled intermediate-shell motif evolution as a kinetic origin of polymorph selection and provide a framework for predicting target phases in composition-coupled crystallization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“enhanced-sampling simulations”“molecular dynamics simulations”“coupled-flux model”，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：TiO₂₋ₓ（氧非化学计量二氧化钛）中锐钛矿（anatase）与金红石（rutile）两种多晶型的选择问题，具体关注氧空位/氧含量如何通过动力学途径控制成核相选择。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧化学计量比通过改变成核势垒景观和核周围扩散中间壳层的局域结构演化，在热力学上金红石仍更稳定的前提下，动力学上可切换锐钛矿与金红石的相对可及性，从而成为多晶型选择的动力学控制参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氧化学计量比通过改变成核势垒景观和核周围扩散中间壳层的局域结构演化，在热力学上金红石仍更稳定的前提下，动力学上可切换锐钛矿与金红石的相对可及性，从而成为多晶型选择的动力学控制参数。；创新点：将氧化学计量比从经验合成变量提升为动力学控制参数，提出“化学计量比控制的中间壳层基序演化”作为多晶型选择的动力学起源，并建立可预测组成-结晶耦合体系中目标相的定量框架。摘要未突出说明与具体实验方法的对比或超越之处。
papers.method_zh: 增强采样模拟（enhanced-sampling simulations）用于计算成核势垒；分子动力学（MD）模拟用于分析核周围中间壳层的Ti-O配位与连通性；耦合通量模型（coupled-flux model）整合势垒竞争与壳层介导的附着/交换过程，计算相对成核速率图。

papers.title: Unified Bonding Entropy Model for Kekulé Graphene Nanoflakes
papers.abstract: The open-shell character of Kekulé graphene nanoflakes (GNFs) is conventionally rationalized by the gain of Clar aromatic $π$-sextets upon electron unpairing. While this rule successfully explains many quinoidal diradicaloids, it treats only the maximum number of sextets and neglects the multiplicity and spatial distribution of resonance configurations that realize the same Clar count. Here, we identify a second route to open-shell stabilization in which the maximum Clar-sextet number remains unchanged while the number of accessible Clar resonators increases substantially. We term this mechanism \emph{Clar-number-invariant resonance-space expansion}. By enumerating closed-shell and open-shell Clar resonators and combining this analysis with a bonding entropy model (BEM), we show that electron unpairing can release closed-shell pairing constraints, enlarge the resonance manifold, and redistribute C--C bond occupancies away from localized single- and double-bond limits. The BEM-predicted number and spatial distribution of unpaired electrons correlate strongly with density-functional-theory diradical character, local magnetic moments, optimized C--C bond lengths, and relative energies across a broad set of GNFs. The resulting framework offers a graph-based and physically transparent route for screening open-shell carbon nanostructures and for designing tunable molecular spins without requiring an increase in the maximum Clar number.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“bonding entropy model (BEM)”、“density-functional-theory”等理论模型与计算方法。；研究对象：Kekulé石墨烯纳米片（Kekulé graphene nanoflakes, GNFs），具体关注其开壳层（open-shell）电子结构、未配对电子的数目与空间分布，以及C–C键的键序重排。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种新的开壳层稳定化机制——**Clar数不变共振空间扩展**（Clar-number-invariant resonance-space expansion）：在不增加最大Clar六元环数目的前提下，通过电子解配对释放闭壳层配对约束，显著增加可访问的Clar共振结构数目，从而稳定开壳层态。BEM预测的未配对电子数目与空间分布与DFT计算的自由基特征、局域磁矩、键长及相对能量高度相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种新的开壳层稳定化机制——**Clar数不变共振空间扩展**（Clar-number-invariant resonance-space expansion）：在不增加最大Clar六元环数目的前提下，通过电子解配对释放闭壳层配对约束，显著增加可访问的Clar共振结构数目，从而稳定开壳层态。BEM预测的未配对电子数目与空间分布与DFT计算的自由基特征、局域磁矩、键长及相对能量高度相关。；创新点：突破了传统仅以最大Clar六元环数目解释开壳层稳定性的局限，首次提出并系统论证了“Clar数不变但共振空间扩展”这一新机制，为筛选开壳层碳纳米结构及设计可调分子自旋提供了基于图论、物理透明的筛选框架，无需依赖提高最大Clar数。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与第一性原理计算结合：构建闭壳层与开壳层Clar共振结构的图论枚举，提出键合熵模型（BEM）量化共振空间大小；用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算验证BEM预测（包括双自由基特征、局域磁矩、优化C–C键长和相对能量）。

papers.title: Even-harmonic generation from topological edge states in generalized Su-Schrieffer-Heeger models
papers.abstract: High-order harmonic generation (HHG) in solids has emerged as a powerful probe of symmetry and topological properties in quantum materials. In this work, we investigate the HHG response in one-dimensional solids with edge or midgap states under global and local illumination. We numerically compute the HHG spectrum for the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model with next-nearest-opposite sublattice hopping, dubbed the extended SSH (ESSH) model, and the Rice-Mele model, a one-dimensional system with broken inversion symmetry introduced via staggered on-site potentials. By contrasting the spectral features of the ESSH and Rice-Mele models under global illumination, our analysis reveals that although midgap states provide additional pathways for transitions, the resulting interference is destructive, leading to spectral features distinct from those of edge states. Furthermore, when a single boundary of the topological insulator is locally illuminated, the HHG spectrum of the edge states exhibits vanishing odd harmonics, leaving even harmonics dominant in the spectrum. We identify this even-harmonic selection rule as a consequence of the zero-energy character of the edge states and the particle-hole symmetry of the system, which enforces even field parity of the zero-mode response. These findings reveal that the spatial location of the laser illumination offers a route to control the symmetry of the system, thereby selectively suppressing or enhancing even- and odd-order harmonics in low-dimensional nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“numerically compute the HHG spectrum”（数值计算高次谐波谱），属于数值模拟与理论分析结合的研究。；研究对象：一维广义Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型（含次近邻-相反子格跳跃的扩展SSH模型，即ESSH模型）以及Rice-Mele模型（通过交错在位势破缺反演对称性的一维系统），研究其边缘态或带隙中间态在全局和局域光照下的高次谐波产生（HHG）响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在局域光照下，拓扑绝缘体单个边界处的边缘态HHG谱中奇次谐波消失，偶次谐波占主导；该偶次谐波选择定则源于边缘态的零能特性与系统的粒子-空穴对称性。此外，全局光照下带隙中间态提供的跃迁路径产生相消干涉，其谱特征与边缘态明显不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在局域光照下，拓扑绝缘体单个边界处的边缘态HHG谱中奇次谐波消失，偶次谐波占主导；该偶次谐波选择定则源于边缘态的零能特性与系统的粒子-空穴对称性。此外，全局光照下带隙中间态提供的跃迁路径产生相消干涉，其谱特征与边缘态明显不同。；创新点：揭示了激光照射的空间位置（全局vs局域）可作为调控体系对称性的手段，从而选择性地抑制或增强低维纳米结构中的偶次和奇次谐波；首次将偶次谐波选择定则与边缘态的零能本质及粒子-空穴对称性直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 数值计算HHG谱。具体针对ESSH模型和Rice-Mele模型，分别模拟全局光照（整个体系被照射）和局域光照（仅照射单个边界）两种情形，通过对比两种模型的谱特征进行分析。

papers.title: Voltage dynamics of spherical membranes from single ion channel currents
papers.abstract: Ion channels and pumps drive ion-selective currents through cell membranes at localized sites, yet a cell's electrical state is routinely summarized by a single transmembrane voltage. Combining theory and numerical simulations, we resolve the spatiotemporal dynamics of charge reorganization driven by a localized current on a spherical membrane vesicle. At early times, the response is insensitive to membrane geometry: as in the case of a flat membrane (arXiv:2407.11947; arXiv:2508.14001), the transmembrane voltage decays in a monopolar fashion, varying inversely with distance from the source, and crosses over to a dipolar tail that scales as the inverse cube of distance. Under sustained current, this monopolar response spreads outward from the source. Because the vesicle is closed, this response cannot persist indefinitely; once the monopolar front traverses the entire vesicle, the subsequent charging dynamics is dominated by a spatially uniform mode corresponding to capacitive charging of the membrane. We further decompose the bulk potentials into an electrostatic image-charge component that generates the bulk electric fields and a spatially uniform capacitive mode that can be represented as an equivalent circuit. We also derive a nonlocal cable equation governing the transmembrane voltage dynamics and show that the uniform mode is its long-time solution. This work provides a first-principles basis for the electrophysiological simplification of an electrotonically compact cell.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Combining theory and numerical simulations”。；研究对象：球形膜囊泡上由局域离子通道电流驱动的跨膜电压时空动力学，即电荷在闭合球形膜上的重组与电势分布演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域电流在球形膜上产生的跨膜电压响应早期与平面膜一致（单极衰减、随距离反比，后过渡到偶极尾巴、随距离立方反比）；由于囊泡闭合，单极前沿扫过整个囊泡后，充电动力学由空间均匀的电容充电模式主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域电流在球形膜上产生的跨膜电压响应早期与平面膜一致（单极衰减、随距离反比，后过渡到偶极尾巴、随距离立方反比）；由于囊泡闭合，单极前沿扫过整个囊泡后，充电动力学由空间均匀的电容充电模式主导。；创新点：首次从第一性原理出发，解析了局域离子电流在闭合球形膜上从早期几何无关的单极响应到后期空间均匀电容模式的完整时空演化，并建立了非局域电缆方程与等效电路表示，为“电致紧致细胞”的电生理学简化提供了微观基础。摘要未突出说明与平面膜工作（arXiv:2407.11947; arXiv:2508.14001）相比的具体增量。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析推导（包括静电镜像电荷分解、非局域电缆方程）结合数值模拟。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如有限元或边界元），但明确提及了理论框架与模拟的结合。

papers.title: Insight into the molecular dynamics of barocaloric molecular crystals using quasi-elastic neutron scattering
papers.abstract: Barocaloric (BC) molecular crystals exhibit order-disorder phase transitions that o9er a promising basis for solid-state heating and cooling. However, rational design of these next-generation materials requires microscopic understanding of the molecular dynamics that drive the transitional entropy change. Quasi-elastic neutron scattering (QENS) techniques including inelastic fixed-window scans (IFWSs) enable the direct probing of such molecular motions throughout thermodynamic phase transitions. Here we present a QENS-IFWS global fitting methodology for systematically investigating the molecular dynamics underpinning BC performance in molecular crystals. We demonstrate this methodology on neopentyl glycol (NPG) and three derivatives spanning chemically distinct routes to dynamical perturbation. By fixing attempt frequencies across samples, we observe measurable differences in the relative activation energies and mobile fractions of hydroxymethyl and full-molecular rotations. The largest observed e9ect is on the hydroxymethyl rotation activation energies, which is closely related to hydrogen bond network stability, ranging from -3.6% to +11.1% in the derivatives compared to pure NPG. The capability of this global fitting strategy to extract subtle variations in molecular rotations highlights QENS as a versatile design tool for guiding BC molecular crystal design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“quasi-elastic neutron scattering (QENS)”和“inelastic fixed-window scans (IFWSs)”等实验技术，并描述了对样品的测量与拟合分析。；研究对象：压热（barocaloric）分子晶体，具体包括新戊二醇（neopentyl glycol, NPG）及其三种衍生物，研究其有序-无序相变过程中的分子动力学，特别是羟甲基和全分子旋转运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过QENS-IFWS全局拟合方法，发现不同衍生物中羟甲基旋转活化能和可动分数相对于纯NPG有可测量的差异（活化能变化范围从-3.6%到+11.1%），且该变化与氢键网络稳定性密切相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过QENS-IFWS全局拟合方法，发现不同衍生物中羟甲基旋转活化能和可动分数相对于纯NPG有可测量的差异（活化能变化范围从-3.6%到+11.1%），且该变化与氢键网络稳定性密切相关。；创新点：提出了一种系统的QENS-IFWS全局拟合方法论，能够提取分子旋转中细微的动力学差异，将QENS定位为指导压热分子晶体设计的通用工具。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 准弹性中子散射（QENS）结合非弹性固定窗口扫描（IFWS），并采用全局拟合（global fitting）方法，固定尝试频率（attempt frequencies）以比较不同样品的相对活化能和可动分数。

papers.title: Loop currents in Haldane's model and in time-reversal-breaking superconductors
papers.abstract: We present a theoretical study of optical manifestations of loop currents in Haldane's model and in time-reversal-breaking superconductors. For Haldane's model, we calculate the expectation value of loop currents in terms of model parameters and relate it with the integrated optical spectral weight for the frequency-dependent ac Hall conductivity. Thus, experimental measurements of the latter can provide information about the presence and magnitude of steady loop currents in the system. Then we elaborate on loop currents in a chiral superconductor on the honeycomb lattice, studied earlier by Brydon et al. (2019). We demonstrate that a sharp optical absorption peak in the ac Hall conductivity originates from excitations between the lower and upper Dirac bands, activated by the time-reversal-breaking superconductivity. The frequency of the peak is twice the energy difference between the Fermi level and the Dirac point. The optical spectral weight of the peak is directly related to the magnitude of loop currents induced in the unit cells by the chiral superconducting pairing, in similarity to Haldane's model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：theoretical study、calculate、demonstrate。；研究对象：Haldane模型中的环电流（loop currents），以及蜂窝晶格上时间反演对称性破缺的手性超导体中的环电流及其光学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Haldane模型中，稳态环电流的大小与交流霍尔电导率的积分光学谱权重直接相关；在手性超导体中，交流霍尔电导率出现一个尖锐的光学吸收峰，该峰源于时间反演对称性破缺超导所激活的下、上Dirac带之间的激发，其谱权重与超导配对在元胞内诱导的环电流大小成正比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Haldane模型中，稳态环电流的大小与交流霍尔电导率的积分光学谱权重直接相关；在手性超导体中，交流霍尔电导率出现一个尖锐的光学吸收峰，该峰源于时间反演对称性破缺超导所激活的下、上Dirac带之间的激发，其谱权重与超导配对在元胞内诱导的环电流大小成正比。；创新点：将环电流的存在与大小直接关联到可实验测量的交流霍尔电导率光学谱权重上，为探测稳态环电流提供了光学手段；并首次将这一联系推广到手性超导体中的超导诱导环电流。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析计算：基于模型参数计算环电流期望值，并将其与频率依赖的交流霍尔电导率的积分谱权重建立联系；对蜂窝晶格手性超导体（Brydon等人2019年研究的模型）分析其交流霍尔电导率的光学吸收峰来源。

papers.title: Cross-Temperature Defect Identification in Atomistic Simulations via Multi-Level Domain Alignment
papers.abstract: Identifying atomic defects at elevated temperature is difficult because thermal fluctuations blur the local symmetry that both geometric heuristics and supervised classifiers rely on: trustworthy labels exist in low-temperature reference configurations, while the high-temperature regime where robust analysis matters most is effectively unlabeled. We cast this as a cross-temperature domain-shift problem and align the two domains at three levels: an equivariant denoiser at the input level, cross-temperature contrastive learning at the representation level, and a morphology-aware regularizer that steers predictions toward the compact geometry of physical defect structures. Because no atom-wise truth exists at temperature, we further introduce a label-free evaluation suite that scores predicted defect structures along five spatial and physics-based axes, enabling model assessment and selection without high-temperature labels. Near the melting point, the framework identifies vacancies and self-interstitial atoms across face-centered-cubic, body-centered-cubic, and hexagonal-close-packed iron systems with every interstitial localized and zero false detections in every vacancy system against Wigner-Seitz ground truth, with no high-temperature labels used in training. It sustains this fidelity on a million-atom, 2.5 ns trajectory, resolving single vacancy hops and complete Frenkel-pair recombination, and captures grain-boundary phase transformations in aluminum bicrystals, distinguishing two nucleation modes. Multi-level domain alignment thus offers a practical, label-efficient route to temperature-robust structural analysis of large-scale molecular dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于原子模拟（atomistic simulations）、分子动力学（molecular dynamics）轨迹分析，以及机器学习模型（equivariant denoiser、contrastive learning）的开发与验证。；研究对象：高温下金属材料中的原子缺陷，具体包括面心立方（FCC）、体心立方（BCC）、六方密堆积（HCP）铁体系中的空位（vacancies）和自间隙原子（self-interstitial atoms），以及铝双晶（aluminum bicrystals）中的晶界相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过多层级域对齐（输入级去噪、表示级对比学习、形态学正则化），该框架在接近熔点的温度下无需任何高温标签即可准确识别缺陷：所有间隙原子均被定位，所有空位体系对Wigner-Seitz真值的假阳性检测为零；并在百万原子、2.5 ns轨迹中保持该精度，可分辨单空位跳跃和完整Frenkel对复合，还能捕捉铝双晶中两种成核模式的晶界相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过多层级域对齐（输入级去噪、表示级对比学习、形态学正则化），该框架在接近熔点的温度下无需任何高温标签即可准确识别缺陷：所有间隙原子均被定位，所有空位体系对Wigner-Seitz真值的假阳性检测为零；并在百万原子、2.5 ns轨迹中保持该精度，可分辨单空位跳跃和完整Frenkel对复合，还能捕捉铝双晶中两种成核模式的晶界相变。；创新点：将高温缺陷识别形式化为跨温度域偏移问题，并首次实现无需任何高温原子级标签的训练；同时引入无标签评估套件，解决了高温下缺乏原子级真值导致的模型选择难题。摘要未突出说明与其他机器学习势或描述符方法的直接性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 多层级域对齐框架，包含三个对齐层级：①输入层：等变去噪器（equivariant denoiser）；②表示层：跨温度对比学习（cross-temperature contrastive learning）；③输出层：形态学感知正则化（morphology-aware regularizer）。此外，提出了一种无标签评估套件，沿五个空间和物理轴对预测缺陷结构打分，用于无高温标签时的模型评估与选择。验证体系为FCC、BCC、HCP铁的分子动力学模拟，并与Wigner-Seitz真值对比。

papers.title: Impact of interstitial carbon on local lattice distortions in CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloys
papers.abstract: Here, we explore component-dependent local lattice distortions in polycrystalline, equiatomic, face-centered cubic CrMnFeCoNi high-entropy alloys and their modifications induced by dilute interstitial carbon. Multi-edge extended X-ray absorption fine structure spectroscopy combined with reverse Monte Carlo analysis reveals that the Cr component experiences the most substantial local distortions, independent of the temperature of prolonged annealing treatments (993 K or 1373 K) and the nominal carbon content (0 to 0.8 at.%). The static disorder around Cr atoms was found to increase markedly and monotonically upon carbon alloying, whereas Mn, Fe, Co, and Ni demonstrate weaker and non-monotonic tendencies. The carbon-induced lattice distortions extend over several coordination shells, indicating the pronounced effect of the carbon presence on the local environment around Cr absorbers. First-principles density functional theory and finite-temperature molecular dynamics simulations confirm the greater impact of carbon on the local lattice distortions around Cr than around the other $3d$ constituent elements, based on the previous finding that carbon preferentially occupies Cr-rich interstitial sites. These results provide decisive hints towards the atomistic origin of the non-monotonic diffusion behavior previously reported for carbon-doped CrMnFeCoNi alloys, and are noticeable for understanding the carbon-induced phase transitions in compositionally complex systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：实验上使用多边扩展X射线吸收精细结构谱（EXAFS）结合反向蒙特卡洛（RMC）分析；计算上使用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）和有限温度分子动力学模拟。；研究对象：等原子比面心立方（FCC）CrMnFeCoNi高熵合金（Cantor合金）中，间隙碳原子对各组分元素局域晶格畸变的影响，以及碳掺杂引起的畸变随退火温度和碳含量的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cr元素在所有组分中承受最大的局域晶格畸变，且碳合金化使Cr周围的静态无序度显著且单调增加，而Mn、Fe、Co、Ni的变化较弱且非单调；碳诱导的畸变延伸至多个配位壳层，证实碳优先占据Cr富集的间隙位点，从而对Cr周围局域环境产生显著影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cr元素在所有组分中承受最大的局域晶格畸变，且碳合金化使Cr周围的静态无序度显著且单调增加，而Mn、Fe、Co、Ni的变化较弱且非单调；碳诱导的畸变延伸至多个配位壳层，证实碳优先占据Cr富集的间隙位点，从而对Cr周围局域环境产生显著影响。；创新点：首次系统揭示了间隙碳对不同组分元素局域晶格畸变的组分依赖性差异，特别是Cr的独特响应，并将这一微观畸变行为与先前报道的碳掺杂CrMnFeCoNi合金中非单调扩散行为及碳诱导相变联系起来，为理解成分复杂体系中的碳效应提供了原子尺度的直接证据。
papers.method_zh: 多边扩展X射线吸收精细结构谱（multi-edge EXAFS）结合反向蒙特卡洛（RMC）模拟；第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算；有限温度分子动力学（MD）模拟。退火处理温度为993 K和1373 K，碳含量范围为0至0.8 at.%。

papers.title: Physics-Constrained Neural Flow Maps for Long-Horizon Prediction of Spin Dynamics
papers.abstract: Conventional simulation of current-driven magnetization relies on fine-step integration of the spin-transfer-torque Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation, creating a computational bottleneck in parameter sweeps and control searches. In this work, we propose a physics-constrained neural flow map that learns finite-time dynamics directly on the unit sphere. The model maps the current magnetization, spin-torque strength, and requested time span to a future state in a single forward pass. Tangent-space projection and spherical retraction preserve unit magnetization during recursive, composition-consistent rollout. We validate the framework on single-spin trajectories under in-domain torques and previously unseen but stronger drive.
