Beyond the training horizon, it achieves an in-domain root mean square error of $0.00425$ with norm drift at the $10^{-7}$ level. The flow outperforms an adapted Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) in in-domain accuracy and geometric stability, although the LSTM retains slightly lower out-of-distribution state error. The resulting geometry-preserving propagator reduces reliance on fine-step integration and enables physically admissible long-horizon prediction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“simulation”“learns finite-time dynamics”“model maps”等计算建模与机器学习方法关键词。；研究对象：电流驱动下的自旋动力学，具体为自旋转移力矩-朗道-利夫希茨-吉尔伯特（STT-LLG）方程描述的单自旋磁化动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种物理约束的神经流映射方法，可在单位球面上直接学习有限时间自旋动力学，实现单次前向传播预测未来状态，并在训练时间范围外达到0.00425的域内均方根误差，范数漂移低至10⁻⁷量级，从而减少对细步长积分的依赖，实现物理上可接受的长时程预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种物理约束的神经流映射方法，可在单位球面上直接学习有限时间自旋动力学，实现单次前向传播预测未来状态，并在训练时间范围外达到0.00425的域内均方根误差，范数漂移低至10⁻⁷量级，从而减少对细步长积分的依赖，实现物理上可接受的长时程预测。；创新点：将神经流映射与单位球面上的几何约束（切空间投影与球面回缩）相结合，实现组合一致的递归预测，在保持几何结构的同时超越训练时间范围进行长时程外推，且相比LSTM在域内精度和几何稳定性上更优。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 采用物理约束的神经流映射（physics-constrained neural flow map），结合切空间投影（tangent-space projection）和球面回缩（spherical retraction）操作，保证递归、组合一致的 rollout 过程中磁化强度单位范数守恒。模型输入为当前磁化状态、自旋力矩强度和所需时间跨度，输出为未来状态。对比方法为改进的长短期记忆网络（LSTM）。

papers.title: Beyond second-long trajectory of the Trp-cage peptide generated using a Kinetic Monte Carlo model derived from molecular dynamics
papers.abstract: We present a kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) modeling approach to describe the stochastic dynamics of a peptide molecule spanning nanosecond to second timescales. The dynamics of protein conformational changes is interpreted at a local level in terms of dihedral transitions. Taking Trp-cage miniprotein as an example, the KMC model "learns" about the transitions from multiple MD trajectories. Training is based on local divide-and-conquer strategy that identifies the discretized backbone dihedral states as building blocks for the conformational space, along with associated transition rates of dihedral flips to describe the conformational state-to-state dynamics. A key feature in our approach is the incorporation of backbone correlations, such that rates are conditioned on the local environment and steric coupling. We show that with the correlations built-in, the KMC model closely matches MD. Such an approach is shown to reach second timescales in a few CPU hours on a standard desktop computer, and can easily yield multiple stochastic realizations of the conformational dynamics. Our KMC model construction scheme should be generally applicable to a wide range of proteins, and can be used for bridging local flexibility to protein-wide dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) modeling、molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories、modeling approach。；研究对象：Trp-cage 微型蛋白（Trp-cage miniprotein）的构象随机动力学，具体关注其从纳秒到秒时间尺度上的二面角跃迁驱动的构象变化过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入骨架二面角之间的局域相关性（即跃迁速率依赖于局部环境和空间位阻耦合），所构建的KMC模型能够与分子动力学模拟结果高度吻合，并可在标准台式机上用数CPU小时达到秒级时间尺度，同时轻松生成多条随机构象动力学轨迹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入骨架二面角之间的局域相关性（即跃迁速率依赖于局部环境和空间位阻耦合），所构建的KMC模型能够与分子动力学模拟结果高度吻合，并可在标准台式机上用数CPU小时达到秒级时间尺度，同时轻松生成多条随机构象动力学轨迹。；创新点：在KMC模型中系统性地引入骨架二面角之间的相关性，使跃迁速率条件化于局域环境与空间位阻耦合，从而在保持计算效率的同时显著提升与MD的匹配度；该建模方案具有普适性，可推广至多种蛋白质，用于连接局域柔性与整体蛋白动力学。
papers.method_zh: 基于分子动力学（MD）轨迹训练的动力学蒙特卡洛（KMC）模型。训练采用局部分治策略，将离散化的骨架二面角态作为构象空间的基本构建块，并提取相应的二面角翻转跃迁速率；关键改进是在速率中显式纳入骨架相关性（局域环境与位阻耦合）。

papers.title: Nudged Elastic Band Method in the CRYSTAL code. Theory and Applications
papers.abstract: The nudged elastic band (NEB) method is a widely used algorithm for determining minimum energy paths and transition states in chemical reactions and phase transitions. In this work, we present the implementation of different NEB algorithm schemes in the CRYSTAL code, a quantum mechanical ab initio program for the calculation of electronic properties of condensed matter systems, based on Hartree-Fock and density functional theory. The use of a set of localized Gaussian-type functions to expand the wavefunction permits a very efficient evaluation of the exact exchange series for the hybrid exchange-correlation functionals. Therefore, our implementation allows an accurate characterization of transition states in both molecular and condensed phase systems, at the hybrid functional level of theory. The theoretical framework, including the force projection scheme, tangent estimation, optimization strategies, as well as the extensions of the method with climbing image and variable spring constant variants, is recalled. Then, the NEB algorithm is validated through a series of benchmark tests: two molecular reactions (a collinear proton transfer process and the keto-enol tautomerization in formamide) and a proton exchange process in a periodic chabazite zeolite. Our results are in excellent agreement with experimental and previous theoretical data, confirming the accuracy and applicability of the implementation. This work opens the possibility for future studies of complex reactive processes on extended periodic systems, using hybrid functionals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法学文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“implementation”（程序实现）、“benchmark tests”（基准测试），属于计算方法开发与验证类工作。；研究对象：论文研究的体系包括：分子体系（线性质子转移反应、甲酰胺的酮-烯醇互变异构）以及周期性凝聚态体系（菱沸石分子筛中的质子交换过程）。核心物理现象是化学反应中的最小能量路径与过渡态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CRYSTAL代码中实现了多种NEB算法方案（含爬坡镜像和可变弹簧常数变体），并通过分子和周期性体系的基准测试验证了其准确性，结果与实验及先前理论数据高度一致，尤其支持在杂化泛函水平下对凝聚态体系过渡态进行精确表征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CRYSTAL代码中实现了多种NEB算法方案（含爬坡镜像和可变弹簧常数变体），并通过分子和周期性体系的基准测试验证了其准确性，结果与实验及先前理论数据高度一致，尤其支持在杂化泛函水平下对凝聚态体系过渡态进行精确表征。；创新点：首次在CRYSTAL代码中系统实现并验证了多种NEB算法方案，使得在杂化泛函水平下对分子和凝聚态体系（尤其是周期性系统）进行精确过渡态表征成为可能。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于Hartree-Fock和密度泛函理论（DFT）的CRYSTAL代码，采用局域高斯型函数展开波函数，从而高效计算杂化交换相关泛函的精确交换级数。具体实现了NEB方法，包括力投影方案、切线估计、优化策略，以及爬坡镜像（climbing image）和可变弹簧常数（variable spring constant）扩展。

papers.title: Odd-frequency pair correlations in the trapped fermionic Tonks-Girardeau gas
papers.abstract: The fermionic Tonks-Girardeau gas is an exactly solvable model realizing a conventional macroscopic condensate of p-wave Cooper pairs. Here we demonstrate that, when confined by a trapping potential, it also hosts unconventional odd-frequency pairing, i.e., pair correlations with s-wave symmetry that are only present with a finite time delay t between fermions forming a pair. Quantitative results for fixed particle number are obtained using a generalization of Yang's theory of off-diagonal long-range order to define a t-dependent order parameter that is antisymmetric under combined t inversion and exchange of fermion-pair indices. Odd-frequency pairing in the fermionic Tonks-Girardeau gas is found to be a mesoscopic effect, localized at the system's boundary and therefore nonextensive thermodynamically. Our results show that this elusive hidden order is accessible in systems having fixed particle number, suggesting new avenues towards its experimental realization and further detailed study.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“exactly solvable model”“generalization of Yang's theory”“quantitative results”等理论推导与解析计算关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：囚禁势阱中的费米子 Tonks-Girardeau 气体，具体研究其奇频（odd-frequency）配对关联，即具有 s 波对称性、仅在费米子对之间存在有限时间延迟 t 时出现的配对关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 囚禁势阱中的费米子 Tonks-Girardeau 气体除常规的 p 波 Cooper 对凝聚体外，还承载非常规的奇频配对；该奇频配对是一种介观效应，局域于系统边界，在热力学上非广延（不随系统尺寸线性增长）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：囚禁势阱中的费米子 Tonks-Girardeau 气体除常规的 p 波 Cooper 对凝聚体外，还承载非常规的奇频配对；该奇频配对是一种介观效应，局域于系统边界，在热力学上非广延（不随系统尺寸线性增长）。；创新点：首次在固定粒子数的可解模型中明确展示奇频配对的存在，并揭示其作为介观边界效应的热力学非广延特性，为奇频配对这一“隐藏序”的实验实现提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 利用 Yang 的离域长程有序（off-diagonal long-range order）理论的推广，定义了一个依赖于时间延迟 t 的序参量，该序参量在联合时间反演与费米子对指标交换下反对称；在固定粒子数条件下获得定量结果。

papers.title: Extrinsic nonlinear spin currents in spin-orbit coupled systems: A Boltzmann transport study
papers.abstract: We develop a semiclassical Boltzmann framework for second-order extrinsic spin transport in the presence of skew scattering. The conventional relaxation-time approximation reduces the full collision integral to a single phenomenological timescale and thereby neglects the angular structure of impurity scattering. While the transport relaxation time primarily characterizes the leading angular harmonic of the nonequilibrium distribution, nonlinear response is sensitive to its higher angular harmonics, which are governed by distinct components of the collision operator. We therefore retain the angular and band dependence of the scattering kernel and decompose both the collision integral and the distribution function into Fourier harmonics. The resulting coupled algebraic equations allow the symmetric and skew-scattering corrections to the distribution function to be obtained recursively order by order in the electric field. We apply this formalism to the gapped surface states of a topological insulator with spin-dependent impurity scattering and evaluate the corresponding second-order extrinsic spin-current response. Our results show that higher angular harmonics of the nonequilibrium distribution and scattering between distinct constant-energy contours play an essential role in extrinsic nonlinear spin transport beyond the single-relaxation-time approximation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a semiclassical Boltzmann framework”“Boltzmann transport study”，属于输运理论建模。；研究对象：自旋-轨道耦合体系中的二阶外禀自旋输运，具体以拓扑绝缘体带隙表面态为例，考虑自旋依赖的杂质散射。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在存在斜散射（skew scattering）的二阶外禀自旋输运中，仅用单一弛豫时间近似会丢失非平衡分布函数的高阶角谐波信息，而这些高阶谐波以及不同等能轮廓之间的散射对非线性自旋电流至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在存在斜散射（skew scattering）的二阶外禀自旋输运中，仅用单一弛豫时间近似会丢失非平衡分布函数的高阶角谐波信息，而这些高阶谐波以及不同等能轮廓之间的散射对非线性自旋电流至关重要。；创新点：突破了传统弛豫时间近似仅保留输运弛豫时间（主导角谐波）的限制，系统纳入碰撞算子的高阶角谐波分量，揭示了它们在二阶外禀自旋输运中的关键作用。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论框架。具体做法：保留散射核的角分辨和能带依赖结构，将碰撞积分和分布函数均做傅里叶角谐波分解，得到耦合代数方程组，并逐阶（电场幂次）递归求解分布函数的对称与斜散射修正。

papers.title: Pair Filters in an Extended Hubbard Model at Resonance
papers.abstract: We investigate the dynamics of bound pairs in an extended Hubbard model at resonance. We show that a single fermion and a singlet bound pair possess identical dispersion relations and scatter off each other. In contrast, a neighboring doublon pair is dynamically pinned in the strong-interaction regime. Remarkably, a single fermion and a singlet bound pair exhibit fundamentally different scattering behaviors when encountering a pinned doublon pair acting as a scattering center. While the singlet bound pair undergoes perfect transmission, the single fermion is completely reflected. These results demonstrate that a neighboring doublon pair functions as an efficient filter that separates bound pairs from single particles. Numerical simulations fully support the analytical predictions. Our findings provide a dynamical mechanism for generating and manipulating bound-pair states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We show”“analytical predictions”“Numerical simulations”等表述，属于理论分析与数值模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：共振条件下的扩展Hubbard模型中的束缚对（bound pairs）动力学，具体涉及单费米子、单重态束缚对（singlet bound pair）以及相邻双占据对（doublon pair）之间的散射行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强相互作用区域，相邻双占据对可作为高效“过滤器”：单重态束缚对可完美透射通过该散射中心，而单个费米子则被完全反射，从而实现束缚对与单粒子的分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强相互作用区域，相邻双占据对可作为高效“过滤器”：单重态束缚对可完美透射通过该散射中心，而单个费米子则被完全反射，从而实现束缚对与单粒子的分离。；创新点：首次提出并证明相邻双占据对可作为动态“过滤器”，在强相互作用共振条件下实现束缚对与单粒子的选择性分离，为产生和操控束缚对态提供了一种动力学机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析（解析推导色散关系与散射行为）结合数值模拟（摘要未明确说明具体数值方法，如DMRG或精确对角化等，仅称“Numerical simulations”）。

papers.title: Monitored free fermions under periodic driving
papers.abstract: We investigate analytically and numerically a one-dimensional periodically driven free-fermionic system subjected to monitoring of the local particle density. Based on the analytical approach that describes the long-wavelength physics of the time-dependent Hamiltonian in the field-theoretical language using the nonlinear sigma-model (NLSM), we reveal that driving does not alter the universality class of the problem. As a consequence, the system retains the area-law behavior in the thermodynamic limit, with an intermediate diffusive regime giving rise to logarithmic growth of entanglement entropy for a small monitoring rate. At the same time, driving leads to a renormalization of the bare coupling constant of the NLSM, which controls the space-time ``conductivity'' in the diffusive regime. We derive the analytic form of this renormalization, which becomes particularly strong in the case of a ``maximally symmetric'' drive and sufficiently short driving period. In addition, we employ the Wiener-Hopf method to investigate the ballistic-diffusive crossover. These analytical predictions are corroborated by numerical simulations of the von-Neumann entanglement entropy and the density correlation function. Our numerical results clearly demonstrate that, with an increase in the system size, there are successive crossovers from ballistic to diffusive behavior and ultimately to localization. Furthermore, in the diffusive regime, we observe weak-localization corrections that are in agreement with the analytical predictions of the NLSM. Overall, our results provide a unified analytical and numerical framework for understanding the effects of monitoring in time-modulated fermionic systems, paving a way for broader investigations of driven quantum matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“analytically and numerically”“analytical approach”“numerical simulations”。；研究对象：一维周期驱动（periodically driven）的自由费米子体系，并受到局域粒子密度监测（monitoring of local particle density）。属于受监测量子系统与周期驱动（Floquet）体系的交叉物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 周期驱动不改变该受监测自由费米子系统的普适类，热力学极限下仍保持面积律纠缠熵；但驱动会重整化非线性sigma模型（NLSM）中的裸耦合常数，从而影响扩散区间的“时空电导率”。数值模拟证实了从弹道到扩散再到局域化的连续交叉，并在扩散区间观察到与NLSM理论一致的弱局域化修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：周期驱动不改变该受监测自由费米子系统的普适类，热力学极限下仍保持面积律纠缠熵；但驱动会重整化非线性sigma模型（NLSM）中的裸耦合常数，从而影响扩散区间的“时空电导率”。数值模拟证实了从弹道到扩散再到局域化的连续交叉，并在扩散区间观察到与NLSM理论一致的弱局域化修正。；创新点：首次将周期驱动与监测效应结合，在NLSM框架下统一解析描述驱动对监测自由费米子普适类的影响，并给出驱动导致的耦合常数重整化的解析形式，特别是“最大对称”驱动和短周期情形下的强重整化效应。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为非线性sigma模型（NLSM）描述长波长物理；解析上还使用Wiener-Hopf方法研究弹道-扩散交叉；数值上模拟了von-Neumann纠缠熵和密度关联函数。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal Control of the Goos--Hänchen Shift via the Barnett Effect in Cavity Magnomechanics
papers.abstract: We propose a theoretical scheme for realizing a tunable nonreciprocal Goos-Hänchen shift (GHS) in a hybrid cavity magnomechanical system. The setup consists of a rotating yttrium iron garnet sphere embedded in a microwave cavity, with magnetic-dipole and magnetostrictive interactions mediating magnon-photon and magnon-phonon couplings, respectively. Owing to the Barnett effect, the magnon frequency acquires a rotation-induced shift whose sign can be reversed by changing the direction of the bias magnetic field. We show that the output probe spectrum exhibits a Fano resonance, while the associated GHS responds asymmetrically to opposite field directions, providing a controllable mechanism for nonreciprocal beam shifts. The magnon-photon and magnon-phonon interactions are found to affect the GHS in opposite ways, while the cavity length offers an additional degree of tunability. These results provide a route toward magnetically reconfigurable microwave photonic devices and sensitive detection of Barnett-induced effective fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a theoretical scheme、theoretical scheme。；研究对象：混合腔磁力子系统（hybrid cavity magnomechanical system），具体为嵌入微波腔中的旋转钇铁石榴石（YIG）球体，研究其非互易Goos–Hänchen位移（GHS）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Barnett效应诱导的磁子频率旋转位移，可实现符号可调的非互易Goos–Hänchen位移，且该位移对磁场方向呈不对称响应，为可重构微波光子器件和Barnett有效场灵敏探测提供了途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Barnett效应诱导的磁子频率旋转位移，可实现符号可调的非互易Goos–Hänchen位移，且该位移对磁场方向呈不对称响应，为可重构微波光子器件和Barnett有效场灵敏探测提供了途径。；创新点：首次在腔磁力系统中利用Barnett效应实现非互易GHS控制，并发现磁子-光子与磁子-声子相互作用对GHS具有相反影响，同时腔长提供额外调谐自由度。摘要未突出说明与已有非互易GHS方案的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论方案分析，基于磁偶极相互作用（磁子-光子耦合）和磁致伸缩相互作用（磁子-声子耦合）的哈密顿量建模，结合输出探针谱的Fano共振分析与GHS响应计算。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如量子主方程或输入-输出理论），但属于解析/半解析理论框架。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium statistics of harmonically trapped run-and-tumble particles: An exact convolution approach
papers.abstract: We study one-dimensional run-and-tumble particles confined by a harmonic potential and coupled to an equilibrium thermal bath. Exploiting the coupling of active and thermal degrees of freedom through the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck propagator, we show that the position distribution factorizes, as a convolution, into the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck distribution and the distribution of the athermal run-and-tumble problem. This yields closed-form results, correcting expressions from earlier treatments by identifying the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck propagator, rather than the free-diffusion one, as the correct kernel. Results are confirmed both in Fourier space and by direct Langevin simulation. We further focus our analysis on the stationary regime, characterized by two dimensionless parameters--the ratio of trapping to persistence length, and the ratio of thermal to active diffusion--which control the crossover from a non-Gaussian, boundary-peaked distribution to the Gaussian, equilibrium-like limit. Energy fluctuations and the Kullback-Leibler divergence from the equilibrium distribution quantify the resulting non-equilibrium character of the confined active particle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“exact convolution approach”“closed-form results”“Fourier space”等理论推导与解析求解关键词，并辅以Langevin模拟验证。；研究对象：一维谐振子势阱中、与平衡热浴耦合的run-and-tumble活性粒子（RTP）体系，重点关注其非平衡稳态统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性粒子位置分布可精确分解为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck分布与无热run-and-tumble分布的卷积，从而获得闭式解析结果；稳态由两个无量纲参数（俘获长度与持续长度之比、热扩散与活性扩散之比）控制，体系呈现从非高斯、边界峰型分布到高斯平衡极限的交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性粒子位置分布可精确分解为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck分布与无热run-and-tumble分布的卷积，从而获得闭式解析结果；稳态由两个无量纲参数（俘获长度与持续长度之比、热扩散与活性扩散之比）控制，体系呈现从非高斯、边界峰型分布到高斯平衡极限的交叉。；创新点：纠正了以往处理中错误地将自由扩散传播子作为卷积核的做法，明确指出应以Ornstein-Uhlenbeck传播子为正确核函数，从而得到精确闭式解。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 利用Ornstein-Uhlenbeck传播子耦合活性与热自由度，通过卷积分解求解位置分布；在Fourier空间验证解析结果，并直接进行Langevin动力学模拟对照。进一步计算能量涨落和Kullback-Leibler散度以量化非平衡程度。

papers.title: Breakdown of Aharonov-Bohm cage in Rydberg synthetic lattices: the roles of inhomogeneity and long-range exchange
papers.abstract: While the interaction-induced breakdown of Aharonov-Bohm (AB) cage is typically attributed to uniform bound-pair transport, systems with inhomogeneous exchange interactions realized with Rydberg synthetic lattices exhibit more complex dynamics. Employing the evolution-path symmetry (EPS) framework developed recently, we analyze the two-particle dynamics via path interference in Fock space. We find that a homogeneous nearest-neighbor exchange interaction cannot break the AB cage, regardless of whether the long-range exchange interaction is present or not. In contrast, we demonstrate that inhomogeneous nearest-neighbor exchange interaction breaks the destructive-interference EPS, and lifts the degeneracy of many-body compact localized states, thereby generating non-local dispersive eigenstates. Consequently, the initial state gains a non-zero overlap with these dispersive states, enabling delocalized transport. Furthermore, while long-range exchange interaction alone preserves the AB cage, its coupling with nearest-neighbor inhomogeneous exchange interaction opens non-canceling pathways that alter the diffusion profile. Our work connects microscopic path interference with macroscopic spectral reorganization, offering an analytical understanding of the mechanism underlying exchange-interaction-induced transport in Rydberg synthetic lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“Employing the evolution-path symmetry (EPS) framework developed recently”“we analyze”“we demonstrate”等理论分析与推导表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：Rydberg 合成晶格（Rydberg synthetic lattices）中由相互作用诱导的 Aharonov-Bohm（AB）笼的破坏现象，具体关注非均匀交换相互作用与长程交换相互作用对两粒子动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 均匀最近邻交换相互作用（无论是否存在长程交换）均不能破坏 AB 笼；而非均匀最近邻交换相互作用会破坏相消干涉的 EPS 对称性，解除多体紧致局域态的简并，从而产生非局域色散本征态，使初始态获得非零重叠并实现退局域输运。长程交换单独存在时保持 AB 笼，但与最近邻非均匀交换耦合时会打开不可抵消的路径，改变扩散轮廓。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：均匀最近邻交换相互作用（无论是否存在长程交换）均不能破坏 AB 笼；而非均匀最近邻交换相互作用会破坏相消干涉的 EPS 对称性，解除多体紧致局域态的简并，从而产生非局域色散本征态，使初始态获得非零重叠并实现退局域输运。长程交换单独存在时保持 AB 笼，但与最近邻非均匀交换耦合时会打开不可抵消的路径，改变扩散轮廓。；创新点：将微观路径干涉与宏观谱重组联系起来，为 Rydberg 合成晶格中交换相互作用诱导输运的机制提供了解析理解；明确区分了均匀与非均匀交换相互作用对 AB 笼破坏的不同作用，并揭示了长程交换与最近邻非均匀交换耦合的协同效应。
papers.method_zh: 采用近期发展的演化路径对称性（evolution-path symmetry, EPS）框架，在 Fock 空间中进行路径干涉分析，研究两粒子动力学。

papers.title: Dynamic Magnetic Pair-Density Function of a One-Dimensional Ferromagnet
papers.abstract: The dynamic magnetic pair-density function (DymPDF) $D_{\rm M}(r, E)$ is derived by extending the static magnetic pair distribution function (mPDF) to finite energy transfer. The analytical DymPDF of a one-dimensional Heisenberg ferromagnet is obtained from the magnon dispersion and compared with simulations performed using {\textsc SpinW}. Excellent agreement is achieved for energy dependence of the nearest-neighbor spin-pair correlation, demonstrating that the DymPDF changes sign at the magnon-mode transition occurring at one-half of the maximum magnon energy. The real-space DymPDF at low energy is also reproduced with a model including finite instrumental resolution, magnetic correlation length, and Fourier-termination effects. These results establish the theoretical foundation of DymPDF analysis for investigating local spin dynamics in magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytical DymPDF is obtained”（解析推导）以及“compared with simulations performed using SpinW”（数值模拟对比），属于理论推导+模拟验证的混合类型。；研究对象：一维海森堡铁磁体（one-dimensional Heisenberg ferromagnet）中的局域自旋动力学，具体关注动态磁对分布函数（DymPDF）在实空间和能量空间的关联行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了动态磁对分布函数 DymPDF 的解析表达式，并发现最近邻自旋对关联的能量依赖在最大磁振子能量的一半处发生符号反转，对应磁振子模式转变点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了动态磁对分布函数 DymPDF 的解析表达式，并发现最近邻自旋对关联的能量依赖在最大磁振子能量的一半处发生符号反转，对应磁振子模式转变点。；创新点：首次建立了 DymPDF 的解析理论框架，将实空间磁对分布函数分析从静态推广至动态能量分辨领域，为研究磁性材料局域自旋动力学提供了新的理论工具。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为将静态磁对分布函数（mPDF）推广到有限能量转移，得到 DymPDF 的解析形式；数值模拟采用 SpinW 软件包进行对比验证；同时构建了包含仪器分辨率、磁关联长度和傅里叶截断效应的模型来重现低能实空间 DymPDF。

papers.title: High-Efficiency Ising Machine with Time-Dimensional Exchange Coupling
papers.abstract: Conventional probabilistic Ising machines often suffer from inefficient exploration of configuration space, while replica-based quantum Monte Carlo methods reduce sampling bottlenecks at the cost of large hardware overhead. Here we propose a time-dimensional exchange coupling (TEC) that replaces spatial replica coupling with a temporal exchange interaction between successive spin configurations of a single p-bit network. This TEC improves sampling efficiency without duplicating replica hardware. At low temperatures, antiferromagnetic TEC expands sampling range; at high temperatures, ferromagnetic TEC stabilizes the optimal state. For MaxCut problems with up to 2000 vertices, TEC significantly accelerates convergence speed. SPICE simulations confirm hardware feasibility. TEC offers a scalable, hardware-efficient strategy to enhance combinatorial optimization on existing Ising machines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（含电路仿真验证）。判断依据：提出理论方案（TEC）、算法性能测试（MaxCut问题）、SPICE仿真。；研究对象：概率Ising机（p-bit网络）中的组合优化问题求解，具体针对MaxCut问题（最多2000个顶点）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出时间维度交换耦合（TEC）机制，用单个p-bit网络在时间上相邻自旋构型之间的交换相互作用替代空间副本耦合，在无需复制硬件的情况下提升采样效率：低温下反铁磁TEC扩大采样范围，高温下铁磁TEC稳定最优态，显著加速MaxCut问题的收敛速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出时间维度交换耦合（TEC）机制，用单个p-bit网络在时间上相邻自旋构型之间的交换相互作用替代空间副本耦合，在无需复制硬件的情况下提升采样效率：低温下反铁磁TEC扩大采样范围，高温下铁磁TEC稳定最优态，显著加速MaxCut问题的收敛速度。；创新点：以时间维度交换耦合替代空间副本耦合，在单个p-bit网络中实现类似副本交换的采样效率提升，避免了复制硬件带来的巨大开销，为现有Ising机提供可扩展的硬件高效增强策略。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与算法设计：在单p-bit网络中引入时间维度上的交换耦合（TEC），替代传统副本量子蒙特卡洛方法中的空间副本耦合；通过MaxCut问题（顶点数至2000）进行性能测试；使用SPICE电路仿真验证硬件可实现性。

papers.title: Pitch-controlled reorientational nonlinearity in chiral nematic liquid crystals: a reduced-order model for self-focusing and soliton formation
papers.abstract: We present a reduced-order semi-analytical model for reorientational nonlinearity in chiral nematic liquid crystals, showing that the chiral pitch acts as the dominant physical length scale governing the onset of nonlinear self-focusing and soliton formation. Starting from the full Frank-Oseen equation, we derive a closed-form expression for the optically induced molecular rotation that captures the essential saturable response of the medium while reducing computational cost by more than two orders of magnitude compared with standard relaxation-method solvers. Despite its simplicity, the model reproduces the essential features of the numerically obtained nonlinear refractive index, the onset of self-localization, and the transition from discrete to continuous solitons in one and two dimensions. It further predicts the formation of fully localized astigmatic nematicons with only minor shifts in the self-localization threshold due to the neglect of nonlocal effects. The proposed model provides direct physical insight into light-matter interactions with soft matter media and offers a computationally efficient tool for the design and optimization of nonlinear photonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“reduced-order semi-analytical model”“derived from the full Frank-Oseen equation”“numerically obtained”等关键词，属于理论建模与数值计算结合的研究。；研究对象：手性向列相液晶（chiral nematic liquid crystals）中的光致分子重取向非线性效应，具体关注自聚焦（self-focusing）和孤子（soliton）形成现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 手性螺距（chiral pitch）是控制非线性自聚焦和孤子形成的主导物理长度尺度；所提出的约化模型能以极低计算成本再现标准数值方法得到的非线性折射率、自局域化阈值以及从离散到连续孤子的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：手性螺距（chiral pitch）是控制非线性自聚焦和孤子形成的主导物理长度尺度；所提出的约化模型能以极低计算成本再现标准数值方法得到的非线性折射率、自局域化阈值以及从离散到连续孤子的转变。；创新点：提出了一个计算效率比标准方法高两个数量级以上的约化模型，同时保留了介质饱和非线性响应的关键物理特征；首次明确将手性螺距确立为控制自聚焦和孤子形成的主导长度尺度，并预测了完全局域的像散“nematicons”孤子（仅因忽略非局域效应而阈值有微小偏移）。
papers.method_zh: 从完整的Frank-Oseen方程出发，推导出光致分子旋转的闭式解析表达式（约化半解析模型），并与标准弛豫法（relaxation-method）数值求解器进行对比验证；在二维和三维（一维和二维空间）中分析孤子形态。

papers.title: Thermodynamic and Kinetic Tests for Low-Pressure Metal-Flux Growth of Diamond, with an Extension to Cubic Boron Nitride
papers.abstract: Diamond was grown from a liquid Ga-Fe-Ni-Si alloy near 1 atm, although bulk graphite is thermodynamically more stable under those conditions. This Perspective asks what must be true for a diamond growth front to continue advancing in such a metastable regime. I define a finite-difference transfer free energy for a specified interfacial event and identify the completed attachment of one carbon atom at a kink as the repeatable event that governs sustained growth. In the macroscopic limit, surface terms cancel, and the required carbon activity is fixed by the bulk free energy of diamond. On a graphite-normalized scale, the diamond equilibrium threshold is about 2.0 at 1300 K, whereas graphite saturation occurs at unity. Diamond growth therefore requires kinetic selection above the graphite threshold, not a reversal of bulk phase stability. The analysis distinguishes thermodynamic driving force, kinetic accessibility, experimental detection limits, and the carbon retained after an experiment. It gives isotope-resolved tests for distinguishing sustained diamond growth from seed survival, transient carbon attachment, or failure to detect graphite. A $^{13}\mathrm{C}$-enriched diamond seed provides a test of natural-abundance gas or condensed carbon sources: a registered, crystallographically continuous $^{12}\mathrm{C}$-rich layer outside the original seed can establish source-attributed overgrowth without isotopically labeling each feed. The same accounting is extended to cubic boron nitride. Separate boron and nitrogen chemical potentials are required, and $^{10}\mathrm{B}/^{11}\mathrm{B}$ and $^{15}\mathrm{N}$ contrasts could distinguish reservoir supply from seed loss for each element. The resulting criteria make low-pressure metal-flux growth claims quantitatively testable and guide experiments, thermodynamic modeling, and atomistic simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/分析文章。关键词：Perspective、finite-difference transfer free energy、thermodynamic modeling、atomistic simulation。；研究对象：低压金属熔剂（Ga-Fe-Ni-Si合金）中金刚石及立方氮化硼（cBN）的亚稳生长机制，具体关注碳原子在台阶扭折位（kink）的附着过程及生长判据。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在石墨热力学更稳定的条件下，金刚石生长并非依赖体相稳定性的反转，而是需要碳活度超过石墨饱和阈值（约1.0）并达到金刚石平衡阈值（1300 K时约2.0），通过动力学选择实现亚稳生长。该框架给出了区分持续生长与种子存活、瞬时附着或未检测到石墨的同位素分辨判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在石墨热力学更稳定的条件下，金刚石生长并非依赖体相稳定性的反转，而是需要碳活度超过石墨饱和阈值（约1.0）并达到金刚石平衡阈值（1300 K时约2.0），通过动力学选择实现亚稳生长。该框架给出了区分持续生长与种子存活、瞬时附着或未检测到石墨的同位素分辨判据。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但明确提出了将热力学驱动力、动力学可达性、实验检测限和实验后残留碳四者区分开的定量判据，并设计了无需逐次标记每种原料的同位素分辨验证方案（如¹³C种子外延层检测），使低压金属熔剂生长金刚石及cBN的宣称可被定量检验。
papers.method_zh: 理论热力学分析：定义了界面事件的有限差分转移自由能，在宏观极限下消去表面项，以石墨归一化标度确定金刚石生长的碳活度阈值；并提出了¹³C富集金刚石种子结合天然丰度碳源的同位素标记实验方案，以及针对cBN的¹⁰B/¹¹B和¹⁵N同位素对比测试方法。

papers.title: First-Principles Atomistic Structure and Dynamics of Polyethylene During High-Pressure Radical Polymerization via Machine Learning Force Fields
papers.abstract: Polyethylene (PE) is one of the most commonly used synthetic polymers. While the synthesis and processing protocols for PE are well established, precise experimental assignment of microscopic structures at atomistic resolution (i.e., the position of each atom) remains largely limited to highly crystalline systems. This gap is often addressed via computer simulations using empirical interatomic potentials, which use approximate but efficient descriptions of interatomic interactions to reach the length and time scales needed to describe macromolecules. These empirical potentials typically perform well for bulk and/or collective properties but face challenges with chemical realism for complex systems, e.g., during reactive processes. In this work, we address this challenge by combining the computational efficiency of a deep potential (DP) machine-learning force field and the chemical realism of first-principles van der Waals (vdW) corrected hybrid density functional theory (DFT) enabled by a SeA high-throughput framework. Using this approach, we study the structure and dynamics of PE oligomers and polymers in an ethylene solvent under common high-pressure (supercritical) radical polymerization conditions. We found that the local solvation environment of radical-containing PE oligomers converges for chain lengths greater than (n~6), suggesting extensibility of our oligomer-trained MLFF to significantly longer polymers. We then confirmed the extensibility of these models to long PE chains by characterizing the molecular weight scaling of single-chain structure and dynamics, which showed classic good solvent behavior. Our PE MLFF retained a consistent level of fidelity and stability across a wide range of thermodynamic state points and chain lengths, at full atomistic resolution, therefore paving the way towards first-principles-based polymer structure and property prediction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“computer simulations”“machine learning force field”“first-principles DFT”等关键词，属于第一性原理计算与机器学习力场结合的模拟研究。；研究对象：聚乙烯（PE）及其低聚物/聚合物在乙烯溶剂中、高压（超临界）自由基聚合条件下的原子级结构与动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机器学习力场（DP）与杂化泛函DFT结合，成功模拟了高压自由基聚合条件下PE链的局域溶剂化环境与单链结构/动力学，发现自由基PE低聚物的局域溶剂化环境在链长n≈6以上收敛，且模型可外推至长链，呈现经典良溶剂行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机器学习力场（DP）与杂化泛函DFT结合，成功模拟了高压自由基聚合条件下PE链的局域溶剂化环境与单链结构/动力学，发现自由基PE低聚物的局域溶剂化环境在链长n≈6以上收敛，且模型可外推至长链，呈现经典良溶剂行为。；创新点：将第一性原理精度的杂化DFT（含vdW修正）与机器学习力场的效率结合，首次实现了对高压自由基聚合条件下PE体系的全原子级、第一性原理基准确模拟，并验证了从低聚物到长链的可扩展性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用深度势能（Deep Potential, DP）机器学习力场，结合含范德华修正的杂化密度泛函理论（hybrid DFT + vdW），并通过SeA高通量框架生成训练数据。模拟了PE低聚物/聚合物在超临界乙烯溶剂中的结构与动力学，并分析了链长标度行为。

papers.title: Non-uniform swelling of polyelectrolyte hydrogels: effects of charge regulation
papers.abstract: We investigate the impact of charge regulation (CR) on the non-uniform swelling behavior of polyelectrolyte hydrogels. The Poisson-Boltzmann theory with electro-elastic coupling between the local polymer density and elastic deformation is considered. We investigate the spatial distributions of the elastic displacement and polymer density under different salt concentrations and compare charge-regulated gels with fixed-charge (non-CR) gels of the same net charge. Our results show that the CR induces spatially varying charge fractions, which strengthen the electro-elastic response and lead to stronger non-uniform swelling compared with non-CR gels. These findings provide a theoretical basis for understanding and controlling non-uniform swelling in responsive polyelectrolyte hydrogels.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Poisson-Boltzmann theory with electro-elastic coupling”，属于连续介质理论建模。；研究对象：聚电解质水凝胶的非均匀溶胀行为，重点研究电荷调节（charge regulation, CR）效应如何影响凝胶在盐溶液中的弹性位移和聚合物密度空间分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电荷调节效应导致空间变化的电荷分数，增强了电-弹耦合响应，使得凝胶的非均匀溶胀程度比相同净电荷的固定电荷凝胶更强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电荷调节效应导致空间变化的电荷分数，增强了电-弹耦合响应，使得凝胶的非均匀溶胀程度比相同净电荷的固定电荷凝胶更强。；创新点：首次在非均匀溶胀框架中系统纳入电荷调节效应，揭示了CR导致的局域电荷分数变化对电-弹响应和非均匀形变的增强机制，为响应性聚电解质水凝胶的形变控制提供了理论依据。
papers.method_zh: 采用Poisson-Boltzmann理论，并耦合局部聚合物密度与弹性形变的电-弹相互作用，通过求解空间分布（弹性位移、聚合物密度）来比较不同盐浓度下的行为，并与固定电荷（非CR）凝胶进行对照。

papers.title: Comparative Assessment of Thermal Transport Theories: Dual-Channel Mechanism Dictates Heat Transport in Ultralow-$κ$ Materials
papers.abstract: Anomalous heat transport in strongly anharmonic crystalline solids poses both a fundamental challenge to the theoretical understanding and an opportunity for thermoelectric and thermal barrier coating applications. Although Green-Kubo theory reproduces experimental thermal conductivity ($κ$) at high temperatures, it lacks microscopic insight and neglects the Bose-Einstein statistics of lattice vibrations. On the other hand, the conventional Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) framework, based on a phonon-gas picture, fails due to strong anharmonicity-induced overdamped phonons. Herein, the thermal transport properties in TlAgSe, a metal chalcogenide, and Cs$_2$PbI$_2$C$_2$, an all-inorganic layered Ruddlesden-Popper perovskite, are investigated by explicitly accounting for temperature-dependent lattice dynamics through machine learning interatomic potentials and employing the Wigner transport equation (WTE) framework. Crucially, heat conduction is governed not only by higher-order phonon scattering-dominated populations' transport channel described within the BTE, but also by a coherences' channel in the WTE framework arising from wave-like interbranch coherence between eigenstates. Incorporating four-phonon scattering, WTE predicts average room-temperature $κ$ values of 0.31 Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$ (TlAgSe) and 0.38 Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$ (Cs$_2$PbI$_2$C$_2$), in excellent agreement with experiments. Phonon scattering-rate analysis reveals strong coherences' contributions and prevalent overdamped phonon modes, demonstrating the breakdown of the conventional BTE framework based on the phonon quasiparticle picture with only first-order anharmonic perturbation. This computational approach provides a unified description of heat transport in ultralow-$κ$ materials, offering a basis for the rational design of phononic and thermoelectric devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials、Wigner transport equation (WTE) framework、computational approach。；研究对象：两种超低热导率材料：金属硫族化合物 TlAgSe 和无机层状 Ruddlesden-Popper 钙钛矿 Cs₂PbI₂C₂；核心物理现象为强非谐晶格振动（过阻尼声子）主导的异常热输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超低热导率材料中，热传导由 BTE 描述的粒子输运通道与 WTE 框架中波状支间相干（coherences）通道共同决定；仅含三声子散射的常规 BTE 失效，必须引入四声子散射与相干通道才能定量复现实验热导率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超低热导率材料中，热传导由 BTE 描述的粒子输运通道与 WTE 框架中波状支间相干（coherences）通道共同决定；仅含三声子散射的常规 BTE 失效，必须引入四声子散射与相干通道才能定量复现实验热导率。；创新点：首次在两种不同结构类型的超低κ材料中统一验证了双通道（粒子+相干）热输运机制，并明确展示了常规声子准粒子图像（仅一阶非谐微扰）的失效；摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）显式考虑温度依赖的晶格动力学，结合 Wigner输运方程（WTE）框架计算热导率；同时进行声子散射率分析以区分粒子通道与相干通道贡献，并对比四声子散射与常规 BTE 结果。

papers.title: Emergent Second Law for Time-Dependent Nonequilibrium States
papers.abstract: For nonautonomous open systems described by macroscopic stochastic thermodynamics, we derive an emergent second law that constrains time-dependent macroscopic fluctuations by the entropy production along the most probable evolution under the time-reversed driving protocol. We show that this bound can be understood as a macroscopic consequence of the fluctuation theorem: the time reverse of this evolution provides a possible fluctuation path under the forward dynamics. In the linear-response and slow-driving regime, the bound becomes an equality to first order and generalizes the McLennan-Zubarev formula to the time-dependent probability density of nonautonomous systems with weak nonconservative affinities. We illustrate our results in a bistable system under sudden quenches and periodic driving.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“derive”（推导）、“macroscopic stochastic thermodynamics”（宏观随机热力学）等理论推导关键词，且无实验或数值模拟描述。；研究对象：非自治开放系统的宏观随机热力学，具体涉及时间依赖的非平衡态、熵产生、涨落定理，以及双稳系统在突然淬火和周期驱动下的动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出一个“涌现第二定律”：在时间反演驱动协议下，沿最概然演化的熵产生约束了时间依赖的宏观涨落。该界限可视为涨落定理的宏观推论，且在线性响应和慢驱动极限下，该界限在一阶精度下变为等式，推广了McLennan-Zubarev公式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出一个“涌现第二定律”：在时间反演驱动协议下，沿最概然演化的熵产生约束了时间依赖的宏观涨落。该界限可视为涨落定理的宏观推论，且在线性响应和慢驱动极限下，该界限在一阶精度下变为等式，推广了McLennan-Zubarev公式。；创新点：将传统上适用于稳态或自治系统的第二定律约束推广到非自治（时间依赖驱动）开放系统，并建立了与涨落定理的宏观联系；同时将McLennan-Zubarev公式推广到含时概率密度情形。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导框架：基于宏观随机热力学和涨落定理，结合时间反演协议下的最概然路径分析；在弱非保守亲和力条件下采用线性响应和慢驱动近似；并以双稳系统在突然淬火和周期驱动下的情形作为示例说明。

papers.title: Attractor-Basin-Limited Fidelity in Reproducible Multistate Vortex Memory
papers.abstract: Multilevel non-volatile memory technologies face recurring trade-offs among information density, endurance, retention, and switching energy. We investigate an alternative state variable based on the discrete vortex configuration of self-organized vortices in a boundary-driven electron fluid. A dissipative point-vortex model derived from magnetohydrodynamic dynamics yields six reproducible vortex codewords, corresponding to 2.585 bits per cell, whose write fidelity, noise sensitivity, 100-cycle endurance, and effective information capacity are quantified. The ordering of their finite-amplitude basin radii $r_{50}$ differs from that predicted by both fixed-circulation and fully coupled linear-stability spectra. A nonlinear saddle-point construction based on the reduced dynamics likewise does not recover the measured basin ordering. The discrepancy is associated with escape pathways involving coupled position--circulation dynamics that are absent from the fixed-circulation description. These results show that local stability alone does not determine the finite perturbation tolerance of the vortex states considered here. The proposed memory requires active hold power, and passive retention remains to be established experimentally.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“dissipative point-vortex model derived from magnetohydrodynamic dynamics”（基于磁流体动力学的耗散点涡模型）以及“linear-stability spectra”“nonlinear saddle-point construction”等理论分析手段，未提及实验测量。；研究对象：基于边界驱动电子流体中自组织涡旋的离散构型（discrete vortex configuration）的多态非易失性存储器。具体状态变量为涡旋的拓扑排列，而非传统电荷或磁化状态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该涡旋存储器可实现每个单元2.585比特（6个可复现码字），但其写入保真度对应的有限振幅吸引域半径（r50）的排序既不符合固定环量线性稳定性谱的预测，也不符合全耦合线性谱或基于约化动力学的非线性鞍点构造的预测。该偏差源于耦合位置-环量动力学中的逃逸路径，表明局部稳定性不足以决定涡旋态的有限扰动容限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该涡旋存储器可实现每个单元2.585比特（6个可复现码字），但其写入保真度对应的有限振幅吸引域半径（r50）的排序既不符合固定环量线性稳定性谱的预测，也不符合全耦合线性谱或基于约化动力学的非线性鞍点构造的预测。该偏差源于耦合位置-环量动力学中的逃逸路径，表明局部稳定性不足以决定涡旋态的有限扰动容限。；创新点：首次提出并系统量化了基于自组织涡旋离散构型的多态存储方案，并揭示了固定环量近似下缺失的耦合位置-环量逃逸通道对有限振幅稳定性的决定性影响——这一发现挑战了“局部稳定性即决定扰动容限”的常规假设。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：1）从磁流体动力学推导的耗散点涡模型；2）固定环量与全耦合线性稳定性谱分析；3）基于约化动力学的非线性鞍点构造；4）数值模拟量化写入保真度、噪声敏感性、100次循环耐久性及有效信息容量。

papers.title: Charge Transport Framework for Crystalline pi-Conjugated Materials
papers.abstract: Quantitative charge-transport modelling in crystalline pi-conjugated polymers requires an electronic representation that captures extended conjugation and material-specific electron-phonon interactions on equal footing. We present a Wannier-orbital-based formulation of the transient-polaron-localization (TPL) framework for quantitative charge-transport simulations in crystalline pi-conjugated polymers. By expressing all interactions directly in a Wannier representation derived from first-principles calculations, the approach avoids artificial fragmentation of polymer backbones and enables a consistent, material-specific description of electronic couplings and electron-phonon interactions. Low- and high-frequency vibrational modes are incorporated within a mode-resolved TPL formalism, yielding an effective electronic Hamiltonian that captures both dynamic disorder and polaronic renormalization. The methodology is demonstrated for the ambipolar crystalline naphthalenediimide-bithiophene copolymer, enabling a direct comparison of electron and hole transport along the polymer backbone and pi-stacking directions. The simulations reproduce key transport features, including pronounced anisotropy and higher electron than hole mobility. Additional studies on single- and bi-chain systems reveal the essential role of inter-chain coherence in supporting efficient transport along the polymer backbone. Beyond this specific system, the Wannier-orbital-based TPL framework provides a transferable route to disentangle intrinsic charge-transport mechanisms in crystalline pi-conjugated materials and establishes a foundation for future work.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Wannier-orbital-based formulation、first-principles calculations、simulations。；研究对象：结晶性π共轭聚合物中的电荷输运，具体材料为双极性结晶萘二酰亚胺-联噻吩共聚物（naphthalenediimide-bithiophene copolymer），关注沿聚合物主链和π-堆叠方向的电子与空穴输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于Wannier轨道的瞬态极化子局域化（TPL）框架能够定量重现该共聚物的关键输运特征，包括显著的各向异性以及电子迁移率高于空穴迁移率；同时揭示链间相干性对沿主链高效输运的必要作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于Wannier轨道的瞬态极化子局域化（TPL）框架能够定量重现该共聚物的关键输运特征，包括显著的各向异性以及电子迁移率高于空穴迁移率；同时揭示链间相干性对沿主链高效输运的必要作用。；创新点：通过Wannier表示避免了聚合物主链的人为碎片化，实现了电子耦合与电子-声子相互作用的材料特异性一致描述；该框架具有可迁移性，为解耦结晶性π共轭材料中的本征电荷输运机制提供了通用途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于第一性原理导出的Wannier表示来构建瞬态极化子局域化（TPL）框架，所有相互作用直接在Wannier基中表达；将低频和高频振动模式纳入模式分辨的TPL形式，得到包含动态无序和极化子重整化的有效电子哈密顿量。对单链和双链体系进行了对比模拟研究。

papers.title: A high-entropy form of $R$Mn$_6$Sn$_6$ with distinct magnetotransport regimes correlated to different magnetic structures
papers.abstract: The kagome $R$Mn$_6$Sn$_6$ material family has attracted significant attention as high-temperature metallic magnets with a host of different magnetic orderings and anisotropy. Theoretical studies point to the rare-earth ($R$) as the determining factor for both the direction of magnetic anisotropy and the type of magnetic ordering in a given compound. This motivates studying high-entropy forms of $R$Mn$_6$Sn$_6$ to examine how the interplay of several rare-earth elements leads to different magnetic states in a single crystal. Here, we present a rare-earth mix of Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, and Lu that produces phase transitions from a paramagnet to an easy-plane ferrimagnet (FiM) below $T_{\text{C}}$ = 380 K, then to a FiM easy-axis state at $T_{\text{SR1}}$ = 207 K, to a canted FiM ground state below $T_{\text{SR2}}$ = 79 K. This behavior is consistent with previously reported high-entropy $R$Mn$_6$Sn$_6$ compounds; however, uniquely, the rare-earth mix studied here exhibits a broad transition from easy-plane to easy-axis anisotropy from 270 K to 170 K, and reveals a nonmonotonic magnetoresistance. Using neutron scattering data, we found that both observations correlate with an incommensurate modulated contribution to the spin state due to competing rare-earth interactions. This magnetoresistive behavior and the correlated spin structures underscore the potential for rare-earth engineering of magnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“neutron scattering data”（中子散射数据），并描述了相变、磁电阻等实验观测结果。；研究对象：高熵形式的 kagome 材料 RMn₆Sn₆，其中 R 位由 Tb、Dy、Ho、Er、Tm 和 Lu 六种稀土元素混合占据。研究聚焦于该体系中不同磁性结构（易面铁磁、易轴铁磁、倾斜铁磁）与磁输运行为的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该高熵 RMn₆Sn₆ 单晶在冷却过程中经历从顺磁到易面铁磁（T_C = 380 K）、再到易轴铁磁（T_SR1 = 207 K）、最终到倾斜铁磁基态（T_SR2 = 79 K）的系列相变，并表现出非单调的磁电阻行为。中子散射表明，这些现象与稀土元素间竞争相互作用导致的自旋非公度调制分量相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该高熵 RMn₆Sn₆ 单晶在冷却过程中经历从顺磁到易面铁磁（T_C = 380 K）、再到易轴铁磁（T_SR1 = 207 K）、最终到倾斜铁磁基态（T_SR2 = 79 K）的系列相变，并表现出非单调的磁电阻行为。中子散射表明，这些现象与稀土元素间竞争相互作用导致的自旋非公度调制分量相关。；创新点：首次在 RMn₆Sn₆ 高熵体系中观察到从易面到易轴各向异性的宽温度区间（270 K–170 K）连续转变，并将非单调磁电阻与竞争稀土相互作用引起的非公度自旋调制直接关联，展示了通过稀土元素混合（“稀土工程”）调控磁性的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 单晶生长（稀土混合）、磁化率/磁化强度测量（确定相变温度与各向异性转变）、磁电阻（磁输运）测量、中子散射（确定磁结构与非公度调制）。

papers.title: Electrostatic Persistence Length Revisited. II. Simulations and Comparison to Experiment
papers.abstract: For decades, debate has surrounded the electrostatic persistence length (EPL) controlling local polyelectrolyte stiffening, centered on two competing power laws: the linear BJ prediction, $\textbf{l}_\mathrm{e} \sim r_\mathrm{D}$, and the quadratic OSF/KK scaling, $\textbf{l}_\mathrm{e} \sim r_\mathrm{D}^{2}$, where $r_\mathrm{D}$ is the Debye screening length. Building on the asymptotic scaling theory developed in the accompanying paper, we validate a complete diagram of limiting regimes using large-scale coarse-grained Monte Carlo simulations of ideal chains with charged monomers interacting through a screened Coulomb potential. By simulating long chains of up to $N \simeq 10^{4} - 10^{5}$ Kuhn segments, we demonstrate that the electrostatic stiffening of both semiflexible and flexible polyelectrolytes obeys the same quadratic OSF/KK law. We track the exponent $α$ which measures how the chain size $R$ grows with the Debye radius, $R \sim r_\mathrm{D}^α$. For both cases, in agreement with the OSF/KK theory, $α$ rises past 3/5 and slowly approaches 1 as the chain length increases, whereas within the BJ theory it can never exceed 2/5. We further find that three common size measures, the end-to-end distance $R_\mathrm{ee}$, radius of gyration $R_\mathrm{g}$, and hydrodynamic radius $R_\mathrm{h}$, reach this asymptotic behavior at progressively increasing chain lengths. Consequently, for any real polyelectrolyte, the apparent exponents obey $α_\mathrm{ee} \geq α_\mathrm{g} \geq α_\mathrm{h}$, making $R_\mathrm{g}$ a sharper experimental probe than $R_\mathrm{h}$. Finally, we re-analyze the available experimental data and show that they rule out the linear BJ law and support the quadratic KK scaling, thereby resolving contradictions that stem from mistaking the apparent slopes measured for short chains for the true asymptotic exponent.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章（兼有实验数据再分析）。关键词：coarse-grained Monte Carlo simulations、comparison to experiment。；研究对象：聚电解质（polyelectrolytes）的静电持续长度（electrostatic persistence length, EPL）及其对链刚性的影响，具体涉及半柔性（semiflexible）和柔性（flexible）聚电解质链在屏蔽库仑势作用下的尺寸标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过大规模粗粒化蒙特卡洛模拟，证明聚电解质的静电刚化效应遵循二次方OSF/KK标度律（l_e ~ r_D²），而非线性BJ律（l_e ~ r_D）；对已有实验数据的再分析也排除了BJ律，支持KK标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过大规模粗粒化蒙特卡洛模拟，证明聚电解质的静电刚化效应遵循二次方OSF/KK标度律（l_e ~ r_D²），而非线性BJ律（l_e ~ r_D）；对已有实验数据的再分析也排除了BJ律，支持KK标度。；创新点：建立了完整的极限标度行为相图，并系统揭示了三种常见尺寸量（R_ee、R_g、R_h）达到渐近标度所需链长的差异，指出R_g比R_h更适合作为实验探针；通过实验数据再分析澄清了此前因短链表观指数误判而导致的BJ与OSF/KK之争。（摘要未突出说明其他创新点）
papers.method_zh: 大规模粗粒化蒙特卡洛模拟（coarse-grained Monte Carlo simulations），模拟链长N≈10⁴–10⁵个Kuhn段，带电单体间以屏蔽库仑势（screened Coulomb potential）相互作用；同时追踪链尺寸R随Debye半径r_D的标度指数α，并比较三种尺寸量（端到端距离R_ee、回转半径R_g、流体力学半径R_h）的渐近行为；最后对已有实验数据进行重新分析。

papers.title: Vibrational, structural, and chemical fingerprints of ion diffusion in crystalline solids
papers.abstract: Predicting mobile-ion self-diffusivity $D^*$ from molecular dynamics (MD) simulations is essential for identifying promising solid-state electrolytes, but directly simulating ion diffusion is computationally expensive, particularly with high-accuracy machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). Diffusion is a slow, emergent process that requires long trajectories to converge. Thermodynamic properties, by contrast, converge much faster: the enthalpy $h$, vibrational entropy $s_{vib}$, and 2-body, excess configurational entropy $s^{ex}_{2,config}$ can be extracted from comparatively short MD trajectories, and they encode rich information about the free energy landscape from which transport properties like self-diffusivity ultimately arise. Intuitive correlations are discussed between these thermodynamic properties and ion diffusion, motivating a data-driven approach to exploit this link. A simple neural network was trained to predict diffusivity from features computed over short MD trajectories: a vibrational fingerprint (the vibrational density of states, VDOS) and a structural fingerprint (the radial distribution function, RDF), conditioned on chemistry information encoded in the MLIP embedding. This combination allows the model to predict the converged $\log_{10} D^*$ (cm$^2$/s) \textemdash\ normally obtained from significantly longer MD simulations \textemdash\ with a mean absolute error of 0.398 and a Spearman's rank correlation $ρ$ of 0.844.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到分子动力学（MD）模拟、机器学习原子间势（MLIP）、神经网络训练等计算手段。；研究对象：晶态固体中的离子扩散现象，具体关注固态电解质中可移动离子的自扩散系数 D*，以及其与热力学性质（焓、振动熵、构型熵）之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从短时间 MD 轨迹中提取的振动指纹（振动态密度 VDOS）和结构指纹（径向分布函数 RDF），结合化学信息，可以高精度预测本需长轨迹模拟才能收敛的离子自扩散系数 log₁₀D*，平均绝对误差为 0.398，Spearman 秩相关系数为 0.844。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从短时间 MD 轨迹中提取的振动指纹（振动态密度 VDOS）和结构指纹（径向分布函数 RDF），结合化学信息，可以高精度预测本需长轨迹模拟才能收敛的离子自扩散系数 log₁₀D*，平均绝对误差为 0.398，Spearman 秩相关系数为 0.844。；创新点：提出了一种数据驱动的方法，利用短 MD 轨迹中快速收敛的热力学指纹（振动与结构）来替代昂贵的长轨迹扩散模拟，从而显著降低高精度 MLIP 下预测离子扩散系数的计算成本。摘要未突出说明与已有机器学习预测扩散方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟（短轨迹提取热力学量）；机器学习原子间势（MLIP）用于描述原子间相互作用；神经网络模型用于预测扩散系数，输入特征为 VDOS 和 RDF，并利用 MLIP 嵌入中的化学信息作为条件。

papers.title: Electrostatic Persistence Length Revisited. I. Theory
papers.abstract: The problem of single-chain conformations of polyelectrolytes in salt-added dilute solutions, and the associated concept of the electrostatic persistence length $\textbf{l}_\mathrm{e}$, has remained unresolved for decades. To address this challenge, we develop a comprehensive scaling theory and corroborate it with simulations. A unified scaling diagram is constructed that encompasses both flexible and intrinsically semiflexible/stiff polyelectrolytes. Nine distinct scaling regimes are identified, each characterized by different conformational statistics. The concept of the Gaussian electrostatic blob $ξ_\mathrm{e}$ used in the description of flexible polyelectrolytes is extended to the semiflexible case, and the new characteristic length $ξ_\mathrm{e}^{|}$ referred to as the rodlike electrostatic blob is introduced. This enables delineating the important crossovers and showcasing an analogy between semiflexible and flexible chains. The concept of electrostatic excluded volume is also reconsidered and generalized. Upon increasing the salt concentration, i.e., decreasing the Debye length $r_\mathrm{D}$, chain conformations evolve from (i) rodlike stretches to (ii) Gaussian and then (iii) swollen coils with local electrostatic stiffening characterized by $\textbf{l}_\mathrm{e}$, followed by (iv) swollen coils without stiffening but with electrostatic exclude volume, and finally to (v) quasi-neutral Gaussian coils. In regimes of type (ii) and (iii), the electrostatic persistence length scales quadratically with $r_\mathrm{D}$, in agreement with the OSF and KK predictions for semiflexible and flexible chains, respectively: $\textbf{l}_\mathrm{\mathrm{OSF}} \simeq r_\mathrm{D}^{2}/ξ_\mathrm{e}^{|}$ and $\textbf{l}_\mathrm{\mathrm{KK}} \simeq r_\mathrm{D}^{2}/ξ_\mathrm{e}$. These asymptotic scalings are confirmed by coarse-grained simulations presented in the accompanying article.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有模拟验证）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a comprehensive scaling theory and corroborate it with simulations”，属于理论+粗粒化模拟的混合类型，但以理论为主。；研究对象：盐溶液中聚电解质的单链构象问题，特别是静电持续长度（electrostatic persistence length, l_e）的概念及其标度行为。体系涵盖柔性聚电解质和本征半柔性/刚性聚电解质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构建了涵盖柔性与半柔性聚电解质的统一标度图，识别出九个不同的构象标度区。随着盐浓度增加（Debye长度 r_D 减小），链构象依次经历棒状拉伸、高斯链、局部静电刚化的溶胀链、无刚化但有静电排除体积的溶胀链，最终过渡到准中性高斯链。在特定标度区中，静电持续长度与 r_D 呈二次方标度关系，分别符合OSF和KK预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构建了涵盖柔性与半柔性聚电解质的统一标度图，识别出九个不同的构象标度区。随着盐浓度增加（Debye长度 r_D 减小），链构象依次经历棒状拉伸、高斯链、局部静电刚化的溶胀链、无刚化但有静电排除体积的溶胀链，最终过渡到准中性高斯链。在特定标度区中，静电持续长度与 r_D 呈二次方标度关系，分别符合OSF和KK预测。；创新点：首次将柔性聚电解质的静电blob概念系统推广至半柔性链，引入“棒状静电blob”这一新特征长度，从而统一描述了柔性与半柔性聚电解质的构象标度行为，并厘清了OSF与KK两种静电持续长度预测的适用范围。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为标度理论（scaling theory），引入了高斯静电blob（ξ_e）向半柔性情形的推广，并定义了新的特征长度——棒状静电blob（ξ_e^|）。同时重新审视并推广了静电排除体积的概念。模拟验证采用粗粒化模拟（coarse-grained simulations），具体细节在配套文章中给出。

papers.title: Investigating Sulfur Vacancy Passivation in Monolayer MoS2 FETs via Optically Coupled Low-Frequency Electrical Noise Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers are promising materials for electronic and photonic applications, yet the performance of chemical vapour deposition grown films is severely limited by native sulphur vacancies that introduce mid-gap trap states, degrade carrier mobility, and elevate electrical noise. Here we investigate octane thiol passivation of sulphur vacancies in monolayer MoS2 field effect transistors, combining x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, photoluminescence, and Raman scattering with electrical transport and optically coupled low-frequency noise spectroscopy. Thiol treatment reduces the sulphur vacancy concentration from 7.5% to 5%, which increases the channel resistance 35-fold while restoring gate switching with an on/off ratio of 10^4 and improving field-effect mobility from 1 to 5 cm^2/Vs. Low frequency noise spectroscopy directly quantifies the defect suppression: the Hooge parameter drops by more than two orders of magnitude after passivation. Gate-dependent noise confirms carrier mobility fluctuation as the dominant dark noise mechanism, while optical excitation drives a crossover to carrier number fluctuation dominated noise, reflecting preferential interaction of photogenerated carriers with residual vacancy states via generation-recombination trapping, a mechanistic distinction inaccessible to gate- bias measurements alone. Density functional theory calculations corroborate these findings, showing suppression of vacancy-induced mid-gap states by more than 50% and partial restoration of the intrinsic bandgap. These results establish optically coupled low-frequency noise spectroscopy as a sensitive, low-cost, and non-destructive tool for quantifying defect passivation in TMDC-based devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，辅以计算验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combining x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, photoluminescence, and Raman scattering with electrical transport and optically coupled low-frequency noise spectroscopy”等实验手段，同时包含“Density functional theory calculations”进行理论佐证。；研究对象：单层二硫化钼（monolayer MoS2）场效应晶体管（FET）中的硫空位（sulfur vacancy）缺陷及其钝化处理（octane thiol passivation，辛硫醇钝化）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 辛硫醇钝化可将单层MoS2 FET中的硫空位浓度从7.5%降至5%，使Hooge参数下降两个数量级以上，同时将场效应迁移率从1提升至5 cm²/Vs，并恢复10⁴的开关比。光耦合低频噪声谱揭示了暗态下载流子迁移率涨落主导噪声、光照下转变为载流子数涨落主导的机制转变，这一区分是纯栅压测量无法实现的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：辛硫醇钝化可将单层MoS2 FET中的硫空位浓度从7.5%降至5%，使Hooge参数下降两个数量级以上，同时将场效应迁移率从1提升至5 cm²/Vs，并恢复10⁴的开关比。光耦合低频噪声谱揭示了暗态下载流子迁移率涨落主导噪声、光照下转变为载流子数涨落主导的机制转变，这一区分是纯栅压测量无法实现的。；创新点：将低频噪声谱与光学激发相结合，实现了对暗态与光照下噪声机制的区分（迁移率涨落 vs. 载流子数涨落），从而直接量化缺陷钝化效果，这是一种对栅压测量不敏感的机制性区分手段。摘要未突出说明该技术是否首次用于TMDC体系，但明确强调其作为“sensitive, low-cost, and non-destructive tool”的潜力。
papers.method_zh: - X射线光电子能谱（XPS）：定量硫空位浓度

papers.title: A minimal mechanism to generate long timescales without fine tuning
papers.abstract: Long timescales in brain dynamics give rise to power law correlations measured in experiments. A simple linear recurrent neural network model can reproduce this power law behavior, but the recurrent interaction strength needs to be fine tuned in order to sit at the edge of stability. We show that by adding a dynamical recurrent feedback gain to the simple linear model removes the need for fine tuning, because the gain self-organizes so that the spectrum of the effective recurrent matrix is always gapless with the top eigenvalue landing on the stability edge for any recurrent strength. As a consequence, long timescales and scale free correlations arise generically, as we demonstrate both analytically and numerically.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值验证）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“analytically and numerically”，核心是理论模型分析与推导。；研究对象：大脑动力学中的长时间尺度与幂律关联现象，具体为一个线性循环神经网络（linear recurrent neural network）模型及其动力学稳定性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过向简单线性循环网络引入动态的循环反馈增益（dynamical recurrent feedback gain），系统无需精细调节即可自组织地使有效循环矩阵的谱保持无隙（gapless），最大本征值始终落在稳定性边缘，从而普遍产生长时间尺度与无标度关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过向简单线性循环网络引入动态的循环反馈增益（dynamical recurrent feedback gain），系统无需精细调节即可自组织地使有效循环矩阵的谱保持无隙（gapless），最大本征值始终落在稳定性边缘，从而普遍产生长时间尺度与无标度关联。；创新点：提出了一种无需精细调节即可产生长时标的“最小机制”——通过动态反馈增益的自组织替代传统模型中对手征相互作用强度的临界微调，使系统对任意循环强度均自动处于临界边缘。摘要未突出说明与具体生物实验或脑区数据的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析（线性循环神经网络模型的谱性质与稳定性分析）结合数值模拟。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如蒙特卡洛、ODE求解等），仅提及“numerically”。

papers.title: Noise-Robust Spin-Orbit Qubit in Germanium Holes via p-Orbital Encoding
papers.abstract: Germanium hole spin qubits are a leading platform for semiconductor quantum computation due to their strong spin-orbit coupling, all-electrical operability, and absence of valley degeneracy. A central obstacle is charge noise, which couples to the qubit through the same spin-orbit interaction that enables fast electrical control. In this work, we propose a new operational mode of a three-hole quantum dot in a planar Ge/SiGe heterostructure, modeled within a four-band Luttinger-Kohn--Bir-Pikus framework: a spin-$p$-orbital (SpO) qubit encoded in the $p$-shell of the topmost hole. We characterize charge noise sweet spots in the parameter space of electrostatic confinement and magnetic field, and estimate that relaxation rates of the SpO qubit are comparable to those of spin qubits hosted in single holes. We then design and optimize an all-electrical Landau-Zener state-transfer protocol that induces logical qubit state transitions without microwave driving, and we show that the quadrupole-quadrupole Coulomb interaction between neighboring dots enables fast two-qubit entangling gates operated by adiabatic shuttling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“modeled within a four-band Luttinger-Kohn--Bir-Pikus framework”“estimate”“design and optimize”等理论建模与数值设计关键词，未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：平面Ge/SiGe异质结中的三空穴量子点，具体为最顶层空穴的p壳层编码的自旋-轨道（SpO）量子比特，以及相邻量子点间的四极-四极库仑相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于锗空穴p轨道编码的新型自旋-轨道量子比特（SpO qubit），该量子比特在静电约束和磁场参数空间中存在电荷噪声“甜点”（sweet spots），其弛豫率与单空穴自旋量子比特相当；并设计了无需微波驱动的全电学Landau-Zener态转移协议及基于绝热穿梭的两量子比特纠缠门。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于锗空穴p轨道编码的新型自旋-轨道量子比特（SpO qubit），该量子比特在静电约束和磁场参数空间中存在电荷噪声“甜点”（sweet spots），其弛豫率与单空穴自旋量子比特相当；并设计了无需微波驱动的全电学Landau-Zener态转移协议及基于绝热穿梭的两量子比特纠缠门。；创新点：首次提出在锗空穴量子点的p壳层（而非传统s壳层）编码自旋-轨道量子比特，利用p轨道特性实现电荷噪声抑制，并展示了无需微波驱动的全电学操控方案及基于库仑四极相互作用的快速两比特门。摘要未突出说明与已有单空穴自旋量子比特方案在噪声鲁棒性上的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用四带Luttinger-Kohn–Bir-Pikus框架对平面Ge/SiGe异质结中的三空穴量子点进行建模；通过参数空间扫描表征电荷噪声甜点；计算自旋弛豫率；设计并优化全电学Landau-Zener态转移协议；分析相邻量子点间的四极-四极库仑相互作用以实现两比特门。

papers.title: Automated Analysis to Reveal Grain Boundary Phase Microstructures
papers.abstract: We develop a method for analyzing grain boundary (GB) microstructures that identifies distinct interfacial phases and the dislocation line defects separating them. Similar to bulk materials, GBs can adopt multiple distinct interfacial phases and undergo first-order phase transitions. When these phases coexist, their spatial arrangement and phase junctions constitute a GB microstructure, characterized by variations in excess properties and line defects with associated dislocation content. Despite this intrinsic heterogeneity, our ability to quantitatively characterize GB microstructures remains limited, as it requires identification of individual GB phases, phase-resolved excess properties, and the Burgers content of phase junctions, capabilities not available in existing automated methods. Here, we present an automated tool that performs interfacial microstructure mapping for planar coincidence site lattice GBs. The method identifies the spatial distribution of GB phases, quantifies phase-specific excess properties, and estimates the Burgers content of GB phase junctions. We demonstrate the approach using three representative cases: (i) quantification of mass transport during diffusion-limited GB phase transformations; (ii) identification of structurally indistinguishable phases formed by vacancy and interstitial loops; and (iii) characterization of GB microstructures containing phase nuclei. More broadly, this framework enables quantitative studies of GB evolution processes, including spinodal decomposition and coarsening with direct implications for GB deformation, creep, and migration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：摘要强调“develop a method”“automated tool”“quantify”，属于计算方法与数据分析框架开发。；研究对象：晶界（grain boundary, GB）微观结构，具体为平面重合位置点阵（planar coincidence site lattice）晶界中的界面相（interfacial phases）、相结（phase junctions）及其位错线缺陷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种自动化分析工具，能够对晶界微观结构进行空间映射，识别不同界面相、量化各相的超额性质（excess properties），并估算相结的Burgers矢量含量，从而实现对晶界相变、扩散控制相转变及相成核等过程的定量表征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种自动化分析工具，能够对晶界微观结构进行空间映射，识别不同界面相、量化各相的超额性质（excess properties），并估算相结的Burgers矢量含量，从而实现对晶界相变、扩散控制相转变及相成核等过程的定量表征。；创新点：现有自动化方法无法同时完成晶界相识别、相分辨超额性质测量和相结Burgers含量估算，该工作首次提供了完整的自动化晶界微观结构映射工具，并展示了其在晶界自旋分解、粗化及变形/蠕变/迁移研究中的潜在应用。
papers.method_zh: 自动化界面微观结构映射算法，用于平面CSL晶界。具体功能包括：识别晶界相的空间分布、量化相分辨的超额性质、估算相结的Burgers含量。通过三个代表性案例验证：扩散限制晶界相变中的质量输运定量、空位与间隙原子环形成的结构不可区分相的识别、含相核的晶界微观结构表征。

papers.title: High Speed Contact-Resonance Tracking using Brownian motion
papers.abstract: Contact-resonance atomic force microscopy (CR-AFM) provides nanoscale maps of contact stiffness, dissipation, and electromechanical response, but conventional piezoacoustic excitation can obscure the cantilever resonance with actuator and sample-holder modes. Pure Brownian excitation avoids this transfer-function background, yet its small amplitude generally requires averaging that is incompatible with routine imaging. We introduce interferometric dual-AC resonance tracking (iDART), which combines quadrature-phase differential interferometry with two-frequency resonance tracking. By positioning the interferometric spot near the displacement maximum of the first contact-resonance mode, the detector noise floor is reduced below the off-resonance thermal displacement of the cantilever. Brownian spectra identify the contact mode and define the tracking frequencies, while active electrical excitation provides the signal-to-noise ratio required for pixel-resolved imaging. Simultaneous low-frequency and resonant measurements show that both electrical and photothermal drive increases contrast in the amplitude and phase channels without appreciably shifting the contact resonance. These results establish a practical route to resonance-enhanced, drive free nanomechanical imaging at conventional AFM scan rates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：introduce、measurements、imaging、experimental setup（干涉仪、AFM扫描）。；研究对象：接触共振原子力显微镜（CR-AFM）中的纳米力学成像，具体涉及悬臂梁的布朗运动激发、接触刚度/耗散/机电响应的纳米尺度映射，以及电驱动和光热驱动下的共振行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将干涉仪探测点置于第一接触共振模位移最大处，可将探测器噪声底降至悬臂梁非共振热位移以下，从而利用布朗运动谱识别接触模式并定义跟踪频率，同时结合主动电激励实现像素级成像，且电/光热驱动不显著移动接触共振频率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将干涉仪探测点置于第一接触共振模位移最大处，可将探测器噪声底降至悬臂梁非共振热位移以下，从而利用布朗运动谱识别接触模式并定义跟踪频率，同时结合主动电激励实现像素级成像，且电/光热驱动不显著移动接触共振频率。；创新点：首次将纯布朗运动激发与干涉式双频跟踪结合，在常规AFM扫描速率下实现无驱动器背景、共振增强的纳米力学成像，避免了传统压电声学激发中执行器/样品架模式对悬臂共振的干扰。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：干涉式双交流共振跟踪（iDART），结合正交相位差分干涉仪与双频共振跟踪；使用布朗运动（无驱动）激发获取接触共振谱，辅以主动电激励和光热激励进行成像；同时进行低频与共振频率的同步测量。

papers.title: Machine-learned exchange-correlation functionals for molecules, solids, and reactive surfaces
papers.abstract: The application of density functional theory to heterogeneous catalysis is hindered by the shortcomings of conventional density functional approximations. We combine machine learning with explicitly non-local physically informed descriptors and introduce an exchange-correlation functional (CIDER26SS) framework regularized for wide transferability. CIDER26SS is size-extensive, highly efficient, provides a balanced and accurate description of both molecular and solid-state systems, and is specifically well-optimized for transition metal surface chemistry. Surpassing existing conventional functionals, CIDER26SS resolves the CO/Pt puzzle, identifying the correct binding site for CO adsorption on the Pt(111) surface, along with an accurate adsorption energy, Pt lattice constant, and surface energy. Predictions agree well with the experimental values, even when all bulk and surface data for Pt are excluded from the training set. Remarkably, CIDER26SS exceeds the accuracy of semilocal approximations even for systems far outside the training domain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“machine learning”“exchange-correlation functional”“density functional theory”等关键词，属于密度泛函理论框架下的方法开发与验证。；研究对象：分子、固体以及过渡金属表面（特别是Pt(111)表面上的CO吸附体系），涉及异相催化中的表面化学问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 新提出的机器学习交换关联泛函CIDER26SS能够解决CO/Pt(111)吸附位点难题（即“CO/Pt puzzle”），给出正确的吸附位点、准确的吸附能、Pt晶格常数和表面能，且预测与实验值吻合良好，即使训练集中完全排除Pt的所有体相和表面数据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：新提出的机器学习交换关联泛函CIDER26SS能够解决CO/Pt(111)吸附位点难题（即“CO/Pt puzzle”），给出正确的吸附位点、准确的吸附能、Pt晶格常数和表面能，且预测与实验值吻合良好，即使训练集中完全排除Pt的所有体相和表面数据。；创新点：CIDER26SS在单一泛函框架内同时实现对分子和固态体系的平衡且准确描述，并专门针对过渡金属表面化学进行了优化；其超越传统半局域泛函的精度在训练域之外的体系上依然成立，且对Pt的预测是在完全排除Pt训练数据的情况下实现的，体现了强外推能力。
papers.method_zh: 将机器学习与非局域物理信息描述符（explicitly non-local physically informed descriptors）相结合，构建了具有广泛可迁移性的交换关联泛函框架CIDER26SS，并对其进行了正则化处理。该泛函具有尺寸外推性（size-extensive）和高计算效率。

papers.title: Theory of the Spinon-Mediated Witness Spin Glass in Herbertsmithite
papers.abstract: Herbertsmithite is a prototypical candidate quantum spin liquid (QSL), believed to feature a long-range entangled ground state and deconfined fractionalised spinon excitations. Confirmation of these properties has been hindered by the presence of magnetic impurities (spin-1/2 Cu2+ spins substituted onto non-magnetic Zn2+ sites). Recently these impurities were reconceptualised as 'witnesses' of the QSL, inheriting long-range interactions and entanglement mediated by the QSL spinons, leading to spin glass formation amongst witnesses below 260 mK. Here we present a full theoretical account of this idea. Despite having only one free parameter (the witness-kagome spin coupling), our model captures the full range of experimental data, including: the formation of a spin glass amongst witnesses; the frequency and temperature dependence of the magnetic noise; a sharp peak in the DC magnetic susceptibility as a function of temperature; and the static neutron scattering structure factor at 2 K. Both candidate QSLs (Z2 and U(1)) give similar agreement with all data; however, our model predicts a qualitative difference between the Z2 and U(1) neutron scattering intensities below 260 mK, providing a long-sought definitive test to distinguish the two cases. We also predict phase diagrams as a function of temperature and witness concentration, finding a phase transition to different long-range ordered witness states for Z2 and U(1) at high concentration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Theory of...”“Here we present a full theoretical account”“our model predicts”等表述，属于理论建模与预测。；研究对象：Herbertsmithite（一种候选量子自旋液体材料）中的“见证自旋玻璃”现象，具体为磁性杂质（替代非磁性Zn²⁺位点的自旋-1/2 Cu²⁺）在量子自旋液体自旋子（spinon）介导下形成的自旋玻璃态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅含一个自由参数（见证自旋与kagome自旋耦合）的模型即可定量解释Herbertsmithite中自旋玻璃形成、磁噪声、直流磁化率峰及中子散射结构因子等全部实验数据；模型预测Z₂和U(1)两种候选量子自旋液体在260 mK以下的中子散射强度存在定性差异，可提供区分二者的决定性实验判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅含一个自由参数（见证自旋与kagome自旋耦合）的模型即可定量解释Herbertsmithite中自旋玻璃形成、磁噪声、直流磁化率峰及中子散射结构因子等全部实验数据；模型预测Z₂和U(1)两种候选量子自旋液体在260 mK以下的中子散射强度存在定性差异，可提供区分二者的决定性实验判据。；创新点：首次对“见证自旋玻璃”机制给出完整理论描述，并预言Z₂与U(1)量子自旋液体在中子散射强度上的定性区别，为长期悬而未决的两种QSL类型判别提供了可实验检验的方案。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：构建见证自旋与kagome自旋（自旋子）耦合的唯象模型，分别针对Z₂和U(1)两种量子自旋液体类型进行计算，并与实验数据（磁噪声的频率/温度依赖、直流磁化率、静态中子散射结构因子）进行对比；同时计算温度-见证浓度相图。

papers.title: All-Optical Control of Interfacial Polarization in MoS$_2$/WSe$_2$ Heterobilayers
papers.abstract: All-optical tuning of van der Waals heterostructures with coherent radiation offers a promising path toward ultrafast memory and optoelectronic devices. In the first-principles framework of real-time time-dependent density functional theory, we predict the induction of a persistent, long-lived out-of-plane polarization in MoS$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterobilayers, resonantly driven by intense ultrafast pulses. While weak fields preserve the intrinsic type-II band alignment, intermediate intensities trigger a four-fold enhancement of interlayer charge transfer. By analyzing the high-harmonic generation spectrum, we identify a transition from the perturbative to the strong-field regime inducing photoinduced interfacial polarity. We additionally show that lattice strain, ubiquitously present in heterobilayers, can be used as additional knob to adjust the resonant condition without compromising the permanent dipole induction. Our findings provide a theoretical blueprint for the all-optical manipulation of polar phases in low-dimensional heterostructures at the femtosecond scale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles framework of real-time time-dependent density functional theory”（第一性原理实时含时密度泛函理论），属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层（van der Waals 异质结）中的界面极化现象，具体关注超快激光脉冲驱动的层间电荷转移与面外极化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层中，利用强超快激光脉冲可以共振诱导出持久、长寿命的面外极化；中等光强可使层间电荷转移增强四倍，并伴随从微扰区到强场区的转变，从而实现全光调控界面极性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层中，利用强超快激光脉冲可以共振诱导出持久、长寿命的面外极化；中等光强可使层间电荷转移增强四倍，并伴随从微扰区到强场区的转变，从而实现全光调控界面极性。；创新点：首次在实时 TDDFT 框架下预测了 MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层中全光诱导的持久面外极化，并揭示了从微扰到强场区的跃迁特征；此外，提出利用普遍存在的晶格应变作为额外调控手段来调节共振条件，而不牺牲永久偶极的诱导。
papers.method_zh: 实时含时密度泛函理论（rt-TDDFT），并结合高次谐波产生（HHG）光谱分析来识别光场驱动机制；同时考虑了晶格应变对共振条件的调控作用。

papers.title: Dynamical Signatures and Kibble-Zurek Scaling of Localization in Tilted Bose-Einstein Condensates
papers.abstract: We study nonequilibrium signatures of tilt-induced localization in a one-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensate loaded in a shallow optical lattice. The tilt strength acts as a control parameter for the localization-delocalization crossover. We also consider the effects of repulsive interactions, which tend to delocalize the condensate. We first characterize localized and delocalized regimes through sudden quenches of the interaction strength and the external tilt. The resulting dynamics is analyzed using the survival probability and its power spectral density. Localized condensates exhibit strong memory retention, pronounced revivals, regular dynamics and a narrow spectral response, whereas delocalized condensates show suppressed recurrences, irregular dynamics and a broader distribution of spectral weight over many frequencies. We then investigate finite-rate ramps of the tilt strength across the localization threshold. Using the localization length and the Bogoliubov excitation gap, we extract the relevant critical exponents and perform Kibble-Zurek scaling analysis in the driven dynamics. Our results establish quench response and finite-rate scaling as complementary dynamical probes of localization in interacting Bose gases, with direct relevance to cold-atom experiments in tilted optical lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“sudden quenches”“finite-rate ramps”“Kibble-Zurek scaling analysis”等，属于对动力学过程的数值模拟与标度分析，未涉及实验装置或实测数据。；研究对象：一维浅光晶格中倾斜诱导局域化的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC），重点研究倾斜强度与排斥相互作用共同调控的局域化-去局域化交叉行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域化凝聚体表现出强记忆保持、显著回波、规则动力学和窄谱响应；去局域化凝聚体则呈现抑制的回波、不规则动力学和宽频分布。通过有限速率倾斜扫描，提取了临界指数并建立了Kibble-Zurek标度关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域化凝聚体表现出强记忆保持、显著回波、规则动力学和窄谱响应；去局域化凝聚体则呈现抑制的回波、不规则动力学和宽频分布。通过有限速率倾斜扫描，提取了临界指数并建立了Kibble-Zurek标度关系。；创新点：将淬火响应与有限速率标度相结合，作为相互作用玻色气体中局域化的互补动力学探针，为倾斜光晶格冷原子实验提供了可直接检验的动力学判据。
papers.method_zh: 通过相互作用强度和外部倾斜的突然淬火（sudden quenches）研究动力学，使用存活概率（survival probability）及其功率谱密度（power spectral density）分析局域化特征；通过有限速率倾斜扫描，利用局域化长度和Bogoliubov激发能隙提取临界指数，并进行Kibble-Zurek标度分析。

papers.title: Electrostatic lens of a charged vortex
papers.abstract: We study the local electrostatic response of a charged superfluid in the presence of a cylindrically symmetric vortex, allowing both the particle density and the thermodynamic compressibility to vary with the radial coordinate. Starting from the electrostatic charge response obtained from the phase-only Popov action, we introduce a local-density extension and derive the regular near-axis expansion of the scalar potential. The constant, quadratic, and quartic coefficients are obtained explicitly in terms of the local screening response and of the leading nonuniform contribution to the vortex density profile. For a three-dimensional unitary Fermi equation of state, the density dependence of the compressibility generates a definite thermodynamic contribution to the quartic coefficient. The resulting decomposition separates this equation-of-state contribution from the ordinary constant-screening and charge-source terms that occur at the same order. This provides a compact analytical connection between vortex-core thermodynamics and the local electrostatic profile of a charged superfluid.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Popov作用量”“局域密度扩展”“解析推导”等理论物理方法，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：带电超流体中柱对称涡旋的局域静电响应，具体关注粒子密度与热力学压缩率随径向坐标变化时，标量电势在涡旋轴附近的展开行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维幺正费米气体状态方程下，压缩率对密度的依赖会在电势四次方系数中产生确定的热力学贡献，从而可将该状态方程贡献与同阶的常数屏蔽项和电荷源项清晰分离，建立涡旋芯热力学与带电超流体局域静电势之间的紧凑解析联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维幺正费米气体状态方程下，压缩率对密度的依赖会在电势四次方系数中产生确定的热力学贡献，从而可将该状态方程贡献与同阶的常数屏蔽项和电荷源项清晰分离，建立涡旋芯热力学与带电超流体局域静电势之间的紧凑解析联系。；创新点：首次将涡旋芯的热力学性质（通过压缩率的密度依赖）与带电超流体的局域静电势剖面在解析层面直接关联，并给出四次方系数的明确分解方案。摘要未突出说明与已有涡旋静电研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 从仅含相位自由度的Popov作用量出发推导静电电荷响应，引入局域密度近似扩展，并解析推导标量电势在轴附近的规则展开（常数项、二次项、四次项系数），系数用局域屏蔽响应和涡旋密度剖面的非均匀贡献显式表达。

papers.title: Power Series for the Quantum Statistical Mechanics Probability with Results for the Second Virial Coefficient of Helium
papers.abstract: A power series for the Wigner-Kirkwood pair commutation function for quantum statistical mechanics in classical phase space is given with terms automatically generated by recursion. The calculated second virial coefficient agrees with the measured values of helium for temperatures greater than 65 K. Prospects for a general quantum Monte Carlo algorithm are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“power series”“recursion”“quantum Monte Carlo algorithm”等理论推导与算法讨论关键词。；研究对象：量子统计力学中经典相空间内的Wigner-Kirkwood对易函数（pair commutation function），以及氦气的第二维里系数（second virial coefficient）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过递归自动生成的幂级数计算得到的氦气第二维里系数，在温度高于65 K时与实验测量值一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过递归自动生成的幂级数计算得到的氦气第二维里系数，在温度高于65 K时与实验测量值一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其创新在于以递归方式自动生成幂级数项，避免了手动推导高阶项的繁琐，并展示了该级数在真实体系（氦气）维里系数计算中的定量准确性。
papers.method_zh: 采用递归方法自动生成Wigner-Kirkwood对易函数的幂级数展开项，并基于该级数计算第二维里系数；同时讨论了将该方法推广为通用量子蒙特卡洛算法的前景。

papers.title: Reentrant Localization Transition in a Quasiperiodic Thue-Morse Chain
papers.abstract: We investigate single-particle localization in a dimerized Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) chain with a quasiperiodic onsite potential masked by the deterministic Thue--Morse sequence. Using exact diagonalization, we map the localization behavior as a function of the quasiperiodic potential strength and hopping dimerization through the correlation dimension, inverse participation ratio, and normalized participation ratio. For appropriate hopping ratios, increasing the potential strength drives the mid-spectrum states through a localized--multifractal--localized sequence, producing a reentrant recovery of participation before localization is restored at stronger modulation. Energy-resolved diagnostics show that this recovery is concentrated in the central spectral region rather than occurring uniformly throughout the spectrum. Extrapolations of the generalized dimensions to the thermodynamic limit reveal a systematic moment-dependent hierarchy in the reentrant window, accompanied by a broadened thermodynamic-limit singularity spectrum. Real- and momentum-space diagnostics provide complementary evidence for multifractal scaling in this regime, while two-size crossings yield finite-size estimates of the reentrant boundaries. Comparisons with random, globally balanced, pair-canceling, and block-permuted masks show that short-range sign anticorrelation promotes reentrance when it is aligned with the dominant SSH hopping bonds. The resulting reduction of the onsite mismatch across the strong bonds provides an effective-dimer interpretation of the reentrant response, while longer-range Thue--Morse correlations modify its location and strength.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用精确对角化”（exact diagonalization），并涉及数值诊断量（关联维数、逆参与率、归一化参与率）及热力学极限外推。；研究对象：具有Thue-Morse准周期在位势的二聚化Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链中的单粒子局域化现象，重点研究局域化-多分形-再入局域化的转变序列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在适当的跳跃二聚化比值下，增大准周期势强度会使谱中态经历“局域化→多分形→再入局域化”的序列，即在更强调制下最终恢复局域化之前，参与率出现再入式恢复；该恢复集中在谱的中央区域而非全谱均匀发生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在适当的跳跃二聚化比值下，增大准周期势强度会使谱中态经历“局域化→多分形→再入局域化”的序列，即在更强调制下最终恢复局域化之前，参与率出现再入式恢复；该恢复集中在谱的中央区域而非全谱均匀发生。；创新点：首次在Thue-Morse准周期SSH链中揭示再入局域化转变，并指出短程符号反关联（与主导SSH跳跃键对齐时）是促进再入的关键机制；提出“有效二聚体”图像解释再入响应，同时表明长程Thue-Morse关联会调制再入的位置和强度。
papers.method_zh: 精确对角化（exact diagonalization）；计算关联维数（correlation dimension）、逆参与率（inverse participation ratio）、归一化参与率（normalized participation ratio）；广义维数热力学极限外推；实空间与动量空间诊断；双尺寸交叉（two-size crossings）估计再入边界；与随机、全局平衡、成对抵消、块置换等掩码进行对比。

papers.title: Dissipation-induced Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev physics in many-body cavity quantum electrodynamics
papers.abstract: We show that cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) devices can realize dissipative Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) physics, a paradigmatic setting for quantum chaos in open many-body systems. Ultracold fermions with disordered, all-to-all cavity-mediated interactions provide two complementary routes: atomic spontaneous emission in a single-mode cavity and photon leakage from a multimode cavity. Strikingly, both converge to the same non-Hermitian random-matrix universality despite originating from integrable and chaotic closed-system limits, respectively. In the single-mode case, dissipation therefore creates quantum chaos from an integrable Hamiltonian. We trace this convergence to a tunable growth in dissipative rank, controlled, respectively, by the Lamb-Dicke parameter and the cavity-mode spacing. The resulting chaos leaves a dynamical fingerprint: a crossover from long-lived prethermal memory to rapid thermalization, visible in single-atom-resolved densities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show that... can realize...”“provide two complementary routes”等表述，属于理论分析与模型构建，未提及实验数据或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：腔量子电动力学（cavity QED）装置中的多体开放量子系统，具体为超冷费米子与腔模耦合形成的耗散Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SYK）物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单模腔中的原子自发辐射与多模腔中的光子泄漏两种耗散机制，均能使系统收敛到相同的非厄米随机矩阵普适类，从而在开放多体系统中实现耗散诱导的SYK量子混沌。特别地，在单模情形下，耗散可从可积哈密顿量中产生量子混沌。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单模腔中的原子自发辐射与多模腔中的光子泄漏两种耗散机制，均能使系统收敛到相同的非厄米随机矩阵普适类，从而在开放多体系统中实现耗散诱导的SYK量子混沌。特别地，在单模情形下，耗散可从可积哈密顿量中产生量子混沌。；创新点：首次提出腔QED装置可作为耗散SYK物理的实现平台，并揭示两种物理起源不同的耗散通道（可积与混沌闭系统极限）收敛到同一非厄米普适类，且将耗散秩的可调增长与混沌涌现建立联系。摘要未突出说明与已有SYK实验方案的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：非厄米随机矩阵理论、SYK模型分析；具体机制包括：单模腔原子自发辐射（由Lamb-Dicke参数控制耗散秩）、多模腔光子泄漏（由腔模间距控制耗散秩），并分析单原子分辨密度中的动力学指纹（预热记忆到快速热化的交叉）。

papers.title: Inertial synchronization of networked oscillators in arbitrary dimensions
papers.abstract: The Kuramoto model provides a paradigmatic framework for studying synchronization of interacting oscillators, and has been generalized to arbitrary dimensions to describe swarms, flocks and multi-dimensional opinion dynamics. Yet, existing formulations neglect inertia, a key mechanism known to enhance information propagation and collective responsiveness. Here, we introduce and analyze an inertial Kuramoto model in arbitrary dimensions.
