We show that inertia fundamentally alters the nature of the synchronization transition, inducing a crossover from continuous to discontinuous behavior, with the onset of hysteresis depending explicitly on both inertia and dimensionality parity. Our analytical theory is supported by extensive numerical simulations. These results establish inertia as a crucial ingredient of high-dimensional collective dynamics and reveal a novel universal structure in synchronization phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中出现“analytical theory”“extensive numerical simulations”。；研究对象：任意维度下的惯性Kuramoto模型，用于描述振荡器网络、群体运动（swarms、flocks）及多维意见动力学中的同步现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 惯性会从根本上改变同步相变的性质，使连续相变转变为不连续（跳变）相变，且迟滞现象的出现与否同时依赖于惯性大小和系统维度的奇偶性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：惯性会从根本上改变同步相变的性质，使连续相变转变为不连续（跳变）相变，且迟滞现象的出现与否同时依赖于惯性大小和系统维度的奇偶性。；创新点：首次在任意维度下引入惯性项推广Kuramoto模型，揭示了惯性对高维集体动力学中同步转变普适结构的关键影响。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论分析（推导同步转变的临界行为与迟滞条件）结合大规模数值模拟验证。

papers.title: Environmental Control Extends Beyond Quantum Dephasing in Exciton Energy Transfer
papers.abstract: Excitation-energy transfer underpins the conversion of light into usable energy in photosynthetic organisms and serves as a paradigm for evolutionary optimized transport in open quantum systems. Although this process is often described as incoherent thermally assisted hopping, such descriptions become inadequate when electronic coupling, vibronic interactions and environmental fluctuations occur on comparable energy scales. Determining how the environment controls transport therefore remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we use temperature-dependent 2DES to investigate energy transfer in the photosynthetic antenna protein allophycocyanin over the range 10 - 296 K. The dominant $β\rightarrow α$ transfer step exhibits a pronounced non-monotonic temperature dependence: the transfer time decreases from 400 fs at 10 K to 200 fs near 30- 40 K before increasing again to 400 fs at 296 K. In contrast, the homogeneous optical dephasing time decreases monotonically across the same temperature range. To interpret these observations, we model APC as a vibronically coupled excitonic dimer interacting with a structured environment and solve the dynamics using hierarchical equations of motion. Conventional fixed-bath models, including Drude-Lorentz and explicit intermolecular-mode spectral densities, fail to reproduce the observed turnover. Quantitative agreement is obtained only when the low-frequency sector of the environmental spectral density is allowed to anharmonically evolve strongly with temperature, while the high-frequency bath remains essentially unchanged. More broadly, these findings demonstrate that transport efficiency is controlled not simply by the magnitude of environmental fluctuations, but by the distribution of environmental spectral weight across frequency space, providing new experimental constraints on theories of molecular transport in complex quantum environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论计算）。判断依据：实验上使用温度依赖的二维电子光谱（2DES），理论上使用分层运动方程（HEOM）进行动力学模拟。；研究对象：光合天线蛋白别藻蓝蛋白（allophycocyanin, APC）中的激发能量转移过程，特别是β→α亚基间的能量传递步骤，以及环境（溶剂/蛋白环境）对该量子输运过程的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: APC中主导的β→α能量转移时间随温度呈非单调变化（10 K时约400 fs，30–40 K时最快约200 fs，296 K时回到约400 fs），而均匀光学退相时间则随温度单调减小。只有当环境谱密度的低频部分随温度发生强非谐演化、而高频部分基本不变时，理论才能定量重现实验观测，表明输运效率由环境谱权重的频率分布而非总涨落幅度决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：APC中主导的β→α能量转移时间随温度呈非单调变化（10 K时约400 fs，30–40 K时最快约200 fs，296 K时回到约400 fs），而均匀光学退相时间则随温度单调减小。只有当环境谱密度的低频部分随温度发生强非谐演化、而高频部分基本不变时，理论才能定量重现实验观测，表明输运效率由环境谱权重的频率分布而非总涨落幅度决定。；创新点：首次通过温度依赖2DES实验揭示能量转移时间与退相时间截然不同的温度依赖行为，并证明传统固定浴模型（Drude-Lorentz及显式分子间模式）无法描述该现象，提出环境谱密度低频部分随温度非谐演化是定量解释的关键——这一发现为复杂量子环境中的分子输运理论提供了新的实验约束。
papers.method_zh: 实验：温度依赖的二维电子光谱（2DES），温度范围10–296 K。理论：将APC建模为振动耦合的激子二聚体（vibronically coupled excitonic dimer），与结构化环境相互作用，采用分层运动方程（HEOM）求解动力学；对比了Drude-Lorentz谱密度和显式分子间振动模式谱密度的固定浴模型。

papers.title: Quantum-Geometric Length Scale for Long-distance Squeezing in Bosonic Bogoliubov Systems
papers.abstract: Multimode squeezing is a key resource for continuous-variable quantum technologies, but its spatial range in bosonic lattices is usually tied to dispersive propagation. Here we show that parametric pairing can create an exactly flat Bogoliubov band spanned by compact Bogoliubov generators, while producing phase-sensitive anomalous correlations and sub-vacuum collective-mode squeezing that extend far beyond their finite support. Each compact generator mixes annihilation and creation operators, thereby encoding the Bogoliubov squeezing structure, and neighboring translated generators can have nonzero commutator overlap. Enforcing canonical bosonic commutation relations therefore requires spatially extended linear combinations of these translated compact generators, which define the canonical Bogoliubov modes. The squeezing transformation of these modes varies with momentum and is quantified by the squeezing-sector symplectic quantum metric. A complex-momentum singularity of the analytically continued canonical Bogoliubov modes sets both the anomalous-correlation decay length and the momentum-space width of this metric, defining an intrinsic quantum-geometric length scale. This singularity can be tuned continuously while preserving exact flatness, thereby controlling the spatial range of correlations and squeezing. Away from exact flatness, long-distance correlations persist through multiple decay channels, while modes localized by defects and dimerized boundaries provide complementary probes of the underlying quantum geometry. In the weak-damping limit, the same quantum-geometric length scale can be extracted from frequency-filtered two-port correlations. Our results establish the quantum geometry of canonical Bogoliubov modes as a mechanism for spatially extended quantum resources arising from compact Bogoliubov generators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论推导（“canonical bosonic commutation relations”“analytical continuation”）、模型分析（“bosonic Bogoliubov systems”）以及量子几何量（“symplectic quantum metric”），未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：玻色子Bogoliubov晶格系统中的多模压缩（multimode squeezing）现象，特别是由参数配对（parametric pairing）产生的平坦Bogoliubov能带及其空间关联性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 参数配对可产生由紧致Bogoliubov生成元张成的完全平坦能带，同时产生远超其有限支撑范围的长程相位敏感反常关联和亚真空集体模压缩；该长程行为由解析延拓的规范Bogoliubov模的复动量奇点所决定的量子几何长度标度控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：参数配对可产生由紧致Bogoliubov生成元张成的完全平坦能带，同时产生远超其有限支撑范围的长程相位敏感反常关联和亚真空集体模压缩；该长程行为由解析延拓的规范Bogoliubov模的复动量奇点所决定的量子几何长度标度控制。；创新点：首次将规范Bogoliubov模的量子几何（symplectic量子度量及其复动量奇点）确立为空间扩展量子资源的机制，并证明该长度标度可在保持能带精确平坦的同时连续调谐，从而控制关联与压缩的空间范围。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，具体包括：Bogoliubov变换与正则对易关系的构造、紧致生成元的平移组合分析、symplectic量子度量的计算、复动量平面解析延拓与奇点分析，以及弱阻尼极限下频率滤波双端口关联的推导。

papers.title: Landau theory, effective temperature, and tricritical phenomena in a holographic nonequilibrium steady state
papers.abstract: We investigate the critical exponents $(γ,ν)$ at the current-driven tricritical point (TCP) associated with chiral symmetry breaking in a nonequilibrium steady state described by the D3/D7 model. In the symmetry-broken phase, we find that, unlike in the conventional Landau theory, both $γ$ and $ν$ can take values different from those predicted by the Landau theory and depend on the path along which the TCP is approached in the phase diagram. However, when the TCP is approached with the ratio of the effective temperature to the heat bath temperature, $T_{*}/T$, held fixed, the critical exponents agree with those of the Landau theory. These results suggest that the critical phenomena at the current-driven TCP may be described by the Landau theory along the $T_{*}/T$-fixed line, whereas a nontrivial extension of the Landau theory is required for a more general description of the critical phenomena along arbitrary paths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“holographic”“Landau theory”“critical exponents”等理论物理术语，且未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：D3/D7全息模型中由电流驱动的非平衡稳态（NESS）下，手征对称性破缺相关的三临界点（TCP）及其临界现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在对称性破缺相中，临界指数(γ, ν)不再遵循传统Landau理论的普适值，且依赖于相图中趋近TCP的路径；但当沿有效温度与热浴温度之比T*/T固定的路径趋近时，临界指数与Landau理论一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在对称性破缺相中，临界指数(γ, ν)不再遵循传统Landau理论的普适值，且依赖于相图中趋近TCP的路径；但当沿有效温度与热浴温度之比T*/T固定的路径趋近时，临界指数与Landau理论一致。；创新点：首次揭示了非平衡稳态中电流驱动三临界点的临界指数具有路径依赖性，并指出在T*/T固定线上Landau理论仍适用，而一般路径需要非平凡的Landau理论扩展。
papers.method_zh: 全息对偶方法（D3/D7模型），结合Landau理论框架分析非平衡稳态中的临界指数，并考察不同趋近路径对临界指数的影响。

papers.title: Breakdown of Edgeworth Expansion in Finite-Blocklength Regime and Exact Absorption via $q$-Deformation
papers.abstract: This paper addresses the structural breakdown of the Edgeworth expansion in the finite-blocklength (FBL) regime, where conventional asymptotic approximations yield unphysical negative probabilities in the deep-tail region. We propose a $q$-deformed framework that resolves this inconsistency by replacing additive polynomial perturbations with a geometric deformation of the information density space. Motivated by the linearization of nonlinear dynamics, we prove that dynamically scaling the $q$-logarithmic parameter exactly absorbs the third-order skewness while preserving global nonnegativity. We establish a universal asymptotic matching, demonstrating that the framework encapsulates higher-order asymptotic scales. Numerical results confirm that the proposed method matches the state-of-the-art precision of the Cornish-Fisher bound without the risk of negative probabilities. The framework offers a robust and computationally stable foundation for evaluating operational limits in ultra-reliable communications such as 6G and URLLC.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“prove”“establish”“framework”等理论推导词汇，且无实验手段描述。；研究对象：有限块长（FBL）体制下信息论中的Edgeworth展开结构，具体涉及深尾区域概率近似失效问题，以及面向6G/URLLC超可靠通信的误码率/容量评估。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统Edgeworth展开在有限块长深尾区域会产生非物理的负概率；通过引入q-变形框架，用几何形变替代加性多项式扰动，可精确吸收三阶偏度并保持全局非负性，且数值精度与Cornish-Fisher界相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统Edgeworth展开在有限块长深尾区域会产生非物理的负概率；通过引入q-变形框架，用几何形变替代加性多项式扰动，可精确吸收三阶偏度并保持全局非负性，且数值精度与Cornish-Fisher界相当。；创新点：提出用q-变形（几何形变）替代传统加性多项式修正来解决Edgeworth展开的负概率问题，并证明动态标度q参数可精确吸收三阶偏度，同时保持全局非负性——这是对现有FBL渐近方法的结构性改进。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为q-对数（q-logarithmic）参数的动态标度方法，结合非线性动力学线性化思想；通过渐近匹配证明该框架能涵盖高阶渐近尺度；数值验证采用与Cornish-Fisher界对比的方式。

papers.title: Quantum Monte Carlo in the Age of Many-Body Quantum Information
papers.abstract: Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) methods are among the central numerical tools for studying strongly correlated quantum many-body systems, particularly in higher dimensions. As quantum information has introduced new information-theoretic perspectives and diagnostics into many-body physics, QMC methods have accordingly been extended beyond the measurement of conventional linear observables. This review summarizes recent progress in adapting QMC to many-body quantum-information, focusing on qubit or spin-$1/2$ systems as a concrete setting while keeping the discussion broadly applicable to qudit and bosonic systems. We present a unified perspective on the extraction of nonlinear diagnostics, including entanglement entropies and entanglement spectra, Rényi negativities for mixed-state entanglement, stabilizer entropies for quantum magic, and decoherence-driven phenomena such as the interplay between imaginary-time evolution and decoherence and strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。判断依据：摘要明确说明“This review summarizes recent progress...”，属于对已有研究进展的系统总结。；研究对象：强关联量子多体系统，具体以自旋-1/2（qubit）体系为讨论载体，同时涵盖qudit和玻色子体系；研究重点是这些体系中的多体量子信息量，包括纠缠熵、纠缠谱、Rényi负性、稳定子熵以及退相干驱动的现象（如虚时演化与退相干相互作用、强-弱自发对称性破缺）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）方法已从仅测量传统线性可观测量，扩展为能够提取多种非线性量子信息诊断（如纠缠熵、纠缠谱、Rényi负性、稳定子熵等）的有效工具，从而为研究强关联体系中的量子信息特性提供了统一框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）方法已从仅测量传统线性可观测量，扩展为能够提取多种非线性量子信息诊断（如纠缠熵、纠缠谱、Rényi负性、稳定子熵等）的有效工具，从而为研究强关联体系中的量子信息特性提供了统一框架。；创新点：摘要未突出说明单一创新点，但整体新意在于：将QMC从传统线性观测量测量拓展到多体量子信息非线性诊断的领域，并给出一个统一视角来涵盖多种量子信息量（纠缠、混合态纠缠、量子魔法、退相干现象）的QMC计算方法。
papers.method_zh: 量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）方法，具体包括针对非线性量子信息量的QMC扩展技术，用于提取纠缠熵、纠缠谱、Rényi负性、稳定子熵等诊断量。摘要未明确说明具体算法变体（如行列式QMC、随机级数展开等）。

papers.title: Correlation inequalities for transversal field models with application to quantum glasses
papers.abstract: We study the class of transversal field models with pair interactions, including the quantum Curie-Weiss and the transversal field Ising model, as well as quantum spin glasses based on the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) and Edwards-Anderson models. Our main result is a general correlation inequality based on a Gaussian convolution estimate, which is derived from an extension of the Ding-Song-Sun inequality and an application of Brascamp-Lieb convexity techniques. The results apply for sufficiently strong transversal fields and, for quantum spin glasses, yield a high-field regime without replica order. Combined with the previously established low-field replica-symmetry-breaking regime, this gives distinct low- and high-field overlap phases. As a corollary of the logarithmic Sobolev inequalities for the underlying functional integrals derived here, we show the concentration of the self- and replica-overlap, and determine the high-field asymptotics of the pressure in the quantum SK model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：correlation inequality、Gaussian convolution estimate、Brascamp-Lieb convexity、logarithmic Sobolev inequalities。；研究对象：横场模型（transversal field models）及其量子自旋玻璃变体，具体包括量子Curie-Weiss模型、横场Ising模型，以及基于Sherrington-Kirkpatrick（SK）和Edwards-Anderson模型的量子自旋玻璃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在足够强的横场下，量子自旋玻璃体系存在一个无复制对称破缺（replica order）的高场区域；结合此前已建立的低温低场复制对称破缺区域，体系呈现出明确的低场与高场重叠（overlap）相。此外，自重叠与复制重叠的浓度性质以及量子SK模型压强的渐近行为在高场极限下被确定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在足够强的横场下，量子自旋玻璃体系存在一个无复制对称破缺（replica order）的高场区域；结合此前已建立的低温低场复制对称破缺区域，体系呈现出明确的低场与高场重叠（overlap）相。此外，自重叠与复制重叠的浓度性质以及量子SK模型压强的渐近行为在高场极限下被确定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。核心工具包括：基于Ding-Song-Sun不等式的推广得到的Gaussian卷积估计，以及Brascamp-Lieb凸性技术；同时推导了底层泛函积分满足的对数Sobolev不等式，并利用其证明重叠浓度的集中性。

papers.title: From Maxwell Fluid to Kelvin Voigt Solid: A Transient Network Model of Condensate Aging and Morphology Transition in Phase Separation
papers.abstract: Biomolecular condensates can undergo striking changes, such as transitioning from a liquid-like to a gel- or a solid-like aggregate due to changes in molecular interactions in response to changes in the biochemical environment. The question of how modified molecular interactions lead to such a transition in the material properties and spatial organization of condensates has not yet been elucidated. To address this question, we represent the biochemical environment as a triphasic mixture comprising a liquid-like protein-rich phase, a network-like protein-rich phase, and solvent. Owing to a change in the biochemical environment, protein molecules can reversibly switch between two conformational states. In a switched conformational state, the cross-linking domains of molecules are exposed which promote transient network formation in phase separated states. We develop a transient-network model and a continuum framework that couples phase separation, molecular switching, and dynamic cross-linking to predict condensate morphology and mechanics. The transient-network model predicts that a non-aging network behaves like a Maxwell fluid. When a network slowly ages via stabilization of cross-links, it shows Maxwell-like behavior and waiting time-dependent relaxation. However, a strongly aged network shows elastic recoil like characteristic of a Kelvin-Voigt solid. Our coupled continuum model demonstrates that the interplay of molecular switching and dynamic cross-linking in network formation shapes the spatial organization of condensate phases. In summary, this work demonstrates a mechanistic route explaining how conformational switching and molecular cross-linking regulate material properties and morphology of condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：transient-network model、continuum framework、model predicts。；研究对象：生物分子凝聚体的相分离过程，具体为蛋白质凝聚体从液态（Maxwell流体）向凝胶/固态（Kelvin-Voigt固体）的形态与力学性质转变，涉及三组分混合物（类液富蛋白相、类网络富蛋白相、溶剂）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分子构象切换与动态交联的耦合，凝聚体网络的老化程度决定了其力学响应：非老化网络表现为Maxwell流体，强老化网络表现为Kelvin-Voigt固体；分子切换与交联的相互作用还决定了凝聚体相的空间组织形态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分子构象切换与动态交联的耦合，凝聚体网络的老化程度决定了其力学响应：非老化网络表现为Maxwell流体，强老化网络表现为Kelvin-Voigt固体；分子切换与交联的相互作用还决定了凝聚体相的空间组织形态。；创新点：首次将分子构象切换（暴露交联域）与动态交联网络老化机制纳入相分离连续模型，从力学本构角度统一解释了凝聚体从液态到固态的转变路径及其空间形态调控。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比验证。
papers.method_zh: 构建瞬态网络模型（transient-network model）与连续介质理论框架，耦合相分离、分子构象切换（两态可逆切换）和动态交联过程，用于预测凝聚体的形态与力学性质。

papers.title: What do position and time mean in the quantum wavefunction?
papers.abstract: The notation $ψ(x,t)$ is among the first pieces of quantum mechanics that students learn. It is also among the easiest to over-interpret. Because $x$ and $t$ occur as arguments of the same function, students may ask whether they have the same mathematical status. They may also ask whether $ψ(t)$ should require a generalized bra $\bra{t}$ in the same way that $ψ(x)=\braket{x}ψ$ is often written. A related question is whether the absence of a universal time operator follows simply from Pauli's argument. These questions mix several structures that are usually introduced in different parts of the curriculum. We present a unified pedagogical treatment built around two maps hidden in $ψ(x,t)$. Time evolution selects a state along a trajectory in Hilbert space. A spectral representation then maps that state to amplitudes labelled by outcomes of a chosen observable. We formulate the position representation without generalized eigenkets. We recover Dirac's $\ket{x}$ notation as a controlled continuum shorthand and use a finite-grid limit to show where delta normalization enters. We distinguish background coordinates, translation parameters, observables, spectral labels, and physical records. We also clarify the Stone-theorem analogy, compare prescribed-time position measurements with arrival-time measurements, state what the strong form of Pauli's argument excludes, and exhibit an exactly solvable boundary case in which a canonical self-adjoint time observable exists. Spin, circuit-QED, and optical-clock examples provide experimentally grounded checks. The aim is not a new interpretation of time. It is a reusable teaching framework for separating mathematical role from notation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确为“pedagogical treatment”（教学性理论处理），讨论量子力学形式体系与数学结构，无实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：量子波函数 ψ(x,t) 中位置 x 与时间 t 的数学地位与物理含义，涉及希尔伯特空间轨迹、位置表象、广义本征矢、时间算符存在性等基础量子力学概念。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将 ψ(x,t) 分解为“时间演化选态”与“谱表示映射”两个隐藏结构，可统一澄清位置与时间在数学角色上的本质区别，并说明 Pauli 论证的适用范围及其边界情形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将 ψ(x,t) 分解为“时间演化选态”与“谱表示映射”两个隐藏结构，可统一澄清位置与时间在数学角色上的本质区别，并说明 Pauli 论证的适用范围及其边界情形。；创新点：提出一个可复用的教学框架，将量子力学课程中分散引入的多种数学结构（希尔伯特空间轨迹、谱表示、广义本征矢、时间算符）统一在 ψ(x,t) 的两个映射之下，并明确区分数学角色与记号含义，而非提出新的时间诠释。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：采用有限网格极限（finite-grid limit）替代广义本征矢构造位置表象，恢复 Dirac 的 |x⟩ 记号作为连续极限简写；区分背景坐标、平移参数、可观测量、谱标签与物理记录；对比规定时间位置测量与到达时间测量；借助 Stone 定理类比；给出自伴时间算符存在的可解边界例子；以自旋、电路 QED、光钟为实验检验案例。

papers.title: A Physical Response-and-Memory Model for Muon Optimization
papers.abstract: Training large language models is costly. How low a loss the same compute can ultimately reach depends on how each step's gradient is converted into a weight update; the rule that performs this conversion is the optimizer. From SGD and AdamW to the recent Muon, effective update rules have mostly been shaped by engineering intuition and then selected on benchmarks. Muon semi-orthogonalizes the momentum matrix before applying the update and has kept breaking records on public training benchmarks; yet why the semi-orthogonalized direction works, and over how long a history the momentum should average, are two questions at present answered mainly by experience. Here we treat the weight matrix during training as a responsive medium with memory and build a physical model for it, in which both questions find answers: the semi-orthogonalized direction is the maximally dissipative response under an output-side safety budget, which explains why it works; momentum is the internal stress accumulated by the medium; how long it should average is set by the relaxation of this stress, and a real medium relaxes on more than one timescale, the simplest form being one fast and one slow. On this basis we propose the Bi-Maxwell optimizer. The framework further yields a testable consequence: gradient directions change fast early in training and more slowly later, so the optimal memory length should grow with training stage; step-by-step measurements of a proxy for it by a read-only probe across 8 independent training trajectories are consistent with this consequence. Replacing the memory kernel alone, from a single timescale to two, brings training to the target loss in noticeably fewer steps on a public large-language-model optimizer benchmark.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“build a physical model”“the framework further yields a testable consequence”，并包含在公共基准上的训练实验（“brings training to the target loss”），属于理论建模加数值验证的混合类型。；研究对象：本文研究的对象并非传统凝聚态材料，而是将大语言模型训练中的权重矩阵类比为“具有记忆的响应介质”（responsive medium with memory），研究其在外场（梯度）作用下的耗散响应与内部应力（动量）弛豫行为。物理上对应的是非平衡统计力学中的线性响应与多时间尺度弛豫现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 半正交化方向（Muon优化器的更新方向）是在输出端安全预算约束下最大耗散响应的方向，这解释了其有效性；动量应视为介质内部累积的应力，其最优平均时长由应力的多时间尺度弛豫决定（最简单形式为一快一慢两个时间尺度），据此提出Bi-Maxwell优化器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：半正交化方向（Muon优化器的更新方向）是在输出端安全预算约束下最大耗散响应的方向，这解释了其有效性；动量应视为介质内部累积的应力，其最优平均时长由应力的多时间尺度弛豫决定（最简单形式为一快一慢两个时间尺度），据此提出Bi-Maxwell优化器。；创新点：首次将优化器的更新规则从物理角度建模为“响应-记忆”问题，给出了半正交化方向为何有效的理论解释（最大耗散响应），并预言最优动量记忆长度应随训练阶段增长（梯度方向早期变化快、后期变化慢），该预言通过探针测量得到验证。摘要未突出说明与已有优化器理论（如自适应矩估计的几何解释）的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为线性响应理论（将梯度视为外场、权重更新视为响应）与黏弹性介质模型（动量类比为内部应力，引入多时间尺度弛豫核）。数值验证手段包括：在8条独立训练轨迹上使用只读探针（read-only probe）测量梯度方向变化速率的代理量，以及在公共大语言模型优化器基准上替换记忆核（从单时间尺度改为双时间尺度）进行训练步数对比。

papers.title: `It from Bit': is there a second law of quantum complexity?
papers.abstract: At a deeper level the principle of least action is interpreted as the law of least entropy increase consistent with Prigogine's principle of minimum entropy production, and the implications of quasistatic information quantization rule (Proc. R. Soc. A 480: 20240024), are explored for the conjectured second law of quantum complexity. It is thus shown that the conjectured second law of complexity is derivable from the information quantization rule such that long after heat-death the quantum state complexity evolves as $C(t)=C_{\rm max}\exp(-1/t)$, increasing with time to a saturation value $C_{\rm max}$ that is exponential in the equilibrium entropy $S_{\rm max}$. For the out-of-equilibrium circumstances, however, the quantum complexity can decrease with the time, asymptotically tending to a minimum determined by the distance from equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：interpreted、derivable、conjectured second law、information quantization rule。；研究对象：量子复杂度（quantum complexity）及其随时间演化的规律，特别是与热寂（heat-death）后量子态复杂度增长及非平衡态下复杂度变化的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从准静态信息量子化规则出发，可推导出量子复杂度的“第二定律”：在热寂之后，复杂度随时间按 C(t)=C_max exp(−1/t) 增长并趋于饱和值 C_max（该值正比于平衡熵的指数）；而在非平衡条件下，复杂度可随时间下降，渐近趋于由离平衡距离决定的最小值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从准静态信息量子化规则出发，可推导出量子复杂度的“第二定律”：在热寂之后，复杂度随时间按 C(t)=C_max exp(−1/t) 增长并趋于饱和值 C_max（该值正比于平衡熵的指数）；而在非平衡条件下，复杂度可随时间下降，渐近趋于由离平衡距离决定的最小值。；创新点：将信息量子化规则与量子复杂度第二定律的猜想联系起来，给出了复杂度单调增长定律在热寂后及非平衡情形下的具体函数形式，并指出非平衡下复杂度可下降这一反直觉行为。摘要未突出说明与已有复杂度增长定理（如Brown–Susskind猜想）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与概念分析。基于最小作用原理与Prigogine最小熵产生原理的类比，结合作者先前提出的准静态信息量子化规则（Proc. R. Soc. A 480: 20240024）进行演绎推理。

papers.title: Self-consistent modelling of all-optical switching and magneto-optic readout in an integrated Si$_3$N$_4$/GdFeCo waveguide
papers.abstract: What a guided beam carries after passing through an all-optically switched magnetic film has not been computed, although such switching has been demonstrated on a silicon nitride waveguide with electrical readout. We close the chain for an integrated Si$_3$N$_4$/GdFeCo element, an 8 nm film on a 60 $μ$m waveguide, coupling a three-dimensional dispersive finite-difference time-domain solver to absorbed optical work, a four-temperature model, and stochastic two-sublattice Landau-Lifshitz-Bloch dynamics with a fluctuation-dissipation-consistent Langevin field, the magnetization feeding back into the gyrotropic permittivity that a second guided shot reads. Transmission, reflection and absorption are magnetization-blind, closing to 0.974-0.975 and shifting by at most 0.02 between saturated, demagnetized and multidomain films, because magnetization enters the dielectric tensor only through an antisymmetric element on which absorbed power depends at second order; the odd-in-magnetization polarimetry separates them by an order of magnitude in Faraday rotation and two in Kerr. The guided geometry levies a cost free-space measurement does not: a $-11.77^\circ$ geometric pedestal on the reflected channel, exceeding the $8.24^\circ$ rotation it hides. Referencing against a demagnetized film returns it to $0.063^\circ$. The transmitted mode carries a second signature in its lobe balance, needing no polarimetry. Calibrated pulses toggle 0.859 of the film from either saturated state across a $2.4\times$ fluence window, and the shortfall from unity is photonic rather than magnetic: the switched fraction is the complementary cumulative distribution of the guided-mode absorption map at the single-cell threshold, holding to $8\times10^{-4}$ at five full-wave anchors. From exactly zero magnetization, branch selection passes to the Langevin field alone, at occupancy $0.502 \pm 0.004$ over 16 seeds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。关键词：finite-difference time-domain solver（时域有限差分求解器）、four-temperature model（四温度模型）、stochastic two-sublattice Landau-Lifshitz-Bloch dynamics（随机双子格LLB动力学）、self-consistent modelling（自洽建模）。；研究对象：集成Si₃N₄/GdFeCo波导中的全光开关与磁光读出过程。具体体系为8 nm厚的GdFeCo磁性薄膜沉积在60 μm长的Si₃N₄波导上，研究光波导模式与磁化动力学之间的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在集成波导几何中，透射、反射和吸收对磁化状态不敏感（变化≤0.02），但极化测量（Faraday/Kerr旋转）可将不同磁化态区分开（Faraday旋转差一个量级，Kerr差两个量级）。波导几何引入−11.77°的几何基底，参考退磁态后可恢复至0.063°。校准脉冲可在2.4倍通量窗口内实现0.859的磁化翻转，翻转不完整源于光子学而非磁性因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在集成波导几何中，透射、反射和吸收对磁化状态不敏感（变化≤0.02），但极化测量（Faraday/Kerr旋转）可将不同磁化态区分开（Faraday旋转差一个量级，Kerr差两个量级）。波导几何引入−11.77°的几何基底，参考退磁态后可恢复至0.063°。校准脉冲可在2.4倍通量窗口内实现0.859的磁化翻转，翻转不完整源于光子学而非磁性因素。；创新点：首次对全光开关后的导波光束在集成波导中的传播特性进行自洽计算，闭合了从光吸收→热动力学→磁化动力学→磁光读出的完整链条；发现波导几何特有的几何极化基底效应，并提出以退磁态为参考的消除方案；发现透射模式的瓣平衡可作为无需偏振测量的第二读出通道。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 三维色散时域有限差分（FDTD）求解器，耦合吸收光功、四温度模型（4TM）、随机双子格Landau-Lifshitz-Bloch（LLB）动力学（含涨落-耗散一致的Langevin场），磁化反馈回旋磁介电张量，由第二束导波光进行读出。采用多物理场自洽耦合方案。

papers.title: $\mathscr{PT}$-symmetric hydrodynamics of odd viscous liquids and their oscillator counterparts
papers.abstract: Odd viscosity, the nondissipative part of the viscous response of a time-reversal-broken fluid, is notoriously difficult to measure precisely because it does no work. Here we show that parity-time ($\mathscr{PT}$) symmetry, familiar from non-Hermitian optics, converts this elusiveness into a measurement principle. The odd Navier-Stokes equations, that include the nonlinear inertial terms, are $\mathscr{PT}$-symmetric, follow from a Lagrangian, and linearize to a Schrödinger equation in which the odd viscosity plays the role of Planck's constant; potential vorticity obeys a generalized Ertel conservation law. A probe trapped in an odd liquid realizes a pair of oscillators coupled by odd friction, and supplying balanced loss and gain drives a twofold $\mathscr{PT}$ transition whose exceptional point and Rabi sidebands locate the odd viscosity with square-root-enhanced sensitivity. Upon quantization the spectrum is of Fock-Darwin form, and the dissipative pair exhibits a Liouvillian exceptional point separating linear from exponential heating. These results furnish mechanical, stochastic, and spectroscopic protocols for measuring odd transport coefficients in classical and quantum fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、follow from a Lagrangian、linearize to a Schrödinger equation、upon quantization。；研究对象：奇粘滞（odd viscosity）流体，即时间反演对称破缺流体中的无耗散粘滞响应；具体体系包括奇粘滞液体中的探针振荡器对，以及其量子化后的对应物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 奇粘滞流体的流体力学方程具有$\mathscr{PT}$对称性，且奇粘滞系数在方程中扮演普朗克常数的角色；通过构造具有平衡增益与损耗的振荡器对，可在$\mathscr{PT}$对称破缺的例外点处实现对奇粘滞系数的平方根增强灵敏度测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：奇粘滞流体的流体力学方程具有$\mathscr{PT}$对称性，且奇粘滞系数在方程中扮演普朗克常数的角色；通过构造具有平衡增益与损耗的振荡器对，可在$\mathscr{PT}$对称破缺的例外点处实现对奇粘滞系数的平方根增强灵敏度测量。；创新点：将非厄米光学中熟知的$\mathscr{PT}$对称性引入奇粘滞流体力学，将奇粘滞“不做功、难测量”的缺点转化为测量原理，并提出机械、随机与光谱三种测量方案；同时揭示了奇粘滞与普朗克常数的类比关系及广义Ertel守恒律。摘要未突出说明与以往奇粘滞测量方案的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与解析分析：建立奇Navier-Stokes方程（含非线性惯性项）的$\mathscr{PT}$对称性与拉格朗日形式；线性化得到类薛定谔方程；引入探针-振荡器耦合模型，分析其$\mathscr{PT}$转变、例外点与Rabi边带；对耗散对进行量子化，研究其Liouvillian谱与加热行为。

papers.title: Universal equilibrium magic in quantum many-body systems
papers.abstract: Thermalization conventionally describes local properties of isolated many-body systems at equilibrium. Magic, or nonstabilizerness $\unicode{x2013}$ the resource enabling universal quantum computation $\unicode{x2013}$ is by contrast encoded in the global structure of the many-body wavefunction. We show that, despite its global nature, the magic of equilibrium pure states of chaotic many-body systems, including late-time evolved states and energy eigenstates, is universal: it is captured by the thermal Scrooge ensemble, the minimally informative ensemble of pure states consistent with the Gibbs state at the same effective temperature. Therefore, for systems with no conserved quantities other than the total energy, equilibrium magic is a function of temperature alone, independent of the initial state and other microscopic features of the equilibrium state. This yields concrete universal predictions for the stabilizer Rényi entropies (SREs). At infinite temperature, the SRE is set by Haar-like fluctuations of the Pauli spectrum, while at finite temperature energy conservation induces a volume-law thermodynamic correction controlled by the thermal Pauli spectrum. We support these predictions with analytical arguments and extensive numerical simulations. We further show that chaotic many-body systems at high temperatures possess long-range magic and entanglement that cannot be removed by finite-depth local quantum circuits. Our results establish magic as a thermodynamic property of chaotic many-body systems and suggest that Scrooge ensembles may provide a unified framework for quantum many-body resources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中出现“analytical arguments”“extensive numerical simulations”“show that”等理论推导与数值验证关键词。；研究对象：量子多体系统（chaotic many-body systems）中平衡纯态的“magic”（非稳定化资源，nonstabilizerness），即量子计算通用性资源，以及其与热化、纠缠的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混沌多体系统平衡纯态（包括晚期演化态和能量本征态）的magic具有普适性，仅由有效温度决定，与初态和微观细节无关；该普适magic由热Scrooge系综描述，且高温下系统具有不能被有限深度局域量子电路移除的长程magic和纠缠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混沌多体系统平衡纯态（包括晚期演化态和能量本征态）的magic具有普适性，仅由有效温度决定，与初态和微观细节无关；该普适magic由热Scrooge系综描述，且高温下系统具有不能被有限深度局域量子电路移除的长程magic和纠缠。；创新点：首次将magic确立为混沌多体系统的热力学性质（温度的单值函数），并提出Scrooge系综可作为量子多体资源的统一描述框架；同时揭示了高温下长程magic与纠缠的不可消除性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合大规模数值模拟。具体包括：热Scrooge系综（thermal Scrooge ensemble）框架、稳定化Rényi熵（stabilizer Rényi entropies, SREs）计算、Pauli谱（Pauli spectrum）的Haar-like涨落分析、有限温度下能量守恒导致的体积律热力学修正，以及数值模拟验证。

papers.title: Generalizing Abell-Tersoff bond-order potential with explicit high-order many-body correlations for robust extrapolation of potential energy surfaces
papers.abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials enable accurate and efficient atomistic simulations, but their reliability for out-of-distribution configurations far beyond the training domain remains a significant challenge. Here, to tackle this challenge, we introduce a semiparametric interatomic potential based on a generalization of the Abell--Tersoff bond-order potential, with a chemically informed functional form and explicit high-order many-body correlations. The model is trained and evaluated on various datasets, including silicon, carbon, water, and small molecules, achieving interpolation accuracy comparable to that of existing MLIP models while demonstrating better extrapolation to unseen configurations, including those under high-pressure and high-temperature conditions. These results demonstrate that physically motivated constraints incorporated into the functional form can improve the extrapolation behavior of interatomic potentials, providing insights into the inductive biases that can be used to control extrapolation in machine-learning interatomic potentials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：machine-learning interatomic potentials、semiparametric interatomic potential、functional form、trained and evaluated。；研究对象：硅、碳、水及小分子体系，重点考察这些体系在训练域之外的构型（如高压、高温条件）下的势能面外推行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在Abell–Tersoff键序势的泛化形式中引入物理启发的函数形式和显式高阶多体关联，该模型在插值精度上与现有机器学习原子间势（MLIP）相当，但在外推到未见构型（包括高压高温条件）时表现出更好的鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在Abell–Tersoff键序势的泛化形式中引入物理启发的函数形式和显式高阶多体关联，该模型在插值精度上与现有机器学习原子间势（MLIP）相当，但在外推到未见构型（包括高压高温条件）时表现出更好的鲁棒性。；创新点：将物理启发的约束（化学信息化的函数形式与显式高阶多体关联）直接嵌入势函数形式中，以改善机器学习原子间势的外推行为；摘要未突出说明与具体已有模型（如具体MLIP架构）的详细对比或实现细节。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种半参数（semiparametric）原子间势模型，基于Abell–Tersoff键序势的推广，显式包含高阶多体关联；在硅、碳、水和若干小分子数据集上训练并评估，与现有MLIP模型对比插值精度和外推表现。

papers.title: Importance-Reweighted Fock-Space Variational Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: Fock-space variational Monte Carlo (FS-VMC) evaluates variational quantities by stochastic sampling over discrete many-body configurations. For ab initio electronic Hamiltonians, Born distributions can differ markedly between systems, and a Markov chain that mixes well need not yield low-variance estimators. We introduce importance-reweighted FS-VMC (IR-FS-VMC), which leaves the variational objective unchanged while redesigning its Monte Carlo evaluation. An auxiliary distribution and Hamiltonian-guided proposal define the Markov chain, while an evaluation Markov kernel defines an analytically tractable evaluation distribution. Self-normalized importance reweighting then recovers the Born-distribution expectations entering the energy, gradient, and stochastic reconfiguration (SR) matrix. Controlled comparisons on equilibrium H2O and Fe2S2 separate Markov-chain acceptance from local-energy fluctuations and optimization behavior. Using one production protocol, calculations for H2O dissociation, 36-site hydrogen lattices, and Fe2S2 and Fe4S4 active spaces yield accurate variational energies across different Born distributions and electronic-correlation regimes. Together, these results show that the production protocol can support robust FS-VMC optimization across the electronic-structure regimes studied here.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确涉及“Fock-space variational Monte Carlo (FS-VMC)”、“stochastic sampling”、“Markov chain”、“variational energies”等计算方法与理论框架关键词。；研究对象：电子结构量子多体系统，具体包括：平衡态H2O分子、H2O解离过程、36位点氢晶格（氢链/氢格子），以及Fe2S2和Fe4S4活性空间（铁硫簇模型）。研究覆盖不同Born分布和不同电子关联强度区域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种重要性重加权Fock空间变分蒙特卡洛（IR-FS-VMC）方法，在不改变变分目标函数的前提下重新设计蒙特卡洛评估过程，使得在不同Born分布和电子关联区域下均能获得准确的变分能量，支持稳健的FS-VMC优化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种重要性重加权Fock空间变分蒙特卡洛（IR-FS-VMC）方法，在不改变变分目标函数的前提下重新设计蒙特卡洛评估过程，使得在不同Born分布和电子关联区域下均能获得准确的变分能量，支持稳健的FS-VMC优化。；创新点：核心创新在于将变分目标函数与蒙特卡洛评估过程解耦：通过重要性重加权技术，使马尔可夫链的混合效率与估计器的方差控制不再受限于Born分布本身，从而在系统间Born分布差异显著时仍能保持低方差估计。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: Fock空间变分蒙特卡洛（FS-VMC）的改进版本——重要性重加权FS-VMC（IR-FS-VMC）。具体技术要素包括：辅助分布与哈密顿量引导的提议分布（Hamiltonian-guided proposal）用于定义马尔可夫链；解析可处理的评估马尔可夫核（evaluation Markov kernel）定义评估分布；自归一化重要性重加权（self-normalized importance reweighting）恢复Born分布期望值，用于能量、梯度和随机重构（stochastic reconfiguration, SR）矩阵的计算。对比实验采用统一的生成协议（production protocol）。

papers.title: Deterministic Preparation of Arbitrary Spin Eigenfunctions
papers.abstract: Quantum states with conserved total spins, or spin eigenfunctions, are important for studying quantum chemistry and quantum manybody physics problems. A typical class of spin eigenfunctions are Dicke states, which attain maximal spins. While we already have many efficient quantum algorithms to prepare Dicke states, it is not yet clear if we could do so for arbitrary spin eigenfunctions deterministically. Generalizing Bärtschi and Eidenbenz's elegant algorithms for Dicke state preparation, we successfully prepare arbitrary spin eigenfunctions characterized by branching paths and binary spin trees. As a byproduct, we also develop the corresponding classical algorithms to reconstruct all these spin states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum algorithms、deterministically prepare、classical algorithms。；研究对象：自旋本征函数（spin eigenfunctions），即具有守恒总自旋的量子态，包括最大自旋的Dicke态以及更一般的任意自旋本征态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过推广Bärtschi和Eidenbenz的Dicke态制备算法，实现了任意自旋本征函数的确定性量子制备，并同时给出了对应的经典重构算法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过推广Bärtschi和Eidenbenz的Dicke态制备算法，实现了任意自旋本征函数的确定性量子制备，并同时给出了对应的经典重构算法。；创新点：首次实现了对任意自旋本征函数（而非仅限于最大自旋的Dicke态）的确定性制备，并附带开发了相应的经典算法以重构这些自旋态。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为量子算法设计，具体基于分支路径（branching paths）和二元自旋树（binary spin trees）的结构，推广已有的Dicke态确定性制备算法。

papers.title: Topological space-time waves in complex channels
papers.abstract: Structured light in space and time has become a powerful playground in which to explore the fundamental physics of wave systems, while simultaneously introducing new exotic forms of light, from spatio-temporal vortices to toroidal pulses of light. Yet their creation remains restricted by complex optical systems while directly observing their evolution in arbitrary channels remains elusive, complicated by the interplay of dispersion and diffraction and exacerbated by the lack of suitable detection tools. Here we create topological space-time beams in a single step by a resonant response of a symmetry-broken metasurface, mixing spatial, temporal and polarisation degrees of freedom in a single microwave field. Our realisation in the microwave regime allows us to directly observe their dynamics in arbitrary channels, from free-space to complex random media, showing the preservation of topology while the foundational degrees of freedom are scrambled. We use our control to show how to unscramble the space-time properties for the first crosstalk-free transmission of space-time waves. Our work advances the physics of space-time waves, introduces a new toolkit for their creation and control, and offers an exciting roadmap to their exploitation in real-world scenarios, e.g., for robust communications through noisy channels.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Here we create...”“Our realisation in the microwave regime allows us to directly observe...”，属于实验实现与直接观测。；研究对象：拓扑时空波（topological space-time beams/waves），在微波频段通过对称性破缺的超表面（metasurface）产生，并研究其在自由空间、复杂随机介质等任意通道中的传播行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过对称性破缺超表面的共振响应，可一步产生拓扑时空波束，且其拓扑性质在传播过程中（包括经过复杂随机介质后）保持稳定，而空间、时间、极化等基本自由度会被打乱；进一步利用该控制手段实现了首次无串扰的时空波传输。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过对称性破缺超表面的共振响应，可一步产生拓扑时空波束，且其拓扑性质在传播过程中（包括经过复杂随机介质后）保持稳定，而空间、时间、极化等基本自由度会被打乱；进一步利用该控制手段实现了首次无串扰的时空波传输。；创新点：首次在单一步骤中通过超表面共振响应产生拓扑时空波束（无需复杂光学系统）；首次在任意通道（包括复杂随机介质）中直接观测其演化，并展示拓扑保持而自由度被打乱的现象；首次实现时空波的无串扰传输（unscramble）。摘要未明确说明具体超表面结构设计与数值模拟细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用微波频段的对称性破缺超表面（metasurface）作为单步产生器件，将空间、时间与极化自由度混合于单一微波场中；在自由空间和复杂随机介质等不同通道中直接观测时空波束的动力学演化。

papers.title: Evolution of cooperation with Q-learning: how much information do we need?
papers.abstract: Cooperation is ubiquitous in both natural and human societies, yet its evolutionary basis remains a major challenge. A long-standing puzzle is whether having more information leads to better decision-making and thus a higher level of cooperation. To address this question, we adopt a recently developed reinforcement learning framework in which individuals learn through trial and error to maximize cumulative rewards - a paradigm that has successfully explained diverse emergent patterns in human behaviors. Specifically, we equip a structured population with the Q-learning algorithm and systematically vary the size of the interactive neighborhood, which serves as a proxy for perceived information. Interestingly, we observe a non-monotonic relationship between cooperation prevalence and neighborhood size in both two-dimensional square lattices and Barabasi-Albert scale-free networks. This inverted U-shaped dependence reveals that an optimal amount of information exists, yielding the highest level of cooperation. Mechanistic analyses show that a moderate neighborhood size enables individuals to strike an optimal balance between information sufficiency and decision-making tractability. This balance allows them to detect reciprocal opportunities while avoiding the deterioration of decision quality due to information overload. Our findings challenge everyday intuition, suggesting that a proper amount of information - not more - is optimal for the emergence of cooperation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：采用Q-learning强化学习框架进行模型构建与数值模拟，涉及结构化种群上的演化博弈。；研究对象：合作行为的演化，具体为在二维方格和Barabási–Albert无标度网络上，个体通过Q-learning学习策略时，交互邻域大小（作为感知信息量的代理）对合作水平的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 合作水平与邻域大小呈倒U型（非单调）关系，存在一个最优信息量使合作水平最高；信息过多反而降低合作，挑战了“信息越多越好”的直觉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：合作水平与邻域大小呈倒U型（非单调）关系，存在一个最优信息量使合作水平最高；信息过多反而降低合作，挑战了“信息越多越好”的直觉。；创新点：将强化学习框架引入合作演化研究，首次系统揭示信息量（邻域大小）与合作水平之间的倒U型依赖关系，并给出机制解释（信息充分性与决策质量的平衡）。
papers.method_zh: 基于Q-learning的强化学习模型，在结构化种群（二维方格和Barabási–Albert无标度网络）中进行演化模拟，系统改变交互邻域大小，并辅以机制分析（信息充分性与决策可处理性之间的权衡）。

papers.title: Dynamics of Flat-Top--Bubble Vector Solitons
papers.abstract: We investigate the dynamics of two-component flat-top--bubble vector solitons using a variational approximation and numerical simulations. The system is described by coupled cubic-quintic nonlinear Schrödinger equations with repulsive intercomponent coupling. We introduce a self-induced mechanism in which a localized flat-top soliton (FTS) generates a density bubble in a second component: the localized density acts as a repulsive potential for the background field, creating a composite bound state. A background-subtracted formulation and normalized super-Gaussian profiles yield collective-coordinate equations for the component centers and an effective interaction potential for their relative separation. The potential forms a binding well that is nearly triangular over its global displacement range but smooth and locally parabolic near its minimum. The variational approximation consequently predicts harmonic internal oscillations whose frequency is independent of amplitude in the small-oscillation regime. Real-time simulations verify this weak-kick behavior with good agreement between the variational and numerical frequencies. For strong phase imprints, equating the exact kick energy to the variational binding depth predicts a kick scale \(K_{\mathrm{escape}}\) for the onset of partial FTS escape. Real-time simulations support this prediction: below this scale, the composite remains nearly intact, whereas above it, a substantial fraction of the localized component leaves the bubble.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算混合型文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“variational approximation”（变分近似）和“numerical simulations”（数值模拟），未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：双组分平顶-气泡矢量孤子（flat-top–bubble vector solitons），由具有排斥性分量间耦合的耦合三次-五次非线性薛定谔方程描述。具体物理现象为：局域平顶孤子（FTS）在第二分量背景场中自诱导产生密度气泡，形成复合束缚态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 变分近似预测平顶-气泡复合体的相对分离存在一个近三角形、在极小值附近光滑且局部抛物的束缚势阱，从而支持振幅无关的谐波内振荡；数值模拟验证了弱扰动下的频率一致性，并确认了强相位扰动下部分平顶孤子逃逸的临界扰动尺度 \(K_{\mathrm{escape}}\)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：变分近似预测平顶-气泡复合体的相对分离存在一个近三角形、在极小值附近光滑且局部抛物的束缚势阱，从而支持振幅无关的谐波内振荡；数值模拟验证了弱扰动下的频率一致性，并确认了强相位扰动下部分平顶孤子逃逸的临界扰动尺度 \(K_{\mathrm{escape}}\)。；创新点：提出了一种自诱导机制——局域平顶孤子的密度分布作为排斥势作用于第二分量背景场，从而无需外部势阱即可形成复合束缚态；并给出了该复合体内部振荡频率与振幅无关的解析预测及逃逸阈值的定量判据。
papers.method_zh: 1）变分近似：采用背景扣除（background-subtracted）表述和归一化超高斯（super-Gaussian）试探函数，推导出分量中心的集体坐标方程及有效相互作用势；2）实时数值模拟：对耦合三次-五次非线性薛定谔方程进行时间演化，验证弱扰动下的振荡频率和强扰动下的逃逸阈值。

papers.title: Laughlin quasihole geometry from a single snapshot ensemble
papers.abstract: Can a probability distribution measured in one basis determine complex quantum geometry? The answer is affirmative for a lattice Laughlin quasihole. The exact occupation law at one generic reference position, together with the known analytic quasihole factor, fixes the complete complex Gram kernel. A finite snapshot ensemble estimates this kernel without preparing another member of the family, and thereby determines finite-distance overlaps, Bargmann phases, the quantum metric, and the Berry curvature. The same analytic structure confines the family to an exact projective subspace whose dimension grows at most linearly with particle number. Exact enumeration of a Nielsen-Cirac-Sierra state demonstrates finite-shot reconstruction of both the metric and a geometric phase. Moreover, a Rényi-2 divergence sets the statistical range of the reconstruction while, at nondegenerate points, occupation readout also attains the local single-copy multiparameter information bound.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：probability distribution、analytic structure、exact enumeration、information bound，属于量子信息与量子几何的理论分析。；研究对象：格点Laughlin准空穴（lattice Laughlin quasihole）的量子几何性质，具体涉及Nielsen-Cirac-Sierra态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅凭单一基下测量的概率分布（即单个快照系综），即可完全确定Laughlin准空穴族的复Gram核，进而重构量子度量与Berry曲率等几何量；该族被限制在维数随粒子数至多线性增长的精确投影子空间中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅凭单一基下测量的概率分布（即单个快照系综），即可完全确定Laughlin准空穴族的复Gram核，进而重构量子度量与Berry曲率等几何量；该族被限制在维数随粒子数至多线性增长的精确投影子空间中。；创新点：首次证明无需制备族中其他成员，仅凭单一基下的概率测量即可重构完整的量子几何信息（包括度量与曲率），并给出有限快照下的统计误差界；同时揭示该族具有精确的、维数线性增长的投影子空间结构。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导结合精确枚举（exact enumeration）：利用已知解析准空穴因子与一个参考位置的占据数分布，固定完整复Gram核；通过有限快照系综估计该核，并计算有限距离重叠、Bargmann相位、量子度量与Berry曲率；使用Rényi-2散度刻画重构的统计范围，并检验单拷贝多参数信息下界。

papers.title: Spanning trees in the Assignment Problem: two theorems and two conjectures
papers.abstract: The \emph{Minimum Matching Problem} consists of finding an independent edge set of minimum weight $M_{\star}(G)$ in a given edge-weighted graph $G$. When $G$ is bipartite, this reduces to the \emph{Assignment Problem}. We consider a variant of this problem defined by taking the union of optimal matchings across various slightly modified versions of the base graph: $H_{\mathcal{J}}(G)=\bigcup_{U \in \mathcal{J}} M_{\star}(G_{U})$. We establish two families of results: (1) In two distinct settings for the Assignment Problem, we prove that the resulting graphs $H_{\mathcal{J}}$, as well as certain associated graphs $\bar{H}_{\mathcal{J}}$, are spanning trees on the relevant base graphs $G$ and $\bar{G}$. (2) In these same settings, assuming the edge weights are given by the $p$-th power of Euclidean distances for point configurations in the plane, we show that for $p=1$ the tree $H_{\mathcal{J}}$ is non-crossing (i.e., its planar embedding has no crossing edges), whereas, remarkably, for $p=2$ the associated tree $\bar{H}_{\mathcal{J}}$ is non-crossing. Finally, we introduce novel conjectures in Statistical Mechanics, to be explored in future work: in the Random Euclidean Assignment Problem (where points are i.i.d.\ on a planar domain), we conjecture that for $p=2$ the trees $\bar{H}_{\mathcal{J}}$ are asymptotically distributed as Uniform Spanning Trees with free and wired boundary conditions in the two respective settings. In particular, suitable paths on the tree in the second setting, and on its planar dual in the first setting, are asymptotically distributed as $\text{SLE}_κ$ with $κ=2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theorem、conjecture、proof、Statistical Mechanics。；研究对象：组合优化与统计物理交叉问题：赋权图中的最小匹配问题（二分图情形即指派问题），以及由多个最优匹配并集构造的图结构；具体涉及欧氏距离的p次幂作为边权的平面点构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在两类指派问题设定下，由最优匹配并集构造的图H_J及相关图\bar{H}_J是基础图上的生成树；当边权为欧氏距离的p次幂时，p=1时H_J为非交叉树，p=2时\bar{H}_J为非交叉树。此外提出随机欧氏指派问题中这些树渐近服从均匀生成树分布的猜想。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在两类指派问题设定下，由最优匹配并集构造的图H_J及相关图\bar{H}_J是基础图上的生成树；当边权为欧氏距离的p次幂时，p=1时H_J为非交叉树，p=2时\bar{H}_J为非交叉树。此外提出随机欧氏指派问题中这些树渐近服从均匀生成树分布的猜想。；创新点：首次系统证明指派问题中多个最优匹配并集形成生成树，并揭示其非交叉性与欧氏距离幂次p的关联；提出将均匀生成树与SLE_2联系的新统计力学猜想。摘要未突出说明与已有生成树构造方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明与猜想提出。利用最优匹配的结构性质构造并集图，分析其生成树性质；结合平面几何论证非交叉性；基于随机欧氏指派问题提出统计力学猜想（涉及SLE_κ，κ=2）。

papers.title: Bloch states of an infinite one-dimensional lattice under transverse electric field
papers.abstract: We consider an effectively one-dimensional periodic atomic chain subjected to a weak static electric field transverse to the chain axis. The intrinsic lattice is represented in reciprocal space by a harmonically weighted periodic pseudopotential, while the transverse field produces a weak elastic and polarizable response whose minimum-energy distribution is approximated by a periodically repeated catenary profile. Bloch reduction places both contributions in a common reciprocal-space Hamiltonian. The intrinsic lattice produces a \ (|r-s|^ {-1} \) hierarchy, whereas the catenary contribution is a symmetric Toeplitz correction with coefficients proportional to \((1+π^2(r-2) ^ {-1} \) and therefore asymptotically to \ (|r-s|^ {-2} \). The complete nonzero reciprocal weight of the catenary contribution is absolutely convergent and sums to \ (|V_ {\rm c} |/e \). At the unit-cell level, the lowest intrinsic harmonic together with the catenary term gives a Mathieu equation containing both cosine and hyperbolic-cosine modulations. A first-Brillouin-zone reduction then yields the field-dependent band energies and the corresponding hierarchy of Bragg gaps. The model isolates a simple mechanism by which a transverse electric field can reorganize the Bloch spectrum of a low-dimensional periodic system. Keywords: Bloch theory; transverse electric field; catenary potential; Mathieu equation; Brillouin zone; band structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。依据：摘要中明确使用“We consider”“Bloch reduction places”“gives a Mathieu equation”等理论推导语言，未提及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：一维周期性原子链在横向（垂直于链轴）静电场作用下的布洛赫电子态与能带结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 横向电场通过引入一种“悬链线”（catenary）型弹性极化势，在倒空间中产生一个系数渐近为 |r−s|⁻² 的对称Toeplitz修正项，与固有晶格的 |r−s|⁻¹ 层级叠加后，可在第一布里渊区内重整化布洛赫谱，并改变Bragg带隙的层级结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：横向电场通过引入一种“悬链线”（catenary）型弹性极化势，在倒空间中产生一个系数渐近为 |r−s|⁻² 的对称Toeplitz修正项，与固有晶格的 |r−s|⁻¹ 层级叠加后，可在第一布里渊区内重整化布洛赫谱，并改变Bragg带隙的层级结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异，但其核心新意在于：将横向电场对低维周期体系的影响归结为一个可解析处理的“悬链线势”机制，并明确给出该势在倒空间中的绝对收敛权重和（|V_c|/e），从而在单粒子布洛赫理论框架内隔离出横向场重排能谱的简单物理图像。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：倒空间布洛赫约化（Bloch reduction）构造统一哈密顿量；用谐波加权周期赝势表示固有晶格；对横向电场引起的极化响应采用最小能量悬链线分布近似；在单胞层面将最低固有谐波与悬链线项结合，导出含余弦和双曲余弦调制的Mathieu方程，再通过第一布里渊区约化求解场依赖的能带与带隙。

papers.title: Experimental Investigation of Tunable-Order Hilbert-Space Ergodicity
papers.abstract: Hilbert-space ergodicity (HSE) provides a new framework for studying thermalization in driven quantum systems, complementing the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis, which is restricted to static systems. This ergodicity is hierarchical: by quantifying how randomly the dynamics explores the Hilbert space, one obtains a family of levels termed $k$-HSE. While HSE has been observed at the lowest and highest levels, finite-order HSE dynamics remains largely unexplored due to the difficulty of constructing such drives. Here, we explore this intermediate regime and uncover its distinctive physics. We first propose and prove that a family of $m$-tone drives on qubits realizes $k$-HSE up to $k = 2m{-}3$, with drive parameters determined at $O(k)$ cost. Using a single nitrogen-vacancy center in diamond, we verify this design by showing that a 3-tone drive realizes 3-HSE, with fourth-order statistics depending on the initial state. Further in-depth theoretical analysis shows that this initial-state dependence is generic across drives, demonstrating the possibility of recovering the initial state from higher-order statistics even when the dynamics is ergodic. Our work broadens the study of quantum ergodicity and reveals intriguing physics within its hierarchy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 理论证明）。关键词：experimental investigation、propose and prove、theoretical analysis、nitrogen-vacancy center。；研究对象：驱动量子系统中的希尔伯特空间遍历性（Hilbert-space ergodicity, HSE），具体为可调阶数（k-HSE）的遍历动力学，实验体系为金刚石中的单个氮-空位（NV）色心（qubit 体系）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并证明了一族 m 音（m-tone）驱动在 qubit 上可实现最高 k = 2m−3 阶的 k-HSE；实验上以 3 音驱动实现 3-HSE，并发现其四阶统计量依赖初始态，且该初始态依赖性在一般驱动中具有普适性——即使动力学是遍历的，仍可从高阶统计量中恢复初始态信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并证明了一族 m 音（m-tone）驱动在 qubit 上可实现最高 k = 2m−3 阶的 k-HSE；实验上以 3 音驱动实现 3-HSE，并发现其四阶统计量依赖初始态，且该初始态依赖性在一般驱动中具有普适性——即使动力学是遍历的，仍可从高阶统计量中恢复初始态信息。；创新点：首次实验实现并表征了有限阶（非最低/非最高阶）的 k-HSE 动力学，填补了 HSE 层级中间区域的空白；揭示了高阶统计量可保留初始态信息这一与“遍历性”看似矛盾的普适现象。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明（构造 m-tone 驱动族并证明其 k-HSE 阶数，驱动参数以 O(k) 代价确定）；实验上采用单 NV 色心（金刚石）进行相干驱动与量子态层析/统计测量，验证 3-tone 驱动下的 3-HSE 行为及四阶统计量的初始态依赖。

papers.title: A novel strategy for achieving a low-field lightweight permanent MRI magnet system with good magnetic field homogeneity and low eddy current
papers.abstract: In low-field, lightweight, pole-pieceless permanent-magnet MRI systems built with sintered Nd-Fe-B or Sm-Co magnets, the rapid switching of gradient fields readily induces eddy currents in the sintered magnets, leading to image artifacts. To address this, we report for the first time a Sm-Fe-N permanent-magnet MRI system based on anisotropic Sm-Fe-N bonded magnets, whose high electrical resistivity reduces the eddy currents in the X, Y and Z directions to 0.093%, 0.172% and 2.38%, respectively, while a magnetic field inhomogeneity below 150 ppm is achieved at the boundary of a 220 mm diameter of spherical volume (DSV). Compared with sintered Nd-Fe-B and Sm-Co magnets, using Sm-Fe-N bonded magnets as the source of the static magnetic field not only suppresses eddy currents but also makes a closely tiled, densely packed magnetic-circuit layout feasible, providing a more uniform static magnetic field for the MRI system. Imaging results free of obvious geometric distortion and banding artifacts further indicate that the Sm-Fe-N magnet system delivers low eddy currents and high static magnetic field homogeneity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：report、imaging results、measured eddy current reductions（摘要中描述了实际系统构建与成像结果）。；研究对象：基于各向异性Sm-Fe-N粘结磁体的低场、轻量化、无极片永磁MRI（磁共振成像）磁体系统，具体关注其涡流抑制与静磁场均匀性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次报道了Sm-Fe-N永磁MRI系统：其高电阻率使X、Y、Z方向涡流分别降至0.093%、0.172%和2.38%，同时在220 mm球形成像区（DSV）边界实现低于150 ppm的磁场不均匀度，成像无几何畸变和条带伪影。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次报道了Sm-Fe-N永磁MRI系统：其高电阻率使X、Y、Z方向涡流分别降至0.093%、0.172%和2.38%，同时在220 mm球形成像区（DSV）边界实现低于150 ppm的磁场不均匀度，成像无几何畸变和条带伪影。；创新点：首次将Sm-Fe-N粘结磁体（而非烧结Nd-Fe-B或Sm-Co）用作MRI静磁场源，利用其高电阻率从源头抑制涡流，同时其可紧密拼接的特性使磁路布局更致密，从而提升静磁场均匀性。
papers.method_zh: 实验构建了基于各向异性Sm-Fe-N粘结磁体的永磁MRI系统，测量了三个方向的涡流相对值、DSV内磁场不均匀度，并进行了MRI成像验证（评估几何畸变与条带伪影）。

papers.title: Critical Topological Photonics in Synthetic Dimensions
papers.abstract: Topological states and criticality have long been regarded as incompatible ingredients: the former requires a finite spectral gap, whereas the latter demands its closure. Guided by this view, topological photonics has focused almost exclusively on gapped phases, treating gap-closing transitions as mere phase boundaries. In this work, we propose a class of topological states in which topology coexists with criticality in experimentally accessible synthetic-frequency photonic platforms. In a one-dimensional (1D) synthetic lattice, we identify such critical topological photonic states through midgap degeneracies in the single-particle entanglement spectrum, and uncover a topology-enforced multicritical point that reorganizes the topology of neighboring critical states. We further extend this framework to two dimensions (2D). Our work provides an experimentally accessible route to critical topological photonics, and may also inspire novel applications such as critical topological sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we propose”“we identify”“we extend this framework”等表述，未提及实验数据或数值模拟细节，属于理论构建与框架提出。；研究对象：合成频率维度光子平台中的临界拓扑光子态，具体包括一维（1D）合成晶格和二维（2D）扩展体系中的拓扑态与临界性共存现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在合成频率维度光子平台中，拓扑态可以与临界性共存：通过单粒子纠缠谱中的中隙简并识别出临界拓扑光子态，并发现一种由拓扑强制的多临界点，它重组了相邻临界态的拓扑结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在合成频率维度光子平台中，拓扑态可以与临界性共存：通过单粒子纠缠谱中的中隙简并识别出临界拓扑光子态，并发现一种由拓扑强制的多临界点，它重组了相邻临界态的拓扑结构。；创新点：打破了“拓扑态必须具有有限能隙、临界性要求能隙闭合”的传统对立观念，首次在实验可及的合成频率光子平台中提出拓扑与临界性共存的态，并揭示拓扑强制的多临界点这一新现象。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架分析：基于合成频率维度光子平台构建一维合成晶格模型，利用单粒子纠缠谱（single-particle entanglement spectrum）中的中隙简并（midgap degeneracies）来表征拓扑态；随后将该框架推广至二维体系。摘要未提及具体数值方法（如精确对角化、张量网络等）。

papers.title: Coexistence of Magnon-Induced Optical Vortex and Gaussian Beam Scattering Assisted by Rotational Umklapp Process
papers.abstract: The exploitation of crystal-lattice symmetries to engineer angular momentum transfer between structured light and magnons marks a novel frontier for optomagnonic research. In Brillouin light scattering, when focused light propagates parallel to an external magnetic field and interacts with ferromagnetic uniform magnons, only optical-vortex scattering is expected to be permitted. Due to the combined effects of magneto-optical coupling and optical spin-orbit interaction, the transfer of magnon spin angular momentum to photon orbital angular momentum allows for this distinctive scattering phenomenon. Here, we experimentally demonstrate that, for a specific ferromagnetic crystal orientation, Gaussian-beam scattering coexists with the optical-vortex scattering, contrary to conventional expectations based on angular momentum conservation between magnons and photons. We show that the crystal lattice, via the rotational Umklapp process, provides the missing angular momentum required for the Gaussian-beam scattering. Furthermore, we predict that as the degree of light focusing increases, the relative efficiencies of the Gaussian-beam and optical-vortex scattering processes reverse.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimentally demonstrate、Brillouin light scattering）。；研究对象：铁磁晶体中聚焦光与均匀铁磁磁振子（magnon）的布里渊光散射，具体关注散射光中光学涡旋（optical vortex）与高斯光束（Gaussian beam）的共存现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在特定铁磁晶体取向下，高斯光束散射与光学涡旋散射可以共存，这违背了基于磁振子-光子角动量守恒的传统预期；晶体晶格通过旋转Umklapp过程提供了高斯光束散射所缺失的角动量。此外，随着光聚焦程度增加，两种散射过程的相对效率会发生反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在特定铁磁晶体取向下，高斯光束散射与光学涡旋散射可以共存，这违背了基于磁振子-光子角动量守恒的传统预期；晶体晶格通过旋转Umklapp过程提供了高斯光束散射所缺失的角动量。此外，随着光聚焦程度增加，两种散射过程的相对效率会发生反转。；创新点：首次实验证实了旋转Umklapp过程在磁振子-光子散射中提供额外角动量的作用，打破了以往认为该散射仅允许光学涡旋通道的预期，并预言了聚焦程度对两种散射通道相对效率的反转效应。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用布里渊光散射（BLS）技术，聚焦光沿外磁场方向传播并与铁磁均匀磁振子相互作用；结合磁光耦合与光学自旋-轨道相互作用的物理图像进行分析，并基于旋转Umklapp过程解释角动量补偿机制。

papers.title: Width-Independent Compressibility of Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract: It has long been known that well-trained neural networks can be compressed very strongly without affecting their performance, an important phenomenon that remains poorly understood. We prove a uniform compressibility theorem for deep multilayer perceptrons with analytic activations. For a deep, wide fixed teacher network, there exists a narrow (same depth) network that approximately represents the same function as the original. The reachable compressed width is strikingly independent of the original width, but is $O((\log(1/\varepsilon))^{d_{in}})$, where $\varepsilon$ is the error budget and $d_{in}$ is the effective input dimension. Our construction involves a novel derivative-matching technique which is aware of the low-dimensional input, and a layer-wise reweighting that preserves the input-output mapping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“prove”“theorem”“construction”等数学证明与理论构造关键词。；研究对象：深度多层感知机（deep multilayer perceptrons）的压缩性质，属于神经网络理论，而非传统凝聚态物理体系。摘要未涉及具体材料或量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于任意深度、宽度固定的教师网络，存在一个同深度但宽度显著更窄的学生网络，能在给定误差预算内近似表示同一函数；可达到的压缩后宽度与原始宽度无关，仅由误差预算和有效输入维度决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于任意深度、宽度固定的教师网络，存在一个同深度但宽度显著更窄的学生网络，能在给定误差预算内近似表示同一函数；可达到的压缩后宽度与原始宽度无关，仅由误差预算和有效输入维度决定。；创新点：首次给出深度多层感知机在解析激活函数下的均匀可压缩性定理，且压缩后宽度对原始宽度具有独立性（仅依赖输入维度与误差），并引入低维输入感知的导数匹配与逐层重加权构造。摘要未突出说明与已有压缩理论的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明与构造性方法：采用导数匹配技术（derivative-matching technique）以利用输入数据的低维结构，并结合逐层重新加权（layer-wise reweighting）保持输入-输出映射不变。

papers.title: Translation of a spherical viscous drop driven by localized forcing in Stokes flow
papers.abstract: Localized forcing in the fluid inside or outside a viscous drop can drive drop translation. Using the Lorentz reciprocal theorem, we derive an integral expression for the translational velocity of a spherical Newtonian drop subject to localized force and source distributions in either fluid and to interfacial traction. For a clean drop, we obtain explicit responses to Stokeslets, force dipoles, rotlets, general second force moments, and source dipoles as functions of position, orientation, and viscosity ratio. Interior forcing obeys a finite selection rule: only force moments through second order and the first source moment contribute directly to translation. Exterior forcing can couple to multipoles of all orders and produces distance-dependent responses. Although different enclosed singularities can produce the same drop velocity, resolving their exterior flows in drop-centered spherical Stokes modes provides additional constraints on the underlying forcing. We also distinguish regularized force distributions, governed by prescribed kernel moments, from resolved rigid particles, governed by low-order surface-traction moments and prescribed slip. The framework unifies these representations and shows how exterior-flow measurements provide information beyond drop translation, laying the foundation for constructing squirmer-like viscous drop solutions with controllable far-field behaviors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Lorentz reciprocal theorem”（洛伦兹互易定理）进行推导，属于解析理论流体力学研究。；研究对象：粘性液滴（球形牛顿液滴）在Stokes流中的平移运动，具体研究液滴内部或外部局部力（如Stokeslet、力偶极子、rotlet、源偶极子等）驱动下的平移响应，以及液滴与周围流体的界面相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出球形液滴平移速度对局部力分布和界面牵引力的积分表达式；发现内部力仅有限阶（力矩至二阶、源矩至一阶）直接贡献平移，而外部力可耦合所有阶多极子并产生距离依赖的响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出球形液滴平移速度对局部力分布和界面牵引力的积分表达式；发现内部力仅有限阶（力矩至二阶、源矩至一阶）直接贡献平移，而外部力可耦合所有阶多极子并产生距离依赖的响应。；创新点：统一了不同奇异力分布（内部/外部、正则化/刚性粒子）对液滴平移的贡献框架，并指出外部流场测量可提供超越平移速度的额外约束信息，为构造具有可控远场行为的类squirmer粘性液滴解奠定基础。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导，核心工具为Lorentz reciprocal theorem（洛伦兹互易定理），结合Stokes流中的多极展开（Stokeslet、力偶极子、rotlet、二阶力矩、源偶极子等），并采用液滴中心球面Stokes模式分解外部流场。还区分了正则化力分布（由核矩决定）与刚性粒子（由低阶表面牵引矩和滑移决定）。

papers.title: A surviving pink spinel records an early aluminous melt on the ureilite parent body
papers.abstract: Ureilites are ultramafic achondrites interpreted as fragments of a differentiated parent body, yet their origin and evolution remain debated because textural equilibrium coexists with chemically primitive compositions. Here we report mineralogical, isotopic, and microstructural observations from polymict ureilite Elephant Moraine (EET) 87720. The sample contains unusually magnesian olivine (Mg# up to 98.7), Ca-poor pyroxene (Wo as low as 1.0), and rare coarse-grained pink aluminous spinel containing 56.4-58.7 wt% Al2O3 and 11.3-11.8 wt% Cr2O3. In situ triple oxygen isotope measurements of spinel and associated forsteritic olivine plot along the ~1-slope Carbonaceous Chondrite Anhydrous Mineral (CCAM) line, consistent with bulk ureilites. The clasts also follow the ureilitic Fe-loss/addition trend, with near-constant chondritic Mn/Mg ratios. These observations demonstrate that the clasts are indigenous to the ureilite parent body and extend the known ureilite oxygen isotope range to delta18O ~9.7 per mil. Three-dimensional dark-field X-ray microscopy reveals a hierarchical deformation microstructure in the spinel, comprising distributed lattice curvature, localized slip-band-like boundaries, and coherent mosaic-domain boundaries, indicating multiscale accommodation of shock-induced crystal-plastic deformation. We propose that the aluminous spinel crystallized from a locally Al-rich, Ca-poor melt under low oxygen fugacity. Al partitioning between coexisting spinel and olivine yields a crystallization temperature of 1318 +/- 43 K, consistent with a thermally elevated parent body. The spinel may therefore preserve a rare crystallization product of an early aluminous melt that has largely disappeared from the ureilite record, providing an archive of early planetary differentiation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“mineralogical, isotopic, and microstructural observations”“in situ triple oxygen isotope measurements”“three-dimensional dark-field X-ray microscopy”等实验观测手段。；研究对象：顽辉石无球粒陨石（ureilite）母体上的早期铝质熔体及其结晶产物——富铝粉红色尖晶石（含56.4–58.7 wt% Al₂O₃、11.3–11.8 wt% Cr₂O₃），以及与之共生的富镁橄榄石（Mg#高达98.7）和贫钙辉石（Wo低至1.0）。研究对象为陨石样品Elephant Moraine (EET) 87720中的碎屑。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在顽辉石无球粒陨石母体中首次发现粗粒富铝粉红色尖晶石，它记录了一种早期铝质贫钙熔体在低氧逸度条件下的结晶产物，结晶温度约1318 ± 43 K，为早期行星分异过程提供了新的矿物学档案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在顽辉石无球粒陨石母体中首次发现粗粒富铝粉红色尖晶石，它记录了一种早期铝质贫钙熔体在低氧逸度条件下的结晶产物，结晶温度约1318 ± 43 K，为早期行星分异过程提供了新的矿物学档案。；创新点：首次在顽辉石无球粒陨石中识别出粗粒富铝尖晶石，将已知的顽辉石无球粒陨石氧同位素范围扩展到δ¹⁸O约9.7‰；通过三维暗场X射线显微术揭示了尖晶石中多尺度分级变形微结构（晶格曲率、滑移带状边界、镶嵌畴边界），并据此提出该尖晶石保存了在顽辉石无球粒陨石记录中已基本消失的早期铝质熔体的结晶产物。
papers.method_zh: 具体手段包括：矿物学与地球化学分析（主量元素成分测定）、原位三氧同位素测量（in situ triple oxygen isotope measurements，用于判别陨石母体来源）、三维暗场X射线显微成像（3D dark-field X-ray microscopy，用于表征尖晶石的变形微观结构）、以及尖晶石-橄榄石间Al分配热力学温度计（用于计算结晶温度）。

papers.title: Superdiffusivity of random walks on the three-dimensional randomly oriented Manhattan lattice
papers.abstract: We study the superdiffusive behavior of random walks on the randomly oriented Manhattan lattice, i.e., the $d$-dimensional integer lattice $\mathbb{Z}^d$ where each axis-aligned line is independently assigned a random direction (forward or backward) with equal probability. The walker takes nearest-neighbor steps, choosing an axis randomly and moving along the assigned direction of that axis's line, with equal probabilities for each axis. We show that, in the critical dimension $d=3$, the diffusion coefficient of the random walk diverges in the Tauberian sense as $\sqrt{\log t}$ with a multiplicative correction $(\log\log t)^{\pm(2+\varepsilon)}$ as time $t\to\infty$. This gives an answer to a conjecture by Ledger, Tóth and Valkó (2018).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及数学证明（“we show that…”）、渐近行为分析（Tauberian sense）及对已有猜想的回答，属于严格的理论/概率论研究。；研究对象：三维随机取向曼哈顿晶格上的随机游走。该体系为 \(\mathbb{Z}^3\) 整数格点，每条轴平行线独立随机赋予前/后方向，游走者沿随机选择的轴按该轴方向做最近邻跳跃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界维度 \(d=3\) 下，随机游走的扩散系数随时间 \(t\to\infty\) 以 Tauberian 意义发散，主阶为 \(\sqrt{\log t}\)，并带有 \((\log\log t)^{\pm(2+\varepsilon)}\) 的乘性修正，从而证实了 Ledger、Tóth 和 Valkó（2018）的猜想。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界维度 \(d=3\) 下，随机游走的扩散系数随时间 \(t\to\infty\) 以 Tauberian 意义发散，主阶为 \(\sqrt{\log t}\)，并带有 \((\log\log t)^{\pm(2+\varepsilon)}\) 的乘性修正，从而证实了 Ledger、Tóth 和 Valkó（2018）的猜想。；创新点：首次严格证明了三维随机取向曼哈顿晶格上随机游走的超扩散行为，并给出了扩散系数发散的具体对数修正形式，解决了此前悬而未决的猜想。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用概率论与随机游走渐近分析（Tauberian 定理），研究扩散系数的长时间发散行为。摘要未提及数值模拟或具体数学技术细节。

papers.title: Motional Degrees of Freedom in Network Hamiltonian Models
papers.abstract: Network Hamiltonian Models (NHMs) provide an efficient framework for modeling the aggregation of interacting particles (e.g., the condensation of proteins into gel-like, oligomeric, or fibrillar states), representing the system as a network whose edges represent bound interactions. Terms within the network Hamiltonian represent multi-body interactions governing aggregation behavior, and are specified via topological degrees of freedom. Because motional degrees of freedom are not explicitly represented within the NHM, their influence must be indirectly accounted for by introduction of corresponding terms to the Hamiltonian. Here, we describe specifications for terms representing motional degrees of freedom of two, three, and four-body interactions. We also consider the impact of these terms on the aggregation states of a minimal system governed only by a pairwise edge potential, showing that three and four-body interactions favor condensation of the system into small droplet-like structures at low temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了对哈密顿量中运动自由度的“规格说明”（specifications），并“考虑这些项对……的影响”（consider the impact），属于理论建模与数值分析范畴。；研究对象：网络哈密顿模型（NHM）中的多体相互作用，具体针对二体、三体和四体相互作用的运动自由度项，以及这些项对粒子聚集行为（如蛋白质凝聚为凝胶状、寡聚体或纤维状状态）的影响。体系为受成对边势支配的最小聚集系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三体和四体运动自由度项在低温下促使系统凝聚成小液滴状结构，而仅含二体项时无此效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三体和四体运动自由度项在低温下促使系统凝聚成小液滴状结构，而仅含二体项时无此效应。；创新点：首次在网络哈密顿模型中显式给出二体、三体和四体运动自由度项的规格，并揭示了三体和四体项对低温聚集形态（小液滴结构）的关键影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为网络哈密顿模型，将系统表示为边代表结合相互作用的网络，通过拓扑自由度指定多体相互作用项；本文具体给出了二体、三体和四体运动自由度项的规格形式，并对仅含成对边势的最小系统进行了低温聚集态分析（具体数值方法摘要未明确说明）。

papers.title: Neural Network Field Theory at Finite Width
papers.abstract: Under mild assumptions, any quantum mechanical (QM) model or quantum field theory (QFT) admits a representation in terms of an ensemble of neural networks with countably many random parameters. We investigate the features of NN-QM and NN-FT models with finitely many parameters, such as a feedforward network of width $N < \infty$. We find that, generically, such models must violate one of the properties of conventional Euclidean QFTs, such as reflection positivity or cluster decomposition. We present several complementary ways of understanding which features can and cannot be preserved at finite $N$, both in QM and in QFT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论量子力学模型/量子场论的数学表示与性质，属于理论物理研究。；研究对象：有限宽度（N < ∞）的前馈神经网络所对应的量子力学模型（NN-QM）与量子场论模型（NN-FT），即用有限数量随机参数的神经网络系综表示的量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限宽度 N 下，这类模型通常必须违反传统欧几里得量子场论的性质之一，例如反射正性或团簇分解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限宽度 N 下，这类模型通常必须违反传统欧几里得量子场论的性质之一，例如反射正性或团簇分解。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但明确指出该工作系统分析了有限宽度下哪些传统 QFT 性质可以被保留、哪些必然被破坏，并提供了多种互补视角。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于“任何 QM/QFT 在温和假设下可用可数随机参数的神经网络系综表示”这一前提，对有限宽度前馈网络对应的 NN-QM 和 NN-FT 模型进行一般性性质考察，并给出多种互补的理解方式。

papers.title: Scaling vs entanglement in measurement-induced phase transition for non-integrable systems
papers.abstract: We find that the measurement-induced phase transition generated by deterministic global measurements, previously observed in the integrable transverse-field Ising model (TFIM), persists in non-integrable variants of the same. To address this question, we consider the TFIM with longitudinal field and the axial next-nearest-neighbor Ising (ANNNI) model. We show that both the survival probability and the bipartite entanglement entropy consistently capture a transition between area-law and volume-law entangled phases for two distinct initial states: a product state with all spins polarized along the transverse direction and a Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) state. Finite-size scaling reveals a pronounced initial state dependence: for the polarized product state, the transition point follows an inverse-square-root scaling with system size in both non-integrable models, consistent with the integrable TFIM, whereas for the GHZ initial state, it deviates from this scaling and approaches zero considerably more slowly in the non-integrable models than in the integrable TFIM. These results establish the robustness of measurement-induced transitions under deterministic measurements against integrability breaking while highlighting the crucial role of the initial state in governing their scaling behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“有限尺寸标度”（Finite-size scaling）、“模型”（models）等理论分析关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：非可积（non-integrable）量子自旋系统中的测量诱导相变（measurement-induced phase transition），具体体系为带纵场的横场伊辛模型（TFIM with longitudinal field）和轴向次近邻伊辛（ANNNI）模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 确定性全局测量诱导的相变在非可积系统中依然存在，且相变点对初态有显著依赖：极化乘积态的相变点随系统尺寸呈平方根反比标度，而GHZ初态下相变点偏离该标度，在非可积模型中趋近零的速度比可积TFIM慢得多。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：确定性全局测量诱导的相变在非可积系统中依然存在，且相变点对初态有显著依赖：极化乘积态的相变点随系统尺寸呈平方根反比标度，而GHZ初态下相变点偏离该标度，在非可积模型中趋近零的速度比可积TFIM慢得多。；创新点：首次证明确定性全局测量诱导的相变在打破可积性后依然稳健存在，并揭示了初态选择（极化态 vs GHZ态）对相变点标度行为的决定性影响。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值计算研究两个非可积模型（带纵场TFIM和ANNNI模型），计算存活概率（survival probability）和二分纠缠熵（bipartite entanglement entropy），并采用有限尺寸标度分析相变点随系统尺寸的变化。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如DMRG、精确对角化等）。

papers.title: Many-body ergodicity breaking from wavefunction snapshots
papers.abstract: Modern quantum experiments can probe many-body wavefunctions through projective measurements, providing snapshots of individual many-body configurations. A fundamental question is whether the intrinsic structure of their measurement distributions can reveal quantum dynamics beyond predefined observables. Here, we address this question at the many-body ergodicity-breaking transition using two complementary characteristics of nonequilibrium wavefunction snapshots: their binary intrinsic dimension (BID) and the topology of wavefunction networks constructed from Hamming distances. We show that the critical point is characterized by an extensive but submaximal BID, and scale-free network connectivity with highly connected hubs. These signatures distinguish the ergodic, critical, and nonergodic regimes, and provide experimentally accessible probes of ergodicity breaking from projective measurement snapshots.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中未提及实验手段，主要围绕“特征量”“构建网络”“标度”等理论分析与数值计算关键词展开。；研究对象：多体量子系统的遍历性破缺（ergodicity breaking）转变，具体关注由投影测量得到的多体波函数快照（wavefunction snapshots）的统计结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在遍历性破缺临界点，波函数快照的二元本征维数（BID）呈广延但非最大，且由汉明距离构建的波函数网络具有无标度连通性和高度连接的枢纽节点，可区分遍历、临界与非遍历三个区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在遍历性破缺临界点，波函数快照的二元本征维数（BID）呈广延但非最大，且由汉明距离构建的波函数网络具有无标度连通性和高度连接的枢纽节点，可区分遍历、临界与非遍历三个区域。；创新点：提出从投影测量快照的“内在结构”（而非预设观测量）直接诊断多体遍历性破缺，提供了实验上可获取的普适判据。摘要未突出说明与已有诊断方法的详细对比。
papers.method_zh: 利用两种互补特征量：二元本征维数（BID）和基于汉明距离构建的波函数网络拓扑分析（包括网络连通性与枢纽结构）。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如精确对角化、张量网络等）。

papers.title: Anomalous Local Heat Capacity and Bipartite Entanglement
papers.abstract: The heat capacity of a system quantifies how it energetically responds to changes in temperature at equilibrium. Whilst this quantity is positive and even additive for non-interacting systems, self-gravitating systems such as stars or subsystems of strongly interacting quantum systems are known to have negative or anomalous specific heat capacities. In this work, we investigate how the presence of entanglement at equilibrium can influence how an interacting system responds energetically to changes in temperature. We examine the local heat capacity of interacting quantum systems providing an analytical understanding for when anomalies occur. Most interestingly, we find a connection between local heat capacity anomalies and entanglement by deriving a separability bound based on the fluctuations of local and interaction energies. We illustrate our results with two examples (i) a nearest neighbour spin-1/2 chain and (ii) two coupled quantum harmonic oscillators. Lastly, we provide an information-theoretic formula connecting mutual information and athermality to the non-additivity of the heat capacity. Our results provide model-independent thermodynamic entanglement detection bounds and insight into the relationship between quantum correlations and the heat capacity of quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we investigate”、“we derive”、“we provide”等表述，并涉及解析推导（deriving a separability bound）和信息论公式，未提及任何实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：强相互作用量子系统在平衡态下的局域热容（local heat capacity）异常现象，以及该异常与量子纠缠（bipartite entanglement）之间的内在联系。具体模型包括最近邻自旋-1/2链和两个耦合量子谐振子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域热容出现异常（负值或非可加性）与系统在平衡态下的纠缠结构存在直接关联；通过推导基于局域能和相互作用能涨落的可分性界限（separability bound），建立了热容异常与纠缠存在的判定条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域热容出现异常（负值或非可加性）与系统在平衡态下的纠缠结构存在直接关联；通过推导基于局域能和相互作用能涨落的可分性界限（separability bound），建立了热容异常与纠缠存在的判定条件。；创新点：提出了一个模型无关（model-independent）的热力学纠缠探测界限，即仅通过测量局域热容异常即可判定系统是否存在纠缠，无需依赖具体的哈密顿量细节。此外，首次将互信息与热容非可加性通过信息论公式直接关联，为理解量子关联与热力学响应之间的关系提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析推导。具体包括：分析相互作用量子系统局域热容的解析表达式，推导基于能量涨落的可分性判据，并引入信息论公式将互信息（mutual information）和“非热性”（athermality）与热容的非可加性联系起来。通过两个具体模型（自旋-1/2链和耦合谐振子）进行例证说明。

papers.title: Earth as a Closed Life-Support System: Finite Buffers, Dynamical Thresholds, and Planetary Sustainability
papers.abstract: Earth is nearly closed with respect to matter but open with respect to energy. We formulate planetary sustainability as a minimal nonequilibrium dynamical problem for coupled finite stocks and fluxes, using the operational language of closed ecological and engineered life-support systems: inventories, flux balances, recycling efficiencies, processing capacities, reserve times, and failure thresholds. The framework is organized around two finite buffers: resource stocks that can be depleted and waste-processing capacities that can be saturated. The physiological contrast between fasting and renal failure motivates a reserve-time principle: the dominant constraint is the buffer that becomes critical first. The resulting nonlinear model couples a regenerative resource stock, an accumulated waste stock, and an aggregate activity variable. It exhibits a soft waste threshold, at which accumulated waste suppresses growth while processing remains capable, and a hard threshold, at which waste production exceeds maximal processing capacity. We extend the model to recycling and multiple resource and waste classes, give an explicit toy numerical example, and relate the approach to Spaceship Earth, planetary boundaries, Limits to Growth, and stock-pollution growth models. A multiscale analogy---cell, organism, planet---emphasizes that life-support functions are distributed across degradation, recycling, transport, regulation, and removal. The central claim is conditional: carrying capacity is an emergent, time-dependent property of coupled resource, waste, recycling, technological, and institutional dynamics; either resource depletion or elimination failure may become the binding constraint, depending on their characteristic reserve times.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要使用“formulate”“model”“framework”等关键词，属于理论建模与概念分析，非实验或计算研究。；研究对象：地球作为一个近封闭的生命支持系统，具体研究资源存量（可耗竭）与废物处理容量（可饱和）两个有限缓冲器，以及二者与活动变量之间的非线性耦合动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 地球承载力是资源、废物、回收、技术和制度耦合动力学的涌现性、时间依赖性属性；资源耗竭或废物消除失效何者成为约束取决于各自的特征储备时间，主导约束由先达到临界值的缓冲器决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：地球承载力是资源、废物、回收、技术和制度耦合动力学的涌现性、时间依赖性属性；资源耗竭或废物消除失效何者成为约束取决于各自的特征储备时间，主导约束由先达到临界值的缓冲器决定。；创新点：将“禁食 vs 肾衰竭”的生理学对比引入行星可持续性分析，提出储备时间原则（先临界者为主导约束），并区分软废物阈值（废物抑制增长但处理仍可行）与硬阈值（废物产生超过最大处理能力），将生命支持功能按降解、回收、运输、调节、清除进行跨尺度（细胞—生物体—行星）类比。摘要未突出说明与既有行星边界、增长极限模型相比的具体定量改进。
papers.method_zh: 采用最小非平衡动力学框架，借用封闭生态与工程生命支持系统的操作语言（库存、通量平衡、回收效率、处理能力、储备时间、失效阈值），建立耦合再生资源存量、累积废物存量与活动变量的非线性模型，并扩展到回收及多资源/多废物类别，给出玩具数值示例。

papers.title: Collective photon echoes in the Tavis-Cummings model: distribution independence, two detuning regimes, and the Dicke ladder
papers.abstract: An ensemble of $N$ two-level molecules prepared in its ground state and sharing a lossless cavity with a weak field does not simply absorb: the intensity collapses and then recurs, in a train of collective photon echoes. Working from the exact solution of the Tavis-Cummings model in the few-photon regime $\bar n<N$, we confirm the echo time $τ_E=4π\sqrt{N+Δ}/g$ numerically at resonance from $N=5$ to $400$, the small-$N$ end discriminating this form from the alternative $4π\sqrt{N-\bar n+Δ}/g$ in its favor. The initial state requires no preparation, being the ground state. The echo time is independent of the initial photon distribution: coherent, thermal, squeezed and oscillatory-squeezed distributions spanning variances from 2 to 34 all recur together, as does a controlled pair with identical mean and variance differing only in the shape of $ρ_{nn}$. The echo amplitude is not: it varies at the tens-of-percent level at fixed mean, including a factor of 1.8 with the squeezing phase at fixed squeezing strength. Detuning organizes the dynamics into two clean regimes separated by a fragmented crossover, the dispersive-branch echo time approaching one-half the resonant one, and sufficient detuning removes the dependence on the initial Dicke state. For arbitrary initial Dicke state, emission replaces absorption at $m\simeq-N/2+\bar n$, and the echo envelope acquires one component per step up the ladder: a single-component echo occurs only at the ground state.
